Question: Which course change is refused by the controller?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：区调，CES 16，由于天气原因，我们需要左偏30度。
管制员：CES 16，由于有冲突飞机，无法批准。你们能接受右偏20度吗？
飞行员：可以，我们能接受右偏20度，航向090度，CES 16。
问题：管制员拒绝了哪项航向改变请求？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. 30 degrees left

cards.audioText:
C: QFA 501, hold short of runway16, give way to landing traffic, contact tower on 124.95.
Question: Why does Tower ask QFA 501 to hold short?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：QFA 501，在16号跑道外等待，避让着陆飞机，在124.95联系塔台。
问题：塔台为什么要求QFA 501在跑道外等待？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Landing traffic on R/W 16

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 7421, RVR Runway 27 touchdown 200m, midpoint 300m, stop end 1000m.
Question: What type of problem will the landing aircraft have?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：BAW 7421，27号跑道跑道视程：接地区200米，中间段300米，停止端1,000米。
问题：着陆飞机会遇到哪类问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Poor visibility

cards.audioText:
C: NWA 14 heavy, moderate turbulence reported ahead above FL 380. Would you like a lower altitude? P: roger, is FL360 available, NWA 14 heavy.
Question: Where is the reported turbulence?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：NWA 14，重型，前方FL380以上报告有中度颠簸。你们需要较低高度吗？
飞行员：收到，FL360可用吗？NWA 14，重型。
问题：报告的颠簸位于哪里？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Ahead and above FL 380.

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 215, FL310 is not available at the moment. The alternative is FL350, advise.
Question: Which statement is true?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：AFR 215，目前FL310不可用，可选择FL350，请告知。
问题：哪项说法正确？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. FL350 is now available.
choices: FL310 and FL350 are not available.

cards.audioText:
C: NWA 152, Turn left heading 050, traffic will be at your 1 o'clock when she completes the turn.
Question: When will the traffic be at 1 o'clock?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：NWA 152，左转航向050度。完成转弯后，冲突飞机会出现在你一点钟方向。
问题：冲突飞机什么时候会出现在一点钟方向？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. After completing the turn.

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 889, expect lower altitude until the climbing aircraft has passed, confirm you are leveling at 11,500m.
Question: What altitude does the controller think UAL 889 is at right now?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：UAL 889，在那架爬升飞机通过前，预计保持较低高度。确认你正在11,500米改平。
问题：管制员认为UAL 889目前处于什么高度？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Maintaining 11,500 m.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 173, climb straight ahead until passing 900m before turning right, cleared for takeoff, wind 340 degrees.
Question: What does the controller ask the pilot to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 173，保持直线爬升，通过900米后再右转。允许起飞，风向340度。
问题：管制员要求飞行员做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To turn right after 900m.

cards.audioText:
P: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, AFR 214, we have fire in the rear toilet, descending to FL40, request emergency landing, position 45 miles northwest of ..., heading 150. C: AFR 214, roger MAYDAY. Break, break, all stations, stop transmitting, MAYDAY.
Question: What is the current situation of the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，AFR 214，后部洗手间起火，正在下降至FL40，请求紧急着陆。位置在……西北45海里，航向150度。
管制员：AFR 214，收到MAYDAY。各台注意，停止发射，保持无线电静默，MAYDAY。
问题：飞机当前处于什么情况？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Distress

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 101, due to traffic congestion, make a 360 turn left at your present position.
Question: What is the aircraft expected to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 101，由于空中交通拥堵，在当前位置左转盘旋一周。
问题：预计飞机要做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. To lose time

cards.audioText:
P: Melbourne Tower, QFA 344, hold at holding point of Runway 29, ready for departure. C: QFA 344, hold at holding point for a few minutes, the runway is still blocked by a Cessna.
Question: Why does the controller ask the pilot to hold?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：墨尔本塔台，QFA 344，在29号跑道等待点等待，已准备好离场。
管制员：QFA 344，在等待点再等几分钟，跑道仍被一架塞斯纳飞机占用。
问题：管制员为什么要求飞行员等待？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Because an aircraft blocked the runway
choices: Because there is an airplane on final
Because an aircraft blocked the runway
Because there is a tug on the runway
Because the vehicle blocked the runway
choicesZh: 因为有一架飞机在五边
因为一架航空器占用了跑道
因为跑道上有一辆牵引车
因为一辆车辆占用了跑道

cards.audioText:
P: Control, CCA 980, confirm holding instruction. C: CCA 980, hold at N VOR/DME 120 radial, inbound track 220, right hand turn.
Question: What is the inbound track?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：区调，CCA 980，请证实等待指令。
管制员：CCA 980，在N VOR/DME的120度径向线上等待，向台航迹220度，右转。
问题：向台航迹是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 220

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 321, caution, unknown balloon over right turning base of Runway 36 at time 32, altitude 300m, moving northbound 40km per hour.
Question: Why should UAL 321 keep a good lookout?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：UAL 321，注意，32分时在36号跑道右转四边上空发现不明气球，高度300米，正以每小时40公里向北移动。
问题：UAL 321为什么要加强观察？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. There is a balloon near the runway.
choices: There is a balloon near the runway.
He is 40 KM per hour too fast.
He is turning base for R/W36.
choicesZh: 他的速度快了每小时40千米

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 133, SIA Ground, take the first left, then contact Ground 121.6.
Question: What radio frequency is ground control on?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：AFR 133，新加坡地面，在第一个道口左转，然后在121.6联系地面管制。
问题：地面管制使用什么无线电频率？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. 121.6

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 230, expedite descent to 6000m, upon reaching, turn left 30 degrees, traffic 12 o'clock 10 miles, opposite direction, United B747 climbing to your altitude.
Question: What is the relative motion of the traffic?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CSN 230，加速下降至6,000米，到达后左转30度。冲突飞机位于十二点钟方向10海里，相向飞行，是一架正爬升至你高度的联合航空波音747。
问题：冲突飞机的相对运动方向是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Opposite direction, below and climbing.

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 146, cleared to taxi to Runway 10 via V1 and V2, be advised low visibility procedures are in force, RVR Runway 10 is 250m, mid point 220, stop end 200m.
Question: What is mid-point RVR?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：SIA 146，允许经V1和V2滑行至10号跑道。注意，低能见度程序正在实施；10号跑道跑道视程为250米，中间段220米，停止端200米。
问题：中间段跑道视程是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. 220 metres

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 981, Wuhan Tower, radar shows you are 200 feet above glide slope. P: Tower, CCA 981, roger, we've just lost glide slope indication on the instrument, we are going around as published.
Question: What type of approach was CCA 981 flying before the missed approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 981，武汉塔台，雷达显示你们高于下滑道200英尺。
飞行员：塔台，CCA 981，收到。我们的仪表刚刚失去下滑道指示，正在按公布程序复飞。
问题：CCA 981复飞前实施的是什么进近？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. ILS

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 243, descend and maintain FL240. P: Control, can we have that at pilot's discretion?
Question: What was the pilot's intention under this situation?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：UAL 243，下降至FL240并保持。
飞行员：区调，可以由机组自行决定何时开始下降吗？
问题：在这种情况下，飞行员的意图是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. To decide when to descend by himself.
choices: To continue descent by ATC instruction.
To decide how to fly by himself.
To decide when to descend by himself.

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 302, turn right heading 040, descend to 900 meters, QFE 1002.
Question: Which of the following is true?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CSN 302，右转航向040，下降至900米，场压（QFE）1002。
问题：下列哪一项是正确的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Descend to 900 m.

cards.audioText:
P: Delivery, CCA 334. Confirm after departure, heading south. C: Negative, for your information, a glider is over south field.
Question: Why did the controller deny the pilot's confirmation?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：放行，CCA 334，请确认离场后向南飞行。
管制员：不对。提醒你，机场南侧上空有一架滑翔机。
问题：管制员为什么否定飞行员的确认？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Flying activity is in the southfield.
choices: The controller wants the pilot to fly east.
Flying activity is in the southfield.
A glider will land in the southfield.
A glider is hanging in the northfield.
choicesZh: 管制员希望飞行员向东飞
一架滑翔机将在南侧机场着陆
一架滑翔机悬停在北侧机场

cards.audioText:
P: Departure, AFR 486, reaching 3000ft. C: AFR 486, climb to 9000ft, expedite climb until passing 5000ft, report 7000ft.
Question: In which section of altitude should AFR 486 speed up the climb?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：离场，AFR 486，正到达3,000英尺。
管制员：AFR 486，爬升至9,000英尺，在通过5,000英尺前加速爬升，7,000英尺时报告。
问题：AFR 486应在哪一段高度加速爬升？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. 3000 to 5000 feet.

cards.audioText:
P: UAL 655, we have serious fuel leak, we are returning. C: UAL 655, descend to 3300m. P: Leaving 5400m for 3300m, UAL 655. C: UAL 655, do you require emergency services on landing? P: Affirm, UAL 655.
Question: What is the problem with the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：UAL 655，我们发生严重燃油泄漏，正在返航。
管制员：UAL 655，下降至3,300米。
飞行员：离开5,400米下降至3,300米，UAL 655。
管制员：UAL 655，着陆时需要应急服务吗？
飞行员：需要，UAL 655。
问题：飞机出了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Fuel leak

cards.audioText:
P: UAL 350, we can't hold any longer, we have a seriously ill passenger on board. C: UAL 350, leave the holding pattern, fly heading 050. P: Heading 050, UAL 350. Request first aid upon landing. C: Roger, UAL 350.
Question: What will be the immediate need after landing?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：UAL 350，我们无法继续等待，机上有一名病情严重的乘客。
管制员：UAL 350，离开等待，航向050度。
飞行员：航向050度，UAL 350。请求着陆后立即提供急救。
管制员：收到，UAL 350。
问题：着陆后最迫切需要什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Medical service

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Approach, AFR 132, 25km south of Wuhan, northbound, 2100m. C: AFR 132, say your intentions.
Question: What does the controller mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉进近，AFR 132，位于武汉以南25公里，向北飞行，高度2,100米。
管制员：AFR 132，请告知你的意图。
问题：管制员是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To know what the pilot wants to do next.
choices: To know what the pilot wants to do next.
To ask the pilot his rating.
To verify the pilot's original airport.
choicesZh: 了解飞行员下一步意图
核实飞行员的起飞机场

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 480, flames coming out from your No. 3 engine on takeoff, please advise. P: Roger, declaring an emergency, request immediate return, BAW 480.
Question: Why are they declaring an emergency?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：BAW 480，你们起飞时3号发动机有火焰冒出，请告知意图。
飞行员：收到，宣布紧急情况，请求立即返场，BAW 480。
问题：他们为什么宣布紧急情况？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. engine fire

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, AFR 121, stand Z4, information F, ready for pushback and startup. C: AFR 121, the tug AB assigned to push you back has malfunctioned. I am working on sending another tug. Stand by. P: Wilco, AFR 121.
Question: Why does the controller ask AFR 121 to wait?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：地面，AFR 121，Z4机位，通播F，已准备好推出开车。
管制员：AFR 121，执行推出的蓝色拖车发生故障，我正在派另一辆拖车，稍等。
飞行员：照办，AFR 121。
问题：管制员为什么要求AFR 121等待？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Tug has broken down
choices: There is a vehicle behind the aircraft

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 726, expedite descent to and maintain 3000ft on QNH1012, join right downwind Runway 21L.
Question: Which level should the aircraft descend to and maintain?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：BAW 726，按QNH1012加速下降至3,000英尺并保持，加入21L跑道右三边。
问题：飞机应下降至并保持什么高度？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. 3,000 feet on QNH1012

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 503, taxi with caution, the previous pilot reported there were iced ruts and ridges on the taxiway.
Question: What does the controller ask the pilot to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：ACA 503，小心滑行，前机飞行员报告滑行道上有结冰的车辙和冰脊。
问题：管制员要求飞行员做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. To taxi on the taxiway carefully.
choices: To report the condition of the previous traffic.
To move the ice from the runway.
To taxi on the taxiway carefully.
choicesZh: 报告前一架航空器的状况

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 204, taxi to holding point of Runway 27 via taxiway F, J and G. P: F, J, G to holding point Runway 27, BAW 204.
Question: What is the taxi route?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：BAW 204，经F、J和G滑行道滑行至27号跑道等待点。
飞行员：经F、J、G滑行道前往27号跑道等待点，BAW 204。
问题：滑行路线是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. F, J and G

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 765, reply not received, if you read, turn left heading 040, I say again, turn left heading 040.
Question: What problem might Air France have?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：AFR 765，未收到回答。如果你能听到，左转航向040度。再说一遍，左转航向040度。
问题：法航飞机可能遇到了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Transmitter failure

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 505, after departure, contact departure on 119.7, cleared for takeoff Runway 25L, wind calm.
Question: Which runway is the runway in use?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：BAW 505，离场后在119.7联系离场管制，允许从25L跑道起飞，静风。
问题：当前使用哪条跑道？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Runway 25L

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 785, left on F, right on E, hold short of E4.
Question: What are they going to do at E4?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 785，在F滑行道左转，在E滑行道右转，在E4外等待。
问题：他们到达E4时要做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. stop and wait

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 985, the weather is deteriorating, RVR Runway 13 is now only 600m.
Question: What do you learn from the statement?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 985，天气正在恶化，13号跑道的跑道视程现在只有600米。
问题：从这段通话中可以得知什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Visibility is reducing.

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, CCA 101, can we take the second right? C: CCA 101, negative, backtrack and exit the runway on the first left turnoff, there are workmen on the second right.
Question: Why did CCA 101 have to backtrack?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：塔台，CCA 101，我们可以从第二个右侧道口脱离吗？
管制员：CCA 101，不可以。调头滑行，从第一个左侧脱离道离开跑道，第二个右侧道口有施工人员。
问题：CCA 101为什么必须调头滑行？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Workmen on the right second
choices: The pilot on the first left
A vehicle on the second right.
choicesZh: 飞行员在左侧第一个路口
施工人员在左侧第一个路口
一辆车在右侧第二个路口
施工人员在右侧第二个路口

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 655, hold short of T5, give way to Airbus taxiing in for parking.
Question: What does the controller ask the pilot to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：UAL 655，在T5外等待，避让那架正滑入停机位的空客飞机。
问题：管制员要求飞行员做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To hold at a holding point.
choices: To hold at a holding point.

cards.audioText:
C: NWA 482, descend to FL290 now for crossing traffic, be level at FL290 in two minutes or less. P: Roger, descend to FL290 in two minutes or less for crossing traffic, leaving FL330 now, NWA 482.
Question: When should they begin their descent?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：NWA 482，为避让穿越冲突飞机，立即下降至FL290，并在两分钟以内于FL290改平。
飞行员：收到，为避让穿越飞机，两分钟以内下降至FL290，现在离开FL330，NWA 482。
问题：他们应该什么时候开始下降？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Immediately

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, request go around the CB from the right. C: CCA 101, negative due to prohibited area. Turn left 40 degrees, track out 30km, report clear of CB.
Question: Why was CCA 101 not allowed to turn to the left?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉区调，请求从右侧绕飞积雨云。
管制员：CCA 101，由于有禁区，不能批准。左转40度，向外飞30公里，脱离积雨云后报告。
问题：为什么不允许CCA 101左转？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Forbidden area

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 7634, overhead BEKOL, maintaining 1500m, entering the hold.
Question: What action is CCA 7634 about to commence?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 7634，飞越BEKOL，保持1,500米，正在进入等待。
问题：CCA 7634即将开始什么动作？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Fly a holding pattern
choices: Hold at the runway holding point

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 889, when clear of crossing traffic, turn left heading 050, confirm your level 1500.
Question: When should they make the turn?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：UAL 889，脱离穿越冲突飞机后，左转航向050度。确认你的高度为1,500。
问题：他们应该什么时候转弯？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. when clear of crossing traffic

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 705, climb at pilot's discretion to 8000m, maintain heading 150 until advised. P: Leaving 6000m for 8000m, will advise, CCA 705.
Question: What is their present altitude?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 705，可自行决定爬升时机，爬升至8,000米；保持航向150度，直至另行通知。
飞行员：离开6,000米爬升至8,000米，将报告，CCA 705。
问题：他们当前的高度是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. 6000 m
choicesZh: 由飞行员自行决定爬升

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 982, 22km from touchdown, turn right heading 330, cleared for ILS Runway 36L, report established.
Question: Which of the following information is not true?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 982，距接地点22公里，右转航向330度，允许对36L跑道实施ILS进近，建立后报告。
问题：下列哪项信息不正确？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Cleared for IGS Runway 36L.

cards.audioText:
M1: Captain, the panel shows the aft cargo door was open. M2: Roger, check the cabin. M1: The cabin pressure is normal. M2: It might be a false indication. It happened last time. Report that to ATC.
Question: What had happened?
cards.audioTextZh:
男1：机长，面板显示后货舱门开着。
男2：收到，检查客舱。
男1：客舱压力正常。
男2：可能是虚假指示，上次也发生过。把情况报告给空中交通管制。
问题：发生了什么情况？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. There was a possible false indication.
choices: There was a possible false indication.
The aft cargo door was open.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 981, windshear warning, strong low-level windshear observed in the vicinity of Beijing Airport at 1400 hours, what's your intention? P: We'd like to delay our approach 30 minutes, CCA 981.
Question: Why do they want to delay their approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 981，风切变警告。14:00在北京机场附近观测到强烈低空风切变，请告知意图。
飞行员：我们希望将进近推迟30分钟，CCA 981。
问题：他们为什么希望推迟进近？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Because of wind condition.

cards.audioText:
C: Remain in your present position, there is a towed aircraft passing behind.
Question: What is the meaning of the controller's instruction?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：保持在当前位置，后方有一架正在被拖行的飞机通过。
问题：管制员的指令是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Hold position

cards.audioText:
P: MD-11 on final in sight, BAW 315. C: BAW 315, line up after the landing MD-11.
Question: What is BAW 315 going to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：已经看到最后进近的MD-11，BAW 315。
管制员：BAW 315，在那架MD-11着陆后进入跑道对正。
问题：BAW 315将要做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. To line up after MD-11.

cards.audioText:
P: Tianjin Tower, CCA 996, we have found some rubber on the runway. Have you heard any reports from aircraft that have departed from this runway recently? C: CCA 996, negative. You are the first reporter. Where exactly have you found the debris?
Question: What did the pilot report?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：天津塔台，CCA 996，我们发现跑道上有一些橡胶碎片。最近是否有从该跑道离场的航空器报告过情况？管制员：CCA 996，没有，你们是第一个报告者。你们具体在哪里发现这些碎片？
问题：飞行员报告了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Rubber on the runway

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 130, taxi straight ahead, A320 coming from the right will give way to you at the intersection.
Question: Which aircraft will give way to ACA 130?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：ACA 130，直线滑行，从右侧驶来的空客A320将在交叉口给你让路。
问题：哪架飞机会给ACA 130让路？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. A320 on the right.

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 223, RVR Runway 36L touchdown 600m, midpoint 850m, stop end missing. P: UAL 223.
Question: What is the best RVR?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：UAL 223，36L跑道跑道视程：接地区600米，中间段850米，停止端数据缺失。
飞行员：UAL 223。
问题：最好的跑道视程数值是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. midpoint

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 151, severe turbulence was reported at FL290 over DAH. P: Roger, request alter the route because we have some problem with our yaw damper.
Question: What does the pilot want to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 151，DAH上空FL290报告有严重颠簸。
飞行员：收到。由于我们的偏航阻尼器出现问题，请求改变航路。
问题：飞行员想做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To use alternate route

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 785, behind departing AFR 74, cross Runway 14L behind, turn right on C, hold short of Runway 14R.
Question: What are they going to do when they reach Runway 14L?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 785，在离场的AFR 74之后穿越14L跑道，在C滑行道右转，在14R跑道外等待。
问题：他们到达14L跑道时要做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Cross the RW behind AFR 74.
choicesZh: 右转并在14L跑道上反向滑行

cards.audioText:
C: SAS 996, for identification, turn left heading 270, then turn right 360. P: Roger, left 270, then right 360, SAS 996.
Question: What is going on?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：SAS 996，为进行雷达识别，左转航向270度，然后右转航向360度。
飞行员：收到，左转270度，然后右转360度，SAS 996。
问题：正在进行什么操作？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The controller is trying to find the aircraft on radar
choices: The controller is trying to find the aircraft on radar
The controller is trying to find the planes squawk.
choicesZh: 管制员正在雷达上搜寻该航空器
管制员正在查找该飞机的应答机编码

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 101, backtrack on Runway 11R, then take the first convenient left to vacate the runway.
Question: On which runway should the aircraft backtrack?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 101，在11R跑道上调头滑行，然后从第一个方便的左侧道口脱离跑道。
问题：飞机应该在哪条跑道上调头滑行？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Runway 11R

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 505, your slot time is 1250, correction 1205, start up at own discretion.
Question: When is the aircraft expected to depart?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：BAW 505，你们的时隙时间是12:50；更正，12:05。可自行决定启动发动机。
问题：预计飞机什么时候离场？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. 12:05

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 141, avoid taxiing over the broken surface. It's likely to cause bumps.
Question: What does the speaker mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：BAW 141，避免从破损道面上滑过，那里可能会造成颠簸。
问题：说话人是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. The surface is damaged

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 480, smoke coming out from your left main gear during takeoff, please advise your intention. P: roger, stand by, will advise, BAW 480.
Question: What information did the controller give to BAW 480?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：BAW 480，你们起飞时左主起落架有烟冒出，请告知意图。
飞行员：收到，稍等，随后告知，BAW 480。
问题：管制员向BAW 480提供了什么信息？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Smoke from the main gear.

cards.audioText:
P: Beijing Tower, CSN 311, ILS approach Runway 36L. C: CSN 311, continue approach, maintain 170 knots until 7 DME. P: continue approach, speed 170 knots until 7 DME, CSN 311.
Question: What was the controller's instruction?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：北京塔台，CSN 311，ILS进近36L跑道。
管制员：CSN 311，继续进近，在距离台7海里前保持170节。
飞行员：继续进近，在距离台7海里前保持170节，CSN 311。
问题：管制员发布了什么指令？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Maintain 170 knots until 7 DME.

cards.audioText:
P: 2507 request touch and go. C: 2507, negative due traffic congestion. Make a full stop. Clear to land Runway 36L.
Question: what is the pilot's intention?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）2507请求低空通场并连续起飞。
管制员（C）:2507，不行，因为交通拥堵。做全停着陆。可以在36左跑道着陆。
问题：飞行员的意图是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To takeoff right after landing.

cards.audioText:
C: EAL 668, ready to depart the fix for landing, expect a normal landing. C: EAL 668, turn left heading 350 for a right base, Runway 18L. P: Left heading 350, EAL 668.
Question: what might EAL 668 be doing when this conversation is going on?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员（C）：EAL 668，准备离开定位点降落，预计正常降落。
管制员（C）：EAL 668，左转航向350度进入右起落航线，跑道18左。
飞行员（P）：左转航向350度，EAL 668。
问题：在这段对话进行时，EAL 668可能在做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Making a procedure turn.

cards.audioText:
C: KLM 567, you are still gaining on the traffic ahead. Reduce speed to 140 KTS. P: We can't reduce to that, 567. C: Roger, in that case, I am breaking off this approach. Turn right heading 340 for delaying action.
Question: what will the pilot do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员（C）：KLM 567，你正逐渐靠近前方的飞机。将速度降至140节。
飞行员（P）：567，我们无法降至那个速度。
管制员（C）：收到，既然这样，中断进近。右转，航向340度，进行延误操作。
问题：飞行员将会怎么做？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To wait for a while before approach.
choices: To wait for a while before approach.
To catch up the traffic ahead.

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 331, if you can read, turn left heading 310. C: Break break, CCA 103. We have lost contact with the converging traffic. Turn right heading 360 for separation. P: Right heading 360, CCA 103.
Question: Why did the controller instruct CCA 103 to change heading?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CSN 331，如你能收到，左转航向310。
管制员：CCA 103。我们与冲突的航空器失去联系。右转航向360以保持间隔。
飞行员：右转航向360，CCA 103。
问题：为什么管制员指示CCA 103改变航向？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. For traffic avoidance.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan approach, NWA 108, over DA Airport in sight, request visual approach, Runway 36L. C: NWA 108, negative due emergency traffic on the ground, continue ILS approach, report outer marker.
Question: Why use the ILS approach ?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：西北108，正接近武汉进近，可见德尔塔阿尔法机场，请求目视进近，36左跑道。
管制员（C）：西北108，由于地面有紧急交通，目视进近不可行，继续仪表着陆系统（ILS）进近，外指点标报。
问题：为什么进行仪表着陆？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Emergency traffic is on the ground.
choices: Emergency traffic is on the ground.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan approach, AFR 188, over Rune Factories, Information E. Good morning. C: AFR 188, Wuhan approach, radar contact. Glide path Runway 36R is inoperative. Expect ILS approach Runway 36L for landing.
Question: what is a reason for using Runway 36L?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：武汉进近，AFR 188，飞越符文工厂（Rune Factories），已收到E情报。早上好。
管制员（C）：AFR 188，武汉进近，雷达已识别。36右跑道下滑道故障。预计使用36左跑道仪表着陆系统（ILS）进近着陆。
问题：使用36左跑道的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Runway 36R glide path is out of order.
choices: Runway 36L glide path is out of service.
Runway 36L is closed due to snow removal.
Runway 36R glide path is out of order.
Runway 36R is covered with pathes of snow.

cards.audioText:
P: ASA 304, ML in 2 minutes. C: ASA 304, proceed to GC and hold at FL150 due to traffic congestion. P: Standard pattern GC, FL150, ASA 304.
Question: Why is the pilot required to hold?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：ASA 304，预计2分钟到达ML。管制员：ASA 304，由于交通拥堵，前往GC并在FL150等待。飞行员：按标准等待航线飞往GC，FL150，ASA 304。
问题：为什么要求飞行员等待？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Crowded flight path.

cards.audioText:
P: NWA 546, please brighten up the approach lights. They look dim. C: NWA 546, they are already on maximum setting. Cleared to land. P: Cleared to land, five four six.
Question: what is the weather probably like?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：NWA 546，麻烦把进近灯调亮些。看起来很暗。
管制员（C）：NWA 546，进近灯已经设置到最亮了。可以着陆。
飞行员（P）：NWA 546，明白，可以着陆。
问题：天气可能是什么样的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Dark.

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 302, for your information, taxi via C; centerline lighting is unserviceable. P: Roger, 302.
Question: What do you learn from the exchange between the pilot and the controller?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CSN 302，提醒你，经C滑行道滑行；滑行道中线灯不工作。飞行员：收到，302。
问题：从飞行员与管制员的通话中可以了解到什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The taxiway centerline lighting is not available.
choices: There is a danger of lightening.
The information broadcast is not serviceable.
The taxiway centerline lighting is not available.
The taxiway centerline lighting are out.

cards.audioText:
P: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan approach, CES 141, we have no fuel on board, due long time holding, request priority landing. C: CES 141, Roger that, radar vector for ILS approach Runway 18L.
Question: Why did the crew declare urgency?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN（紧急情况但非遇险），武汉进近，CES 141，因长时间等待，机上燃油已耗尽，请求优先着陆。
管制员（C）：CES 141，收到，雷达引导至18左跑道仪表着陆系统（ILS）进近。
问题：机组为何宣布紧急情况？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Due fuel shortage.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan approach, JAL 121, we have to come back. Right engine ingested a bird during climbing. We have already shut down the affected engine. C: JAL 121, turn right heading 030, descend to and maintain 1800 meters on QNH.
Question: what's the crew's intention?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：武汉进近，JAL 121，我们需返航。右发动机在爬升过程中吸入鸟类，已关闭受影响发动机。
管制员（C）：JAL 121，右转航向030，按QNH（场面气压）下降并保持1800米。
问题：机组信息的意图是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To return to land.

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 214, ILS approach is not available due to antenna problem. Cleared VOR approach Runway 36L, no delay expected. P: Roger, VOR approach Runway 36L, AFR 214.
Question: what makes ILS approach unserviceable?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员（C）：AFR 214，因天线故障，仪表着陆系统（ILS）进近不可用。允许使用甚高频全向信标（VOR）进近36左跑道，预计无延误。
飞行员（P）：收到，AFR 214使用VOR进近36左跑道。
问题：什么原因导致ILS进近无法使用？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Antenna problem.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan approach, KLM 256. We have difficulty in maintaining straight course. Our plane tends to drift to the left. We are coming back. C: KLM 256, join downwind Runway 18L, you are number one.
Question: what happened to KLM 256?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：武汉进近，KLM 256。我们难以保持直线航向，飞机有向左偏航的趋势，我们正在返航。
管制员（C）：KLM 256，加入18左跑道下风边，你第一。
问题：KLM 256发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. KLM 256  has a control problem.

cards.audioText:
C: JAL 728, can you make a slot time of 52 minutes? P: Negative, we now have a catering delay. Put me back fifteen past the hour, JAL 728. C: Roger, 728, let me know when you are ready.
Question: why does the pilot want to delay?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员（C）：JAL 728，你能在52分离场吗？
飞行员（P）：不行，我们现在因餐饮服务（准备）延误了。请把我们安排到整点过15分钟，JAL 728。
管制员（C）：收到，728，你准备好时告知我。
问题：为什么飞行员想要延误？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Due to food loading

cards.audioText:
P: Guangzhou tower, CSN 304, flaps and slats are jammed, we can't extend beyond 15, request divert to Zhuhai airport which has a longer runway. C: CSN 304, cleared to Zhuhai, I'll inform Zhuhai you have a Configuration problem.
Question: what is the problem of CSN 304?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：广州塔台，CSN 304，襟翼和缝翼卡住了，我们无法将其展开超过15，请求改航至跑道更长的珠海机场。
管制员（C）：CSN 304，准许改航至珠海，我会告知珠海你们存在构型问题。
问题：CSN 304遇到了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Improper configuration problem

cards.audioText:
P: Shanghai Approach, EAL 456, request priority landing. We got a passenger on board who feels difficulty in breathing. C: EAL 456, down to 3000 feet, straight in approach Runway 18R, first to land.
Question: what might be the problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：上海进近，EAL 456，请求优先着陆。我们机上有一名乘客呼吸困难。
管制员（C）：EAL 456，下降至3000英尺，直线进近18右跑道，优先着陆。
问题：可能出了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. There is a patient with severe asthma.
choices: There is a patient with severe diarrhea.
There is a patient with severe asthma.
There is a patient with severe flu.
There is a patient with severe stomachache.
choicesZh: 一名患者患有严重腹泻
一名患者患有严重哮喘

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan approach, DAL 335, we are returning due to burst tire during gear retraction. Request priority landing. C: DAL 335, Roger, radar vector for ILS approach Runway 18L, you are number one.
Question: What's the problem of DAL 335?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：武汉进近，DAL 335，因收轮时轮胎爆裂需返航，请求优先着陆。
管制员（C）：D335，收到，雷达引导至18左跑道仪表着陆系统（ILS）进近，你第一。
问题：DAL 335的问题是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Tyre blownout.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan approach, TWA 368. We have to come back. We nearly stalled during the climb out. Cargo shifted in the front hold. C: TWA 368, Roger, turn left heading 270.
Question: Why did TWA 368 return?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：武汉进近，TWA 368，我们需返航。爬升时险些失速，前货舱货物发生移位。
管制员（C）：TWA 368，收到，左转航向270。
问题：TWA 368为何返航？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Loading problem.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan delivery, AFR 123, ready to copy ATC clearance. C: AFR 123, standby. We have not received your flight plan yet. Let me check and call you later.
Question: What problem does AFR 123 have?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：武汉放行，AFR 123，准备接收空管放行指令。
管制员（C）：AFR 123，请稍候。我们尚未收到你的飞行计划，我核查后稍后联系你。
问题：AFR 123遇到什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Flight plan not received by Delivery.
choices: Flight plan not received by Delivery.
choicesZh: 放行管制未收到飞行计划

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan ground, AFR 321, radio check on 121 decimal 3. How do you read? C: Station calling ground, say again your call sign. Your transmission is jammed. Check your transmitter.
Question: What are the pilot and controller doing?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：武汉地面，AFR 321，在121.3（频率）进行无线电检查。你听到的效果如何？
管制员（C）：呼叫地面的电台，重复你的呼号。你的信号受干扰。检查你的发射机。
问题：飞行员和管制员分别在做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Radio check.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, AFR 213. Passenger boarding is taking a longer time than before. It has not been completed yet. Please delay our departure time until 0850. C: AFR 213, Roger. Call back when you're ready.
Question: What happened to AFR 213?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：地面，AFR 213。旅客登机时间比以往更长，尚未完成。请将我们的起飞时间推迟至08:50。
管制员（C）：AFR 213，收到。准备好后回电。
问题：AFR 213发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. They have a slow boarding.
choices: They need an early slot time.

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 321, your company dispatcher advised us that there was an error in your load sheet. Please call the dispatcher. P: Roger, thanks. AFR 321.
Question: What does the pilot need to call the dispatcher?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员（C）：AFR 321，你公司签派员告知我们，你的载重表存在错误，请联系签派员。
飞行员（P）：收到，谢谢。AFR 321。
问题：飞行员为何需要联系签派员？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Because of the loading sheet error.
choices: Because of the loading sheet error.

cards.audioText:
P: Delivery, AFR 131, five minutes before start, request ATC clearance. C: AFR 131, standby. There's an error in your flight plan, the reporting office says you haven't filed the alternate.
Question: Why is the aircraft asked to stand by?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：放行，AFR 131，预计5分钟后启动发动机，请求空中交通管制许可。
管制员（C）：AFR 131，稍等。你的飞行计划存在错误，报告部门称你未提交备降场信息。
问题：飞机为何被要求等待？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Because they did not file the alternate.
choices: Because it is 5 minutes before start.
Because they did not file the alternate.
Because they did not submit the flight plan.
choicesZh: 因为放行管制尚未准备好
因为他们没有申报备降场
因为他们没有提交飞行计划

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, NWA 146, we can't start up due flat batteries. Would you check with ground services for us, and see if we can use a GPU? C: NWA 146, stand by, I will inform them.
Question: what does the crew want?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：地勤，NWA 146，由于电池电量不足，我们无法启动（飞机）。你能帮我们联系一下地勤服务人员，看看我们能否使用地面电源设备（GPU）吗？
管制员（C）：NWA 146，稍等，我会通知他们。
问题：机组人员想要什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To start up with ground power.
choices: Ground stuff to check their batteries.
To start up with ground power.

cards.audioText:
P: Control, SWA 3343, oil pressure dangerously low on the number two engine. Can we proceed Portland direct? C: Affirm, proceed to Tacoma direct at flight level one three zero.
Question: what happened?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：管制员，SWA 3343号航班，2号发动机油压低至危险水平。我们能直飞波特兰吗？
管制员（C）：可以，以飞行高度层130直飞塔科马。
问题：发生了什么事？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. low oil pressure.

cards.audioText:
P: Pacific 28, fuel leak on the left wing, coming back. Request clearance to Dosson direct. C: Cleared to Dosson, FL150.
Question: what is the problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：太平洋航空28号航班，左翼燃油泄漏，准备返航。请求直飞Dosson。
管制员（C）：准许直飞多森，飞行高度层150。
问题：出现了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Fuel leakage.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan approach, ACA 196. We are returning due to burst tire during gear retraction. Request priority landing. C: ACA 196, Roger, radar vectors, expect ILS approach Runway 32, you are number one.
Question: What is the problem of ACA 196?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉进近，这里是ACA 196。由于收轮时轮胎爆裂，我们正在返航。请求优先着陆。
管制员：ACA 196，收到。雷达引导，预计使用32号跑道仪表着陆系统进近，你是第一顺位。
问题：ACA 196遇到了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Tyres blew out.

cards.audioText:
C: DLH 117, unknown traffic, 3:00, 15 kilometers, westbound, Airbus 320, 7800 meters, descending. P: Looking out, DLH 117.
Question: where is the traffic?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员（C）：汉莎117，不明航空器，方位3点钟方向，距离15公里，向西飞行，空客320，高度7800米，正在下降。
飞行员（P）：观察中，汉莎117。
问题：目标机在哪里？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. 3 o'clock, 15 kilometers, 7800m.

cards.audioText:
C: CES 5581, Beijing ground, continue stand by for push back. A special fly is taxiing in. P: Roger, standing by, CES 5581.
Question: Why was CES 5581 delayed for push back?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员（C）：CES 5581，北京地面，继续等待推出。有一架专机正在滑行。
飞行员（P）：收到，等待中，CES 5581。
问题：为什么CES 5581航班在推出时被延误了？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. A special aircraft was taxiing in.
choices: A special aircraft was taxiing in.
It wasn’t the slot time yet.
choicesZh: 一架特殊航空器正在滑入

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan ground, CCA 151, gate 10, request push back and start up. C: CCA 151, standby. Your slot time is not determined due to flow control. Call you back.
Question: why did the Controller refuse CCA 151's request？
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：武汉地面，CCA 151，10号登机口，请求推出和启动发动机。
管制员（C）：CCA 151，稍等。因流量控制，你的离场时间尚未确定。等会儿通知你。
问题：管制员为何拒绝CCA 151的请求？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Slot time not determined.

cards.audioText:
P: ACA 760, request holding procedure. C: ACA 760, hold over Enshi NDB 4200 meters, inbound track 250, left hand pattern, outbound time one minute.
Question: What is the out bound track of the holding pattern?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：ACA 760，请求等待程序。
管制员（C）：ACA 760，在恩施导航台上空等待，高度4200米，向台航迹250，左等待航线，出航时间1分钟。
问题：等待航线的出航航迹是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 070.

cards.audioText:
In order to reduce RTF communication, a pilot will make a position report only on first transfer of communication from another area control center, on reaching the limit of the ATC clearance, and when instructed by ATC.
Question: When will a pilot make a position report?
cards.audioTextZh:
为了减少无线电通话（RTF）通信，飞行员仅在从另一个区域管制中心首次转接通信时、达到空中交通管制许可的限制时以及在收到空中交通管制的指示时，才会进行位置报告。
问题：飞行员在什么时候会进行位置报告？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. All above.
choices: Reaching the limit of ATC clearance.

cards.audioText:
P: Shanghai Control, SIA 235, Boeing 777, hold over ZMK VOR, outbound leg, turn inbound. C: SIA 235, Shanghai Control, continue hold ZMK, delay not determined.
Question: When will SIA 235 make approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：上海管制，SIA 235，机型波音777，在ZMK VOR等待，出航航段，转向进近航段。
管制员（C）：SIA 235，上海管制，继续ZMK等待，延误时间未确定。
问题：SIA 235什么时候进近？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Delay not determined.

cards.audioText:
P: Hong Kong Tower, AFR 985, long final. C: AFR 985, Hong Kong Tower, number 2, wind calm. P: Number 2, AFR 985.
Question: what is the landing sequence for AFR 985?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：香港塔台，AFR 985，长五边。
管制员（C）：AFR 985，香港塔台，（你是）第二个（降落），静风。
飞行员（P）：明白是第二个（降落），AFR 985。
问题：AFR 985的降落顺序是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Number two to land.

cards.audioText:
P: Guangzhou, CSN 304, flaps and slats are jammed. We can't extend beyond one five. Request divert to Zhuhai airport, which has a longer runway. C: CSN 304, clear to Zhuhai. I'll inform Zhuhai you have a configuration problem.
Question: what does the crew intend to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：广州，CSN 304，襟翼和缝翼卡阻，无法放出超过15度。请求备降珠海机场，因其跑道更长。
管制员（C）：CSN 304，允许备降珠海。我将通知珠海你存在构型问题。
问题：机组打算做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To divert to Zhuhai.
choices: To make a high speed approach.

cards.audioText:
P: Beijing Tower, CSN 302, no contact at minima (=poor visibility), going around.
C: CSN 302, standard procedure.
Question: What is the reason for going around?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 北京塔台，CSN 302，在最低标准处无法建立目视接触，复飞。
C: CSN 302，按标准程序执行。
问题：复飞的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. A. Poor visibility.

cards.audioText:
C: CES 5195, go around, follow the localizer, climb to and maintain 2100 meters, the preceding aircraft aborted takeoff.
P: Going around, CES 5195.
Question: Why was CES 5195 instructed to go around?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CES 5195，复飞，沿航向道飞行，爬升并保持2100 meters，前机中断起飞。
P: 正在复飞，CES 5195。
问题：为什么指示CES 5195复飞？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The preceding aircraft rejected takeoff.
choices: The preceding aircraft was unable to vacate the runway.
The aircraft was too close to the preceding aircraft.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, Eva 761, request start engine at the gate due APU malfunction.
C: Eva 761, start engine at the gate approved, report ready for pushback.
Question: Why did the pilot request start engine at the gate?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 地面，EVA 761，由于APU故障，请求在停机位启动发动机。
C: EVA 761，批准在停机位启动发动机，准备推出时报告。
问题：飞行员为什么请求在停机位启动发动机？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Due to APU failure.
choicesZh: 由于地面电源装置失效
由于控制显示组件失效

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 428, expedite climb, terrain ahead, terrain alert, expedite passing 5000 feet, expedite.
P: expediting, CCA 428.
Question: Why was CCA 428 asked to expedite climb?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 428，加速爬升，前方有地形，地形警告，加速通过5000 feet，加速。
P: 正在加速爬升，CCA 428。
问题：为什么要求CCA 428加速爬升？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Due to terrain alert.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, Qatar 274, we are fully ready for pushback and startup.
C: Qatar 274, roger, stand by, indefinite delay, emergency in progress.
Question: Why was Qatar 274 instructed to stand by?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 地面，QTR 274，我们已完全准备好推出和启动。
C: QTR 274，收到，等待，延误时间未定，正在处置紧急情况。
问题：为什么指示QTR 274等待？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Due emergency in progress.
choicesZh: 由于正在处置紧急情况
由于后方有航空器滑行

cards.audioText:
P: KLM 73 Echo, we have some unruly passengers on board, so we would like to return to the gate, request the police at the gate.
C: KLM 73 Echo, roger.
Question: Why did KLM 73 Echo request to return to the gate?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: KLM 73E，机上有一些扰乱秩序的乘客，因此我们希望返回登机口，请求警察在登机口等候。
C: KLM 73E，收到。
问题：KLM 73E为什么请求返回登机口？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. There were some unruly passengers on board.
choices: There were some unruly passengers on board.
There was a seriously ill passenger on board.
There was a seriously injured passenger on board.
There was an illegal stowaway on board.
choicesZh: 机上有不守规矩的乘客
机上有一名病情严重的乘客
机上有一名受重伤的乘客
机上有一名非法偷渡者

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Approach, CES 5325, what's the delay like?
C: CES 5325, delay not determined due variable visibility, suggest divert to Changsha Airport.
Question: Why did the controller suggest CES 5325 diverting to Changsha?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 武汉进近，CES 5325，延误情况如何？
C: CES 5325，由于能见度变化，延误时间无法确定，建议改航长沙机场。
问题：管制员为什么建议CES 5325改航长沙？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Because delay was not determined due variable visibility.
choices: Because delay was not determined due variable visibility.
Because delay was not determined due runway obstruction.
Because delay was not determined due runway closure.
Because delay was not determined due variable wind.
choicesZh: 由于能见度多变，延误时间未定
由于跑道受阻，延误时间未定
由于跑道关闭，延误时间未定
由于风向多变，延误时间未定

cards.audioText:
C: DAL 303, reduce speed to 140 knots due separation.
P: negative, our minimum approach speed is 150 knots, DAL 303.
Question: Why was DAL 303 unable to accept 140 knots?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: DAL 303，由于间隔需要，减速至140 knots。
P: 无法执行，我们的最低进近速度是150 knots，DAL 303。
问题：DAL 303为什么无法接受140 knots？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Due aircraft performance.

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, this is BAW 233, we are ready for departure on Runway 29L.
C: BAW 233, your transmission is cut in and out. Check your mike button and call back.
Question: What was the problem in the transmission?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 塔台，BAW 233，我们已准备好从Runway 29L离场。
C: BAW 233，你的通话时断时续。检查话筒按钮后重新呼叫。
问题：通话出现了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Intermittent

cards.audioText:
P: Departure, AFR 456, we are coming back due to cracked windscreen caused by bird strike during departure.
C: AFR 456, roger, join right downwind.
Question: Why did AFR return?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 离场，AFR 456，我们正在返航，因为离场期间鸟击造成风挡破裂。
C: AFR 456，收到，加入右三边。
问题：AFR为什么返航？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Windscreen cracked.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 1141, vacate runway via taxiway A4, caution, much trench on right side, correction, much trench on the left side of A4.
Question: What does the controller mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 1141，经滑行道A4脱离跑道，注意，A4右侧有沟槽，更正，沟槽在A4左侧。
问题：管制员是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. A trench is on the left side of taxiway.
choices: A trench is on the left side of taxiway.
Work in progress next to the apron.
The center of the taxiway A4 is damaged.
The left of the taxiway A4 is damaged.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 981, take first left, then T5, P to Gate 212.
P: T5, P to Gate 212, CCA 981.
Question: When did this conversation take place?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 981，第一个路口左转，然后经T5、P滑行至Gate 212。
P: 经T5、P滑行至Gate 212，CCA 981。
问题：这段通话发生在什么时候？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. During taxi in.

cards.audioText:
C: QFA 501, hold short of Runway 16, give way to landing traffic, contact tower on 124.95.
Question: Why does Tower ask QFA 501 to hold short?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: QFA 501，在Runway 16外等待，给着陆航空器让行，在124.95联系塔台。
问题：塔台为什么要求QFA 501在跑道外等待？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Landing traffic on Runway 16

cards.audioText:
C: NWA 40 heavy, moderate turbulence reported ahead above FL 380. Would you like a lower altitude?
P: roger, is FL360 available, NWA 40 heavy.
Question: Where is the reported turbulence?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: NWA 40 heavy，前方FL 380以上报告有中度湍流。你是否需要较低高度？
P: 收到，FL360可用吗？NWA 40 heavy。
问题：报告的湍流位于哪里？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Ahead and above FL 380.

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 889, expect lower altitude until the climbing aircraft has passed, confirm you are levelling at 11,500m.
Question: What altitude does the controller think UAL 889 is at right now?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: UAL 889，在爬升航空器通过前预计使用较低高度，确认你正在11,500m改平。
问题：管制员认为UAL 889目前位于什么高度？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Maintaining 11,500 m.

cards.audioText:
P: Moscow Approach, CSN 235, overhead GCF, 4500ft on QNH, request joining instructions.
Question: What stage of flight is CSN 235 about to carry out next?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 莫斯科进近，CSN 235，飞越GCF，QNH高度4500ft，请求加入指令。
问题：CSN 235接下来准备进入哪个飞行阶段？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Approach

cards.audioText:
P: Control, CCA 980, confirm holding instruction.
C: CCA 980, hold at N VOR/DME 120 radial, inbound track 220, right hand turn.
Question: What is the inbound track?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 管制，CCA 980，确认等待指令。
C: CCA 980，在N VOR/DME的120径向线上等待，向台航迹220，右转。
问题：向台航迹是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 220

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 321, caution, unknown balloon over right turning base of Runway 36at 32, altitude 300m moving northbound 40km per hour.
Question: Why should UAL 321 keep a good look out?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: UAL 321，注意，Runway 36右转基准边上空有不明气球，时间32，高度300m，以40km per hour向北移动。
问题：UAL 321为什么应保持仔细观察？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. There is a balloon near the runway.
choices: There is a balloon near the runway.
He is 40 KM per hour too fast.
He is turning base for R/W36.
choicesZh: 他的速度快了每小时40千米

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 230, expedite descent 6000m, upon reaching, turn left 30 degrees, traffic 12 o'clock 10 miles, opposite direction, United B737 climbing to your altitude.
Question: What is the relative motion of the traffic?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CSN 230，加速下降至6000m，到达后左转30度；冲突航空器位于12点钟方向、距离10 miles，相向飞行，是一架正在爬升至你方高度的UAL B737。
问题：冲突航空器的相对运动是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Opposite direction, below and climbing.

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 243, descend and maintain FL240.
P: Control, can we have that at pilot's discretion.
Question: What was the pilot's intention under this situation?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: UAL 243，下降并保持FL240。
P: 管制，我们可以由飞行员自行决定何时下降吗？
问题：在这种情况下，飞行员的意图是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. To decide when to descend by himself.
choices: To continue descent by ATC instruction.
To decide how to fly by himself.
To decide when to descend by himself.

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 302, turn right heading 040, descend to 900m QFE 1002.
Question: Which of the following is true?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CSN 302，右转航向040，下降至900m，QFE 1002。
问题：以下哪一项正确？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Descend to 900 m.

cards.audioText:
P: Delivery, CCA 334. Confirm after departure, heading south.
C: Negative, for your information, a glider is over south field.
Question: Why did the controller deny the pilot's confirmation?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 放行，CCA 334，确认离场后向南飞。
C: 不对，提醒你，南部机场上空有一架滑翔机。
问题：管制员为什么否定飞行员的确认？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Flying activity is in the south field.
choices: The controller wants the pilot to fly east.
Flying activity is in the south field.
A glider will land in the south field.
A glider is hanging in the north field.
choicesZh: 管制员希望飞行员向东飞
一架滑翔机将在南侧机场着陆
一架滑翔机悬停在北侧机场

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Approach, AFR 132, 25km south of wuhan, northbound, 2100m.
C: AFR 132, say your intentions.
Question: What does the controller mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 武汉进近，AFR 132，位于武汉以南25km，向北飞行，高度2100m。
C: AFR 132，报告你的意图。
问题：管制员是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To know what the pilot wants to do next.
choices: To know what the pilot wants to do next.
To ask the pilot his rating.
To verify the pilot's original airport.
choicesZh: 了解飞行员下一步意图
核实飞行员的起飞机场

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 480, flames coming out from your No. 3 engine on takeoff, please advise.
P: roger, declaring an emergency, request immediate return, BAW 480.
Question: Why are they declaring an emergency?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: BAW 480，起飞时你的No. 3发动机有火焰冒出，请报告意图。
P: 收到，宣布紧急状态，请求立即返航，BAW 480。
问题：他们为什么宣布紧急状态？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Engine fire.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, CSN 15, on Taxiway N for Runway 27L, we see debris on the left side of runway near the high speed turn off. It appears to be a part of engine cowling.
Question: Where is the debris?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 地面，CSN 15，我们正在滑行道N上前往Runway 27L。我们看到跑道左侧靠近快速脱离道处有碎片，看起来像是发动机整流罩的一部分。
问题：碎片在哪里？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. On the left side of the runway.
choices: On the high speed turn off.
On the right side of the runway.
On the left side of the runway.

cards.audioText:
P: Guangzhou Departure, CSN 5469, airborne 600m, climbing to 3000m, request heading 290 due weather.
Question: What stage of the flight does the transmission refer to?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 广州离场，CSN 5469，离地600m，正在爬升至3000m，由于天气原因请求航向290。
问题：这段通话指的是哪个飞行阶段？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. After takeoff.

cards.audioText:
P: Approach, good morning, CCA 512, descending FL200, Squawking 4123.
Question: What is the squawk code of CCA 512?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 进近，早上好，CCA 512，正在下降通过FL200，应答机代码4123。
问题：CCA 512的应答机代码是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. 4123

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 503, taxi with caution, the previous pilot reported there was iced ruts and ridges on taxiway.
Question: What does the controller ask the pilot to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 503，谨慎滑行，前机飞行员报告滑行道上有冰辙和冰脊。
问题：管制员要求飞行员做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. To taxi on the taxiway carefully.
choices: To report the condition of the previous traffic.
To move the ice from the runway.
To taxi on the taxiway carefully.
choicesZh: 报告前一架航空器的状况

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 204, taxi to holding point of Runway 27via taxiway F, J and G.
P: F, J, G to holding point Runway 27, BAW 204.
Question: What are the taxi route?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: BAW 204，经滑行道F、J和G滑行至Runway 27等待点。
P: 经F、J、G滑行至Runway 27等待点，BAW 204。
问题：滑行路线是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. F, J and G

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 985, the weather is deteriorating, RVR Runway 13is now only 600m.
Question: What do you learn from the statement?
A. The runway direction changed.
B. RVR increased. RVR
C. The runway is only 600m long.
D. Visibility is reducing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 985，天气正在恶化，Runway 13的RVR目前仅为600m。
问题：从这段陈述中可以得知什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Visibility is reducing.

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 655, hold short of T5, give way to Airbus taxiing in for parking.
Question: What does the controller ask the pilot to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: UAL 655，在T5外等待，给正在滑向停机位的Airbus让行。
问题：管制员要求飞行员做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To hold at a holding point.
choices: To hold at a holding point.

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 889, when clear of crossing traffic, turn left heading 150, confirm your level 1500.
Question: When should they make the turn?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: UAL 889，避开穿越航空器后，左转航向150，确认你的高度为1500。
问题：他们应在什么时候转弯？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. When clear of crossing traffic

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 705, climb at pilot's discretion to 8000m, maintain heading 150 until advised.
P: leaving 6000m for 8000m, will advise, CCA 705.
Question: What is their present altitude?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 705，由飞行员自行决定爬升至8000m，保持航向150直至另行通知。
P: 离开6000m爬升至8000m，将报告，CCA 705。
问题：他们目前的高度是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. 6000m
choicesZh: 由飞行员自行决定爬升

cards.audioText:
P: MD-11 on final in sight, BAW 315.
C: BAW 315, line up after the landing MD-11.
Question: What is BAW 315 going to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 已看到最后进近中的MD-11，BAW 315。
C: BAW 315，在着陆的MD-11之后进入跑道。
问题：BAW 315准备做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. To line up after MD-11.

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 223, RVR Runway 26L touchdown 600m, mid point 850m, stop end missing.
P: UAL 223.
Question: What is the best RVR?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: UAL 223，Runway 26L的RVR：接地区600m，中间段850m，停止端数据缺失。
P: UAL 223。
问题：哪一段的RVR最好？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Midpoint

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 785, behind departing AFR 74, cross Runway 14L behind, turn right on C, hold short of Runway 14R.
Question: What are they going to do when they reach RW14L?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 785，在离场的AFR 74之后穿越Runway 14L，在C右转，并在Runway 14R外等待。
问题：到达Runway 14L时，他们准备做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Cross the RW behind AFR 74.
choicesZh: 右转并在14L跑道上反向滑行

cards.audioText:
Pilot: "Shanghai Tower, CES 567, radio check on 123.45."
Controller: "CES 567, Shanghai Tower, read you 3, your signal is weak. Check your transmitter."
Question: What is the controller's response to the pilot's radio check?
cards.audioTextZh:
Pilot: “上海塔台，CES 567，在123.45进行无线电检查。”
Controller: “CES 567，上海塔台，信号强度3，信号较弱。检查你的发射机。”
问题：管制员如何回复飞行员的无线电检查？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The signal is weak
choices: The pilot's call sign is incorrect.

cards.audioText:
P: Guanghan Tower, B9725, radio check on 118.9, how do you read?
C: B9725, Guanghan Tower, I read you 1, check your transmitter.
Question: How is the radio signal of B9725?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 广汉塔台，B9725，在118.9进行无线电检查，听我的信号如何？
C: B9725，广汉塔台，信号强度1，检查你的发射机。
问题：B9725的无线电信号如何？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Unreadable.

cards.audioText:
P: Chengdu Tower, Sichuan 8885, radio check on 119.25, how do you read?
C: Sichuan 8885, Chengdu Tower, I read you 5.
Question: What's the readability of Sichuan 8885?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 成都塔台，Sichuan 8885，在119.25进行无线电检查，听我的信号如何？
C: Sichuan 8885，成都塔台，信号强度5。
问题：Sichuan 8885的可读性如何？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Perfectly readable.

cards.audioText:
P: Beijing Ground, CCA 4014, radio check on 118.6, how do you read?
C: CCA 4014, Beijing Ground, I read you 3, loud background whistle.
Question: What's the radio signal of CCA 4104 like?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 北京地面，CCA 4014，在118.6进行无线电检查，听我的信号如何？
C: CCA 4014，北京地面，信号强度3，有很响的背景哨声。
问题：CCA 4104的无线电信号如何？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Readable but with difficulty.

cards.audioText:
P: Xiamen Approach, Xiamen 8205, radio check on 118.45, how do you read?
C: Xiamen 8205, Xiamen Approach, I read you 2, you are cut in and out.
Question: What's the readability of Xiamen 8205?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 厦门进近，Xiamen 8205，在118.45进行无线电检查，听我的信号如何？
C: Xiamen 8205，厦门进近，信号强度2，你的信号时断时续。
问题：Xiamen 8205的可读性如何？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Readable now and then.

cards.audioText:
CCA 101, hold short of Runway 36, traffic on short final, report have it in sight.
Question: When should the pilot make a report?
cards.audioTextZh:

cards.audioTextZh: 增加爬升率

cards.audioText: Unable expedite climb due weight.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于重量，不能快速爬升

cards.audioText: Climb to 6000 feet, follow KODAP 01 Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 爬升到6000英尺，按KODAP-01号离场

cards.audioText: Passing altitude 2300 feet, climbing to FL80.
cards.audioTextZh: 过高度2300英尺，爬升到高度层80

cards.audioText: Climb to FL210, level restrictions of KODAP 01 Departure canceled.
cards.audioTextZh: 爬升到高度层210，取消KODAP-01号离场高度限制

cards.audioText: Climb to FL 210, cross AU at FL100 or below.
cards.audioTextZh: 爬升到高度层210，飞越AU时不高于高度层100

cards.audioText: Climb to FL290, level at time 55.
cards.audioTextZh: 爬升到高度层290，55分改平

cards.audioText: Unable FL390 by boundary, request FL330.
cards.audioTextZh: 移交点之前不能到达高度层 390，请求高度层 330

cards.audioText: Descend to FL100, cross YU FL150 or above.
cards.audioTextZh: 下降到高度层100，穿越YU时不低于高度层150

cards.audioText: After passing North Cross, descend to FL150.
cards.audioTextZh: 过North Cross后，下降到高度层150

cards.audioText: We are far above profile. Request holding.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们远高于（飞行）剖面，请求等待

cards.audioText: Stop descent at 5000 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 5000英尺停止下降

cards.audioText: Expedite descent until passing FL80.
cards.audioTextZh: 加速下降通过高度层80

cards.audioText: Expect descent after AK.
cards.audioTextZh: 预计过AK后下降

cards.audioText: Continue approach Runway 36R, maintain visual separation with preceding traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: 继续近进36右跑道，与前机保持目视间隔。

cards.audioText: Contact Control 80 miles after BK.
cards.audioTextZh: 过BK 80 海里处联系区调

cards.audioText: Request change to London Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求切换到伦敦管制频率

cards.audioText: Monitor Tower 118.1.
cards.audioTextZh: 守听塔台频率118.1

cards.audioText: Remain this frequency.
cards.audioTextZh: 本频率长守

cards.audioText: We can see the approach lights at 200 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 200英尺，我们能看到近进灯

cards.audioText: Cleared VOR approach Runway 36, followed by circling to Runway 18.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以VOR近进36号跑道，随后盘旋至18号跑道。

cards.audioText: Expect commencing approach at time 50.
cards.audioTextZh: 预计开始近进时间50分

cards.audioText: Unable circling approach due company policy. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于公司政策，不能盘旋近进，请求备降

cards.audioText: Request RNAV approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求RNAV近进

cards.audioText: RNAV approach not available due FMS database. Request VOR approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于FMS 数据库原因，RNAV 不可用，请求VOR近进

cards.audioText: Cleared for LDA approach Runway 24.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以LDA近进跑道24

cards.audioText: Unable RNAV due equipment, request conventional arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 设备原因，无法RNAV近进，请求传统方式近进

cards.audioText: Unable RNAV, loss of RAIM, request NDB approach
cards.audioTextZh: RAIM丢失，无法RNAV近进，请求NDB近进

cards.audioText: GPS primary lost, going around.
cards.audioTextZh: 失去GPS主要功能，复飞了

cards.audioText: RAIM alert, going around.
cards.audioTextZh: RAIM警告，复飞了

cards.audioText: Negative RNAV.
cards.audioTextZh: 不能RNAV近进

cards.audioText: Proceed to AK, hold as published, expect approach clearance at 30.
cards.audioTextZh: 直飞AK，按公布程序等待，预计近进许可30分

cards.audioText: Request hold for weather improvement, visibility below company minima.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求等待天气好转，能见度低于公司最低要求

cards.audioText: Holding northwest of W VOR FL120, what is the delay for approach?
cards.audioTextZh: W VOR台西北等待，高度层120，请问近进延误情况

cards.audioText: Request to extend the holding pattern for accomplishing the checklist.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求延长等待，完成检查单

cards.audioText: Request extended holding to burn fuel to reduce the weight.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求延长等待耗油，减轻（飞机）重量

cards.audioText: Cleared for CAT II ILS approach Runway 24.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以执行24号跑道II类ILS近进。

cards.audioText: Join right hand downwind, visual approach Runway 24.
cards.audioTextZh: 加入右三边，目视近进24号跑道。

cards.audioText: Continue approach, prepare for possible go around.
cards.audioTextZh: 继续近进，准备可能复飞。

cards.audioText: Disregard. We made the wrong transmission.
cards.audioTextZh: 指令作废，我们报错了

cards.audioText: Roger, request continue approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 明白，请求继续近进

cards.audioText: Stand by. We are carrying out procedures.
cards.audioTextZh: 稍等，我们正在执行程序

cards.audioText: Wilco, words twice.
cards.audioTextZh: 照办，发送两遍

cards.audioText: Maintaining FL350, expect descent after BKM VOR.
cards.audioTextZh: 保持高度层350，预计过BKM VOR台后下降

cards.audioText: Continue climb to FL 290, cross BKM VOR not above FL 230.
cards.audioTextZh: 继续爬升到高度层290，飞越BKM VOR台，不高于高度层230。（3-4

cards.audioText: Negative, unable cross BKM VOR at or above FL230 due performance.
cards.audioTextZh: 不行，由于性能，不能在高度层230或以上，穿越BKM VOR台. （3-4

cards.audioText: Maintaining FL310 until advised.
cards.audioTextZh: 保持高度层310，等待进一步通知。

cards.audioText: Descend to FL170, cross BKM VOR at or above FL210.
cards.audioTextZh: 下降到高度层170，穿越BKM VOR台时，（高度）在高度层210或以上

cards.audioText: Affirm, cross BKM VOR at or above FL190
cards.audioTextZh: 可以，穿越BKM VOR台时（高度）高于高度层190

cards.audioText: Negative, unable to cross BKM VOR below FL170.
cards.audioTextZh: 不行，不能在低于高度层170时穿越BKM VOR台

cards.audioText: Affirm, cross BKM VOR at or before 55
cards.audioTextZh: 可以，在55分或之前，穿越BKM VOR台

cards.audioText: Negative, unable to cross BKM VOR at 43 or later.
cards.audioTextZh: 不行，不能在43分或之后，穿越BKM VOR台

cards.audioText: Request lose time en route due landing delay at destination airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于目的地机场着陆有延误，请求航路上消耗时间

cards.audioText: Request lose time en route to finish the checklist.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求航路消耗时间以完成检查单

cards.audioText: Request parallel offset from current track due weather ahead.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于前方天气，请求平行偏置当前航迹

cards.audioText: Request parallel offset from current airway for 30 minutes due icing condition.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于结冰，请求从当前航路平行偏置 30 分钟

cards.audioText: Proceed offset 10 miles right of track until abeam BKM VOR.
cards.audioTextZh: 在BKM VOR正侧方前，沿航迹右偏10海里飞行。

cards.audioText: Cleared offset 25 miles left of track for 30 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: 允许向航迹左侧偏置25海里，持续30分钟。

cards.audioText: Offset canceled, turn right to rejoin the A1 before BKM VOR.
cards.audioTextZh: 偏置取消，BKM VOR台前右转，重新加入航路A1

cards.audioText: Clear of weather, request to resume flight route.
cards.audioTextZh: 已脱离天气，请求回到飞行航路

cards.audioText: Estimating crossing LV NDB 1123.
cards.audioTextZh: 预计1123分飞越LV NDB台

cards.audioText: BKM 47, FL170 descending to FL120, abeam NLD VOR at 55.
cards.audioTextZh: BKM 47分，高度层170，下降到高度层120，55分正切NLD VOR台

cards.audioText: Report 25 miles from BKM VOR.
cards.audioTextZh: 距离BKM VOR台25海里报

cards.audioText: Report 34 miles from Top of Descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 距离下降顶点34海里报

cards.audioText: Report crossing 270 radial BKM VOR.
cards.audioTextZh: 过BKM VOR台径向线270报

cards.audioText: Report 28 miles DME 210 radial BKM VOR.
cards.audioTextZh: BKM VOR台210度径向线28海里报

cards.audioText: Climb to FL220, report passing FL170.
cards.audioTextZh: 爬升到高度层220，通过高度层170报

cards.audioText: Descending immediately to FL190.
cards.audioTextZh: 立即下降到高度层190

cards.audioText: Leaving FL220 for FL190.
cards.audioTextZh: 离开高度层220，下降到高度层190

cards.audioText: Remain outside controlled airspace, expect joining clearance at time 55.
cards.audioTextZh: 保持在管制空域外，预计55分获得加入许可。

cards.audioText: Request to leave controlled airspace by descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求下降离开管制空域

cards.audioText: Request to leave controlled airspace by climb.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求爬升离开管制空域

cards.audioText: Descending to 5000 feet QNH 1014, report passing 7000 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 下降到5000英尺，修正海压1014，过7000英尺报

cards.audioText: Request VMC descent to FL60.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求目视气象条件下降到高度层60

cards.audioText: Request join airway A1 at DAPRO.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求在DAPRO加入航路A1

cards.audioText: Remain outside controlled airspace, expect further clearance at 55.
cards.audioTextZh: 继续在管制空域外，预计进一步许可55分

cards.audioText: If FL240 not available, we accept FL220.
cards.audioTextZh: 如果高度层240不可用，我们接受高度层220。

cards.audioText: Confirm we are under radar control.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实我们受雷达管制

cards.audioText: Confirm radar service is terminated.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实雷达服务终止

cards.audioText: Confirm radar control is resumed.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实雷达管制恢复

cards.audioText: Affirm RVSM.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以RVSM

cards.audioText: Negative RVSM due equipment downgraded.
cards.audioTextZh: 设备降级，无法RVSM

cards.audioText: Request clearance into RVSM airspace.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求进入RVSM空域许可

cards.audioText: Unable RVSM due turbulence.
cards.audioTextZh: 因为颠簸,无法 RVSM

cards.audioText: Ready to resume RVSM.
cards.audioTextZh: 准备好恢复RVSM

cards.audioText: At 144E (east) squawk 2000.
cards.audioTextZh: 东经144 度，应答机2000

cards.audioText: CPDLC connected.
cards.audioTextZh: CPDLC已连接

cards.audioText: Continue CPDLC make position report via CPDLC.
cards.audioTextZh: 继续CPDLC，通过CPDLC位置报告

cards.audioText: SELCAL CODE EFFG, request SELCAL check.
cards.audioTextZh: SELCALL代码EFFG，请求SELCALL检查

cards.audioText: CPDLC unserviceable, request to revert to voice communication.
cards.audioTextZh: CPDLC 故障，请求切换到语音通讯

cards.audioText: The air conditioning system has malfunctioned.
cards.audioTextZh: 空调系统故障

cards.audioText: Many passengers are suffering from smoke inhalation. Request medical assistance on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 许多乘客吸入烟尘，请求到达时医疗救助

cards.audioText: Our pressurization system has malfunctioned.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们增压系统失效

cards.audioText: We have difficulty in controlling the cabin pressure.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们座舱压力控制有问题

cards.audioText: We have a cabin altitude problem.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们遇到座舱高度问题

cards.audioText: Our cabin rate of climb has red-lined. Request immediate descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们座舱爬升率已经达到红线，请求立即下降

cards.audioText: We have a slow cabin decompression. Request immediate descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们客舱慢失压，请求马上下降

cards.audioText: We are now depressurized and will fly a more shallow descent profile.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们现在失压了，我们需要更平缓的下降剖面

cards.audioText: We have a problem with the avionics ventilation system.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们电子设备通风系统有问题

cards.audioText: The avionics ventilation is unserviceable. Request diversion to the closest suitable airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 电子设备通风不可用，请求备降到最近合适机场

cards.audioText: We have severe vibration coming from the avionics ventilation fan.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们电子设备通风风扇严重抖振

cards.audioText: There are unusual noises coming from the avionics bay.
cards.audioTextZh: 电子设备舱出现异常噪音

cards.audioText: Our FMS has malfunctioned. Request radar vectors.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们 FMS 故障，请求雷达引导

cards.audioText: Request further climb due wind-shear.
cards.audioTextZh: 风切变，请求进一步爬升

cards.audioText: Unable to maintain altitude, request leaving RVSM airspace.
cards.audioTextZh: 不能保持高度，请求离开RVSM空域

cards.audioText: We cannot make RNP approach due equipment.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于设备原因，我们无法 RNP 近进

cards.audioText: Our navigation accuracy is low. Request to climb to minimum safe altitude.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们导航精度低，请求爬升到最低安全高度

cards.audioText: The flight path is unstable. Going around.
cards.audioTextZh: （下降）飞行轨迹不稳定，复飞

cards.audioText: We made a missed approach due to unstable ILS signals.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于ILS信号不稳定，我们复飞了

cards.audioText: We have lost our flight plan after a flight management computer reset.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行管理计算机重置后，我们飞行计划丢了

cards.audioText: We do not meet GPS approach requirement due to flight crew qualifications.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于飞行机组资质，我们无法满足 GPS 近进要求

cards.audioText: Our Airline policy does not allow us to perform CAT IIIC approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 航空公司政策不允许我们执行IIIC类近进

cards.audioText: Our operations manual forbids this procedure.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的运行手册禁止此程序

cards.audioText: Our Aviation Authority does not permit this procedure.
cards.audioTextZh: 航空当局不允许此程序

cards.audioText: We are unable to conform to the noise abatement procedure due performance.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于性能，我们不能遵守降噪程序

cards.audioText: All stations, transmitting blind due to receiver failure.
cards.audioTextZh: 所有单位，接收机失效，盲发

cards.audioText: Our SELCAL has malfunctioned. We will continue monitoring your frequency.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们选择呼叫故障，我们将继续监听你的频率

cards.audioText: We are receiving an ELT signal on 121.5.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们在 121.5 上收到 ELT 信号

cards.audioText: We are picking up a broadcast signal on 121.5.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们在 121.5 上收听播报信号

cards.audioText: Our satellite phone is unserviceable. We are unable to call company operations.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们卫星电话失效，无法跟公司运行部联系

cards.audioText: Our data-link has malfunctioned. Request re-release the flight plan by voice.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们数据链故障，请求用语音重新发布飞行计划

cards.audioText: Our data-link has malfunctioned. Request ATC clearance by voice.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们数据链故障，请求语音放行许可

cards.audioText: My apologies, I wasn’t aware the boom mike was transmitting.
cards.audioTextZh: 很抱歉，我们没有注意到麦克风在发射信息

cards.audioText: Sorry for blocking the frequency due microphone jammed.
cards.audioTextZh: 很抱歉，由于麦克风卡阻堵塞频率

cards.audioText: We have an electrical failure.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们电气系统失效

cards.audioText: Request diversion to the nearest suitable airport due AC BUS failure.
cards.audioTextZh: 因为交流电汇流条失效，请求备降到最近合适机场

cards.audioText: We are not supplying power to our DC BUS. Request priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们无法给直流电汇流条供电，请求优先着陆

cards.audioText: We have a problem with the aircraft battery. Request priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们飞机蓄电瓶有问题，请求优先着陆

cards.audioText: We have had a bird strike. Our windshield has cracked.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们遭遇鸟击，风挡出现裂痕

cards.audioText: The APU is still on fire. We are evacuating. Request emergency services.
cards.audioTextZh: APU仍在着火，我们正在紧急疏散，请求紧急服务

cards.audioText: Request descent to 10000 feet to ventilate the aircraft due smoke.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于烟雾，请求下降到10000英尺，使飞机通风

cards.audioText: We are having flight control problems.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们飞行控制有问题

cards.audioText: We cannot fully extend the flaps. Request the longest runway for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们无法完全放出襟翼。请求最长跑道落地。

cards.audioText: Some of our fuel pumps have low pressure. Request descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们一些燃油泵出现低压，请求下降

cards.audioText: We are leaking fuel slowly. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们燃油慢速泄露，请求备降

cards.audioText: Request climb for dumping fuel and vectors to the fuel dump zone.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求爬升高度放油，请求雷达引导到放油区

cards.audioText: Our left engine failed due to fuel starvation.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们燃油耗竭，左发失效

cards.audioText: We suspect there is contamination in our fuel tanks.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们怀疑燃油油箱有污染物

cards.audioText: One of our hydraulic systems has exceeded temperature limits.
cards.audioTextZh: 一个液压系统超温

cards.audioText: We have shut down one of the hydraulic systems.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已经关掉了其中一个液压系统

cards.audioText: The backup hydraulic system is operational but we still want to divert.
cards.audioTextZh: 备用液压系统在工作，但我们仍想备降

cards.audioText: Two of our hydraulic systems have failed. Request immediate diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 两个液压系统失效，请示立即备降

cards.audioText: I had to abort takeoff because I didn’t receive any airspeed indication.
cards.audioTextZh: 因为我没有看到任何空速指示，我不得不中断起飞

cards.audioText: We made the go around due to navigation accuracy downgrade.
cards.audioTextZh: 因为导航精度降级，我们复飞了

cards.audioText: We made the go around due to FMS position error.
cards.audioTextZh: 因为飞行管理系统位置误差，我们复飞了

cards.audioText: We made the go around due to GPS error.
cards.audioTextZh: 因为GPS误差，我们复飞了

cards.audioText: We made the go around due to lateral deviation exceedance.
cards.audioTextZh: 因为横向偏离超限，我们复飞了

cards.audioText: We made the go around due to CDU failure.
cards.audioTextZh: 因为CDU失效，我们复飞了

cards.audioText: We made the go around because we exceeded the vertical deviation limit.
cards.audioTextZh: 因为我们超出了纵向偏离限制，我们复飞了

cards.audioText: We no longer have altitude warning. Request leaving RVSM airspace.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们不再有高度警告，请求离开RVSM空域

cards.audioText: Our landing capability has degraded. Request terminate our approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 着陆性能下降，请求终止近进

cards.audioText: We performed the go-around because we had a ground proximity warning.
cards.audioTextZh: 因为我们收到近地警告，我们复飞了

cards.audioText: Unable, TCAS RA.
cards.audioTextZh: 不能，TCAS RA

cards.audioText: We are clear of conflict. Request further instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们解除冲突了，请求进一步指令

cards.audioText: Our engine parameters are unstable. Request stop climb at FL220.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们发动机参数不稳定，请求在高度层220时停止爬升

cards.audioText: We are reading high engine vibration. Request to delay takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: 发动机读数（显示）剧烈抖振，请求推迟起飞

cards.audioText: Cabin altitude is increasing abnormally. Request to level off.
cards.audioTextZh: 客舱高度异常增加，请求改平飞

cards.audioText: Our instruments indicate excessive high cabin altitude.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们仪表显示客舱高度过高

cards.audioText: Our instrument indicates abnormal cabin pressure differential.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们仪表显示不正常的客舱压差

cards.audioText: Cockpit oxygen cylinder pressure is low. Request to return for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 驾驶舱氧气瓶压力低，请求返场着陆

cards.audioText: We cannot extend the left landing gear. Request foaming the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们不能放出左起落架，请求在跑道上喷洒泡沫

cards.audioText: Request diversion to a nearby airport with foaming capability.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求备降到附近一个能够喷洒泡沫的机场

cards.audioText: I think we blew a nose wheel tyre. Request holding position.
cards.audioTextZh: 我想我们前轮爆胎了，请求原地等待

cards.audioText: We no longer have airspeed and altitude on our primary displays.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们主显示器不再有空速和高度显示

cards.audioText: We have errors with our navigation. Request radar monitoring.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的导航有误差。请求雷达监控。

cards.audioText: We made the go around because the GPWS warning was triggered.
cards.audioTextZh: 因为近地警告被触发，我们复飞了

cards.audioText: Our ADS-B transmitter appears to be malfunctioning. Terminating further ADS-B transmissions.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们 ADS-B 似乎有故障，中止继续 ADS-B 传送

cards.audioText: ADS-B equipment degradation, will advise when able to resume operations.
cards.audioTextZh: ADS-B 性能下降，能恢复运转时告知你

cards.audioText: GPS unreliable, terminating ADS-B transmissions.
cards.audioTextZh: GPS 不可靠，中止 ADS-B 传送

cards.audioText: Our ADS-B has malfunctioned. Is there any weather advisory at our destination?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们ADS-B发报机已故障，有目的地机场的气象报吗？

cards.audioText: We made an overshoot because our ADS-B indicated a possible runway incursion.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们 ADS-B 显示可能有跑道入侵，我们复飞了

cards.audioText: Our airspeed is unreliable. Request radar vectors for long final.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们空速不可靠，请求雷达引导到长五边

cards.audioText: We made the go-around because the radio altimeter triggered flare mode.
cards.audioTextZh: 因为无线电高度表触发了拉平模式，我们复飞了

cards.audioText: Many passengers have suffered from smoke inhalation. Request medical services.
cards.audioTextZh: 许多乘客已经吸入了烟雾，请求医疗服务

cards.audioText: We are expediting descent to enable a windmill startup. Request further descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 为了能够风转启动发动机，我们正在加速下降，请求进一步下降

cards.audioText: CPDLC has malfunctioned. We are reverting to voice communication.
cards.audioTextZh: CPDLC 发生故障，我们正在转换到语音通讯

cards.audioText: CPDLC terminated due to failure, reverting to voice communication.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于故障，终止CPDLC，恢复语音通信

cards.audioText: We are at bay15. We have an APU fire. Request fire services.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们在停机位 15，有 APU 火警，请求消防服务

cards.audioText: The windshield is cracked on the outside. Request descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 风挡外层裂了，请求下降

cards.audioText: We aborted takeoff due loss of engine oil pressure.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于发动机失去了滑油压力，我们中断起飞了

cards.audioText: We have an engine oil leak. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们发动机滑油泄露，请求备降

cards.audioText: Engine Number One has a temperature problem. Request holding to perform checklist.
cards.audioTextZh: 一发温度有问题，请求等待完成检查单

cards.audioText: We heard an explosion from the cabin. Request to stop climb.
cards.audioTextZh: 客舱传来爆炸声，请求停止爬升

cards.audioText: We are encountering moderate icing. Request immediate descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们遭遇中度结冰，请求马上下降

cards.audioText: We are on emergency descent due severe icing.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于严重结冰，我们正在紧急下降

cards.audioText: Rime ice was reported by previous aircraft during approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 前机报告，在近进时遇到毛冰

cards.audioText: We have a “Wind-shear Ahead” warning. Request to delay our approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们出现了“前方风切变”警告，请求推迟近进

cards.audioText: We made the go around due to wind-shear warning.
cards.audioTextZh: 风切变警告，我们复飞了

cards.audioText: We won’t have to deviate if you allow us to climb to FL430.
cards.audioTextZh: 如果允许我们爬升到高度层430，就不必偏航。

cards.audioText: We have encountered severe clear air turbulence. Request immediate descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们遭遇严重晴空颠簸。请求立即下降。

cards.audioText: Request a general heading of 050 due to multiple cells ahead.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于前方有多个雷暴单体，请求大致航向050

cards.audioText: Roger heavy rain. Request to terminate our approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 明白，大雨。请求终止我们的近进

cards.audioText: Request immediate one eighty turn to the right due volcanic ash.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于火山灰，请求立即 180 度右转

cards.audioText: There are red lights ahead of us. Confirm taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 前方有红灯，证实滑行指令

cards.audioText: There is an obstruction ahead. Confirm taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 前方有障碍物，证实滑行指令

cards.audioText: We have a suspicious bag on board. Request bomb squad.
cards.audioTextZh: 机上有可疑箱包，请求拆弹小组

cards.audioText: The passengers are evacuating. The bomb is still on board.
cards.audioTextZh: 乘客正在撤离，炸弹还在飞机上

cards.audioText: Request a remote apron for parking our aircraft due bomb on board.
cards.audioTextZh: 机上有炸弹，请求远机坪停机位

cards.audioText: Request a large airspace to maneuver due flight control problems.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于飞行控制问题，请求大空域机动

cards.audioText: Unable visual approach due company policy. Request radar vectors.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于公司政策，不能目视近进，请求雷达引导

cards.audioText: Unable circling approach due company policy. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于公司政策，不能盘旋近进，请求备降

cards.audioText: Are we being vectored too close to the parallel aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们是否被引导太靠近平行飞机了？

cards.audioText: Is the preceding aircraft crossing our altitude?
cards.audioTextZh: 前机是否正在穿越我们的高度？

cards.audioText: I see wildfire at my 10 o’clock, about 8 miles.
cards.audioTextZh: 我在10点钟方向、大约8海里处看到了野火

cards.audioText: Request offset 10 miles left to avoid the reported strong downdraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求左偏10海里，避开报告的强下降气流

cards.audioText: Request immediate one-eighty turn to the right due to possible hail ahead.
cards.audioTextZh: 前方可能有冰雹，请求立即向右做180度转弯。

cards.audioText: Some of the hijackers are carrying sharp protruding weapons.
cards.audioTextZh: 几个劫机犯拿着锋利、尖锐武器

cards.audioText: Terrorists started to injure passengers.
cards.audioTextZh: 恐怖分子开始伤害乘客

cards.audioText: Terrorists are threatening to start killing passengers and the crew.
cards.audioTextZh: 恐怖分子威胁要杀死乘客和机组

cards.audioText: A suspicious suitcase was found during the cabin inspection.
cards.audioTextZh: 客舱检查中发现了一个可疑箱包

cards.audioText: The air marshal is searching the aircraft interior for any suspicious articles.
cards.audioTextZh: 安全员正在搜查飞机里的任何可疑物品

cards.audioText: What do the bomb-disposal experts suggest we do?
cards.audioTextZh: 拆弹专家建议我们做什么？

cards.audioText: The cabin crew reports a passenger is behaving strangely.
cards.audioTextZh: 客舱人员报告，一名乘客行为怪异

cards.audioText: We have navigation map drift. Request climb to MEA.
cards.audioTextZh: 导航地图漂移。请求爬升到最低航路高度。

cards.audioText: The cabin crew have used up all the portable extinguishers. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 客舱人员已用完了手提灭火瓶，请求备降

cards.audioText: We almost had a mid-air collision with another aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们差一点与另一架飞机空中相撞

cards.audioText: The conflicting traffic is military. Request avoiding action.
cards.audioTextZh: 冲突飞机是军用飞机，请求避让措施

cards.audioText: Does the flight path of the unknown aircraft converge with ours?
cards.audioTextZh: 不明飞机的飞行路径和我们的飞行路径汇聚吗？

cards.audioText: The conflicting traffic is gray, possibly a military aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 冲突飞机是灰色的，可能是军用飞机

cards.audioText: We have traffic indication at 2 o’clock, 300 feet above our level.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有冲突飞机显示，2点钟方位，我们当前以上300英尺

cards.audioText: We have a possible traffic conflict ahead. Request radar vectors for avoidance.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们前方可能有冲突飞机，请求雷达引导避让

cards.audioText: Request right turn for traffic avoidance.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求右转避让冲突飞机

cards.audioText: Unable to comply, TCAS RA.
cards.audioTextZh: 不能照办，遵守TCAS RA通告

cards.audioText: Clear of conflict, request further instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 冲突解除，请求进一步指令

cards.audioText: We have injuries resulting from our TCAS maneuver. Request ambulance on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: TCAS机动导致部分乘客受伤，请求救护车到场

cards.audioText: Some passengers were injured because their seatbelts weren’t fastened.
cards.audioTextZh: 一些乘客受伤是因为他们没有系安全带

cards.audioText: Some passengers have been scalded by hot drinks.
cards.audioTextZh: 一些乘客被热饮烫伤了

cards.audioText: We overran the runway end. We are evacuating. Request emergency services.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们冲出了跑道头，正在撤离，请求紧急服务

cards.audioText: We will reach our minimum fuel if we are delayed any further.
cards.audioTextZh: 如果进一步延误，我们将达到最低燃油量

cards.audioText: We are declaring fuel emergency. Request priority landing Runway 03R.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们宣布燃油紧急状况，请求优先着陆跑道03右

cards.audioText: The military aircraft is commanding us to land at the airfield below.
cards.audioTextZh: 军用飞机正在命令我们在下面的机场着陆

cards.audioText: We are being escorted towards the national boundary by two military aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们正在被两架军用飞机护送到国境线

cards.audioText: A crew member is incapacitated. Request diversion and medical assistance.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名机组成员失能，请求备降和医疗救助

cards.audioText: Confirm we have enough separation from preceding aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实我们与前机有足够间隔。

cards.audioText: Unable to expedite climb due performance.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于性能，不能快速爬升

cards.audioText: Negative contact due visibility.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于能见度，不能看见（机场或飞机等）

cards.audioText: Unable, we are in IMC.
cards.audioTextZh: 不能，我们处于仪表天气条件

cards.audioText: Unable, we are only authorized during daytime VMC.
cards.audioTextZh: 不能，我们只有白天目视气象条件的资格

cards.audioText: Unable noise abatement due company policy.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于公司政策，不能执行减噪程序

cards.audioText: Did the previous controller tell you about our problem during radar handoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 雷达移交时，前一位管制员是否告诉你我们的故障？

cards.audioText: Is there a frequency change at this compulsory reporting point?
cards.audioTextZh: 在此强制报告点有频率变换吗？

cards.audioText: Request runway change for departure due high crosswind.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于大侧风，请求更换跑道离场

cards.audioText: Request delay the approach due tail wind beyond limits.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于顺风超限，请求推迟近进

cards.audioText: Request holding instructions due weather near the runway threshold.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于跑道入口附近有（雷暴）天气，请求等待指令

cards.audioText: We had to overshoot because of wake turbulence.
cards.audioTextZh: 因为尾流，我们不得不复飞

cards.audioText: Unable CAT II approach due crew qualification.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于机组资质，不能II类ILS近进

cards.audioText: Transmission blocked, say again.
cards.audioTextZh: 发送信息受到干扰了，再说一遍

cards.audioText: Standby, high pilot workload.
cards.audioTextZh: 稍等，飞行员工作负荷大

cards.audioText: We had to go around due to unstable approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 因为不稳定近进，我们不得不复飞

cards.audioText: Right heading 330, descending to 3000 feet, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 右转航向330，下降到3000英尺，可以ILS近进，跑道36右

cards.audioText: Cleared to exit the hold, fly direct to ML. Contact Approach on 128.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以离开等待，直飞ML，联系近进128.35

cards.audioText: After passing SY VOR, leave the hold on heading 250, cleared for VOR approach Runway 06.
