cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, cleared to Paris via flight planned route, initial climb 6600 meters, RENOB-32 departure, request level change for 10400 meters en route, squawk 1725, Runway 36R, departure frequency 127.75.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，按计划航路放行至巴黎，初始爬升至6600米，RENOB-32 离场，航路中申请改平10400米，squawk 1725，36右跑道，离场频率127.75。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Paris via flight planned route, initially climb to 6600 meters, RENOB-32 departure, request level change for 10400 meters en route, squawk 1725, Runway 36R, departure frequency 127.75, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按计划航路放行至巴黎，初始爬升至6600米，RENOB-32 离场，航路中申请改平10400米，squawk 1725，36R跑道，离场频率127.75，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, correct, contact Ground 121.9 for pushback and startup.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，正确，联系地面121.9申请推出和开车。

cards.audioText: B: Contact Ground 121.9 for pushback and startup.
cards.audioTextZh: 联系地面121.9申请推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, AFR 101, Gate 301, request pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，AFR 101，301号登机口，申请推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, Beijing Ground, short delay for pushback, an Airbus 340 inbound for Gate 302.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，北京地面，推出稍有延误，一架Airbus 340正进302号登机口。
cards.referenceText: Roger, stand by, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，等待，AFR 101。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 101, pushback approved.
B: Ask ATC the direction of pushback.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，可以推出。询问空管推出方向。
cards.referenceText: Roger, in which direction should we pushback? AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，请问推出方向？AFR 101。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, my apologies, pushback and startup approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，抱歉，可以推出和开车，机头向东。
cards.referenceText: Pushback and startup approved, facing east, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出和开车，机头向东，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: All engines have been started, everything checked out normal, received information G, request taxi for Beijing Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 所有发动机已启动，各项检查正常，已收到通播G，向北京地面申请滑行。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, AFR 101, information G, ready for taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，AFR 101，通播G，准备好滑行。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 101, information G changed, intersection departure from H is available.
B: Report that you have received H but you want to change Runway 01 for a short course.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，通播已变为H，可从H交叉口离场。报告已收到H，但因航程较短，希望改用01跑道。
cards.referenceText: Roger, information H received, request Runway 01 for a short course, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，已收到通播H，申请01跑道，因航程较短，AFR 101。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 101, roger, Boeing 737 inbound approaching from left for Gate 303, once that aircraft is cleared, taxi via B and D, hold short of Runway 01.
B: You received report from information H that B is closed.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，收到。一架Boeing 737从左侧进近303号登机口，待该机通过后，经B和D滑行，01跑道外等待。你从通播H获知B关闭。
cards.referenceText: Indications say that taxiway B is closed, confirm taxi via B, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通播显示滑行道B关闭，请确认是否经B滑行，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, correction taxi via M and D, hold short of Runway 01.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，更正，经M和D滑行，01跑道外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via M and D, hold short of Runway 01, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经M和D滑行，01跑道外等待，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne. Contact Beijing Departure, you are passing 1200 meters and climbing to 1800 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已离地。联系北京离场，报告正在通过1200米爬升至1800米。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, AFR 101, passing 1200 meters and climbing to 1800 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，AFR 101，正在通过1200米爬升至1800米。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, Beijing Departure, identified, climb to 6000 meters on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，北京离场，雷达识别，按标准气压爬升至6000米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 6000 meters on standard, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按标准气压爬升至6000米，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: Flight attendant reports that there is a man carrying explosives on his body and attempting to detonate them. Require emergency descent to 3000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 乘务员报告一名男子身上携带爆炸物并试图引爆。请求紧急下降至3000米。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Beijing Departure, AFR 101, flight attendant reports that there is a man carrying explosives on his body and attempting to detonate them, request descent to 3000 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，北京离场，AFR 101，乘务员报告一名男子身上携带爆炸物并试图引爆，申请下降至3000米。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 101, roger, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1011, say endurance.
B: Read back and report that you can hold for 2 hours more.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，收到，按QNH 1011下降至3000米，报告续航时间。请复诵并报告还能等待2小时。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1011, endurance 0200, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按QNH 1011下降至3000米，续航0200，AFR 101。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 101, divert immediately to Tongzhou.
B: Request radar vector to Tongzhou.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，立即备降通州。申请雷达引导至通州。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, AFR 101, request reader vector to Tongzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，AFR 101，申请雷达引导至通州。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 101, turn right heading 180, maintain 3000 meters. When able, report current conditions on board.
B: Read back and then give a report that the dangerous man is still struggling and has hurt 2 passengers.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，右转航向180，保持3000米。条件允许时报告机上当前情况。请复诵，并报告危险男子仍在挣扎，已伤及两名旅客。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 180, maintain 3000 metres, the dangerous man is still struggling and has hurt 2 passengers, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向180，保持3000米，危险男子仍在挣扎，已伤及两名旅客，AFR 101。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 101, roger, say intentions.
B: Tell the ATC that the man has finally surrendered, the 2 passengers are in dangerous situation, request return to Beijing airport and priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，收到，报告意图。告诉空管该男子已被控制，两名旅客情况危急，申请返回北京机场并优先落地。
cards.referenceText: The man is under control, request return to Beijing airport and priority landing, 2 passengers are in dangerous situation, Request medical assistance on arrival, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 该男子已被控制，申请返回北京机场并优先落地，两名旅客情况危急，请求到达后医疗协助，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, roger. Cleared Runway 18R, you are number 1. Police officers and medical services will be ready on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，收到。可以18右跑道落地，你是第一架。警方和医疗保障将在到达时待命。
cards.referenceText: Cleared Runway 18R, thanks, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以18R落地，谢谢，AFR 101。

topics.name: AFR 101 中度积冰 左发失效

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is AFR 101, you are at Wuhan Airport, at Gate 215, information G received, request ATC clearance to Paris.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是AFR 101，位于武汉机场215号登机口，已收到通播G，申请前往巴黎的空管放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR 101, gate 215, information G, request ATC clearance to Paris.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，AFR 101，215号登机口，通播G，申请前往巴黎的空管放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, cleared to Paris via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb to 1800 meters, cruising level 10700 meters, Runway 04, contact departure on 119.7, squawk 2521.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，按计划航路放行至巴黎，LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至1800米，巡航高度10700米，04跑道，离场联系119.7，squawk 2521。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Paris via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb to 1800 meters, cruising level 10700 meters, Runway 04, contact departure on 119.7, squawk 2521, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按计划航路放行至巴黎，LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至1800米，巡航高度10700米，04跑道，离场联系119.7，squawk 2521，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: You decide 10700 meters is not acceptable due to heavy weight, ask if 9500 meters is available.
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为因重量较大，10700米不可接受，询问9500米是否可用。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR 101, 10700 meters is not acceptable due to heavy weight, is 9500 meters available ?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，AFR 101，因重量较大，10700米不可接受，请问9500米是否可用？

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, cleared cruising level 9500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，巡航高度改为9500米。
cards.referenceText: Cleared cruising level 9500 meters, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 巡航高度9500米，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Ground control.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已准备好推出和开车，请联系地面管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR 101, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR 101，申请推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, push back and start up approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，可以推出和开车，机头向东。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing east, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出和开车，机头向东，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: You are now on taxiway Z4 with your engines running, ask Ground control for taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在在Z4滑行道，发动机已启动，请向地面管制申请滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR 101, taxiway Z4, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR 101，Z4滑行道，申请滑行。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway Z4 and A, hold short of A4.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，经滑行道Z4和A滑行至04跑道等待点，A4外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway Z4 and A, hold short of A4, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道Z4和A滑行至04跑道等待点，A4外等待，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, give way to the Boeing 737 vacating on E3, after traffic is clear, continue taxi via taxiway A and A9, hold short of Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，让行正在E3脱离的Boeing 737，冲突消除后，继续经滑行道A和A9滑行，04跑道外等待。
cards.referenceText: Give way to the B737 vacating on E3, after traffic is clear, continue taxi via taxiway A and A9, hold short of Runway 04, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 让行正在E3脱离的B737，冲突消除后继续经滑行道A和A9滑行，04跑道外等待，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne at 600 meters climbing, contact Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已离地，600米爬升中，请联系离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR 101, airborne, 600 meters climbing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，AFR 101，已离地，600米爬升中。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, radar contact, turn left, direct to DA, climb to 3000 meters on QNH 1015.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，雷达联系，左转直飞DA，按QNH 1015爬升至3000米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left, direct to DA, climb to 3000 meters on QNH 1015, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞DA，按QNH 1015爬升至3000米，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, climb to and maintain 6000 meters, expedite until passing 3900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，爬升并保持6000米，通过3900米前加快爬升。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 6000 meters, expedite until passing  3900 meters, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持6000米，通过3900米前加快爬升，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: You are experiencing moderate icing while maintaining 6000 meters, request higher level and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: 保持6000米时遇到中度结冰，请申请更高高度并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR 101, we are experiencing moderate icing at 6000 meters, request higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，AFR 101，我们在6000米遇到中度结冰，申请更高高度。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, negative due traffic, maintain 6000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，因冲突飞机不能同意，保持6000米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, maintain 6000 meters, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，保持6000米，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: Suddenly, your left engine failed at 6000 meters, make an Urgency call to ATC and request descent and return to Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 突然，你的左发在6000米失效，请向空管发出紧急信号并申请下降、返回武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Departure, AFR 101, our left engine failed at 6000 meters, request descent and return to Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉离场，AFR 101，我们左发在6000米失效，申请下降并返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, roger your PAN call, descend to 4200 meters, turn left heading 010, expect radar vectors for Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，收到你的紧急呼叫，下降至4200米，左转航向010，预计雷达引导至04跑道。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 4200 meters, turn left heading 010, expect radar vectors for Runway 04, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至4200米，左转航向010，预计雷达引导至04跑道，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, continue descent to 3000 meters on QNH 1015.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，按QNH 1015继续下降至3000米。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to 3000 meters on QNH 1015, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按QNH 1015继续下降至3000米，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have successfully restarted the left engine, but you still decide to return to Wuhan for safety concerns, inform ATC about the current situation and cancel the Urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已成功重启左发，但出于安全考虑仍决定返回武汉，请告知空管当前情况并取消紧急状态。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 101, cancel urgency, we have restarted our left engine, but we still want to return to land for safety concerns.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 101，取消紧急状态，我们已重启左发，但出于安全考虑仍希望返回落地。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are established on the ILS approach Runway 04, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已建立04跑道ILS进近，请联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 101, established on the ILS approach Runway 04.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 101，已建立04跑道ILS进近。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, surface wind 070 degrees, 5 meters per second, Runway 04, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，地面风070度，5米/秒，04跑道，可以落地。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land Runway 04, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以04跑道落地，AFR 101。

topics.name: AFR 675 襟翼卡阻 滑出跑道 前轮陷地

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is AFR 675, a flight from Guangzhou to Wuhan, you have just been handed over from Guangzhou Control to Wuhan Control, you are over DAPRO, maintaining 10100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是AFR 675，从广州飞往武汉，刚由广州管制移交至武汉管制，过DAPRO，保持10100米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR 675, over DAPRO, maintaining 10100 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR 675，过DAPRO，保持10100米。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 675, omit position reports.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 675，免报位置。
cards.referenceText: Omit position reports, AFR 675.
cards.referenceTextZh: 免报位置，AFR 675。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar indicates there is a cumulonimbus ahead, report the situation to Wuhan Control and ask for 20 miles deviation to the west.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的气象雷达显示前方有积雨云，请向武汉管制报告情况，并申请向西偏航20海里。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR 675, our weather radar indicates there is a cumulonimbus ahead, request 20 miles deviation to the west.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR 675，我们气象雷达显示前方有积雨云，申请向西偏航20海里。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 675, negative due prohibited area.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 675，因禁区不能同意。
cards.referenceText: Roger, AFR 675.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，AFR 675。

cards.audioText: B: Now you find the navigation performance has been downgraded, report this to ATC and ask them to verify your flight track.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你发现导航性能下降，请向空管报告，并请他们核实你的飞行航迹。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR 675, the navigation performance has been downgraded, request verify our flight track.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR 675，导航性能下降，请核实我们的飞行航迹。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 675, you are still on track.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 675，你仍在航迹上。
cards.referenceText: Roger, AFR 675.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，AFR 675。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar has failed, tell Wuhan Control you'd like to divert to Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的气象雷达失效，请告诉武汉管制你希望备降武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR 675, our weather radar has failed, request divert to Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR 675，我们气象雷达失效，申请备降武汉机场。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 675, turn left, direct to WHA, descend to 5100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 675，左转直飞WHA，下降至5100米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left, direct to WHA, descend to 5100 meters, AFR 675.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞WHA，下降至5100米，AFR 675。

cards.audioText: B: Ask Wuhan Control for the current weather information at Wuhan.
cards.audioTextZh: 向武汉管制询问武汉当前天气信息。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR 675, request the current weather information at Wuhan.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR 675，请求武汉当前天气信息。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 675, the weather at Wuhan is fine.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 675，武汉天气良好。
cards.referenceText: Roger, AFR 675.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，AFR 675。

cards.audioText: B: During approach, you find your flaps are jammed, tell Wuhan Approach you want to terminate the approach and hold at WHA for trouble-shooting.
cards.audioTextZh: 进近过程中，你发现襟翼卡阻，请告诉武汉进近你希望终止进近，并在WHA等待排故。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 675, our flaps are jammed, request terminate the approach and hold at WHA for trouble-shooting.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 675，我们襟翼卡阻，申请终止进近并在WHA等待排故。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 675, direct to WHA, climb and maintain 900 meters, hold as published.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 675，直飞WHA，爬升并保持900米，按公布程序等待。
cards.referenceText: Direct to WHA, climb and maintain 900 meters, hold as published, AFR 675.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞WHA，爬升并保持900米，按公布程序等待，AFR 675。

cards.audioText: B: After completing the checklist, your flaps are still jammed, tell Wuhan Approach you intend to land at the longest runway, because the touchdown speed will be very high due flapless landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 完成检查单后，襟翼仍然卡阻。告诉武汉进近你打算在最长跑道落地，因为无襟翼着陆会导致接地速度很高。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 675, our flaps are still jammed, request land at the longest runway due the touchdown speed will be very high due flapless landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 675，我们襟翼仍然卡阻；由于无襟翼着陆接地速度会很高，申请使用最长跑道落地。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 675, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R.
B: Read back the ATC instructions and ask the controller the braking action of Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 675，可以ILS进近36右跑道。请复诵空管指令，并询问36右跑道刹车效应。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 675, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R, request the breaking action of Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 675，可以ILS进近36R，请问36R刹车效应。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 675, braking action Runway 36R good.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 675，36右跑道刹车效应好。
cards.referenceText: Breaking action Runway 36R good, AFR 675.
cards.referenceTextZh: 36R刹车效应好，AFR 675。

cards.audioText: B: You have skidded off the runway after landing, your nose wheel was bogged, report it to Wuhan Ground and request emergency assistance.
cards.audioTextZh: 落地后你冲出跑道，前轮陷住，请向武汉地面报告并申请应急援助。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR 675, we have skidded off the runway after landing, our nose wheel was bogged, request emergency assistance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR 675，我们落地后冲出跑道，前轮陷住，申请应急援助。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 675, the tug is on the way.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 675，牵引车正在赶来。
cards.referenceText: Roger, AFR 675.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，AFR 675。

topics.name: AFR 896 皮托管加温,GPS高度地速失效

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is AFR 896, you are from Paris to Wuhan, you are flying at 11300 meters, approaching XIY, call Xi'an Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是AFR 896，从巴黎飞往武汉，当前高度11300米，接近XIY，请呼叫西安管制。
cards.referenceText: Xi'an Control, AFR 896, maintaining 11300 meters,approaching XIY.
cards.referenceTextZh: 西安管制，AFR 896，保持11300米，接近XIY。

cards.audioText: B: You check with Xi'an Control if there is any turbulence reported by preceding aircraft at 10700 meters?
cards.audioTextZh: 向西安管制询问前机在10700米是否报告过颠簸。
cards.referenceText: Xi'an Control, AFR 896, is there any turbulence reported by preceding aircraft at 10700 meters ?
cards.referenceTextZh: 西安管制，AFR 896，请问前机在10700米是否报告过颠簸？

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 896, you are the first aircraft in my sector, there is no report here.
B: Tell the controller you want to descend to 10700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 896，你是我扇区内第一架航空器，这里没有报告。告诉管制员你希望下降至10700米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, request descend to 10700 meters, AFR 896.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，申请下降至10700米，AFR 896。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 896, descend and maintain 10700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 896，下降并保持10700米。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 10700 meters, AFR 896.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持10700米，AFR 896。

cards.audioText: B: You are experiencing severe turbulence at 10700 meters, the pitot static heating feature has malfunctioned, you want to fly back to 11300 meters to avoid turbulence and ice area. This is an Urgent call.
cards.audioTextZh: 你在10700米遇到严重颠簸，皮托静压加温功能故障，希望回到11300米以避开颠簸和结冰区域。这是紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Xi'an Control, AFR 896, we are experiencing severe turbulence at 10700 meters, the pitot static heating feature has malfunctioned, request fly back to 11300 meters to avoid turbulence and ice area.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，西安管制，AFR 896，我们在10700米遇到严重颠簸，皮托静压加温故障，申请回到11300米以避开颠簸和结冰区域。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 896, climb and maintain 11300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 896，爬升并保持11300米。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 11300 meters, AFR 896.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持11300米，AFR 896。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 896, contact Zhengzhou Control on 132.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 896，联系郑州管制132.35。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 896, radar contact, direct to ZHO, descend to 11000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 896，雷达联系，直飞ZHO，下降至11000米。
cards.referenceText: Direct to ZHO, descend to 11000 meters, AFR 896.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞ZHO，下降至11000米，AFR 896。

cards.audioText: B: Ask to climb to 11600 meters due icing.
cards.audioTextZh: 因结冰申请爬升至11600米。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, AFR 896, request climb to 11600 meters due icing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，AFR 896，因结冰申请爬升至11600米。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 896, climb to 11600 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 896，爬升至11600米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 11600 meters, AFR 896.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至11600米，AFR 896。

cards.audioText: B: You have established contact with Wuhan Control, initiated descent for Runway 36R, during descent, airspeed and altitude readings are abnormal, possibly due to ice blockage, advise Wuhan Control this situation. This is an Urgent call.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已与武汉管制建立联系，开始为36右跑道下降。下降过程中，空速和高度读数异常，可能由结冰堵塞造成，请向武汉管制说明情况。这是紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, AFR 896,our airspeed and altitude readings are abnormal, possibly due to ice blockage.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，AFR 896，我们的空速和高度读数异常，可能由结冰堵塞造成。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 896, turn right heading 240.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 896，右转航向240。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, AFR 896.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向240，AFR 896。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 896, advise your intention.
B: Tell controller that your GPS altitude and groundspeed is not accurate compared to barometric indications, but you can still maintain a stable flight, request descend to leave icing area.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 896，报告意图。告诉管制员，与气压高度指示相比，你的GPS高度和地速不准确，但仍能保持稳定飞行，申请下降脱离结冰区域。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR 896, our GPS altitude and groundspeed is not accurate, but we can still maintain a stable flight, request descend to leave icing area.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR 896，我们的GPS高度和地速不准确，但仍能保持稳定飞行，申请下降脱离结冰区域。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 896, descend to 3600 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 896，下降至3600米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 3600 meters, AFR 896.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至3600米，AFR 896。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 896, radar shows you are at 4800 meters, what's your current GPS altitude?
B: Tell the controller GPS altitude is 3600 meters, request descend to 1800 meters.
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：AFR 896，雷达显示你在4800米，你当前GPS高度是多少？
告诉管制员GPS高度为3600米，并申请下降至1800米。
cards.referenceText: Our GPS altitude is 3600 meters, request descend to 1800 meters, AFR 896.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们的GPS高度是3600米，申请下降至1800米，AFR 896。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 896, another aircraft has information with regards to the differences between his barometric and GPS altitude, I have him on 3000 meters, his reported GPS is 3600 meters.
B: Acknowledge the transmission request further descent and leave icing area.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 896，另一架航空器提供了气压高度与GPS高度差异的信息。我给他3000米，他报告的GPS高度是3600米。确认收到，并申请继续下降以离开结冰区域。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 896, roger, request further descent and leave icing area.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 896，收到，申请继续下降并脱离结冰区域。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 896, contact Tower on 124.35, we have informed them your altimeter errors.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 896，联系塔台124.35，我们已通知他们你的高度表误差。
cards.referenceText: 124.35, roger, thanks, AFR 896.

cards.audioText: B: You left the icing area and your instruments have returned to normal, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已离开结冰区域，仪表恢复正常，请向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 896, we left the icing area and our instruments have returned to normal.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 896，我们已离开结冰区域，仪表已恢复正常。

cards.audioText: B: You have established on the ILS Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已建立36右跑道ILS。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 896, established on the ILS Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 896，已建立36R ILS。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 896, wind calm, Runway 36R, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 896，静风，36右跑道，可以落地。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, cleared to land, AFR 896.
cards.referenceTextZh: 36R跑道，可以落地，AFR 896。

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is AFR 332, a flight from Wuhan to Paris, you are at stand 223, ask Wuhan Ground for push back and start up instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是AFR 332，从武汉飞往巴黎，停在223号机位，向武汉地面申请推出和开车指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR 332, stand 223, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR 332，223号机位，申请推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 332, Wuhan Ground, push back and start up approved, long push back.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 332，武汉地面，可以推出和开车，长推出。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, long push back, AFR 332.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出和开车，长推出，AFR 332。

cards.audioText: B: You realize the tow truck is not in position yet, request a tug.
cards.audioTextZh: 你发现牵引车还未就位，申请牵引车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR 332, the tow truck is not in position, request a tug.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR 332，牵引车尚未就位，申请牵引车。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 332, the tug is on the way.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 332，牵引车正在赶来。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, AFR 332.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，AFR 332。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up procedures, you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已完成推出和开车程序，准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR 332, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR 332，推出和开车已完成，申请滑行。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 332, taxi via taxiway A3, A and E5 to holding point Runway 22, taxi with caution, the taxiway is slippery due to heavy rain.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 332，经滑行道A3、A和E5滑行至22跑道等待点，谨慎滑行，因大雨滑行道湿滑。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway A3, A and E5 to holding point Runway 22, roger, thanks, AFR 332.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道A3、A和E5滑行至22跑道等待点，收到，谢谢，AFR 332。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have reached the holding point Runway 22, contact Wuhan Tower and request line up instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已到达22跑道等待点，联系武汉塔台并申请进跑道指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 332, reaching holding point Runway 22, request line up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 332，到达22跑道等待点，申请进跑道。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 332, behind the landing Airbus 330, line up behind.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 332，在落地的Airbus 330后进跑道，跟随其后。
cards.referenceText: Behind the landing A330, line up behind, AFR 332.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在落地的A330后进跑道，跟随其后，AFR 332。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 332, follow ZF-01 departure, maintain runway heading until 1200 meters, contact Wuhan Departure on 124.25, cleared for takeoff Runway 22, wind 200 degrees, 8 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 332，执行ZF-01 离场，保持跑道航向至1200米，联系武汉离场124.25，22跑道可以起飞，风向200度，风速8米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Follow ZF-01 departure, maintain runway heading until 1200 meters, contact Wuhan Departure on 124.25, cleared for takeoff Runway 22, AFR 332.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行ZF-01 离场，保持跑道航向至1200米，联系武汉离场124.25，22跑道可以起飞，AFR 332。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 332, Wuhan Departure, when passing HG, turn left heading 220, then direct to ZF.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 332，武汉离场，过HG后左转航向220，然后直飞ZF。
cards.referenceText: When passing HG, turn left heading 220, then direct to ZF, AFR 332.
cards.referenceTextZh: 过HG后左转航向220，然后直飞ZF，AFR 332。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at 3600 meters, you smelled something unusual in the cockpit, but you haven't found out the source of the smell, report this situation to Wuhan Departure and request hold for doing the checklist.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你在3600米，驾驶舱闻到异常气味，但尚未找到气味来源。向武汉离场报告情况，并申请等待以执行检查单。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR 332, we smelled something unusual in the cockpit, but we haven't found out the source of the smell, request hold for doing the checklist.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，AFR 332，我们在驾驶舱闻到异常气味，但尚未找到来源，申请等待执行检查单。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 332, turn right, direct to ZF, hold at ZF as published.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 332，右转直飞ZF，在ZF按公布程序等待。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to ZF, hold at ZF as published, AFR 332.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞ZF，在ZF按公布程序等待，AFR 332。

cards.audioText: B: As you perform the checklist, there is dense smoke in the cockpit, contact Wuhan Departure and make a Distress call for priority landing at Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 执行检查单时，驾驶舱出现浓烟，请联系武汉离场并宣布遇险，申请优先返回武汉机场落地。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Departure, AFR 332, there is dense smoke in the cockpit, request priority landing at Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，武汉离场，AFR 332，驾驶舱出现浓烟，申请优先返回武汉机场落地。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 332, roger MAYDAY, follow ZF-01 arrival, descend to 1800 meters, when able, report passengers on board.
B: Read back the instructions and tell the controller that you have 220 passengers on board.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 332，收到遇险信号，执行ZF-01 进场，下降至1800米，条件允许时报告机上人数。请复诵指令，并告诉管制员机上有220名旅客。
cards.referenceText: Follow ZF-01 arrival, descend to 1800 meters, POB 220, AFR 332.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行ZF-01 进场，下降至1800米，机上人数220，AFR 332。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 332, descend and maintain 600 meters, turn right to join downwind Runway 22, report when turning base.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 332，下降并保持600米，右转加入22跑道三边，转四边时报告。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 600 meters, turn right to join downwind Runway 22, report when turning base, AFR 332.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持600米，右转加入22跑道三边，转四边时报告，AFR 332。

cards.audioText: B: The smoke situation can't be controlled, request emergency services upon arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 烟雾情况无法控制，申请到达后应急保障。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 332, the smoke situation can't be controlled, request emergency services upon arrival.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 332，烟雾无法控制，申请到达后应急保障。

topics.name: AFR 9939 中断起飞 刹车超温

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is AFR 939, a flight from Wuhan to Beijing, you are parking at gate 07, you have received information H, request ATC clearance from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是AFR 939，从武汉飞往北京，停在07号登机口，已收到通播H，向武汉放行申请空管放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR 9939, gate 07, information H, request ATC clearance to Beijing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，AFR 9939，07号登机口，通播H，申请前往北京的空管放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 939, cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, departure Runway 18, ZF-02 departure, initial climb 2700 meters, request level change en route, departure frequency 127.35, squawk 2615.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 939，按计划航路放行至北京，18跑道离场，ZF-02 离场，初始爬升2700米，航路中申请改平，离场频率127.35，squawk 2615。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, departure Runway 18, ZF-02 departure, initial climb 2700 meters, request level change en route, departure frequency 127.35, squawk 2615, AFR 9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按计划航路放行至北京，18跑道离场，ZF-02 离场，初始爬升2700米，航路中申请改平，离场频率127.35，squawk 2615，AFR 9939。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已准备好推出和开车，请联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR 9939, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR 9939，申请推出和开车。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 939, push back and start up approved, facing east.
B: Tell the controller you have difficulty in starting the engines with strong tailwind, you want to change the push back position in face west.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 939，可以推出和开车，机头向东。告诉管制员，强顺风下发动机启动有困难，希望改为机头向西的推出位置。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing east, but we have difficulty in starting the engines with strong tailwind, request change the push back position in face west, AFR 9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出和开车，机头向东，但强顺风下发动机启动有困难，申请改为机头向西推出，AFR 9939。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up procedures, you are ready for taxi, request taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已完成推出和开车程序，准备好滑行，请申请滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR 9939, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR 9939，推出和开车已完成，申请滑行。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 939, taxi to holding point Runway 18 via taxiway Z4, A and A1.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 939，经滑行道Z4、A和A1滑行至18跑道等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 18 via taxiway Z4, A and A1, AFR 9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道Z4、A和A1滑行至18跑道等待点，AFR 9939。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 939, hold at present position, give way to Airbus 320 vacating via E5.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 939，在当前位置等待，让行经E5脱离的Airbus 320。
cards.referenceText: Holding position, traffic in sight, AFR 9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当前位置等待，看到冲突飞机，AFR 9939。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 939, traffic is clear, continue taxi via A and A1 to holding point Runway 18.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 939，冲突已解除，继续经A和A1滑行至18跑道等待点。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue taxi via A and A1 to holding point Runway 18, AFR 9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续经A和A1滑行至18跑道等待点，AFR 9939。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 939, contact Wuhan Tower on 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 939，联系武汉塔台124.35。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point A1, Runway 18, you have completed pre-takeoff checklist, you are ready for takeoff, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你在A1等待点、18跑道，起飞前检查单已完成，准备好起飞，请联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 9939, holding point A1, Runway 18, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 9939，A1等待点，18跑道，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 939, line up Runway 18.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 939，进入18跑道。
cards.referenceText: Line up Runway 18, AFR 9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进入18跑道，AFR 9939。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 939, cleared for takeoff Runway 18, surface wind calm.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 939，18跑道可以起飞，地面静风。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff Runway 18, AFR 9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 18跑道可以起飞，AFR 9939。

cards.audioText: B: During takeoff role, you notice an Airbus 320 is crossing your runway, you aborted takeoff, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 起飞滑跑过程中，你发现一架Airbus 320正在穿越你的跑道，你中断起飞，请向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 9939, we aborted takeoff due an A320 crossing Runway 18.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 9939，因一架A320穿越18跑道，我们中断起飞。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 939, what is the situation like now?
B: Tell the controller your brakes have exceeded the temperature limit, and request taxi back to apron to have the plane checked.
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：AFR 939，现在情况如何？
告诉管制员刹车已超过温度限制，并申请滑回机坪检查飞机。
cards.referenceText: Our brakes are overheating, request taxi back to apron for check, AFR 9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们刹车过热，申请滑回机坪检查，AFR 9939。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 939, expedite vacate via E1.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 939，尽快经E1脱离。
cards.referenceText: Expedite vacate via E1, AFR 9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 尽快经E1脱离，AFR 9939。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 939, do you need any assistance?
B: Tell the controller you need stair vehicle to disembark the passengers.
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：AFR 939，你需要任何协助吗？
告诉管制员需要客梯车让旅客下机。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, we need stair vehicle to disembark the passengers, AFR 9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 需要，我们需要客梯车让旅客下机，AFR 9939。

topics.name: AFR 113 发动机失效 乘客医疗 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is AFR 113, you're holding at holding point E1, Runway 04, you are fully ready.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 AFR 113，你在 E1 等待点，跑道 04，已完全准备好。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 113, holding at holding point E1, Runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 113，在 E1 等待点，跑道 04，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 113, hold at present position.
cards.audioTextZh: C：AFR 113，在当前位置等待。
cards.referenceText: Hold at present position, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在当前位置等待，AFR 113。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 113, hold at present position, do you have the traffic on short final in sight?
B: Tell the controller yes.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：AFR 113，在当前位置等待，你看到短五边航空器了吗？
B：告诉管制员看到了。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, traffic in sight, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 肯定，看到航空器，AFR 113。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 113, behind the CES 737 on short final, line up behind.
cards.audioTextZh: C：AFR 113，跟在短五边的 CES 737 后面，跟随其后进跑道。
cards.referenceText: Behind the CES 737 on short final, line up behind, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟在短五边的 CES 737 后面，跟随其后进跑道，AFR 113。

cards.audioText: AFR 113, cleared for takeoff, when airborne, contact departure 120.2
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 113，许可起飞，离地后联系离场 120.2。
cards.referenceText: cleared for takeoff, 120.2, AFR 113.

cards.audioText: B: You are passing 900 meters, contact Wuhan Departure, ask if you can cancel the SID and proceed to LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你正通过 900 米，联系武汉离场，询问是否可以取消 SID 并直飞 LKO。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR 113, passing 900 meters, request cancel the SID and proceed to LKO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，AFR 113，正通过 900 米，请求取消 SID 并直飞 LKO。

cards.audioText: AFR 113, radar identified, continue climb to 2,400 meters, turn right to LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 113，雷达识别，继续爬升至 2,400 米，右转直飞 LKO。
cards.referenceText: continue climb to 2400 meters, turn right, LKO, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续爬升至 2400 米，右转，LKO，AFR 113。

cards.audioText: AFR 113, climb to 4500 meters and contact Wuhan control 119.7.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 113，爬升至 4500 米，并联系武汉管制 119.7。
cards.referenceText: climb to 4,500 meters; 119.7, AFR 113.

cards.audioText: B: Your position is just over LKO, the next waypoint is DAPRO, ETA at time 34, make the standard position report and request climb.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的位置刚好在 LKO 上空，下一个航路点是 DAPRO，预计到达时间 34，做标准位置报告并请求爬升。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR 113, over LKO, ETA DAPRO 34, request climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR 113，飞越 LKO，预计 DAPRO 34，请求爬升。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 113, climb to 5100 meters, no speed restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 113，爬升至5100米，无速度限制。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 5100 meters, no speed restriction, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至5100米，无速度限制，AFR 113。

cards.audioText: B: During the climb, your port engine fails, tell the controller this situation and you would like to return to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 爬升过程中左发失效，请向管制员报告情况并申请返航着陆。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, AFR 113, our port engine fails, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，AFR 113，我们左发失效，申请返航着陆。

cards.audioText: C: Roger PAN, AFR 113, descend to 1800 meters, turn right heading 360.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：收到紧急信号，AFR 113，下降至1800米，右转航向360。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1800 meters, turn right heading 360, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至1800米，右转航向360，AFR 113。

cards.audioText: AFR 113, contact approach 119.85.
B: Your altitude is 1800 meters, you have information S, contact Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你当前高度1800米，已收到通播S，请联系进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 113, 1800 meters, information S.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 113，1800米，通播S。

cards.audioText:
AFR 113, current information is T, descend to 900 meters, expect radar vectors for ILS Runway 36L.
B: Read back and ask to use Runway 36R to land due to performance limitations.
cards.audioTextZh:
AFR 113，当前情报为 T，下降至 900 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36L。
B： 复诵，并因性能限制请求使用 Runway 36R 落地。
cards.referenceText: information T, descend to 900 meters; request Runway 36R due performance, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 情报 T，下降至 900 米；因性能限制请求 Runway 36R，AFR 113。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 113, Change landing Runway 36R.
B: You have just got the information from the cabin that one of your passengers suffered stroke during the incident. Inform the controller and ask for ambulance after landing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： AFR 113，更改落地跑道为 Runway 36R。
B： 你刚刚从客舱获悉，一名乘客在此次事件中突发中风。通知管制员，并请求落地后安排救护车。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, one of our passengers suffered stroke, request ambulance after landing, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: Runway 36R，我们的一名乘客突发中风，请求落地后安排救护车，AFR 113。

cards.audioText: C: roger AFR 113, we will notify airport medical assistance, now turn left heading 330, descend to 600 meters, cleared ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C： 收到，AFR 113，我们将通知机场医疗救助。现在左转航向 330，下降至 600 米，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: roger, thanks, turn left heading 330, descend to 600 meters, cleared ILS approach Runway 36R, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，左转航向 330，下降至 600 米，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，AFR 113。

cards.audioText: B: Report that you have intercepted the localizer for RWY 36 right.
cards.audioTextZh: B： 报告你已截获 Runway 36R 的航向道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 113, established on the localizer Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 113，已建立在 Runway 36R 航向道上。

cards.audioText: AFR 113, contact tower 124.35

topics.name: AFR 101 发动机失效 积冰/防冰 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is AFR 101, you are at Wuhan Airport, at Gate 215, information G received, request ATC clearance to Paris.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是AFR 101，位于武汉机场215号登机口，已收到通播G，申请前往巴黎的空管放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR 101, gate 215, information G, request ATC clearance to Paris.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，AFR 101，215号登机口，通播G，申请前往巴黎的空管放行许可。

cards.audioText: AFR 101, cleared to Paris via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb to 1,800 meters, cruising level 10,700 meters, Runway 04, contact departure on 119.7, squawk 2521.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 101，许可按飞行计划航路飞往巴黎，执行 LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1,800 米，巡航高度 10,700 米，Runway 04，联系离场 119.7，应答机 2521。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Paris via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1800 meters, cruising level 1700 meters, departure Runway 04, after departure, contact 119.7, squawk 2521, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往巴黎，执行 LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1800 米，巡航高度 1700 米，离场使用 Runway 04，离场后联系 119.7，应答机 2521，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: You decide that 10700 meters is not acceptable due to heavy weight, ask if 9500 meters is available.
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为由于重量过大，10700 米不可接受，询问 9500 米是否可用。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR 101, 1700 meters is not acceptable due to heavy weight, is 9500 meters available?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，AFR 101，由于重量过大，1700 米不可接受，9500 米是否可用？

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, cleared cruising level 9500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，巡航高度改为9500米。
cards.referenceText: Cleared cruising level 9500 meters, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 巡航高度9500米，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Ground control.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已准备好推出和开车，请联系地面管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR 101, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR 101，申请推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, push back and start up approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，可以推出和开车，机头向东。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing east, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出和开车，机头向东，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: You are now on taxiway Z4 with your engines running, ask Ground control for taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在在Z4滑行道，发动机已启动，请向地面管制申请滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR 101, taxiway Z4, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR 101，Z4滑行道，申请滑行。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway Z4 and A, hold short of A4.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，经滑行道Z4和A滑行至04跑道等待点，A4外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway Z4 and A, hold short of A4, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道Z4和A滑行至04跑道等待点，A4外等待，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: AFR 101, give way to B737 vacating on E3, when traffic is clear, continue taxi via taxiway A and A9, hold short of Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 101，给正在 E3 脱离的 B737 让行，相关航空器通过后，经 A 和 A9 滑行道继续滑行，在 Runway 04 前等待。
cards.referenceText: give way to Boeing 737 vacating on E tree, after traffic is clear, continue taxi via taxiway A and A niner, hold short of Runway 04, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 给正在 E3 脱离的 Boeing 737 让行，相关航空器通过后，经 A 和 A9 滑行道继续滑行，在 Runway 04 前等待，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne at 600 meters climbing, contact Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已离地，600米爬升中，请联系离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR 101, airborne, 600 meters climbing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，AFR 101，已离地，600米爬升中。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, radar contact, turn left, direct to DA, climb to 3000 meters on QNH 1015.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，雷达联系，左转直飞DA，按QNH 1015爬升至3000米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left, direct to DA, climb to 3000 meters on QNH 1015, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞DA，按QNH 1015爬升至3000米，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: AFR 101, climb to 6000 meters, expedite passing 3900m.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 101，爬升至 6000 米，加速爬升直至通过 3900m。
cards.referenceText: climb to and maintain 6000 meters, expedite climb until passing 3900, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 6000 米，加速爬升直至通过 3900，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: You are experiencing moderate icing while maintaining 6000 meters, request higher level and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: 保持6000米时遇到中度结冰，请申请更高高度并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR 101, we are experiencing moderate icing at 6000 meters, request higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，AFR 101，我们在6000米遇到中度结冰，申请更高高度。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, negative due traffic, maintain 6000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，因冲突飞机不能同意，保持6000米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, maintain 6000 meters, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，保持6000米，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: Suddenly your left engine has failed at 6000 meters, make an urgency call to ATC and request to descend and return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的左发突然在 6000 米失效，向 ATC 发出紧急呼叫，并请求下降和返回武汉机场落地。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Departure, AFR 101, our left engine failed at 6000 meters, request descent and return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，武汉离场，AFR 101，我们的左发在 6000 米失效，请求下降并返回武汉机场落地。

cards.audioText: AFR 101, roger your PAN call, descend to 4,200 meters, turn left heading 010, expect radar vector to Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 101，收到你的 PAN 呼叫，下降至 4,200 米，左转航向 010，预计雷达引导至 Runway 04。
cards.referenceText: descend to 4200 meters, turn left heading 010, expect radar vector to Runway 04, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 4200 米，左转航向 010，预计雷达引导至 Runway 04，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, continue descent to 3000 meters on QNH 1015.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，按QNH 1015继续下降至3000米。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to 3000 meters on QNH 1015, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按QNH 1015继续下降至3000米，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have successfully restarted the left engine, but you still decide to return to Wuhan for safety concerns, inform ATC about the current situation and cancel the Urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已成功重启左发，但出于安全考虑仍决定返回武汉，请告知空管当前情况并取消紧急状态。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 101, cancel urgency, we have restarted our left engine, but we still want to return to land for safety concerns.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 101，取消紧急状态，我们已重启左发，但出于安全考虑仍希望返回落地。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are established on the ILS approach Runway 04, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已建立04跑道ILS进近，请联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 101, established on the ILS approach Runway 04.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 101，已建立04跑道ILS进近。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, surface wind 070 degrees, 5 meters per second, Runway 04, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，地面风070度，5米/秒，04跑道，可以落地。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land Runway 04, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以04跑道落地，AFR 101。

topics.name: AFR 896 颠簸 积冰/防冰 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: Your call sign is AFR 896, you are from Paris to Wuhan. You are flying at 11,300 meters, approaching XIY. Call Xi'an Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 AFR 896，正从巴黎飞往武汉。你正以 11,300 米飞行，接近 XIY。呼叫西安管制。
cards.referenceText: Control, AFR 896, 2300 meters, XIY.
cards.referenceTextZh: 管制，AFR 896，2300 米，XIY。

cards.audioText: You check with Xi'an Control if there is any turbulence reported by previous aircraft at 10700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 向西安管制核实前机是否在 10700 米报告过颠簸。
cards.referenceText: Control, AFR 896, is there any turbulence, reported, 1700 meters?
cards.referenceTextZh: 管制，AFR 896，1700 米是否有颠簸报告？

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 896, you are the first aircraft in my sector. There is no report here.
B: Tell the controller you want to descent to 10,700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： AFR 896，你是我管制区内的第一架航空器。这里没有报告。
B： 告诉管制员你想下降至 10,700 米。
cards.referenceText: request descend to 1700 meters, AFR 896, .
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求下降至 1700 米，AFR 896。

cards.audioText: AFR 896, descend and maintain 10,700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 896，下降并保持 10,700 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 1700 meters, AFR 896.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 1700 米，AFR 896。

cards.audioText: You are experiencing severe turbulence at 10,700 meters. The pitot static heating feature has malfunctioned. You want to fly back to 11300 meters to avoid turbulence and ice area. This is an urgent call.
cards.audioTextZh: 你在 10,700 米遭遇严重颠簸。空速管静压加温功能发生故障。你想爬升回 11300 米，以避开颠簸和结冰区。这是紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Control, AFR 896, severe turbulence, 1007 hudnred meters, pitot static heating feature malfunctioned, request climb to 2300 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，管制，AFR 896，严重颠簸，1007 hudnred 米，空速管静压加温功能发生故障，请求爬升至 2300 米。

cards.audioText: AFR 896, climb and maintain 11300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 896，爬升并保持 11300 米。
cards.referenceText: climb and maintain 2300 meters, AFR 896.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 2300 米，AFR 896。

cards.audioText: AFR 896, Contact Zhengzhou Control on 132.35.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 896，联系郑州管制 132.35。

cards.audioText: AFR 896, radar contact. Direct to ZHO, descend to 11,000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 896，雷达识别。直飞 ZHO，下降至 11,000 米。
cards.referenceText: Direct to ZHO, descend to 2000 meters, AFR 896.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 ZHO，下降至 2000 米，AFR 896。

cards.audioText: Ask Zhengzhou Control to climb to 11,600 meters due icing.
cards.audioTextZh: 因积冰向郑州管制请求爬升至 11,600 米。
cards.referenceText: Control, AFR 896, request climb to 2600 meters due icing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 管制，AFR 896，因积冰请求爬升至 2600 米。

cards.audioText: AFR 896, Climb to 11,600 meters.
cards.referenceText: Climb to 2600 meters, AFR 896.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 2600 米，AFR 896。

cards.audioText: You have established contact with Wuhan Control, initiated descend for Runway 36R. During descending, airspeed and altitude readings are abnormal, possibly due to ice blockage. advise Wuhan Control this situation. this is an urgent call.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已与武汉管制建立联系，并开始下降前往 Runway 36R。下降期间，空速和高度读数异常，可能是结冰堵塞所致。向武汉管制通报情况。这是紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Control, AFR 896, airspeed and altitude readings, abnormal, due ice blockage.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，管制，AFR 896，空速和高度读数异常，因结冰堵塞。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 896, turn right heading 240.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 896，右转航向240。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, AFR 896.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向240，AFR 896。

cards.audioText: Tell controller that your GPS altitude and groundspeed is not accurate compared to barometric indications, but you can still maintain a stable flight. request descend to leave icing area.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉管制员，与气压指示相比，你的 GPS 高度和地速不准确，但仍能保持稳定飞行。请求下降以离开结冰区。
cards.referenceText: AFR 896, our GPS altitude and groundspeed, not accurate, maintain a stable flight, request descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: AFR 896，我们的 GPS 高度和地速不准确，能够保持稳定飞行，请求下降。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 896, descend to 3600 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 896，下降至3600米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 3600 meters, AFR 896.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至3600米，AFR 896。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 896, Radar shows you are at 4800 meters. What's your current GPS altitude?
B: Tell the controller GPS altitude is 3600 meters, request descend to 1,800 meters.
P: Wuhan Approach, AFR 896, our GPS altitude is 3600 meters, request descend to 1,800 meters.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： AFR 896，雷达显示你位于 4800 米。你当前的 GPS 高度是多少？
B： 告诉管制员 GPS 高度为 3600 米，请求下降至 1,800 米。
P： 武汉进近，AFR 896，我们的 GPS 高度为 3600 米，请求下降至 1,800 米。
cards.referenceText: AFR 896, our GPS altitude is 3600 meters, request descent to 1800 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: AFR 896，我们的 GPS 高度为 3600 米，请求下降至 1800 米。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 896, Another aircraft has information with regards to the differences between his barometric and GPS altitude. I have him on 3000 meters, his reported GPS is 3600 meters.
B: acknowledge the transmission and request further descent and leave icing area.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： AFR 896，另一架航空器提供了其气压高度与 GPS 高度差异的信息。我掌握的该机高度是 3000 米，其报告的 GPS 高度为 3600 米。
B： 确认收到，并请求进一步下降以离开结冰区。
cards.referenceText: request further descent, AFR 896.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求进一步下降，AFR 896。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 896, contact Tower on 124.35, we have informed them your altimeter errors.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 896，联系塔台124.35，我们已通知他们你的高度表误差。
cards.referenceText: 124.35, roger, thanks, AFR 896.

cards.audioText: B: You left the icing area and your instruments have returned to normal, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已离开结冰区域，仪表恢复正常，请向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 896, we left the icing area and our instruments have returned to normal.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 896，我们已离开结冰区域，仪表已恢复正常。

cards.audioText: You have established on the ILS Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 896, established on the ILS Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 896，已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。

cards.audioText: AFR 896, wind calm Runway 36R, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 896，静风，Runway 36R，许可落地。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, cleared to land, AFR 896.
cards.referenceTextZh: Runway 36R，许可落地，AFR 896。

topics.name: AFR 941 发动机失效 TCAS机动 延误/加油

cards.audioText: Your call sign is AFR 941, you are descending through 3900m for 3600 meters.Contact Wuhan approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 AFR 941，正通过 3900m 下降至 3600 米。联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Approach, AFR 941, 3900, 3600 meters.

cards.audioText: AFR 941, Wuhan approach, radar identified, information E is current, descend to and maintain 3000 meterson QNH 1004.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 941，武汉进近，雷达识别，E 情报有效，在 QNH 1004 上下降至并保持 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: information E, descend, 3000 meters, QNH, 1004, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: E 情报，下降，3000 米，QNH 1004，AFR 941。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 941, descend and maintain 2,400 meters, reduce to minimum clean speed.
B: Read back the instruction and tell the controller that the clean configuration speed of your aircraft is 200 knots.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： AFR 941，下降并保持 2,400 米，将速度减至最小光洁构型速度。
B： 复诵指令，并告诉管制员你的航空器光洁构型速度为 200 节。
cards.referenceText: descend and maintain 2400 meters, reduce to minimum clean speed, 200 knots, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 2400 米，将速度减至最小光洁构型速度，200 节，AFR 941。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 941, turn right heading 300, you are number 3, 25 miles from touchdown.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，右转航向300，你是第三架，距接地点25海里。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 300, roger, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向300，收到，AFR 941。

cards.audioText: AFR 941, turn left proceed direct DA, descend to and maintain 2,100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 941，左转直飞 DA，下降至并保持 2,100 米。
cards.referenceText: turn left, direct to DAL A, descend to 2100 meters, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转，直飞 DAL A，下降至 2100 米，AFR 941。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 941, hold at DA as published.
B: Read back and ask the reason for holding.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，在DA按公布程序等待。请复诵并询问等待原因。
cards.referenceText: Hold at DA as published, what's the reason for holding? AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在DA按公布程序等待，请问等待原因？AFR 941。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 941, they are having a runway inspection at the moment, expect to delay more than 15 minutes.
B: Read back the ATC instruction and report that you are entering the hold.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： AFR 941，目前正在进行跑道检查，预计延误超过 15 分钟。
B： 复诵 ATC 指令，并报告你正进入等待。
cards.referenceText: roger, (runway inspection, expect delay more than 15 minutes, ) entering the hold, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，（跑道检查，预计延误超过 15 分钟，）正在进入等待，AFR 941。

cards.audioText: The EGT of your starboard (=right) engine is fluctuating, state this situation to the controller. Ask to leave the holding pattern right away (=immediately).
cards.audioTextZh: 你的右发 EGT 正在波动，向管制员说明情况。请求立即离开等待航线。
cards.referenceText: Approach, AFR 941, EGT, starboard engine is fluctuating, unstable request leave the holding pattern.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，AFR 941，右发 EGT 波动、不稳定，请求离开等待航线。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 941, roger, stand by, continue your hold, we are changing the landing sequence, expect to call you in 2 min.
B: The oil pressure of your starboard engine is rapidly decreasing, state this situation to the controller, request immediate exit and request descent.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： AFR 941，收到，等待，继续等待，我们正在调整落地顺序，预计 2 分钟后呼叫你。
B： 你的右发滑油压力正在迅速下降，向管制员说明情况，请求立即退出并请求下降。
cards.referenceText: oil pressure, starboard engine, rapidly decreasing, request immediate exit, descent, AFR 941
cards.referenceTextZh: 右发滑油压力正在迅速下降，请求立即退出、下降，AFR 941。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 941, standby, traffic at your 3 o'clock position is maintaining 1,800 meters crossing from your right to left, report visual.
B: Tell the controller you have seen the conflicting aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： AFR 941，等待，你 3 点钟方向的航空器正保持 1,800 米，从你的右侧向左侧穿越，看到后报告。
B： 告诉管制员你已看到冲突航空器。
cards.referenceText: traffic in sight, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 已看到相关航空器，AFR 941。

cards.audioText: B: Your starboard engine has failed, make an Urgency call and ask for landing priority.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的右发已经失效，请发出紧急信号并申请优先落地。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, AFR 941, our starboard engine has failed, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉进近，AFR 941，我们右发失效，申请优先落地。

cards.audioText: AFR 941, roger PAN. Turn left heading 060, descend to 900 meters, cleared ILS approach Runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 941，收到 PAN，左转航向 060，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36L。
cards.referenceText: Turn left, heading 060, descend to 900 meters, cleared ILS approach Runway 36L, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 060，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36L，AFR 941。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 941, contact Wuhan Tower, frequency 124.35, goodbye.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，联系武汉塔台，频率124.35，再见。

cards.audioText: B: Your heading is 060 and your altitude is 900 meters, contact Wuhan Tower and tell him about the condition of the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 你当前航向060，高度900米，请联系武汉塔台并说明飞机状况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 941, heading 060, 900 meters, our starboard engine has failed, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 941，航向060，900米，我们右发失效，申请优先落地。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, AFR 941, maintain present heading.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：收到，AFR 941，保持当前航向。
cards.referenceText: Maintain present heading, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前航向，AFR 941。

cards.audioText: AFR 941, turn left heading 030 to intercept the localizer for Runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 941，左转航向 030，切入 Runway 36L 航向道。
cards.referenceText: turn left heading 030 to intercept the localizer for Runway 36L, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 030，切入 Runway 36L 航向道，AFR 941。

cards.audioText: Report you have established localizer Runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 报告你已建立 Runway 36L 航向道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 941, established localizer Runway 36L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 941，已建立 Runway 36L 航向道。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 941, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，可以落地。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以落地，AFR 941。

topics.name: AFR 675 起落架问题 襟翼问题 雷暴绕飞

cards.audioText: Your call sign is AFR 675, a flight from Guangzhou to Wuhan, you have just been handed over from Guangzhou Control to Wuhan Control, you are over DAPRO, maintaining 10,100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 AFR 675，这是一趟从广州飞往武汉的航班，刚从广州管制移交至武汉管制，位于 DAPRO 上空，正保持 10,100 米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR 675, over DAPRO, maintaining 1100 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR 675，位于 DAPRO 上空，正保持 1100 米。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 675, omit position reports.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 675，免报位置。
cards.referenceText: Omit position reports, AFR 675.
cards.referenceTextZh: 免报位置，AFR 675。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar indicates there is a cumulonimbus ahead, report the situation to Wuhan Control and ask for 20 miles deviation to the west.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的气象雷达显示前方有积雨云，请向武汉管制报告情况，并申请向西偏航20海里。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR 675, our weather radar indicates there is a cumulonimbus ahead, request 20 miles deviation to the west.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR 675，我们气象雷达显示前方有积雨云，申请向西偏航20海里。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 675, negative due prohibited area.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 675，因禁区不能同意。
cards.referenceText: Roger, AFR 675.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，AFR 675。

cards.audioText: B: Now you find the navigation performance has been downgraded, report this to ATC and ask them to verify your flight track.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你发现导航性能下降，请向空管报告，并请他们核实你的飞行航迹。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR 675, the navigation performance has been downgraded, request verify our flight track.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR 675，导航性能下降，请核实我们的飞行航迹。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 675, you are still on track.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 675，你仍在航迹上。
cards.referenceText: Roger, AFR 675.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，AFR 675。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar has failed, tell Wuhan Control you'd like to divert to Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的气象雷达失效，请告诉武汉管制你希望备降武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR 675, our weather radar has failed, request divert to Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR 675，我们气象雷达失效，申请备降武汉机场。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 675, turn left, direct to WHA, descend to 5100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 675，左转直飞WHA，下降至5100米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left, direct to WHA, descend to 5100 meters, AFR 675.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞WHA，下降至5100米，AFR 675。

cards.audioText: B: Ask Wuhan Control for the current weather information at Wuhan.
cards.audioTextZh: 向武汉管制询问武汉当前天气信息。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR 675, request the current weather information at Wuhan.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR 675，请求武汉当前天气信息。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 675, the weather at Wuhan is fine.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 675，武汉天气良好。
cards.referenceText: Roger, AFR 675.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，AFR 675。

cards.audioText: B: During approach, you find your flaps are jammed, tell Wuhan Approach you want to terminate the approach and hold at WHA for trouble-shooting.
cards.audioTextZh: 进近过程中，你发现襟翼卡阻，请告诉武汉进近你希望终止进近，并在WHA等待排故。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 675, our flaps are jammed, request terminate the approach and hold at WHA for trouble-shooting.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 675，我们襟翼卡阻，申请终止进近并在WHA等待排故。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 675, direct to WHA, climb and maintain 900 meters, hold as published.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 675，直飞WHA，爬升并保持900米，按公布程序等待。
cards.referenceText: Direct to WHA, climb and maintain 900 meters, hold as published, AFR 675.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞WHA，爬升并保持900米，按公布程序等待，AFR 675。

cards.audioText: B: After completing the checklist, your flaps are still jammed, tell Wuhan Approach you intend to land at the longest runway, because the touchdown speed will be very high due flapless landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 完成检查单后，襟翼仍然卡阻。告诉武汉进近你打算在最长跑道落地，因为无襟翼着陆会导致接地速度很高。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 675, our flaps are still jammed, request land at the longest runway due the touchdown speed will be very high due flapless landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 675，我们襟翼仍然卡阻；由于无襟翼着陆接地速度会很高，申请使用最长跑道落地。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 675, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R.
B: read back the ATC instructions and ask the controller the braking action of Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： AFR 675，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
B： 复诵 ATC 指令，并询问管制员 Runway 36R 的刹车效应。
cards.referenceText: cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R, request the braking action of Runway 36R, AFR 675.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，请求 Runway 36R 的刹车效应，AFR 675。

cards.audioText: AFR 675, braking action Runway 36R good.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 675，Runway 36R 刹车效应好。
cards.referenceText: braking action Runway 36R good, AFR 675.
cards.referenceTextZh: Runway 36R 刹车效应好，AFR 675。

cards.audioText: B: You have skidded off the runway after landing, your nose wheel was bogged, report it to Wuhan Ground and request emergency assistance.
cards.audioTextZh: 落地后你冲出跑道，前轮陷住，请向武汉地面报告并申请应急援助。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR 675, we have skidded off the runway after landing, our nose wheel was bogged, request emergency assistance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR 675，我们落地后冲出跑道，前轮陷住，申请应急援助。

cards.audioText: AFR 675, the tug is on the way.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 675，牵引车正在赶来。
cards.referenceText: roger, thanks, AFR 675.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，AFR 675。

topics.name: AFR 9939 刹车问题 积冰/防冰 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is AFR 939, a flight from Wuhan to Beijing, you are parking at gate 07, you have received information H, request ATC clearance from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是AFR 939，从武汉飞往北京，停在07号登机口，已收到通播H，向武汉放行申请空管放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR 9939, gate 07, information H, request ATC clearance to Beijing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，AFR 9939，07号登机口，通播H，申请前往北京的空管放行许可。

cards.audioText: AFR 939, cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, departure Runway 18, ZF-02 departure, initial climb 2700 meters, request level change en route, departure frequency 127.35, squawk 2615.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 939，许可按飞行计划航路飞往北京，离场使用 Runway 18，执行 ZF-02 离场，初始爬升至 2700 米，途中申请改变高度，离场频率 127.35，应答机 2615。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, departure Runway 18, ZF-02 departure, initial climb 2700, request level change en route, departure frequency 127.35, squawk 2615, AFR 9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往北京，离场使用 Runway 18，执行 ZF-02 离场，初始爬升至 2700，途中申请改变高度，离场频率 127.35，应答机 2615，AFR 9939。

cards.audioText: Now you are ready for pushback and startup, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR 939, request pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR 939，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 939, push back and start up approved, facing east.
B: Tell the controller you have difficulty in starting the engines with strong tailwind, you want to change the push back position in face west.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 939，可以推出和开车，机头向东。告诉管制员，强顺风下发动机启动有困难，希望改为机头向西的推出位置。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing east, but we have difficulty in starting the engines with strong tailwind, request change the push back position in face west, AFR 9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出和开车，机头向东，但强顺风下发动机启动有困难，申请改为机头向西推出，AFR 9939。

cards.audioText: Now you have completed pushback and startup procedures, you are ready for taxi, request taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已完成推出和开车程序，准备滑行，请求滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR 939, pushback and startup completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR 939，推出和开车已完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 939, taxi to holding point Runway 18 via taxiway Z4, A and A1.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 939，经滑行道Z4、A和A1滑行至18跑道等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 18 via taxiway Z4, A and A1, AFR 9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道Z4、A和A1滑行至18跑道等待点，AFR 9939。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 939, hold at present position, give way to Airbus 320 vacating via E5.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 939，在当前位置等待，让行经E5脱离的Airbus 320。
cards.referenceText: Holding position, traffic in sight, AFR 9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当前位置等待，看到冲突飞机，AFR 9939。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 939, traffic is clear, continue taxi via A and A1 to holding point Runway 18.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 939，冲突已解除，继续经A和A1滑行至18跑道等待点。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue taxi via A and A1 to holding point Runway 18, AFR 9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续经A和A1滑行至18跑道等待点，AFR 9939。

cards.audioText: AFR 939, contact Wuhan Tower on 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 939，联系武汉塔台 124.35。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point A1, Runway 18, you have completed pre-takeoff checklist, you are ready for takeoff, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你在A1等待点、18跑道，起飞前检查单已完成，准备好起飞，请联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 9939, holding point A1, Runway 18, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 9939，A1等待点，18跑道，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: AFR 939, line up Runway 18.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 939，进入 Runway 18。
cards.referenceText: line up Runway 18, AFR 939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进入 Runway 18，AFR 939。

cards.audioText: AFR 939, cleared for takeoff Runway 18, surface wind calm.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 939，许可从 Runway 18 起飞，地面静风。
cards.referenceText: cleared for takeoff Runway 18, AFR 939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可从 Runway 18 起飞，AFR 939。

cards.audioText: During takeoff roll, you notice an Airbus 3 20 is crossing your runway, you aborted takeoff, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 起飞滑跑期间，你注意到一架 Airbus 320 正在穿越跑道，你中断了起飞，向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 9939, we aborted takeoff due an Airbus 320 crossing Runway 18.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 9939，因一架 Airbus 320 正在穿越 Runway 18，我们中断了起飞。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 939, what is the situation like now?
B: Tell the controller your brakes have exceeded the temperature limit, and request taxi back to apron to have the plane checked.
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：AFR 939，现在情况如何？
告诉管制员刹车已超过温度限制，并申请滑回机坪检查飞机。
cards.referenceText: Our brakes are overheating, request taxi back to apron for check, AFR 9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们刹车过热，申请滑回机坪检查，AFR 9939。

cards.audioText: AFR 939, expedite vacate via E1.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 939，经 E1 加速脱离。
cards.referenceText: expedite vacate via E1, AFR 939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 E1 加速脱离，AFR 939。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 939, do you need any assistance?
B: Tell the controller you need stair vehicle to disembark the passengers.
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：AFR 939，你需要任何协助吗？
告诉管制员需要客梯车让旅客下机。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, we need stair vehicle to disembark the passengers, AFR 9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 需要，我们需要客梯车让旅客下机，AFR 9939。

topics.name: AFR 101 发动机失效 积冰/防冰 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is AFR 101, you are at Wuhan Airport, at Gate 215, information G received, request ATC clearance to Paris.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是AFR 101，位于武汉机场215号登机口，已收到通播G，申请前往巴黎的空管放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR 101, gate 215, information G, request ATC clearance to Paris.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，AFR 101，215号登机口，通播G，申请前往巴黎的空管放行许可。

cards.audioText: AFR 101, cleared to Paris via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb to 1,800 meters, cruising level 10,700 meters, Runway 04, contact departure on 119.7, squawk 2521.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 101，许可按飞行计划航路飞往巴黎，执行 LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1,800 米，巡航高度 10,700 米，Runway 04，联系离场 119.7，应答机 2521。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Paris via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1800 meters, cruising level 1700 meters, departure Runway 04, after departure, contact 119.7, squawk 2521, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往巴黎，执行 LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1800 米，巡航高度 1700 米，离场使用 Runway 04，离场后联系 119.7，应答机 2521，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: You decide that 10700 meters is not acceptable due to heavy weight, ask if 9500 meters is available.
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为由于重量过大，10700 米不可接受，询问 9500 米是否可用。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR 101, 1007 hudnred meters is not acceptable due to heavy weight, is 9500 meters available?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，AFR 101，由于重量过大，1007 hudnred 米不可接受，9500 米是否可用？

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, cleared cruising level 9500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，巡航高度改为9500米。
cards.referenceText: Cleared cruising level 9500 meters, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 巡航高度9500米，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Ground control.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已准备好推出和开车，请联系地面管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR 101, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR 101，申请推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, push back and start up approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，可以推出和开车，机头向东。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing east, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出和开车，机头向东，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: You are now on taxiway Z4 with your engines running, ask Ground control for taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在在Z4滑行道，发动机已启动，请向地面管制申请滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR 101, taxiway Z4, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR 101，Z4滑行道，申请滑行。

cards.audioText: AFR 101, taxi to holding point Runway 04via Z4 and A, hold short of A4.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 101，经 Z4 和 A 滑行至 Runway 04 等待点，在 A4 前等待。
cards.referenceText: taxi to holding point Runway 04via taxiway Z four and A, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4 和 A 滑行至 Runway 04 等待点，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: AFR 101, give way to B737 vacating on E3, when traffic is clear, continue taxi via taxiway A and A9, hold short of Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 101，给正在 E3 脱离的 B737 让行，相关航空器通过后，经 A 和 A9 滑行道继续滑行，在 Runway 04 前等待。
cards.referenceText: give way to Boeing 737 vacating on E tree, after traffic is clear, continue taxi via taxiway A and A niner, hold short of Runway 04, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 给正在 E3 脱离的 Boeing 737 让行，相关航空器通过后，经 A 和 A9 滑行道继续滑行，在 Runway 04 前等待，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne at 600 meters climbing, contact Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已离地，600米爬升中，请联系离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR 101, airborne, 600 meters climbing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，AFR 101，已离地，600米爬升中。

cards.audioText: AFR 101, radar contact, turn left, direct to DAL A, climb to 3000 meters on QNH1015.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 101，雷达识别，左转直飞 DAL A，在 QNH 1015 上爬升至 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: turn left, direct to DAL A, climb to 3000 meters QNH 1015, AFR 10 one1.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转，直飞 DAL A，在 QNH 1015 上爬升至 3000 米，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: AFR 101, climb to 6000 meters, expedite passing 3900m.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 101，爬升至 6000 米，加速爬升直至通过 3900m。
cards.referenceText: climb to and maintain 6000 meters, expedite climb until passing 3900, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 6000 米，加速爬升直至通过 3900，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: You are experiencing moderate icing while maintaining 6000 meters, request higher level and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: 保持6000米时遇到中度结冰，请申请更高高度并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR 101, we are experiencing moderate icing at 6000 meters, request higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，AFR 101，我们在6000米遇到中度结冰，申请更高高度。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, negative due traffic, maintain 6000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，因冲突飞机不能同意，保持6000米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, maintain 6000 meters, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，保持6000米，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: Suddenly your left engine has failed at 6000 meters, make an urgency call to ATC and request to descend and return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的左发突然在 6000 米失效，向 ATC 发出紧急呼叫，并请求下降和返回武汉机场落地。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Departure, AFR 101, our left engine failed at 6000 meters, request descent and return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，武汉离场，AFR 101，我们的左发在 6000 米失效，请求下降并返回武汉机场落地。

cards.audioText: AFR 101, roger your PAN call, descend to 4,200 meters, turn left heading 010, expect radar vector to Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 101，收到你的 PAN 呼叫，下降至 4,200 米，左转航向 010，预计雷达引导至 Runway 04。
cards.referenceText: descend to 4200 meters, turn left heading 010, expect radar vector to Runway 04, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 4200 米，左转航向 010，预计雷达引导至 Runway 04，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, continue descent to 3000 meters on QNH 1015.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，按QNH 1015继续下降至3000米。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to 3000 meters on QNH 1015, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按QNH 1015继续下降至3000米，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have successfully restarted the left engine, but you still decide to return to Wuhan for safety concerns, inform ATC about the current situation and cancel the Urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已成功重启左发，但出于安全考虑仍决定返回武汉，请告知空管当前情况并取消紧急状态。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 101, cancel urgency, we have restarted our left engine, but we still want to return to land for safety concerns.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 101，取消紧急状态，我们已重启左发，但出于安全考虑仍希望返回落地。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are established on the ILS approach Runway 04, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已建立04跑道ILS进近，请联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 101, established on the ILS approach Runway 04.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 101，已建立04跑道ILS进近。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, surface wind 070 degrees, 5 meters per second, Runway 04, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，地面风070度，5米/秒，04跑道，可以落地。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land Runway 04, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以04跑道落地，AFR 101。

topics.name: AFR 332 烟雾 TCAS机动 备降/返航

cards.audioText: your call sign is AFR 332, a flight from Wuhan to Paris, you are at Gate 305, you have got information L, contact Wuhan Delivery and request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 AFR 332，这是一趟从武汉飞往巴黎的航班，位于 305 登机口，已收到 L 情报，联系武汉放行并申请 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR 332, gate 305, information L, request ATC clearance to Paris.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，AFR 332，305 登机口，L 情报，申请前往巴黎的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText:
C: Station calling Wuhan Delivery, I read you 2.
B: you find you have some problem with your transmitter, inform Wuhan Delivery of your problem and tell the controller you need maintenance check.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： 呼叫武汉放行的电台，我听你为 2。
B： 你发现发射机有问题，向武汉放行报告问题，并告诉管制员你需要维修检查。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR 332, we have some problem with our transmitter, request maintenance check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，AFR 332，我们的发射机有问题，请求维修检查。

cards.audioText: Now you have fixed the transmitter problem and you have copied the ATC clearance, you are ready for pushback and startup, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已修复发射机问题并抄收 ATC 放行许可，已准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR 332, request pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR 332，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: AFR 332, recleared to Paris, departure Runway 36R, ZF-12 departure, the rest unchanged, pushback and startup approved, facing north.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 332，重新许可飞往巴黎，离场使用 Runway 36R，执行 ZF-12 离场，其余不变，推出和开车批准，机头朝北。
cards.referenceText: recleared to Paris, departure Runway 36R, ZF-12 departure, the rest unchanged, pushback and startup approved, facing north, AFR 332.
cards.referenceTextZh: 重新许可飞往巴黎，离场使用 Runway 36R，执行 ZF-12 离场，其余不变，推出和开车批准，机头朝北，AFR 332。

cards.audioText: Now you are airborne, you are climbing to 1,800 meters, you observed a drone at your 10 o'clock above, closing to your flight track, report it to Wuhan Departure and request right turn for avoidance.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已离地，正爬升至 1,800 米，观察到一架无人机位于 10 点钟上方，正在接近你的航迹，向武汉离场报告并请求右转避让。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR 332, airborne, climbing to 1800 meters, we observed a drone at our 10 o'clock above, closing to our flight track, request right turn for avoidance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，AFR 332，已离地，正爬升至 1800 米，我们观察到一架无人机位于 10 点钟上方，正在接近我们的航迹，请求右转避让。

cards.audioText:
AFR 332, Wuhan Departure, roger, turn right heading 270, climb to 2,400 meters, maintain visual separation. When able, could you describe the drone in detail?
B: read back the ATC instructions and tell the controller it's a white drone, crossing from left to right.
cards.audioTextZh:
