cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 11300 米，UAL 403。

cards.audioText: B: Tell Guangzhou Control you request earlier descent because your landing weight exceeds maximum landing weight, and you will request descent now.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉广州管制，因为着陆重量超过最大着陆重量，请求提前下降，并请求现在开始下降。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL 403, request earlier descent due our landing weight exceeds maximum landing weight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL 403，因着陆重量超过最大着陆重量，请求提前下降。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 403, descend to 4500 meters, reach 4500 meters before ATAGA, start descent at own discretion.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 403，下降至 4500 米，在 ATAGA 前达到 4500 米，自主决定开始下降。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 4500 meters, reach 4500 meters before ATAGA, start descent at own discretion, UAL 403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 4500 米，在 ATAGA 前达到 4500 米，自主决定开始下降，UAL 403。

cards.audioText: B: There is an indication of thunderstorm ahead, contact Guangzhou Control and request offset 10 miles right to avoid the weather.
cards.audioTextZh: B：前方有雷暴迹象，联系广州管制，请求向右偏航 10 海里避让天气。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL 403, request offset 10 miles right due CB ahead.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL 403，前方有 CB，请求向右偏航 10 海里。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 403, 10 miles right approved, report clear of weather.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 403，同意向右 10 海里，脱离天气后报告。
cards.referenceText: 10 miles right approved, report clear of weather, UAL 403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意向右 10 海里，脱离天气后报告，UAL 403。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are clear of whether, report the situation to Guangzhou Control and request direct to TON.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已脱离天气，向广州管制报告并请求直飞 TON。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL 403, clear of whether, request direct to TON.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL 403，已脱离天气，请求直飞 TON。

topics.name: UAL 831 后客舱异响 慢释压

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is UAL 831, a flight from Wuhan to San Francisco, you have completed push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground for taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 UAL 831，从武汉飞往旧金山，已完成推出和开车，联系武汉地面获取滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, UAL 831, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，UAL 831，推出开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway F, A7 and A.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，经滑行道 F、A7 和 A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway F, A7 and A, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 F、A7 和 A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, contact Wuhan Tower on 118.65.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，联系武汉塔台118.65。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point Runway 04, you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在在跑道 04 等待点，准备离场，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL 831, holding point Runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL 831，跑道 04 等待点，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, cleared for takeoff Runway 04, surface wind 060, 10 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，跑道 04 可以起飞，地面风 060，10 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff Runway 04, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 04 可以起飞，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, climbing to 1500 meters, contact Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已离地，通过 600 米，爬升至 1500 米，联系武汉离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL 831, airborne, passing 600 meters, climbing to 1500 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，UAL 831，已离地，通过 600 米，爬升至 1500 米。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, cancel SID, direct to HFE, climb to 3900 meters on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，取消 SID，直飞 HFE，按标准气压爬升至 3900 米。
cards.referenceText: Cancel SID, direct to HFE, climb to 3900 meters on standard, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消 SID，直飞 HFE，按标准气压爬升至 3900 米，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: B: During climb, the purser tells you a passenger has heard abnormal noises from the rear cabin, you decide to level off at 2700 meters, advise Wuhan Departure your intention to level off due possible problem in the cabin.
cards.audioTextZh: B：爬升过程中，乘务长告诉你有旅客听到后客舱异常声响，你决定在 2700 米改平，向武汉离场说明因客舱可能存在问题，请求在 2700 米改平。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL 831, a passenger has heard abnormal noises from the rear cabin, request level off at 2700 meters due possible cabin problem.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，UAL 831，有旅客听到后客舱异常声响，因客舱可能存在问题，请求在 2700 米改平。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, climb to and maintain 2700 meters, advise intention.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，爬升并保持 2700 米，报告意图。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 2700 meters, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 2700 米，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: B: The aircraft is leveling, no one else can confirm the noise that the particular passenger heard, you check all the instruments are indicating normally, you decide to continue the flight and request a higher level, call Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：飞机已改平，没有其他人能确认该旅客听到的声音，各仪表指示正常，你决定继续飞行并请求更高高度，呼叫武汉离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL 831, all the instruments are indicating normally, request continue the flight and request a higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，UAL 831，各仪表指示正常，请求继续飞行并请求更高高度。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, climb to 4500 meters on standard, contact Wuhan Control 120.5.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，按标准气压爬升至 4500 米，联系武汉管制120.5。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 4500 meters on standard, 120.5, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按标准气压爬升至 4500 米，120.5，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 10700 meters, over HFE, squawking 5316, make initial contact with Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在保持 10700 米，飞越 HFE，应答机 5316，首次联系上海管制。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL 831, maintaining 10700 meters, over HFE, squawking 5316.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL 831，保持 10700 米，飞越 HFE，应答机 5316。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, Shanghai Control, radar contact, proceed direct to VMB.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，上海管制，雷达识别，直飞 VMB。
cards.referenceText: Proceed direct to VMB, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 VMB，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: B: Now you confirm the strange sound from the cabin, your instrument indicates cabin altitude is rising slowly, slow depressurization is suspected, request immediate descent from 10700 meters to 3000 meters. This is an Urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在确认客舱有异常声音，仪表显示客舱高度缓慢上升，怀疑缓慢释压，请求从 10700 米立即下降至 3000 米。这是紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Shanghai Control, UAL 831, our instrument indicates cabin altitude is rising slowly, suspect slow depressurization, request immediate descent to 3000 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，上海管制，UAL 831，仪表显示客舱高度缓慢上升，怀疑缓慢释压，请求立即下降至 3000 米。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, roger PAN, turn right heading 150, initially descend and maintain 8900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，收到 PAN，右转航向 150，先下降并保持 8900 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 150, descend and maintain 8900 meters, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 150，下降并保持 8900 米，UAL 831。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 831, turn left heading 210, descend to 3300 meters.
B: Read back ATC instructions and request the nearest suitable airport for landing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 831，左转航向 210，下降至 3300 米。
B：复诵管制指令，并请求前往最近合适机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 210, descend to 3300 meters, request the nearest suitable airport for landing, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 210，下降至 3300 米，请求最近合适机场着陆，UAL 831。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 831, the closest airport is Nanjing Airport, current visibility is marginal, I have to check if they can accommodate an aircraft of your size. Hongqiao and Pudong Airport has longer runway and can definitely accommodate your aircraft, advise your intention?
B: Ask radar vector to Shanghai Hongqiao or Pudong Airport which has a better visibility.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 831，最近的机场是南京机场，当前能见度临界，我需要确认他们能否接收你们这种机型。虹桥和浦东机场跑道更长，肯定可以接收，请报告意图。
B：请求雷达引导至上海虹桥或浦东机场，选择能见度较好的机场。
cards.referenceText: Request radar vector to Shanghai Hongqiao or Pudong Airport which has a better visibility, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求雷达引导至上海虹桥或浦东机场，选择能见度较好的机场，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, direct to HSH, expect radar vectors to land at Pudong Airport, contact Shanghai Approach on 128.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，直飞 HSH，预计雷达引导至浦东机场着陆，联系上海进近128.35。
cards.referenceText: Direct to HSH, expect radar vectors to land at Pudong Airport, 128.35, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 HSH，预计雷达引导至浦东机场着陆，128.35，UAL 831。

topics.name: UAL 182 火山灰 双发失效 一发重启不稳定

cards.audioText: B: Your aircraft call sign is UAL 182, you are at the holding point of Runway 04, call Wuhan Tower you are ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的航空器呼号是 UAL 182，在跑道 04 等待点，呼叫武汉塔台，报告准备起飞。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL 182, holding point of Runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL 182，跑道 04 等待点，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 182, behind China Southern Boeing 777 on short final, line up behind Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 182，在短五边 China Southern Boeing 777 后，跟随其后进入跑道 04。
cards.referenceText: Behind CSN B777 on short final, line up behind Runway 04, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟随短五边 CSN B777 后进入跑道 04，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 182, when airborne, turn right heading 070, climb to 3000 meters, cleared for immediate takeoff Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 182，离地后右转航向 070，爬升至 3000 米，跑道 04 可以立即起飞。
cards.referenceText: When airborne, turn right heading 070, climb to 3000 meters, cleared for immediate takeoff Runway 04, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离地后右转航向 070，爬升至 3000 米，跑道 04 可以立即起飞，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne and passing 200 meters, call Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已离地，通过 200 米，呼叫武汉离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL 182, airborne, passing 200 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，UAL 182，已离地，通过 200 米。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 182, after passing 1200 meters, turn left direct to ZF.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 182，通过 1200 米后左转直飞 ZF。
cards.referenceText: After passing 1200 meters, turn left direct to ZF, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通过 1200 米后左转直飞 ZF，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are in London Control area, FL350, you encountered volcanic ash, tell ATC the situation and request descent, call London Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在在伦敦管制区，飞行高度层 350，遭遇火山灰，向 ATC 报告情况并请求下降，呼叫伦敦管制。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL 182, we encountered volcanic ash at FL350, request descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL 182，我们在 FL350 遭遇火山灰，请求下降。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 182, turn right heading 300, descend to FL290.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 182，右转航向 300，下降至飞行高度层 290。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 300, descend to FL290, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 300，下降至 FL290，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: B: Tell ATC you are still in volcanic ash area, both engines are vibrating highly, but aircraft can still be controlled.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉 ATC 你仍在火山灰区域，双发振动严重，但飞机仍可操控。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL 182, we are still in volcanic ash area, both engines are vibrating highly, but aircraft can still be controlled.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL 182，我们仍在火山灰区域，双发振动严重，但飞机仍可操控。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, both engines flamed out, make a Distress call and request land at the nearest airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中，双发熄火，发出遇险呼叫并请求在最近机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, London Control, UAL 182, both engines flamed out, request land at the nearest airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，伦敦管制，UAL 182，双发熄火，请求在最近机场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 182, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 340.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 182，收到 MAYDAY，右转航向 340。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 340, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 340，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: B: 1 engine was successfully restarted during descent, tell ATC the situation.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中 1 台发动机成功重启，告诉 ATC 当前情况。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL 182, 1 engine was successfully restarted during descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL 182，下降过程中 1 台发动机成功重启。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 182, what's your intention?
B: Tell ATC you still need to land at the nearest airport because the running engine is not stable.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 182，你的意图？
B：告诉 ATC 因工作发动机不稳定，仍需在最近机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL 182, request land at the nearest airport due the running engine is not stable.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL 182，因工作发动机不稳定，请求在最近机场着陆。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 182, continue descent to 9000 feet, expect to land at Beatle Airport.
B: Tell controller you are not familiar with Beatle Airport, request airport information.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 182，继续下降至 9000 英尺，预计在 Beatle Airport 着陆。
B：告诉管制员你不熟悉 Beatle Airport，请求机场信息。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to 9000 feet, we are not familiar with Beatle Airport, request airport information, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降至 9000 英尺，我们不熟悉 Beatle Airport，请求机场信息，UAL 182。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 182, Beatle Airport landing Runway 02, elevation 2000 feet, runway 3000 meters long, 45 meters wide, ILS CAT I and II available.
B: Tell ATC you are able to land at this airport.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 182，Beatle Airport 使用着陆跑道 02，机场标高 2000 英尺，跑道长 3000 米、宽 45 米，可用 ILS CAT I 和 II。
B：告诉 ATC 你可以在该机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL 182, we are able to land at this airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL 182，我们可以在该机场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 182, continue descent to 5000 feet and contact Approach 121.3.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 182，继续下降至 5000 英尺，联系进近 121.3。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to 5000 feet and contact Approach 121.3, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降至 5000 英尺，联系进近 121.3，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: B: Contact Approach, tell them your emergency situation.
cards.audioTextZh: B：联系进近，告知他们你的紧急情况。
cards.referenceText: Approach, UAL 182, we encountered volcanic ash, both engines flamed out, 1 engine was successfully restarted but not stable.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，UAL 182，我们遭遇火山灰，双发熄火，1 台发动机已成功重启但不稳定。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 182, roger your situation, runway is at your 2 o'clock, 10 miles, report airfield in sight.
B: Tell ATC you see the airport.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 182，收到你的情况，跑道在你 2 点钟方向 10 海里，看到机场后报告。
B：告诉 ATC 你看到机场。
cards.referenceText: Approach, UAL 182, airfield in sight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，UAL 182，已看到机场。

cards.audioText: B: Tell Approach you need emergency services to be ready near the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉进近你需要应急服务在跑道附近待命。
cards.referenceText: Approach, UAL 182, request emergency services to be ready near the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，UAL 182，请求应急服务在跑道附近待命。

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is UAL 805 on a flight to Guangzhou, you are approaching WXI, maintaining 11000 meters, squawking 6527, contact Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 UAL 805，飞往广州，正在接近 WXI，保持 11000 米，应答机 6527，联系郑州管制。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL 805, approaching WXI, maintaining 11000 meters, squawking 6527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，UAL 805，接近 WXI，保持 11000 米，应答机 6527。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, radar contact, offset 3 miles right of track, reduce speed to Mach 0.75 due to Wuhan Control restrictions.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，雷达识别，向航迹右侧偏置 3 海里，因武汉管制限制，减速至马赫 0.75。
cards.referenceText: Offset 3 miles right of track, reduce speed to M.75, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 向航迹右侧偏置 3 海里，减速至 M.75，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar indicates there is a thunderstorm ahead, request Zhengzhou Control for 20 miles deviation right of track and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: B：气象雷达显示前方有雷暴，向郑州管制请求向航迹右侧偏航 20 海里，并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL 805, our weather radar indicates there is a thunderstorm ahead, request 20 miles deviation right of track.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，UAL 805，我们气象雷达显示前方有雷暴，请求向航迹右侧偏航 20 海里。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, 20 miles deviation to the right approved, report when clear of weather.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，同意向右偏航 20 海里，脱离天气后报告。
cards.referenceText: 20 miles deviation to the right approved, report when clear of weather, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意向右偏航 20 海里，脱离天气后报告，UAL 805。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 805, reduce speed to Mach 0.72.
B: Advise Zhengzhou Control Mach 0.72 is not acceptable, it's too low for your aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 805，减速至马赫 0.72。
B：告知郑州管制 M.72 不能接受，对你们飞机来说太低。
cards.referenceText: Negative, unable M.72, it's too low for our aircraft, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不能接受，无法保持 M.72，对我们飞机来说太低，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, Zhengzhou Control, maintain Mach 0.75, we are limiting the number of aircraft flying through Wuhan Control area due to Wuhan radar failure.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，郑州管制，保持马赫 0.75，因武汉雷达故障，我们正在限制飞越武汉管制区的飞机数量。
cards.referenceText: Roger, maintain M.75, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，保持 M.75，UAL 805。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 805, what is your estimated time for OBLIK?
B: Inform Zhengzhou Control your estimated time for OBLIK is 0638Z.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 805，你预计到达 OBLIK 的时间是多少？
B：告知郑州管制预计 0638Z 到达 OBLIK。
cards.referenceText: Estimating OBLIK 0638Z, UAL 805
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计 OBLIK 0638Z，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, make an orbit right, reach OBLIK not earlier than 0646.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，右盘旋，抵达 OBLIK 不早于 0646。
cards.referenceText: Orbit right, reach OBLIK not earlier than 0646, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右盘旋，抵达 OBLIK 不早于 0646，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed the orbit, ask Zhengzhou Control to track direct to OBLIK.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已完成盘旋，请求郑州管制直飞 OBLIK。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL 805, request track direct to OBLIK.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，UAL 805，请求直飞 OBLIK。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, negative direct to OBLIK, turn left heading 130 to intercept Amber 461.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，不能直飞 OBLIK，左转航向 130，切入 Amber 461。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 130 to intercept A461, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 130，切入 A461，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, 50 miles to OBLIK, contact Wuhan Control on 118.9.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，距 OBLIK 50 海里，联系武汉管制118.9。

cards.audioText: B: You are over OBLIK at time 0646, maintaining 11000 meters, you are estimating ZF at time 0658, your next way point is WUH, make a standard position report to Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你 0646 飞越 OBLIK，保持 11000 米，预计 0658 到达 ZF，下一航路点 WUH，向武汉管制作标准位置报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 805, over OBLIK 0646, maintaining 11000 meters, estimating ZF 0658, next WUH.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 805，0646 飞越 OBLIK，保持 11000 米，预计 ZF 0658，下一点 WUH。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, roger, maintain 11000 meters, report ZF.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，收到，保持 11000 米，报告 ZF。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 11000 meters, report ZF, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 11000 米，报告 ZF，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, radar failure, for identification, reset squawk 3572.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，雷达故障，为识别，重设应答机 3572。
cards.referenceText: Reset squawk 3572, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 重设应答机 3572，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, squawk ident.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，应答机识别。
cards.referenceText: Squawk ident, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 应答机识别，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, radar identified, resume own navigation, track direct to DAPRO.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，雷达已识别，恢复自主导航，直飞 DAPRO。
cards.referenceText: Resume own navigation, track direct to DAPRO, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 恢复自主导航，直飞 DAPRO，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is UAL 219, from New York to Wuhan, you are maintaining 11000 meters, over OBLIK, squawk number is 3566, call Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 UAL 219，从纽约飞往武汉，保持 11000 米，飞越 OBLIK，应答机 3566，呼叫武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 219, maintaining 11000 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 3566.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 219，保持 11000 米，飞越 OBLIK，应答机 3566。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, Wuhan Control, radar contact, descend and maintain 9200 meters, expedite descent until passing 9800 meters due crossing traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，武汉管制，雷达识别，下降并保持 9200 米，因穿越冲突航空器，通过 9800 米前加快下降。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 9200 meters, expedite descent until passing 9800 meters, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 9200 米，通过 9800 米前加快下降，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 9200 meters, you are experiencing moderate clear air turbulence, inform ATC this situation and request further descent to 8400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在保持 9200 米，遭遇中度晴空颠簸，告知 ATC 并请求继续下降至 8400 米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 219, maintaining 9200 meters, we are experiencing moderate clear air turbulence, further descent to 8400 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 219，保持 9200 米，我们遭遇中度晴空颠簸，请求继续下降至 8400 米。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, continue descent to and maintain 8400 meters, report reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，继续下降并保持 8400 米，到达后报告。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to and maintain 8400 meters, report reaching, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降并保持 8400 米，到达后报告，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: B: TCAS shows a fast moving aircraft at 9 o'clock, check with Wuhan Control if it is a conflicting traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: B：TCAS 显示 9 点钟方向有一架快速移动的航空器，向武汉管制确认是否为冲突航空器。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 219, TCAS shows a fast moving aircraft at 9 o'clock, confirm it is a conflicting traffic.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 219，TCAS 显示 9 点钟方向有一架快速移动航空器，请确认是否为冲突航空器。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, negative, the aircraft is a military aircraft flying parallel to your current track and will overtake you shortly, report clear of traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，不是，该机为军机，与你当前航迹平行飞行，将很快超越你，脱离冲突后报告。
cards.referenceText: Roger, report clear of traffic, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，脱离冲突后报告，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: B: Now that aircraft has passed you, report it to ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在该机已超过你，向 ATC 报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 219, clear of traffic.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 219，已脱离冲突。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, reduce to minimum speed, track direct to ZF, expect ZF-03 arrival Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，减至最小速度，直飞 ZF，预计 ZF-03 进场跑道 36 右。
cards.referenceText: Reduce to minimum speed, track direct to ZF, expect ZF-03 arrival Runway 36R, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 减至最小速度，直飞 ZF，预计 ZF-03 进场跑道 36R，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, continue descent to and maintain 4200 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，继续下降并保持 4200 米。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to and maintain 4200 meters, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降并保持 4200 米，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: B: You are now levelling at 4200 meters and approaching ZF, information A received, make an initial contact with Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在在 4200 米改平并接近 ZF，已收到通播 A，首次联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, UAL 219, maintaining 4200 meters, approaching ZF, information A.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，UAL 219，保持 4200 米，接近 ZF，收到通播 A。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have established ILS approach Runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已建立跑道 36 右 ILS 进近，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL 219, established ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL 219，已建立跑道 36R ILS 进近。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, continue approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，继续进近跑道 36 右。
cards.referenceText: Continue approach Runway 36R, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近跑道 36R，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: C: All stations! All stations! Be advised Runway 36R is closed due to an unserviceable aircraft occupying the runway. Break, Break, UAL 219, flying heading 360, climb to and maintain 1500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：各机注意！各机注意！跑道 36 右因故障航空器占用关闭。Break，Break，UAL 219，飞航向 360，爬升并保持 1500 米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, flying heading 360, climb to and maintain 1500 meters, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，飞航向 360，爬升并保持 1500 米，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, turn right heading 170, expect radar vectors for VOR DME approach runways 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，右转航向 170，预计雷达引导 VOR DME 进近跑道 04。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 170, expect radar vectors for VOR DME approach runways 04, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 170，预计雷达引导 VOR DME 进近跑道 04，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, turn right heading 310, cleared for VOR DME approach Runway 04, report inbound.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，右转航向 310，可以 VOR DME 进近跑道 04，向台时报告。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 310, cleared for VOR DME approach Runway 04, report inbound, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 310，可以 VOR DME 进近跑道 04，向台时报告，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are inbound course for Runway 04, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在在跑道 04 向台航道上，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL 219, inbound Runway 04.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL 219，跑道 04 向台。

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is UAL 835, you are approaching TOL, maintaining 8900 meters, squawking 3566, make initial contact with Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 UAL 835，接近 TOL，保持 8900 米，应答机 3566，首次联系上海管制。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL 835, approaching TOL, maintaining 8900 meters, squawking 3566.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL 835，接近 TOL，保持 8900 米，应答机 3566。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 835, radar contact, descend and maintain 8400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 835，雷达识别，下降并保持 8400 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 8400 meters, UAL 835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 8400 米，UAL 835。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, your TCAS warning was triggered, you are executing TCAS climbing, inform this situation to Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中 TCAS 告警触发，你正在按 TCAS 爬升，向上海管制报告。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL 835, our TACS warning was triggered, TCAS climbing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL 835，TCAS 告警触发，正在按 TCAS 爬升。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 835, roger, the conflicting traffic is military, report clear of traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 835，收到，冲突航空器为军机，脱离冲突后报告。
cards.referenceText: Roger, report clear of traffic, UAL 835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，脱离冲突后报告，UAL 835。

cards.audioText: B: During TCAS maneuver, the cabin crew reports you have 2 serious and 3 minor injuries on board, make an Urgency call to Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：TCAS 机动过程中，客舱乘务员报告机上有 2 人重伤、3 人轻伤，向上海管制发出紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Shanghai Control, UAL 835, we have 2 serious and 3 minor injuries on board during TCAS maneuver.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，上海管制，UAL 835，TCAS 机动过程中机上有 2 人重伤、3 人轻伤。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are clear of the conflicting, contact Shanghai Control and request resume descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已脱离冲突，联系上海管制，请求恢复下降。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL 835, clear of conflict, request resume descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL 835，已脱离冲突，请求恢复下降。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 835, roger, descend to 5100 meters, contact Wuhan Control on 120.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 835，收到，下降至 5100 米，联系武汉管制120.35。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 5100 meters, 120.35, UAL 835.

cards.audioText: B: Now you are passing 5400 meters for 3600 meters, squawking 3125, contact Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在通过 5400 米下降至 3600 米，应答机 3125，联系武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 835, passing 5400 meters for 3600 meters, squawking 3125.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 835，通过 5400 米下降至 3600 米，应答机 3125。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over ZF, maintaining 5100 meters, you have got information G, make initial contact with Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在飞越 ZF，保持 5100 米，已收到通播 G，首次联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, UAL 835, over ZF, maintaining 5100 meters, information G.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，UAL 835，飞越 ZF，保持 5100 米，收到通播 G。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 835, radar contact, turn right, direct to XSH, expect XSH-03A arrival and radar vector for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 835，雷达识别，右转直飞 XSH，预计 XSH-03A 进场，并雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36 右。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to XSH, expect XSH-03A arrival and radar vector for ILS approach Runway 36R, UAL 835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 XSH，预计 XSH-03A 进场并雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R，UAL 835。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 835, turn right heading 300, descend to and maintain 2400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 835，右转航向 300，下降并保持 2400 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 300, descend to and maintain 2400 meters, UAL 835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 300，下降并保持 2400 米，UAL 835。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 835, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell Wuhan Approach that you need ambulances on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 835，你需要什么协助？
B：告诉武汉进近，落地后需要救护车。
cards.referenceText: We need ambulances on arrival, UAL 835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 落地后需要救护车，UAL 835。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 835, ambulance will be ready upon your arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 835，救护车将在你到达时准备好。
cards.referenceText: Roger, UAL 835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，UAL 835。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 835, cleared ILS approach Runway 36R, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 835，可以 ILS 进近跑道 36 右，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: Cleared ILS approach Runway 36R, report established, UAL 835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以 ILS 进近跑道 36R，建立后报告，UAL 835。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have established on ILS Runway 36R, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已建立跑道 36 右 ILS，向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL 835, established on ILS Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL 835，已建立跑道 36R ILS。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 835, Runway 36R, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 835，跑道 36 右，可以落地。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, cleared to land, UAL 835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R，可以落地，UAL 835。

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is UAL 811, from Los Angeles to Wuhan, you have received an Urgency call from AFR 103, AFR 103 had a pressurization problem and the cabin altitude was rising rapidly, relay the message to Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 UAL 811，从洛杉矶飞往武汉，你收到 AFR 103 的紧急呼叫，AFR 103 出现增压问题且客舱高度快速上升，将该信息转报给郑州管制。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Zhengzhou Control, UAL 811, we have intercepted an Urgency call from AFR 103, AFR 103 had a pressurization problem and the cabin altitude was rising rapidly.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，郑州管制，UAL 811，我们截收到 AFR 103 的紧急呼叫，AFR 103 出现增压问题，客舱高度快速上升。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 811, roger PAN PAN, break, break, AFR 103, you are number 1 to land, the medical service will be ready for you.
B: You relay the message to AFR 103.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 811，收到 PANPAN，Break，Break，AFR 103，你是第一架落地，医疗服务将为你准备好。
B：你将该信息转报给 AFR 103。
cards.referenceText: AFR 103, UAL 811, you are No.1 to land, the medical service will be ready for you.
cards.referenceTextZh: AFR 103，UAL 811，你是第一架落地，医疗服务将为你准备好。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 811, offset 3 miles right of track, reduce speed to Mach 0.75 due radar failure.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 811，因雷达故障，向航迹右侧偏置 3 海里，减速至马赫 0.75。
cards.referenceText: Offset 3 miles right of track, reduce speed to M.75, UAL 811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 向航迹右侧偏置 3 海里，减速至 M.75，UAL 811。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar indicates there is a cumulonimbus ahead, request Zhengzhou Control for 20 miles deviation right of track and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: B：气象雷达显示前方有积雨云，向郑州管制请求向航迹右侧偏航 20 海里，并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL 811, our weather radar indicates there is a cumulonimbus ahead, request 20 miles deviation right of track.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，UAL 811，我们气象雷达显示前方有积雨云，请求向航迹右侧偏航 20 海里。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 811, 20 miles deviation to the right approved, report when clear of weather.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 811，同意向右偏航 20 海里，脱离天气后报告。
cards.referenceText: 20 miles deviation to the right approved, report when clear of weather, UAL 811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意向右偏航 20 海里，脱离天气后报告，UAL 811。

cards.audioText: B: You have encountered severe clear air turbulence at 10400 meters, contact Zhengzhou Control and request climb to a higher level.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你在 10400 米遭遇严重晴空颠簸，联系郑州管制，请求爬升到更高高度。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL 811, we have encountered severe clear air turbulence at 10400 meters, request climb to a higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，UAL 811，我们在 10400 米遭遇严重晴空颠簸，请求爬升到更高高度。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 811, climb to and maintain 11000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 811，爬升并保持 11000 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 11000 meters, UAL 811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 11000 米，UAL 811。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 811, reduce speed to Mach 0.72.
B: Advise Zhengzhou Control 0.72 is not acceptable, it's too low for your aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 811，减速至马赫 0.72。
B：告知郑州管制 M.72 不能接受，对你们飞机来说太低。
cards.referenceText: Negative, M.72 is too low for our aircraft, UAL 811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不能接受，M.72 对我们飞机来说太低，UAL 811。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 811, maintain Mach 0.75, we are limiting the number of aircraft flying through Wuhan Control area due to Wuhan radar failure.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 811，保持马赫 0.75，因武汉雷达故障，我们正在限制飞越武汉管制区的飞机数量。
cards.referenceText: Maintain M.75, UAL 811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 M.75，UAL 811。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 811, what is your estimated time for OBLIK?
B: Inform Zhengzhou Control your estimated time for OBLIK is 1152Z time.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 811，你预计到达 OBLIK 的时间是多少？
B：告知郑州管制预计 1152Z 到达 OBLIK。
cards.referenceText: Estimating OBLIK 1152Z, UAL 811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计 OBLIK 1152Z，UAL 811。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 811, make an orbit right, reach OBLIK not earlier than 1200.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 811，右盘旋，抵达 OBLIK 不早于 1200。
cards.referenceText: Make an orbit right, reach OBLIK not earlier than 1200, UAL 811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右盘旋，抵达 OBLIK 不早于 1200，UAL 811。

cards.audioText: B: You are over OBLIK at time 1200Z time, maintaining 11000 meters, you are estimating ZF at time 1230, your next waypoint is WUH, make a standard position report to Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你 1200Z 飞越 OBLIK，保持 11000 米，预计 1230 到达 ZF，下一航路点 WUH，向武汉管制作标准位置报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 811, OBLIK 1200Z, maintaining 11000 meters, estimating ZF 1230, WUH next.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 811，OBLIK 1200Z，保持 11000 米，预计 ZF 1230，下一点 WUH。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 811, Wuhan Control, roger, maintain 11000 meters, report ZF.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 811，武汉管制，收到，保持 11000 米，报告 ZF。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 11000 meters, report ZF, UAL 811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 11000 米，报告 ZF，UAL 811。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 811, for identification, reset squawk 3572.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 811，为识别，重设应答机 3572。
cards.referenceText: Reset squawk 3572, UAL 811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 重设应答机 3572，UAL 811。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 811, radar contact, omit position reports, resume own navigation to ZF.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 811，雷达识别，可以省略位置报告，自主导航至 ZF。
cards.referenceText: Omit position reports, resume own navigation to ZF, UAL 811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 省略位置报告，自主导航至 ZF，UAL 811。

topics.name: UAL 122 左发失效 重启成功

cards.audioText: B: You are parking at the apron and ready for taxi, please request taxi clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你停在停机坪，准备滑行，请求滑行许可。
cards.referenceText: Ground, UAL 122, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，UAL 122，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 122, stand by, snow removal is in progress.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 122，等待，正在除雪。
cards.referenceText: Stand by, UAL 122.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待，UAL 122。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 122, taxi via taxiway B2, B and E3 to holding point Runway 34.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 122，经滑行道 B2、B 和 E3 滑行至跑道 34 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway B2, B and E3 to holding point Runway 34, UAL 122.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 B2、B 和 E3 滑行至跑道 34 等待点，UAL 122。

cards.audioText: B: Please call Tower, you are ready for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：呼叫塔台，报告准备离场。
cards.referenceText: Tower, UAL 122, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 塔台，UAL 122，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 122, line up and be ready for immediate departure.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 122，进跑道，准备立即离场。
cards.referenceText: Line up, UAL 122.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进跑道，UAL 122。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 122, cleared for takeoff, report airborne.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 122，可以起飞，离地后报告。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, report airborne, UAL 122.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，离地后报告，UAL 122。

cards.audioText: B: You are at 1000 feet now, contact Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在 1000 英尺，联系离场。
cards.referenceText: Departure, UAL 122, 1000 feet climbing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离场，UAL 122，通过 1000 英尺爬升中。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 122, Departure, follow GJ-2D departure, expect no further instruction until 3000 feet, after 3000 feet, join your planned route.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 122，离场，执行 GJ-2D 离场，3000 英尺前预计无进一步指令，过 3000 英尺后加入计划航路。
cards.referenceText: Follow GJ-2D departure, expect no further instruction until 3000 feet, after 3000 feet, join planned route, UAL 122.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行 GJ-2D 离场，3000 英尺前预计无进一步指令，过 3000 英尺后加入计划航路，UAL 122。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 122, expedite climb to keep separation, traffic is in your 2 o'clock converging, report when clear of traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 122，加快爬升以保持间隔，2 点钟方向有汇聚航空器，脱离冲突后报告。
cards.referenceText: Expedite climb to keep separation, report when clear of traffic, UAL 122.
cards.referenceTextZh: 加快爬升以保持间隔，脱离冲突后报告，UAL 122。

cards.audioText: B: Tell the controller that you keep well clear of the traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉管制员你已与该航空器保持安全间隔。
cards.referenceText: Departure, UAL 122, clear of the traffic.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离场，UAL 122，已脱离该航空器。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 122, continue climbing to FL250, proceed to HM, contact Control on 122.10 when reaching FL120.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 122，继续爬升至飞行高度层 250，飞往 HM，到达飞行高度层 120 时联系管制 122.10。
cards.referenceText: Continue climbing to FL250, proceed to HM, contact Control on 122.10 when reaching FL120, UAL 122.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续爬升至 FL250，飞往 HM，到达 FL120 时联系管制 122.10，UAL 122。

cards.audioText: B: You are at FL120, call Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你在飞行高度层 120，呼叫管制。
cards.referenceText: Control, UAL 122, reaching FL120.
cards.referenceTextZh: 管制，UAL 122，到达 FL120。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 122, can you lose time on route? Landing delays at OBO Airport.
B: Tell the controller that you can.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 122，你能在航路上消耗时间吗？OBO 机场落地延误。
B：告诉管制员可以。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, UAL 122.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以，UAL 122。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 122, reduce your speed to Mach point 65, maintain FL250.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 122，减速至马赫 0.65，保持飞行高度层 250。
cards.referenceText: Reduce speed to M.65, maintain FL250, UAL 122.
cards.referenceTextZh: 减速至 M.65，保持 FL250，UAL 122。

cards.audioText: B: You tell the controller that your port engine is inoperative.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉管制员你们左发失效。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Control, UAL 122, our port/left engine has failed.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，管制，UAL 122，我们左发失效。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 122, roger PAN call, report your current status.
B: You have shut down the engine and are trying to restart it following the checklist.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 122，收到 PAN 呼叫，报告当前状态。
B：你已关闭左发，正在按检查单尝试重启。
cards.referenceText: We have shut down left engine, we are trying to restart it, UAL 122.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们已关闭左发，正在尝试重启，UAL 122。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 122, roger.
B: Engine restart are unsuccessful, you want priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 122，收到。
B：发动机重启不成功，你希望优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: Control, UAL 122, engine restart are unsuccessful, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 管制，UAL 122，发动机重启不成功，请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 122, turn left heading 170 and descend to 3000 feet, contact Approach on 130.6.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 122，左转航向 170，下降至 3000 英尺，联系进近 130.6。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 170, descend to 3000 feet, 130.6, UAL 122.

topics.name: UAL 403 机翼/控制面损坏 颠簸 雷暴绕飞

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is UAL 403, you are at Wuhan Airport, before departure, you received the cabin report said that there is ice and snow buildup on the wings, contact Wuhan Ground and tell the controller you want to have ice removed before start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 UAL 403，在武汉机场，离场前收到客舱报告，机翼有冰雪堆积，联系武汉地面，告知需要在开车前除冰。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, UAL 403, there is ice and snow buildup on the wings, request de-icing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，UAL 403，机翼有冰雪堆积，请求除冰。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 403, where do you want to de-ice?
B: Tell the controller you want to de-ice on taxiway Z4.
P: Wuhan Ground, UAL 403, request de-icing on taxiway Z4.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： UAL 403，你想在哪里除冰？
B： 告诉管制员你想在 Z4 滑行道除冰。
P： 武汉地面，UAL 403，请求在 Z4 滑行道除冰。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, UAL 403, request de-icing on taxiway Z four. request de-icing on taxiway Z four, UAL 403
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，UAL 403，请求在 Z4 滑行道除冰。请求在 Z4 滑行道除冰，UAL 403。

cards.audioText: B: Tell the Ground controller you have completed de-icing and you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉地面管制员你已完成除冰，准备滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, UAL 403, de-icing completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，UAL 403，除冰完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: UAL 403, taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 403，经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z four, A tree and A, UAL 403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点，UAL 403。

cards.audioText: B: The de-icing fluid is only effective for 30 minutes, tell the Ground controller you need to takeoff before 0835, and request intersection departure from Z4.
cards.audioTextZh: B：除冰液有效时间只有 30 分钟，告诉地面管制你需要在 0835 前起飞，并请求从 Z4 交叉口离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, UAL 403, the de-icing fluid is only effective for 30 minutes, we need to takeoff before 0835, request intersection departure from Z4.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，UAL 403，除冰液有效时间只有 30 分钟，我们需要在 0835 前起飞，请求从 Z4 交叉口离场。

cards.audioText: B: You have encountered moderate turbulence, ask Guangzhou Control for a higher level.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你遭遇中度颠簸，向广州管制请求更高高度。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL 403, we have encountered moderate turbulence, request a higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL 403，我们遭遇中度颠簸，请求更高高度。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 403, 10,700 meters and 11300 meters are both available, which one do you prefer?
B: Tell the controller you want to climb to 10,700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： UAL 403，10,700 米和 11300 米均可用，你希望选择哪一个？
B： 告诉管制员你想爬升至 10,700 米。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL 403, request climb to 1700 meters. request climb to 1700 meters, UAL 403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL 403，请求爬升至 1700 米。请求爬升至 1700 米，UAL 403。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 403, radar shows you are a bit higher than your assigned level, check your altitude.
B: tell the controller you are running into some turbulence.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： UAL 403，雷达显示你略高于指定高度，检查高度。
B： 告诉管制员你正遭遇一些颠簸。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL 403, we are running into some turbulence. we are running into some turbulence, UAL 403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL 403，我们正遭遇一些颠簸。我们正遭遇一些颠簸，UAL 403。

cards.audioText: Ask Guangzhou Control if there is any turbulence reported from preceding aircraft at 11300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 询问广州管制，是否有前机在 11300 米报告颠簸。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL 403, is there any turbulence reported from preceding aircraft at 2300 meters?
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL 403，是否有前机在 2300 米报告颠簸？

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 403, there is no turbulence report at 11300 meters.
B: Tell the controller you want to climb to 11300 meters due turbulence.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： UAL 403，11300 米没有颠簸报告。
B： 告诉管制员你想因颠簸爬升至 11300 米。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL 403, roger, request climb to 2003 hudnred meters due turbulence. request climb to 2003 hudnred meters due turbulence, UAL 403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL 403，收到，因颠簸请求爬升至 2003 hudnred 米。因颠簸请求爬升至 2003 hudnred 米，UAL 403。

cards.audioText: UAL 403, climb and maintain 11,300 meters
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 403，爬升并保持 11,300 米。
cards.referenceText: climb and maintain 2300 meters, UAL 403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 2300 米，UAL 403。

cards.audioText: B: Tell Guangzhou Control you request earlier descent because your landing weight exceeds maximum landing weight, and you will request descent now.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉广州管制，因为着陆重量超过最大着陆重量，请求提前下降，并请求现在开始下降。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL 403, request earlier descent due our landing weight exceeds maximum landing weight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL 403，因着陆重量超过最大着陆重量，请求提前下降。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 403, descend to 4500 meters, reach 4500 meters before ATAGA, start descent at own discretion.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 403，下降至 4500 米，在 ATAGA 前达到 4500 米，自主决定开始下降。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 4500 meters, reach 4500 meters before ATAGA, start descent at own discretion, UAL 403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 4500 米，在 ATAGA 前达到 4500 米，自主决定开始下降，UAL 403。

cards.audioText: B: There is an indication of thunderstorm ahead, contact Guangzhou Control and request offset 10 miles right to avoid the weather.
cards.audioTextZh: B：前方有雷暴迹象，联系广州管制，请求向右偏航 10 海里避让天气。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL 403, request offset 10 miles right due CB ahead.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL 403，前方有 CB，请求向右偏航 10 海里。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 403, 10 miles right approved, report clear of weather.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 403，同意向右 10 海里，脱离天气后报告。
cards.referenceText: 10 miles right approved, report clear of weather, UAL 403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意向右 10 海里，脱离天气后报告，UAL 403。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are clear of whether, report the situation to Guangzhou Control and request direct to TON.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已脱离天气，向广州管制报告并请求直飞 TON。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL 403, clear of whether, request direct to TON.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL 403，已脱离天气，请求直飞 TON。

topics.name: UAL 831 增压问题 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is UAL 831, a flight from Wuhan to San Francisco, you have completed push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground for taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 UAL 831，从武汉飞往旧金山，已完成推出和开车，联系武汉地面获取滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, UAL 831, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，UAL 831，推出开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: UAL 831, taxi to holding point Runway 04via taxiway F, A7 and A.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 831，经 F、A7 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 04 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi to holding point Runway 04via taxiway F, A seven and A, UAL 83 one1.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 F、A7 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 04 等待点，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: UAL 831, contact Wuhan Tower on 118.65.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 831，联系武汉塔台 118.65。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point Runway 04, you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在在跑道 04 等待点，准备离场，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL 831, holding point Runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL 831，跑道 04 等待点，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, cleared for takeoff Runway 04, surface wind 060, 10 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，跑道 04 可以起飞，地面风 060，10 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff Runway 04, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 04 可以起飞，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, climbing to 1,500 meters, contact Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已离地，正通过 600 米，爬升至 1,500 米，联系武汉离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL 831, airborne, passing 600 meters, climbing to 1200 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，UAL 831，已离地，正通过 600 米，爬升至 1,200 米。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, cancel SID, direct to HFE, climb to 3900 meters on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，取消 SID，直飞 HFE，按标准气压爬升至 3900 米。
cards.referenceText: Cancel SID, direct to HFE, climb to 3900 meters on standard, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消 SID，直飞 HFE，按标准气压爬升至 3900 米，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: during climb, the purser tells you a passenger has heard abnormal noises from the rear cabin, you decide to level off at 2,700 meters, advise Wuhan Departure your intention to level off due possible problem in the cabin.
cards.audioTextZh: 爬升期间，乘务长告诉你，一名乘客听到后舱传来异常声响。你决定在 2,700 米改平，向武汉离场报告因客舱可能存在问题而准备改平。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL 831, a passenger has heard abnormal noise in rear cabin, request level off at 2700 meters due possible cabin problem.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，UAL 831，一名乘客听到后舱有异常声响，因客舱可能存在问题，请求在 2,700 米改平。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, climb to and maintain 2700 meters, advise intention.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，爬升并保持 2700 米，报告意图。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 2700 meters, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 2700 米，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: B: The aircraft is leveling, no one else can confirm the noise that the particular passenger heard, you check all the instruments are indicating normally, you decide to continue the flight and request a higher level, call Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：飞机已改平，没有其他人能确认该旅客听到的声音，各仪表指示正常，你决定继续飞行并请求更高高度，呼叫武汉离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL 831, all the instruments are indicating normally, request continue the flight and request a higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，UAL 831，各仪表指示正常，请求继续飞行并请求更高高度。

cards.audioText: UAL 831, climb to 4,500 meters on standard, contact Wuhan Control 120.5
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 831，按标准气压爬升至 4,500 米，联系武汉管制 120.5。
cards.referenceText: climb to 4500 meters on standard, contact Wuhan Control 120.5, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按标准气压爬升至 4,500 米，联系武汉管制 120.5，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: Now you are maintaining 10,700 meters, over HFE, squawking 5316, make initial contact with Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正保持 10,700 米，飞越 HFE，应答机 5316，首次联系上海管制。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL 831, maintaining 1700 meters, over HFE, squawking 5316.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL 831，正保持 1,700 米，飞越 HFE，应答机 5316。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, Shanghai Control, radar contact, proceed direct to VMB.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，上海管制，雷达识别，直飞 VMB。
cards.referenceText: Proceed direct to VMB, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 VMB，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: now you confirm the strange sound from the cabin, your instrument indicates cabin altitude is rising slowly, slow depressurization is suspected, request immediate descent from 10,700 meters to 3,000 meters. This is an urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你确认客舱内有异常声响，仪表显示客舱高度正缓慢上升，怀疑发生缓慢失压，请求立即从 10,700 米下降至 3,000 米。这是一次紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Shanghai Control, UAL 831, our instrument indicates cabin altitude is rising slowly, suspect slow cabin depressurization, request immediate descent to 3000 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，上海管制，UAL 831，我们的仪表显示客舱高度正缓慢上升，怀疑客舱缓慢失压，请求立即下降至 3,000 米。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, roger PAN, turn right heading 150, initially descend and maintain 8900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，收到 PAN，右转航向 150，先下降并保持 8900 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 150, descend and maintain 8900 meters, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 150，下降并保持 8900 米，UAL 831。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 831, turn left heading 210, descend to 3,300 meters.
B: read back ATC instructions and request the nearest suitable airport for landing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： UAL 831，左转航向 210，下降至 3,300 米。
B： 复诵空中交通管制指令，并请求最近的合适机场落地。
cards.referenceText:
turn left heading 210, descend to 3300 meters, request the nearest suitable airport for landing, UAL 831.
or
turn left heading 210, descend to 3,300 meters, request the nearest suitable airport for landing, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh:
左转航向 210，下降至 3,300 米，请求最近的合适机场落地，UAL 831。
或
左转航向 210，下降至 3,300 米，请求最近的合适机场落地，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: ask radar vector to Shanghai Hongqiao or Pudong Airport, which has a better visibility.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求雷达引导前往上海虹桥机场或浦东机场，选择能见度较好的机场。
cards.referenceText: request radar vector to Shanghai Hongqiao or Pudong Airport, which has a better visibility, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求雷达引导前往上海虹桥机场或浦东机场，选择能见度较好的机场，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: UAL 831, direct to HSH, expect radar vectors to land at Pudong airport, contact Shanghai Approach on 128.35.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 831，直飞 HSH，预计雷达引导在浦东机场落地，联系上海进近 128.35。
cards.referenceText: direct to HSH, radar vector to Pudong, 128.35, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 HSH，雷达引导前往浦东，128.35，UAL 831。

topics.name: UAL 182 积冰/防冰 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: B: Your aircraft call sign is UAL 182, you are at the holding point of Runway 04, call Wuhan Tower you are ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的航空器呼号是 UAL 182，在跑道 04 等待点，呼叫武汉塔台，报告准备起飞。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL 182, holding point of Runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL 182，跑道 04 等待点，准备离场。

cards.audioText: UAL 182, behind CSN Boeing 777 on short final, line up behind. Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 182，跟在短五边的 CSN Boeing 777 后进入 Runway 04 等待。
cards.referenceText: behind CSN 777 on short final, line up behind Runway 04, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟在短五边的 CSN 777 后进入 Runway 04 等待，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 182, when airborne, turn right heading 070, climb to 3000 meters, cleared for immediate takeoff Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 182，离地后右转航向 070，爬升至 3000 米，跑道 04 可以立即起飞。
cards.referenceText: When airborne, turn right heading 070, climb to 3000 meters, cleared for immediate takeoff Runway 04, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离地后右转航向 070，爬升至 3000 米，跑道 04 可以立即起飞，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne and passing 200 meters, call Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已离地，通过 200 米，呼叫武汉离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL 182, airborne, passing 200 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，UAL 182，已离地，通过 200 米。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 182, after passing 1200 meters, turn left direct to ZF.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 182，通过 1200 米后左转直飞 ZF。
cards.referenceText: After passing 1200 meters, turn left direct to ZF, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通过 1200 米后左转直飞 ZF，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are in London Control area, FL350, you encountered volcanic ash, tell ATC the situation and request descent, call London Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在在伦敦管制区，飞行高度层 350，遭遇火山灰，向 ATC 报告情况并请求下降，呼叫伦敦管制。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL 182, we encountered volcanic ash at FL350, request descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL 182，我们在 FL350 遭遇火山灰，请求下降。

cards.audioText: UAL 182, turn right heading 300, descent to FL290.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 182，右转航向 300，下降至 FL290。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 300, descent to FL290, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 300，下降至 FL290，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: B: Tell ATC you are still in volcanic ash area, both engines are vibrating highly, but aircraft can still be controlled.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉 ATC 你仍在火山灰区域，双发振动严重，但飞机仍可操控。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL 182, we are still in volcanic ash area, both engines are vibrating highly, but aircraft can still be controlled.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL 182，我们仍在火山灰区域，双发振动严重，但飞机仍可操控。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, both engines flamed out, make a Distress call and request land at the nearest airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中，双发熄火，发出遇险呼叫并请求在最近机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, London Control, UAL 182, both engines flamed out, request land at the nearest airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，伦敦管制，UAL 182，双发熄火，请求在最近机场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 182, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 340.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 182，收到 MAYDAY，右转航向 340。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 340, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 340，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: B: 1 engine was successfully restarted during descent, tell ATC the situation.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中 1 台发动机成功重启，告诉 ATC 当前情况。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL 182, 1 engine was successfully restarted during descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL 182，下降过程中 1 台发动机成功重启。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 182, what's your intention?
B: Tell ATC you still need to land at the nearest airport because the running engine is not stable.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： UAL 182，你的意图是什么？
B： 告诉空中交通管制，由于仍在运转的发动机不稳定，你仍需在最近的机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL 182, request land at the nearest airport due the running engine is not stable. request land at the nearest airport due the running engine is not stable, UAL 182
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL 182，由于仍在运转的发动机不稳定，请求在最近的机场着陆。由于仍在运转的发动机不稳定，请求在最近的机场着陆，UAL 182。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 182, continue descent to 9000 feet, expect to land at Beatle airport.
B: Tell controller you are not familiar with Beatle airport. Request airport information.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： UAL 182，继续下降至 9,000 英尺，预计在 Beatle Airport 着陆。
B： 告诉管制员你不熟悉 Beatle Airport，请求机场资料。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL 182, continue descent to 9000 feet, we are not familiar with Beatle airport. Request airport information. continue descent to 9000 feet, we are not familiar with Beatle airport, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL 182，继续下降至 9,000 英尺，我们不熟悉 Beatle Airport，请求机场资料。继续下降至 9,000 英尺，我们不熟悉 Beatle Airport，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: Tell ATC you are able to land at this airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉空中交通管制，你能够在该机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL 182, we are able to land at this airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL 182，我们能够在该机场着陆。

cards.audioText: UAL 182, continue descent to 5000 feet and contact approach 121.3.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 182，继续下降至 5,000 英尺，联系进近 121.3。
cards.referenceText: continue descent to 5000 feet and contact approach 121.3, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降至 5,000 英尺，联系进近 121.3，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: B: Contact Approach, tell them your emergency situation.
cards.audioTextZh: B：联系进近，告知他们你的紧急情况。
cards.referenceText: Approach, UAL 182, we encountered volcanic ash, both engines flamed out, 1 engine was successfully restarted but not stable.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，UAL 182，我们遭遇火山灰，双发熄火，1 台发动机已成功重启但不稳定。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 182, roger your situation. RWY is at your 2 o'clock, 10 miles, report airfield in sight.
B: Tell ATC you see the airport.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： UAL 182，收到你的情况。跑道在你 2 点钟方向、距离 10 英里，看到机场后报告。
B： 告诉空中交通管制你已看到机场。
cards.referenceText: London Approach, UAL 182, airfield in sight. airfield in sight, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦进近，UAL 182，已看到机场。已看到机场，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: B: Tell Approach you need emergency services to be ready near the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉进近你需要应急服务在跑道附近待命。
cards.referenceText: Approach, UAL 182, request emergency services to be ready near the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，UAL 182，请求应急服务在跑道附近待命。

topics.name: UAL 219 颠簸 积冰/防冰 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: Your call sign is UAL 219, from New York to Wuhan, you are maintaining 11,000 meters over OBLIK, squawk number is 3566, call Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 UAL 219，从纽约飞往武汉，正保持 11,000 米飞越 OBLIK，应答机 3566，呼叫武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 219, maintaining 2000 meters, OBLIK, squawking 3566.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 219，正保持 2,000 米，飞越 OBLIK，应答机 3566。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, Wuhan Control, radar contact, descend and maintain 9200 meters, expedite descent until passing 9800 meters due crossing traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，武汉管制，雷达识别，下降并保持 9200 米，因穿越冲突航空器，通过 9800 米前加快下降。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 9200 meters, expedite descent until passing 9800 meters, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 9200 米，通过 9800 米前加快下降，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: Now you are maintaining 9,200 meters, you are experiencing moderate clear air turbulence, inform ATC this situation and request further descent to 8,400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正保持 9,200 米，正在遭遇中度晴空颠簸，向空中交通管制报告情况并请求进一步下降至 8,400 米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 219, maintaining 9200 meters, we are experiencing moderate clear air turbulence, request further descent to 8400 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 219，正保持 9,200 米，我们正在遭遇中度晴空颠簸，请求进一步下降至 8,400 米。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, continue descent to and maintain 8400 meters, report reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，继续下降并保持 8400 米，到达后报告。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to and maintain 8400 meters, report reaching, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降并保持 8400 米，到达后报告，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: B: TCAS shows a fast moving aircraft at 9 o'clock, check with Wuhan Control if it is a conflicting traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: B：TCAS 显示 9 点钟方向有一架快速移动的航空器，向武汉管制确认是否为冲突航空器。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 219, TCAS shows a fast moving aircraft at 9 o'clock, confirm it is a conflicting traffic.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 219，TCAS 显示 9 点钟方向有一架快速移动航空器，请确认是否为冲突航空器。

cards.audioText: UAL 219, negative, the aircraft is a military aircraft flying parallel to your current track and will overtake you shortly, report clear of traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 219，不行，该航空器是一架军用航空器，正与你当前航迹平行飞行，并将很快超越你，脱离相关航空器后报告。
cards.referenceText: roger, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: B: Now that aircraft has passed you, report it to ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在该机已超过你，向 ATC 报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 219, clear of traffic.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 219，已脱离冲突。

cards.audioText: UAL 219, reduce to minimum speed, track direct to ZF, expect ZF-03 arrival Runway 36.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 219，减至最小速度，直飞 ZF，预计执行 ZF-03 进场，使用 Runway 36。
cards.referenceText: reduce to minimum speed, track direct to ZF, expect ZF-03 arrival Runway 36, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 减至最小速度，直飞 ZF，预计执行 ZF-03 进场，使用 Runway 36，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, continue descent to and maintain 4200 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，继续下降并保持 4200 米。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to and maintain 4200 meters, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降并保持 4200 米，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: you are now leveling at 4,200 meters and approaching ZF, information A received, make an initial contact with Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正在 4,200 米改平并接近 ZF，已收到 A 情报，首次联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, UAL 219, approaching ZF, maintaining 4200 meters, information A.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，UAL 219，接近 ZF，正保持 4,200 米，A 情报。

cards.audioText: Now you have established ILS approach Runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL 219, established ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL 219，已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。

cards.audioText: UAL 219, continue approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 219，继续进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: continue approach Runway 36R, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近 Runway 36R，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: All stations, all stations, be advised Runway 36R is closed due to an unserviceable aircraft occupying the runway. Break, break, UAL 219, flying heading 360, climb to and maintain 1,500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 所有电台，所有电台，请注意，因一架故障航空器占用跑道，Runway 36R 已关闭。暂停，暂停，UAL 219，飞航向 360，爬升至并保持 1,500 米。
cards.referenceText: roger flying heading 360, climb to and maintain 1500 meters, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，飞航向 360，爬升至并保持 1500 米，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: UAL 219, turn right heading 170, expect radar vectors for VOR-DME approach Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 219，右转航向 170，预计雷达引导 VOR-DME 进近 Runway 04。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 170, expect radar vectors for VOR, DME approach Runway 04, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 170，预计雷达引导 VOR、DME 进近 Runway 04，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, turn right heading 310, cleared for VOR DME approach Runway 04, report inbound.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，右转航向 310，可以 VOR DME 进近跑道 04，向台时报告。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 310, cleared for VOR DME approach Runway 04, report inbound, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 310，可以 VOR DME 进近跑道 04，向台时报告，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are inbound course for Runway 04, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在在跑道 04 向台航道上，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL 219, inbound Runway 04.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL 219，跑道 04 向台。

topics.name: UAL 805 雷暴绕飞 TCAS机动 导航/自动驾驶问题

cards.audioText: Your call sign is UAL 805 on a flight to Guangzhou, you are approaching WXI, maintaining 11,000 meters, squawking 6527, contact Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 UAL 805，正飞往广州，接近 WXI，保持 11,000 米，应答机 6527，联系郑州管制。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL 805, approaching WXI, maintaining 2000 meters, squawking 6527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，UAL 805，接近 WXI，保持 2000 米，应答机 6527。

cards.audioText: UAL 805, radar contact, offset 3 miles right of track, reduce speed to mach decimal 75 due to Wuhan Control restrictions.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 805，雷达识别，向航迹右侧偏置 3 英里，因武汉管制限制将速度减至 Mach 0.75。
cards.referenceText: offset tree miles right of track, reduce speed to mach decimal seven five, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 向航迹右侧偏置 3 英里，将速度减至 Mach 0.75，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar indicates there is a thunderstorm ahead, request Zhengzhou Control for 20 miles deviation right of track and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: B：气象雷达显示前方有雷暴，向郑州管制请求向航迹右侧偏航 20 海里，并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL 805, our weather radar indicates there is a thunderstorm ahead, request 20 miles deviation right of track.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，UAL 805，我们气象雷达显示前方有雷暴，请求向航迹右侧偏航 20 海里。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, 20 miles deviation to the right approved, report when clear of weather.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，同意向右偏航 20 海里，脱离天气后报告。
cards.referenceText: 20 miles deviation to the right approved, report when clear of weather, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意向右偏航 20 海里，脱离天气后报告，UAL 805。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 805, reduce speed to mach decimal 72.
B: Advise Zhengzhou Control mach decimal 72 is not acceptable, it's too low for your aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： UAL 805，将速度减至 Mach 0.72。
B： 通知郑州管制，Mach 0.72 不可接受，对你的航空器而言太低。
cards.referenceText: negative, mach decimal seven two is not acceptable due it's too low, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不行，Mach 0.72不可接受，因为太低，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: UAL 805, Zhengzhou Control, maintain mach decimal 75, we are limiting the number of aircraft flying through Wuhan Control area due to Wuhan radar failure.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 805，郑州管制，保持 Mach 0.75，因武汉雷达故障，我们正在限制飞越武汉管制区的航空器数量。
cards.referenceText: roger, maintain mach decimal 75, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，保持 Mach 0.75，UAL 805。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 805, what is your estimated time for OBLIK?
B: Inform Zhengzhou Control your estimated time for OBLIK is 0638Z.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 805，你预计到达 OBLIK 的时间是多少？
B：告知郑州管制预计 0638Z 到达 OBLIK。
cards.referenceText: Estimating OBLIK 0638Z, UAL 805
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计 OBLIK 0638Z，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, make an orbit right, reach OBLIK not earlier than 0646.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，右盘旋，抵达 OBLIK 不早于 0646。
cards.referenceText: Orbit right, reach OBLIK not earlier than 0646, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右盘旋，抵达 OBLIK 不早于 0646，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed the orbit, ask Zhengzhou Control to track direct to OBLIK.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已完成盘旋，请求郑州管制直飞 OBLIK。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL 805, request track direct to OBLIK.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，UAL 805，请求直飞 OBLIK。

cards.audioText: UAL 805, direct to OBLIK, turn left heading 130 to intercept Amber 461.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 805，直飞 OBLIK，左转航向 130，切入 Amber 461。
cards.referenceText: direct to OBLIK, turn left heading 130 to intercept Amber 461, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 OBLIK，左转航向 130，切入 Amber 461，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: UAL 80550 miles to OBLIK, contact Wuhan Control on 118.9.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 805，距 OBLIK 50 英里，联系武汉管制 118.9。
cards.referenceText: roger, 118.9, UAL 805.

cards.audioText: you are over OBLIK at time 0646, maintaining 11,000 meters, you are estimating ZF at time 0658, your next waypoint is WUH, make a standard position report to Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你在 0646 时飞越 OBLIK，保持 11,000 米，预计 0658 时到达 ZF，下一个航路点是 WUH，向武汉管制作标准位置报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 805, over OBLIK 0646, 2000 meters, estimating ZF0658, next WUH.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 805，0646 飞越 OBLIK，2000 米，预计 0658 到达 ZF，下一个航路点 WUH。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, roger, maintain 11000 meters, report ZF.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，收到，保持 11000 米，报告 ZF。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 11000 meters, report ZF, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 11000 米，报告 ZF，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, radar failure, for identification, reset squawk 3572.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，雷达故障，为识别，重设应答机 3572。
cards.referenceText: Reset squawk 3572, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 重设应答机 3572，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, squawk ident.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，应答机识别。
cards.referenceText: Squawk ident, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 应答机识别，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, radar identified, resume own navigation, track direct to DAPRO.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，雷达已识别，恢复自主导航，直飞 DAPRO。
cards.referenceText: Resume own navigation, track direct to DAPRO, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 恢复自主导航，直飞 DAPRO，UAL 805。

topics.name: UAL 811 颠簸 雷暴绕飞 增压问题

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is UAL 811, from Los Angeles to Wuhan, you have received an Urgency call from AFR 103, AFR 103 had a pressurization problem and the cabin altitude was rising rapidly, relay the message to Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 UAL 811，从洛杉矶飞往武汉，你收到 AFR 103 的紧急呼叫，AFR 103 出现增压问题且客舱高度快速上升，将该信息转报给郑州管制。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Zhengzhou Control, UAL 811, we have intercepted an Urgency call from AFR 103, AFR 103 had a pressurization problem and the cabin altitude was rising rapidly.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，郑州管制，UAL 811，我们截收到 AFR 103 的紧急呼叫，AFR 103 出现增压问题，客舱高度快速上升。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 811, roger PANPAN, break, break, AFR 103, descend to 3000 meters on QNH1021.
B: You relay the message to AFR 103.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： UAL 811，收到 PANPAN，暂停，暂停，AFR 103，在 QNH 1021 上下降至 3000 米。
B： 你将该信息转发给 AFR 103。
cards.referenceText: AFR 103, UAL 811, roger PANPAN, descend to 3000 meters QNH 1021.
cards.referenceTextZh: AFR 103，UAL 811，收到 PANPAN，在 QNH 1021 上下降至 3000 米。

cards.audioText: UAL 811, offset 3 miles right of track, reduce speed to mach decimal 75 due radar failure.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 811，向航迹右侧偏置 3 英里，因雷达故障将速度减至 Mach 0.75。
cards.referenceText: offset tree miles right of track, reduce speed to mach decimal seven five, UAL 811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 向航迹右侧偏置 3 英里，将速度减至 Mach 0.75，UAL 811。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar indicates there is a cumulonimbus ahead, request Zhengzhou Control for 20 miles deviation right of track and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: B：气象雷达显示前方有积雨云，向郑州管制请求向航迹右侧偏航 20 海里，并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL 811, our weather radar indicates there is a cumulonimbus ahead, request 20 miles deviation right of track.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，UAL 811，我们气象雷达显示前方有积雨云，请求向航迹右侧偏航 20 海里。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 811, 20 miles deviation to the right approved, report when clear of weather.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 811，同意向右偏航 20 海里，脱离天气后报告。
cards.referenceText: 20 miles deviation to the right approved, report when clear of weather, UAL 811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意向右偏航 20 海里，脱离天气后报告，UAL 811。

cards.audioText: you have encountered severe clear air turbulence between 10,400 meters and 6000 meters, contact Zhengzhou Control and request climb to a higher level.
cards.audioTextZh: 你在 10,400 米至 6000 米之间遭遇严重晴空颠簸，联系郑州管制并请求爬升至更高高度。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL 811, we have encountered severe clear air turbulence between 1400 meters and 6000 meters, request climb to a higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，UAL 811，我们在 1400 米至 6000 米之间遭遇严重晴空颠簸，请求爬升至更高高度。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 811, climb to and maintain 11000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 811，爬升并保持 11000 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 11000 meters, UAL 811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 11000 米，UAL 811。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 811, reduce speed to mach decimal 72.
B: Advise Zhengzhou Control mach decimal 72 is not acceptable, it's too low for your aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： UAL 811，将速度减至 Mach 0.72。
B： 通知郑州管制，Mach 0.72 不可接受，对你的航空器而言太低。
cards.referenceText: negative, mach decimal seven two is too low (for our aircraft), UAL 811
cards.referenceTextZh: 不行，Mach 0.72太低（对我们的航空器而言），UAL 811。

cards.audioText: UAL 811, maintain mach decimal 75, we are limiting the number of aircraft flying through Wuhan Control area due to Wuhan radar failure.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 811，保持 Mach 0.75，因武汉雷达故障，我们正在限制飞越武汉管制区的航空器数量。
cards.referenceText: maintain mach decimal 75, UAL 811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 Mach 0.75，UAL 811。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 811, what is your estimated time for OBLIK?
B: Inform Zhengzhou Control your estimated time for OBLIK is 1152Z time.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 811，你预计到达 OBLIK 的时间是多少？
B：告知郑州管制预计 1152Z 到达 OBLIK。
cards.referenceText: Estimating OBLIK 1152Z, UAL 811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计 OBLIK 1152Z，UAL 811。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 811, make an orbit right, reach OBLIK not earlier than 1200.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 811，右盘旋，抵达 OBLIK 不早于 1200。
cards.referenceText: Make an orbit right, reach OBLIK not earlier than 1200, UAL 811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右盘旋，抵达 OBLIK 不早于 1200，UAL 811。

cards.audioText: you are over OBLIK at time 1200Z, maintaining 11,000 meters, you are estimating ZF at time 1230, your next waypoint is WUH, make a standard position report to Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你在 1200Z 时飞越 OBLIK，保持 11,000 米，预计 1230 时到达 ZF，下一个航路点是 WUH，向武汉管制作标准位置报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 811, OBLIK1200Z, 2000 meters, estimating ZF1230 Z, WUH next.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 811，1200Z 飞越 OBLIK，2000 米，预计 1230Z 到达 ZF，下一个航路点 WUH。

cards.audioText: UAL 811, Wuhan Control, roger, maintain 11,000 meters, report ZF.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 811，武汉管制，收到，保持 11,000 米，到达 ZF 时报告。
cards.referenceText: maintain 11,000 meters, UAL 811.

cards.audioText: C: UAL 811, for identification, reset squawk 3572.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 811，为识别，重设应答机 3572。
cards.referenceText: Reset squawk 3572, UAL 811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 重设应答机 3572，UAL 811。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 811, radar contact, omit position reports, resume own navigation to ZF.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 811，雷达识别，可以省略位置报告，自主导航至 ZF。
cards.referenceText: Omit position reports, resume own navigation to ZF, UAL 811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 省略位置报告，自主导航至 ZF，UAL 811。

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is UAL 835, you are approaching TOL, maintaining 8900 meters, squawking 3566, make initial contact with Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 UAL 835，接近 TOL，保持 8900 米，应答机 3566，首次联系上海管制。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL 835, approaching TOL, maintaining 8900 meters, squawking 3566.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL 835，接近 TOL，保持 8900 米，应答机 3566。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 835, radar contact, descend and maintain 8400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 835，雷达识别，下降并保持 8400 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 8400 meters, UAL 835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 8400 米，UAL 835。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, your TCAS warning was triggered, you are executing TCAS climbing, inform this situation to Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中 TCAS 告警触发，你正在按 TCAS 爬升，向上海管制报告。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL 835, our TACS warning was triggered, TCAS climbing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL 835，TCAS 告警触发，正在按 TCAS 爬升。

cards.audioText: UAL 835, roger, the conflicting traffic is military, report clear of traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 835，收到，冲突航空器为军用航空器，脱离冲突后报告。
cards.referenceText: roger, UAL 835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，UAL 835。

cards.audioText: During TCAS maneuver, the cabin crew reports you have two serious and three minor injuries on board, make an urgency call to Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 在 TCAS 机动期间，客舱机组报告机上有两人重伤、三人轻伤，向上海管制发出紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Shanghai Control, UAL 835, we have two serious and threes minor injuries on board during T CAS maneuver.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，上海管制，UAL 835，在 TCAS 机动期间，我们机上有两人重伤、三人轻伤。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are clear of the conflicting, contact Shanghai Control and request resume descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已脱离冲突，联系上海管制，请求恢复下降。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL 835, clear of conflict, request resume descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL 835，已脱离冲突，请求恢复下降。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 835, roger, descend to 5100 meters, contact Wuhan Control on 120.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 835，收到，下降至 5100 米，联系武汉管制120.35。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 5100 meters, 120.35, UAL 835.

cards.audioText: now you are passing 5400 meters for 3600 meters, squawking 3566, contact Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正通过 5400 米下降至 3600 米，应答机 3566，联系武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 835, passing 5400 meters for 3600 meters, squawking 3566.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 835，正通过 5400 米下降至 3600 米，应答机 3566。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over ZF, maintaining 5100 meters, you have got information G, make initial contact with Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在飞越 ZF，保持 5100 米，已收到通播 G，首次联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, UAL 835, over ZF, maintaining 5100 meters, information G.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，UAL 835，飞越 ZF，保持 5100 米，收到通播 G。

cards.audioText: UAL 835, radar contact, turn right, direct to XSH, expect XSH-03A arrival and radar vector for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 835，雷达识别，右转直飞 XSH，预计执行 XSH-03A 进场，并接受雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: turn right, direct to XSH, expect XSH03 A arrival, radar vector ILS approach Runway 36R, UAL 835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 XSH，预计执行 XSH-03A 进场，雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，UAL 835。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 835, turn right heading 300, descend to and maintain 2400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 835，右转航向 300，下降并保持 2400 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 300, descend to and maintain 2400 meters, UAL 835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 300，下降并保持 2400 米，UAL 835。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 835, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell Wuhan Approach that you need ambulances on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 835，你需要什么协助？
B：告诉武汉进近，落地后需要救护车。
cards.referenceText: We need ambulances on arrival, UAL 835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 落地后需要救护车，UAL 835。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 835, ambulance will be ready upon your arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 835，救护车将在你到达时准备好。
cards.referenceText: Roger, UAL 835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，UAL 835。

cards.audioText: UAL 835, cleared ILS approach Runway 36R, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 835，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: cleared ILS approach Runway 36R, UAL 835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，UAL 835。

cards.audioText: Now you have established on ILS Runway 36R, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL 835, established on ILS Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL 835，已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。

cards.audioText: UAL 835, Runway 36R, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 835，Runway 36R，许可落地。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, cleared to land, UAL 835.
cards.referenceTextZh: Runway 36R，许可落地，UAL 835。

topics.name: UAL 221 颠簸 乘客医疗 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: Your call sign is UAL 221, you are maintaining 11,300 meters, over JTN, squawking 5536, make initial contact with Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 UAL 221，正保持 11,300 米，飞越 JTN，应答机 5536，与上海管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL 221, maintaining 2300 meters, over JTN, squawking 5536.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL 221，正保持 2300 米，飞越 JTN，应答机 5536。

cards.audioText: UAL 221, fly direct to TOL, maintain mach decimal 83 due separation.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 221，直飞 TOL，因间隔需要保持 Mach 0.83。
cards.referenceText: fly direct to TOL, maintain mach decimal eight tree, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 TOL，保持 Mach 0.83，UAL 221。

cards.audioText: you are encountering severe turbulence at 11,300 meters, contact Shanghai Control and check if any higher level is available.
cards.audioTextZh: 你在 11,300 米遭遇严重颠簸，联系上海管制并核实是否有任何更高高度可用。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL 221, we are encountering severe turbulence at 11 thoudand 300 meters, is higher level available?
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL 221，我们在 11300 米遭遇严重颠簸，是否有更高高度可用？

cards.audioText:
