cards.audioText: CCA 1368, Beijing Approach, follow PEK-05 arrival, descend to 2100 meters on QNH 1008, expect ILS approach Runway 01.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 1368，北京进近，执行 PEK-05 进场，在 QNH 1008 上下降至 2100 米，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 01。
cards.referenceText: follow PEK-05 arrival, descend to 2100 meters QNH 1008, expect ILS approach Runway 01, CCA 1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行 PEK-05 进场，在 QNH 1008 上下降至 2100 米，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 01，CCA 1368。

cards.audioText: CCA 1368, descend and maintain 1500 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 01, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 1368，下降并保持 1500 米，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 01，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: descend and maintain 1500 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 01, CCA 1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 1500 米，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 01，CCA 1368。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have intercepted the ILS signals of Runway 01, contact Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已截获跑道 01 的 ILS 信号，联系北京塔台。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 1368, established ILS approach Runway 01.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 1368，已建立跑道 01 ILS 进近。

cards.audioText: CCA 1368, Runway 01, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 1368，Runway 01，许可落地。
cards.referenceText: Runway 01, cleared to land, CCA 1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: Runway 01，许可落地，CCA 1368。

cards.audioText: B: During final approach, an aircraft is crossing Runway 01, you executed a missed approach, report it to Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 最后进近中，一架飞机正在穿越跑道 01，你执行复飞，向北京塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 1368, an aircraft is crossing Runway 01, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 1368，一架飞机正在穿越跑道 01，复飞。

cards.audioText: CCA 1368, climb straight ahead until 230 meters, turn right direct to PEK, hold at PEK at 600 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 1368，直线爬升至 230 米，右转直飞 PEK，在 PEK 以 600 米等待。
cards.referenceText: climb straight ahead until 200 and 30 meters, turn right direct to PEK, hold at PEK at 600 meters, CCA 1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直线爬升至 200 和 30 米，右转直飞 PEK，在 PEK 以 600 米等待，CCA 1368。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have landed on Runway 01, you find the runway surface is slippery, the braking action is medium, report it to Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已在跑道 01 着陆，发现跑道表面湿滑，刹车效应中等，向北京塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 1368, the runway surface is slippery, the breaking action is medium.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 1368，跑道表面湿滑，刹车效应中等。

cards.audioText: CCA 1368, roger, thanks, vacate Runway 01via rapid exit E2.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 1368，收到，谢谢，经 E2 快速脱离道脱离 Runway 01。
cards.referenceText: vacate Runway 01via rapid exit E two, CCA 1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 E2 快速脱离道脱离 Runway 01，CCA 1368。

topics.name: CCA 572 雷暴绕飞 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: Your callsign is CCA 572, a flight from Beijing to Wuhan, you are at Gate 305, you have got information D, contact Beijing Delivery and request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CCA 572，这是一趟从北京飞往武汉的航班，位于 305 登机口，已收到 D 情报，联系北京放行并申请 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, CCA 572, gate 305, information DAL, request ATC clearance to Wuhan.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，CCA 572，305 登机口，DAL 情报，申请前往武汉的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: CCA 572, Beijing Delivery, information DAL is valid, cleared to Wuhan via flight planned route, departure Runway 01, SOSID 21 DAL departure, initial climb 900 meters, cruising level 9200 meters, departure frequency 127.75, squawk 3103.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 572，北京放行，DAL 情报有效，许可按飞行计划航路飞往武汉，离场使用 Runway 01，执行 SOSID-21 DAL 离场，初始爬升至 900 米，巡航高度 9200 米，离场频率 127.75，应答机 3103。
cards.referenceText: information DAL, cleared to Wuhan via flight planned route, departure Runway 01, SOSID 21 DAL departure, initial climb 900 meters, cruising level 9200 meters, departure frequency 127.75, squawk 3103, CCA 572.
cards.referenceTextZh: DAL 情报，许可按飞行计划航路飞往武汉，离场使用 Runway 01，执行 SOSID-21 DAL 离场，初始爬升至 900 米，巡航高度 9200 米，离场频率 127.75，应答机 3103，CCA 572。

cards.audioText: CCA 572, readback correct, expect slot time 0325, report when ready for pushback and startup.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 572，复诵正确，预计时隙时间 0325，准备好推出和开车时报告。
cards.referenceText: Expect slot time 0325, wilco, CCA 572.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计时隙时间 0325，照办，CCA 572。

cards.audioText: Now tell the controller that you are ready for pushback and startup.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在告诉管制员你已准备好推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, CCA 572, ready for pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，CCA 572，已准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: CCA 572, roger, contact Beijing Apron on 121.95for pushback and startup.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 572，收到，联系北京机坪 121.95，申请推出和开车。

cards.audioText: CCA 572, Beijing Apron, startup and pushback approved, Runway 01, QNH1 0 12.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 572，北京机坪，开车和推出批准，Runway 01，QNH 1012。
cards.referenceText: startup and pushback approved, Runway 01, QNH 1012, CCA 572.
cards.referenceTextZh: 开车和推出批准，Runway 01，QNH 1012，CCA 572。

cards.audioText: Now the pushback and startup have been completed, you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在推出和开车已完成，你已准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Apron, CCA 572, pushback and startup completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京机坪，CCA 572，推出和开车已完成，申请滑行。

cards.audioText: CCA 572, taxi via Y4, K and Q zero to holding point Runway 01.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 572，经 Y4、K 和 Q0 滑行至 Runway 01 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi via Y four, Kolo and Q zero to holding point Runway 01, CCA 572.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Y4、K 和 Q0 滑行至 Runway 01 等待点，CCA 572。

cards.audioText: CCA 572, hold short of holding point 13, give way to inbound traffic taxiing in to gate 301, after traffic is clear, continue taxi via K and Q zero to holding point 01.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 572，在 13 等待点前等待，给正滑入 301 登机口的进港航空器让行，相关航空器通过后，经 K 和 Q0 继续滑行至 Runway 01 等待点。
cards.referenceText: hold short of holding point one tree, give way to inbound traffic taxiing in to gate 301, after traffic is clear, continue taxi via K and Q zero to holding point zero one, CCA 572.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在 13 等待点前等待，给正滑入 301 登机口的进港航空器让行，相关航空器通过后，经 K 和 Q0 继续滑行至 Runway 01 等待点，CCA 572。

cards.audioText: Now you are holding short of Runway 01, you are fully ready, contact Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你在 Runway 01 前等待，已完全准备好，联系北京塔台。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 572, holding short of Runway 01, ready.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 572，在 Runway 01 前等待，已准备好。

cards.audioText: CCA 572, Runway 01, cleared for immediate takeoff, surface wind 020 degrees, 3 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 572，Runway 01，许可立即起飞，地面风向 020 度，风速 3 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Runway 01, cleared for immediate takeoff, CCA 572.
cards.referenceTextZh: Runway 01，许可立即起飞，CCA 572。

cards.audioText: Two hours later, you are over HG, your weather radar observed a thunderstorm buildup ahead, contact Wuhan Approach and request 15 miles deviation to the east to avoid it.
cards.audioTextZh: 两小时后，你位于 HG 上空，气象雷达观察到前方有雷暴发展，联系武汉进近并请求向东偏航 15 英里以避让。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA 572, over HG, thunderstorm ahead, request 15 miles deviation to the east.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA 572，位于 HG 上空，前方有雷暴，请求向东偏航 15 英里。

cards.audioText: CCA 57215 miles deviation to the east approved, when able, proceed direct to WHA.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 572，批准向东偏航 15 英里，可以时直飞 WHA。
cards.referenceText: 15 miles deviation to the east approved, direct to WHA, CCA 572.
cards.referenceTextZh: 批准向东偏航 15 英里，直飞 WHA，CCA 572。

cards.audioText: Now you have established ILS Runway 36, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 36，向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 572, established ILS Runway 36.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 572，已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 36。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 572, continue approach, surface wind 200 degrees, 10 meters per second.
B: Because of the strong tailwind, you want to change landing runway to Runway 18.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CCA 572，继续进近，地面风向 200 度，风速 10 米/秒。
B： 因为顺风较强，你想将落地跑道更换为 Runway 18。
cards.referenceText: request change to Runway 18due strong tailwind, CCA 572.
cards.referenceTextZh: 因强顺风请求更换至 Runway 18，CCA 572。

cards.audioText: CCA 572, Runway 18, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 572，Runway 18，许可落地。
cards.referenceText: Runway 18, cleared to land, CCA 572.
cards.referenceTextZh: Runway 18，许可落地，CCA 572。

cards.audioText: CCA 572, expedite vacate Runway 18, traffic turning base.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 572，加速脱离 Runway 18，有航空器正在转入四边。
cards.referenceText: expedite vacate Runway 18, CCA 572.
cards.referenceTextZh: 加速脱离 Runway 18，CCA 572。

topics.name: CCA 1432 雷暴绕飞 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: Your call sign is CCA 1432, you are performing a flight from Guangzhou to Beijing, you are maintaining 5400 meters, over IKUBA, squawking 5655, make initial contact with Beijing Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CCA 1432，正在执行从广州飞往北京的航班，正保持 5400 米，飞越 IKUBA，应答机 5655，与北京进近首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA 1432, maintaining 5400 meters, over IKUBA, squawking 5655.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CCA 1432，正保持 5400 米，飞越 IKUBA，应答机 5655。

cards.audioText: CCA 1432, Beijing Approach, radar contact, climb to and maintain 6600 meters, contact Beijing Control on 118.2.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 1432，北京进近，雷达识别，爬升至并保持 6600 米，联系北京管制 118.2。
cards.referenceText: climb to and maintain 6600 meters, contact Beijing Control on 118.2, CCA 1432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至并保持 6600 米，联系北京管制 118.2，CCA 1432。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 6600 meters, contact Beijing Control and request further climb.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你保持 6600 米，联系北京管制并请求继续爬升。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA 1432, maintaining 6600 meters, requests further climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA 1432，保持 6600 米，请求继续爬升。

cards.audioText: CCA 1432, negative due traffic, maintain 6600 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 1432，不行，因交通原因保持 6600 米。
cards.referenceText: roger, maintain 6600 meters, CCA 1432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，保持 6600 米，CCA 1432。

cards.audioText: CCA 1432, climb to and maintain 8900 meters, turn left heading 210, fly direct to OBLIK.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 1432，爬升至并保持 8900 米，左转航向 210，直飞 OBLIK。
cards.referenceText: climb to and maintain 8900 meters, turn left heading 210, direct to OBLIK, CCA 1432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至并保持 8900 米，左转航向 210，直飞 OBLIK，CCA 1432。

cards.audioText: B: During cruise, your weather radar observed a thunderstorm ahead, request turn right and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 巡航期间，你的气象雷达发现前方有雷暴，请求右转并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA 1432, our weather radar observed a thunderstorm ahead, request turn right.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA 1432，我们的气象雷达发现前方有雷暴，请求右转。

cards.audioText: CCA 1432, negative due military activity. Continue present heading for 20 miles.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 1432，不行，因军事活动，沿当前航向继续飞行 20 英里。
cards.referenceText: roger, Continue present heading for 20 miles, CCA 1432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，沿当前航向继续飞行 20 英里，CCA 1432。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are clear of whether, report it to Beijing Control and request resume flight route.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已脱离天气，向北京管制报告并请求恢复航路。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA 1432, clear of whether, request resume flight route.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA 1432，已脱离天气，请求恢复航路。

cards.audioText: CCA 1432, turn left heading 240 to rejoin Amber 461, climb and maintain 1100 meters
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 1432，左转航向 240，重新加入 Amber 461，爬升并保持 1100 米。
cards.referenceText: turn left heading 240 to rejoin Amber 461, climb and maintain 1100 meters, 10100 meters, CCA 1432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 240，重新加入 Amber 461，爬升并保持 1100 米，10100 米，CCA 1432。

cards.audioText: CCA 1432, maintain 1100 meters, offset 10 miles left to avoid the reported strong downdraft.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 1432，保持 1100 米，为避开已报告的强下沉气流，向左偏置 10 英里。
cards.referenceText: maintain 1100 meters 10100 meters, offset 10 miles left to avoid the reported strong downdraft, CCA 1432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 1100 米，10100 米，为避开已报告的强下沉气流，向左偏置 10 英里，CCA 1432。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are flying into a small cumulonimbus, contact Beijing Control and tell the controller you'd like to hold at PEK VOR for weather improvement.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你正飞入一小块积雨云，联系北京管制，告诉管制员你想在 PEK VOR 等待，等待天气好转。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA 1432, we are flying into a small cumulonimbus, request hold at PEK VOR for weather improvement.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA 1432，我们正飞入一小块积雨云，请求在 PEK VOR 等待，等待天气好转。

cards.audioText: CCA 1432, hold at PEK VOR as published, when clear of weather, contact Beijing Approach on 119.25.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 1432，按公布程序在 PEK VOR 等待，脱离天气后联系北京进近 119.25。
cards.referenceText: hold at PEK VOR as published, when clear of weather, contact Beijing Approach on 119.25, CCA 1432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按公布程序在 PEK VOR 等待，脱离天气后联系北京进近 119.25，CCA 1432。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are approaching RENOB, maintaining 4800 meters, you have got information L, contact Beijing Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你接近 RENOB，保持 4800 米，已收到信息 L，联系北京进近。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA 1432, approaching RENOB, maintaining 4800 meters, information L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CCA 1432，接近 RENOB，保持 4800 米，信息 L。

cards.audioText: CCA 1432, Beijing Approach, radar contact, descend to and maintain 2400 meters, RENOB-2B arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 01.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 1432，北京进近，雷达识别，下降至并保持 2400 米，执行 RENOB-2B 进场，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 01。
cards.referenceText: descend to and maintain 2400 meters, RENOB two B Arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 01, CCA 1432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至并保持 2400 米，执行 RENOB-2B 进场，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 01，CCA 1432。

cards.audioText: CCA 1432, turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared ILS approach Runway 01, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 1432，右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 01，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared ILS approach Runway 01, CCA 1432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 01，CCA 1432。

topics.name: CCA 321 风挡裂纹 雷暴绕飞 积冰/防冰

cards.audioText: Your call sign is CCA 321, a flight from Beijing to Guangzhou, you are maintaining 11,600 meters, over DAPRO, squawking 3120, make initial contact with Guangzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CCA 321，航班从北京飞往广州，保持 11,600 米，飞越 DAPRO，应答机 3120，首次联系广州管制。
cards.referenceText: Control, CCA 321, 11600 meters, DAPRO, squawking 3120.
cards.referenceTextZh: 管制，CCA 321，11600 米，DAPRO，应答机 3120。

cards.audioText: CCA 321, Guangzhou Control, radar contact, maintain present level, omit position reports.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 321，广州管制，雷达已识别，保持当前高度，取消位置报告。
cards.referenceText: maintain present level, omit position reports, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前高度，取消位置报告，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: your weather radar indicates there is a group of cumulonimbus ahead, contact Guangzhou Control and ask to offset 20 miles to the right and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的气象雷达显示前方有一组积雨云，联系广州管制，请求向右偏置 20 英里并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Control, CCA 321, cumulonimbus, CB request offset 20 miles to the right.
cards.referenceTextZh: 管制，CCA 321，积雨云，CB，请求向右偏置 20 英里。

cards.audioText: CCA 321, negative due prohibited area.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 321，不行，因禁区限制。
cards.referenceText: roger, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: ask Guangzhou Control if you can offset 10 miles to the left to avoid the thunderstorm.
cards.audioTextZh: 询问广州管制，是否可以向左偏置 10 英里以避开雷暴。
cards.referenceText: Control, CCA 321, request offset 10 miles to the left.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CCA 321，请求向左偏置 10 英里。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 321, negative due restricted area.
B: you ask if you can turn left heading 100 and descend to 11000m to avoid the thunderstorms.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CCA 321，因限制区，不能批准。
B： 你询问是否可以左转航向 100，并下降至 11,000 米以避开雷暴。
cards.referenceText: Request turn left heading 100, descend to 11000 meters, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求左转航向 100，下降至 11,000 米，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: CCA 321, turn left heading 100 approved, descend to and maintain 11,000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 321，批准左转航向 100，下降至并保持 11,000 米。
cards.referenceText: turn left heading 100 approved, descend to and maintain 2000 meters 11000 meters, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 批准左转航向 100，下降至并保持 2,000 米、11,000 米，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: Now you are clear of weather, inform Guangzhou Control and request direct to ZF and descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已脱离天气，通知广州管制并请求直飞 ZF 和下降。
cards.referenceText: Control, CCA 321, clear of weather, request direct to ZF, descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CCA 321，已脱离天气，请求直飞 ZF 并下降。

cards.audioText: CCA 321, direct to ZF, descend to and maintain 9800 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 321，直飞 ZF，下降至并保持 9,800 米。
cards.referenceText: direct to ZF, descend to and maintain 9800, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 ZF，下降至并保持 9,800 米，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: Suddenly your captain got incapacitated, possibly suffered from cardiac arrest, contact Guangzhou Control. This is a distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的机长突然失能，可能发生心脏骤停，联系广州管制。这是一次遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Guangzhou Control, CCA 321, our captain got incapacitated, possibly cardiac arrest.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，广州管制，CCA 321，我们的机长失能，可能发生心脏骤停。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 321, report your current situation and further intention.
B: Tell Guangzhou Control that the cabin crew offered CPR procedures and first aid to revive the captain, but he has difficulty in breathing, and request priority landing and medical services.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CCA 321，报告你当前的情况和进一步意图。
B： 告诉广州管制，客舱机组对机长实施了心肺复苏和急救，试图使其恢复意识，但他呼吸困难，请求优先着陆和医疗服务。
cards.referenceText: the cabin crew offered CPR procedures, first aid, have difficulty in breathing, request priority landing, medical services, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 客舱机组实施了心肺复苏和急救，机长呼吸困难，请求优先着陆和医疗服务，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: CCA 321, turn right, direct to ZF, descend to and maintain 6000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 321，右转，直飞 ZF，下降至并保持 6,000 米。
cards.referenceText: turn right, direct to ZF, descend to and maintain 6000 meters, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 ZF，下降至并保持 6,000 米，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over ZF, maintaining 6000 meters, inform your situation to Wuhan Approach and request priority landing and medical services.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在 ZF 上空，保持 6000 米，向武汉进近说明情况并请求优先着陆和医疗服务。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Approach, CCA 321, over ZF, maintaining 6000 meters, our captain got incapacitated, he is having difficulty in breathing, request priority landing and medical services.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，武汉进近，CCA 321，过 ZF，保持 6000 米，我们的机长失能，他呼吸困难，请求优先着陆和医疗服务。

cards.audioText: CCA 321, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 330, cleared ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 321，收到 MAYDAY，右转航向 330，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 330, cleared ILS Runway 36R, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 330，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: During approach, you find the ILS signals seem to be unstable and your autopilot has malfunctioned, inform Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 进近期间，你发现 ILS 信号似乎不稳定，而且自动驾驶发生故障，通知武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA 321, ILS signals, unstable, autopilot malfunctioned.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA 321，ILS 信号不稳定，自动驾驶发生故障。

cards.audioText: At minimum altitude, you are unable to see the runway due to low visibility, you decide to divert to Changsha.
cards.audioTextZh: 在最低高度，由于能见度低，你无法看到跑道，因此决定备降长沙。
cards.referenceText: Approach, CCA 321, unable to see the runway, low visibility, request divert to Changsha.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，CCA 321，由于能见度低，无法看到跑道，请求备降长沙。

cards.audioText: During approach, the windshield suddenly had electrical arcing, inform the situation to Wuhan Approach and request delay the approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 进近期间，风挡突然出现电弧，向武汉进近报告情况并请求推迟进近。
cards.referenceText: Approach, CCA 321, windshield had electrical arcing, request delay the approach.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，CCA 321，风挡出现电弧，请求推迟进近。

cards.audioText: Now you find you have some errors with ILS, report it to Wuhan Approach and request auto-land.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你发现 ILS 存在一些误差，向武汉进近报告并请求自动着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA 321, we have some errors with ILS, request auto-land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA 321，我们的 ILS 存在一些误差，请求自动着陆。

cards.audioText: After landing, you can't find the taxiway due to shattered wind shield, request a follow-me car.
cards.audioTextZh: 着陆后，由于风挡破碎，你无法找到滑行道，请求引导车。
cards.referenceText: Ground, CCA 321, can't find the taxiway, shattered wind shield, request follow-me car.
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，CCA 321，由于风挡破碎，无法找到滑行道，请求引导车。

topics.name: CSN 542 撞气球 机翼,控制面损坏

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CSN 542, from Chengdu to Shanghai, you are at gate K10 with information B, request clearance from Chengdu Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 CSN 542，从 Chengdu 到 Shanghai，位于 K10 登机口，收到信息 B，向成都放行请求许可。
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Delivery, CSN 542, Gate K10, information B, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都放行，CSN 542，K10 登机口，信息 B，请求 ATC 许可。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 542, Chengdu Delivery, good afternoon, information B is valid, clear to destination via flight planned route, Runway 02, after departure, turn right direct BHS, initial climb to 1200 meters on QNH 1021, after departure, contact 125.6.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 542，成都放行，下午好，信息 B 有效，可以按计划航路前往目的地，跑道 02，离场后右转直飞 BHS，按 QNH 1021 初始爬升到 1200 米，离场后联系 125.6。
cards.referenceText: Information B is valid, cleared to destination via flight planned route, Runway 02, after departure turn right direct BHS, initial climb to 1200 meters on QNH 1021, after departure contact 125.6, CSN 542.
cards.referenceTextZh: 信息 B 有效，可以按计划航路前往目的地，跑道 02，离场后右转直飞 BHS，按 QNH 1021 初始爬升到 1200 米，离场后联系 125.6，CSN 542。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 542, read back correct, when ready for push back and start up, contact Ground 121.85.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 542，复诵正确，准备推出和开车时联系 地面 121.85。

cards.audioText: B: You are now ready for startup, request push back and permission to start your engines from Chengdu Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你现在准备开车，向成都地面请求推出和开车许可。
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Ground, CSN 542, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都地面，CSN 542，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 542, push back and start up approved.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 542，推出和开车批准。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, CSN 542.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，CSN 542。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 542, we just had a reports the bomb left in the first class passenger section, please advise your intentions.
B: Acknowledge the transmission and tell the controller that you will have the crew check the first class cabin.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CSN 542，我们刚收到报告，头等舱旅客区域有炸弹，请告知你的意图。
B: 确认该通话，并告诉管制员你会让机组检查头等舱。
cards.referenceText: Roger, we will have the crew check the first class cabin, CSN 542.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，我们会让机组检查头等舱，CSN 542。

cards.audioText: B: During the search, the cabin crew find a bag that is not claimed by any passengers, inform Ground about this and tell them that because there are no aircraft around you, you will hold position.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 搜查期间，客舱机组发现一个无人认领的包，通知 地面，并告诉他们由于你周围没有飞机，你将原地等待。
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Ground, CSN 542, the cabin crew found a bag that is not claimed by any passenger, request hold position due there are no aircraft around us.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都地面，CSN 542，客舱机组发现一个无人认领的包，由于我们周围没有飞机，请求原地等待。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, CSN 542, do you need any further assistance?
B: Tell the controller you will disembark the passengers, and request passenger steps and a bomb squad.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，CSN 542，你还需要其他援助吗？
B: 告诉管制员你将让旅客下机，并请求客梯和排爆小组。
cards.referenceText: We will disembark the passengers, request passenger steps and a bomb squad, CSN 542.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们将让旅客下机，请求客梯和排爆小组，CSN 542。

cards.audioText: B: It is now later in the day, the suspected bomb was an empty bag, you are at the holding point of Runway 02, tell the traffic controller you are ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 当天稍后，疑似炸弹是一个空包，你在跑道 02 等待点，告诉交通管制员你准备起飞。
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Tower, CSN 542, the suspected bomb was an empty bag, holding point of Runway 02, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都塔台，CSN 542，疑似炸弹是一个空包，在跑道 02 等待点，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 542, after departure maintain runway heading, cleared for takeoff Runway 02, surface wind 010 at 2 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 542，离场后保持跑道航向，跑道 02 可以起飞，地面风 010，2 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: After departure maintain runway heading, cleared for takeoff Runway 02, CSN 542.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离场后保持跑道航向，跑道 02 可以起飞，CSN 542。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 542, contact Departure on 125.6.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 542，联系 Departure 125.6。

cards.audioText: B: Contact Departure your altitude is now passing 200 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 联系 Departure，你的高度现在通过 200 米。
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Departure, CSN 542, passing 200 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: Chengdu Departure，CSN 542，通过 200 米。

cards.audioText: C: Good afternoon, CSN 542, maintain runway heading, climb to 3000 meters, be advised we have received some reports of a large unmanned weather balloons in your area.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 下午好，CSN 542，保持跑道航向，爬升到 3000 米，通知你，我们收到一些报告称你所在区域有大型无人气象气球。
cards.referenceText: Maintain runway heading, climb to 3000 meters, roger, thanks, CSN 542.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持跑道航向，爬升到 3000 米，收到，谢谢，CSN 542。

cards.audioText: B: As you are climbing you notice a large unmanned balloon, your position is 4 miles North of the airfield and current height is 2000 meters, report this to ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 爬升时你发现一个大型无人气球，你的位置在机场以北 4 海里，当前高度 2000 米，向 ATC 报告。
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Departure, CSN 542, we notice a large balloon, position North of airfield 4 miles 2000 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: Chengdu Departure，CSN 542，我们发现一个大型气球，位置机场以北 4 海里，2000 米。

cards.audioText: B: Before ATC replies, you suddenly hit another balloon you did not see, the aircraft becomes difficult to control and you want to return to land at Chengdu, tell ATC this. This is an Urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 在 ATC 回复前，你突然撞上另一个没看到的气球，飞机变得难以控制，你想返回 Chengdu 着陆，告诉 ATC。这是紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Chengdu Departure, CSN 542, we hit another balloon we did not see, the aircraft becomes difficult to control, request return to land at Chengdu.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，Chengdu Departure，CSN 542，我们撞上另一个未看到的气球，飞机变得难以控制，请求返回 Chengdu 着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 542, roger PAN, turn left heading 200, descend to 1200 meters, all runways available for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 542，收到 PAN，左转航向 200，下降到 1200 米，所有跑道均可用于着陆。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 200, descend to 1200 meters, roger, CSN 542.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 200，下降到 1200 米，收到，CSN 542。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 542, radar vectors are available or you can fly a visual circuit and join left downwind, please advise.
B: Tell the controller you will join left downwind.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CSN 542，可以提供雷达引导，或你可以飞目视起落航线并加入左下风，请告知。
B: 告诉管制员你将加入左下风。
cards.referenceText: Request join left downwind, CSN 542.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求加入左下风，CSN 542。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 542, roger, report downwind and when able can you tell us what is the damage to your aircraft?
B: Reply to the transmission and tell them you have a large hole in your wing and the control surfaces are damaged.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CSN 542，收到，报告下风，可以时告诉我们你的飞机损伤情况。
B: 回复通话，告诉他们机翼上有一个大洞，操纵面受损。
cards.referenceText: We have a large hole in our wing and the control surfaces are damaged, CSN 542.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们的机翼上有一个大洞，操纵面受损，CSN 542。

cards.audioText: B: You are now on downwind, report this to ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你现在在下风，向 ATC 报告。
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Tower, CSN 542, downwind.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都塔台，CSN 542，下风。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 542, you are number 1, cleared to land Runway 02, report on final.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 542，你是第 1 架，跑道 02 可以着陆，五边报告。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land Runway 02, CSN 542.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 02 可以着陆，CSN 542。

topics.name: CSN 342 炸弹电话 复飞

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CSN 342, you are just over ZF and maintaining 4500 meters, you are about to enter the Area control airspace. Make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 CSN 342，刚过 ZF，保持 4500 米，即将进入区域管制空域。与 武汉管制 建立初始联系。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CSN 342, over ZF, maintaining 4500 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CSN 342，过 ZF，保持 4500 米。

cards.audioText: B: Ask Wuhan Control for 8900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 向武汉管制请求 8900 米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CSN 342, request climb to 8900 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CSN 342，请求爬升到 8900 米。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 342, Wuhan Control, radar contact, climb to 7500 meters, expect 8900 meters at time 16.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 342，武汉管制，雷达识别，爬升到 7500 米，预计 16 分给 8900 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 7500 meters, CSN 342.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升到 7500 米，CSN 342。

cards.audioText: B: Inform the controller that you have encountered a severe clear air turbulence, and ask for 8900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 通知管制员你遭遇严重晴空颠簸，并请求 8900 米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CSN 342, we have encountered a severe clear air turbulence, request 8900 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CSN 342，我们遭遇严重晴空颠簸，请求 8900 米。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, CSN 342, climb to 8900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 收到，CSN 342，爬升到 8900 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 8900 meters, CSN 342.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升到 8900 米，CSN 342。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 342, Wuhan Control, is there any damage to the aircraft of passenger injuries?
B: Tell the controller that there isn't any aircraft damage, and the purser told you that passengers are OK.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CSN 342，武汉管制，飞机是否受损或旅客受伤？
B: 告诉管制员飞机没有受损，乘务长告诉你旅客都没事。
cards.referenceText: There isn't any damage to the aircraft, and the purser reported that the passengers are just fine, CSN 342.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机没有受损，乘务长报告旅客都没事，CSN 342。

cards.audioText: B: Inform Wuhan Control that you have just received an anonymous call saying there is a bomb on board your aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 通知 武汉管制，你刚收到匿名电话称飞机上有炸弹。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CSN 342, we have just received an anonymous calls saying there is a bomb on board our aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CSN 342，我们刚收到匿名电话称我们飞机上有炸弹。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, CSN 342, report your intentions.
B: Tell the controller that you wish to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，CSN 342，报告你的意图。
B: 告诉管制员你希望在 Wuhan Airport 着陆。
cards.referenceText: Request to land at Wuhan Airport, CSN 342.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求在 Wuhan Airport 着陆，CSN 342。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 342, roger, turn left direct to ZF and descend to 4800 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 342，收到，左转直飞 ZF，下降到 4800 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to ZF and descend to 4800 meters, CSN 342.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞 ZF，下降到 4800 米，CSN 342。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 342, do you need any assistance?
B: Inform the controller that you need a bomb disposal squad upon landing, and you will use the emergency sliders to deplane the passengers.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CSN 342，你需要什么援助？
B: 通知管制员着陆时需要排爆小组，并将使用应急滑梯让旅客下机。
cards.referenceText: We will use the emergency sliders for evacuation, request a bomb disposal squad on arrival, CSN 342.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们将使用应急滑梯撤离，请求到达时提供排爆小组，CSN 342。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 342, maintain 4800 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 342，保持 4800 米，联系武汉进近118.9。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 4800 meters, 118.9, CSN 342.

cards.audioText: B: Make an initial contact with Wuhan Approach, inform the controller that you have received an anonymous call saying there is a bomb on board your aircraft, and you are returning to Wuhan.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 与 武汉进近 建立初始联系，通知管制员你收到匿名电话称飞机上有炸弹，并且正在返回 Wuhan。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN 342, maintaining 4800 meters, over ZF, we have received an anonymous call saying there is a bomb on board our aircraft, and we are turning back to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN 342，保持 4800 米，过 ZF，我们收到匿名电话称飞机上有炸弹，正在返回 Wuhan Airport 着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 342, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, follow ZF-1A arrival, descend to 2700 meters on QNH 1017, information C.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 342，武汉进近，雷达识别，执行 ZF-1A 进场，按 QNH 1017 下降到 2700 米，信息 C。
cards.referenceText: Follow ZF-1A arrival, descend to 2700 meters on QNH 1017, information C, CSN 342.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行 ZF-1A 进场，按 QNH 1017 下降到 2700 米，信息 C，CSN 342。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 342, descend to 900 meters, expect ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 342，下降到 900 米，预计跑道 36R ILS 进近。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 900 meters, expect ILS approach Runway 36R, CSN 342.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到 900 米，预计跑道 36R ILS 进近，CSN 342。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 342, reduce speed to 200 knots, turn right heading 330.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 342，减速到 200 节，右转航向 330。
cards.referenceText: Reduce speed to 200 knots, turn right heading 330, CSN 342.
cards.referenceTextZh: 减速到 200 节，右转航向 330，CSN 342。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 342, intercept the localizer for Runway 36R, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 342，切入跑道 36R 航向道，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: Intercept the localizer for Runway 36R, report established, CSN 342.
cards.referenceTextZh: 切入跑道 36R 航向道，建立后报告，CSN 342。

cards.audioText: B: Inform the controller that you have captured the signal of the localizer.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 通知管制员你已截获航向道信号。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN 342, ILS established.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN 342，ILS 已建立。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, CSN 342, cleared ILS approach Runway 36R, 13 miles from touchdown, radar service terminated, contact Wuhan Tower on 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 收到，CSN 342，可以跑道 36R ILS 进近，距接地点 13 海里，雷达服务终止，联系武汉塔台124.35。
cards.referenceText: Cleared ILS approach Runway 36R, 124.35, CSN 342.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以跑道 36R ILS 进近，124.35，CSN 342。

cards.audioText: B: Later, you cannot see the runway at decision altitude during approach, inform Tower controller that you need to make another approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 稍后，进近中在决断高度看不到跑道，通知塔台管制员你需要再进近一次。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN 342, no contact at minimum, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN 342，最低标准高度无目视，复飞。

topics.name: CSN 319 一套液压系统失效

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CSN 319, you are parking at gate 51, you have received information C, from Wuhan to Guangzhou, ask for ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CSN 319，停在 51 号登机口，已收到通播 C，从武汉飞往广州，请求 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN 319, gate 51, information C, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CSN 319，51 号登机口，通播 C，请求 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 319, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, follow LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 9800 meters, when airborne, contact 119.7, squawk 2515.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 319，许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 36R，执行 LKO-01 离场，起始爬升至 1200 米，巡航高度 9800 米，离地后联系 119.7，应答机 2515。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, follow LKO-01 departure, initially climb to 1200 meters, cruising level 9800 meters, when airborne, contact 119.7, squawk 2515, CSN 319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 36R，执行 LKO-01 离场，起始爬升至 1200 米，巡航高度 9800 米，离地后联系 119.7，应答机 2515，CSN 319。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 319, due to military activity, expect 1 hour delay, you are number 5 for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 319，因军事活动，预计延误 1 小时，你是第 5 架离场。
cards.referenceText: Roger, CSN 319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，CSN 319。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已准备好推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 319, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 319，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 319, after Boeing 737 behind is clear, push back onto taxiway Z4, abeam gate 213, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 319，后方 Boeing 737 避让后，推出至滑行道 Z4，正对 213 号登机口，机头朝东。
cards.referenceText: After B737 behind is clear, push back onto taxiway Z4, abeam gate 213, facing east, CSN 319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 后方 B737 避让后，推出至滑行道 Z4，正对 213 号登机口，机头朝东，CSN 319。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, request taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出和开车，请求滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 319, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 319，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 319, taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, hold short of Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 319，经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，跑道 36R 外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, hold short of Runway 36R, CSN 319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，跑道 36R 外等待，CSN 319。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point Runway 36R, you are ready for takeoff, contact Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36R 等待点，准备好起飞，联系塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN 319, holding point Runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN 319，跑道 36R 等待点，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 319, behind Boeing 737 on final, line up Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 319，在五边 Boeing 737 后，进入跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Behind B737 on final, line up Runway 36R, CSN 319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在五边 B737 后，进入跑道 36R，CSN 319。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are passing 900 meters, contact Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你正通过 900 米，联系武汉离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CSN 319, passing 900 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，CSN 319，通过 900 米。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 319, climb to 3900 meters, expedite climb until passing 2100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 319，爬升至 3900 米，通过 2100 米前加快爬升。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 3900 meters, expedite climb until passing 2100 meters, CSN 319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 3900 米，通过 2100 米前加快爬升，CSN 319。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 319, stop climbing due to converging traffic, level off at 2700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 319，因汇聚冲突飞机，停止爬升，在 2700 米改平。
cards.referenceText: Stop climb, level off at 2700 meters, CSN 319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 停止爬升，在 2700 米改平，CSN 319。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 319, continue climb to 4500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 319，继续爬升至 4500 米。
cards.referenceText: Continue climb to 4500 meters, CSN 319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续爬升至 4500 米，CSN 319。

cards.audioText: B: During climb, you found 1 of your hydraulic systems has failed, make an Urgency call and tell ATC this situation and ask to level off at 3900 meters and then return to Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B：爬升中，你发现 1 套液压系统失效，发布紧急情况呼叫，告知 ATC 该情况，并请求在 3900 米改平后返回武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Departure, CSN 319, 1 of our hydraulic systems has failed, request level off at 3900 meters and return to Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉离场，CSN 319，我们 1 套液压系统失效，请求在 3900 米改平并返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 319, roger PAN, maintain 3900 meters, turn left, direct to LKO, LKO-02 arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 319，收到 PAN，保持 3900 米，左转，直飞 LKO，LKO-02 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 3900 meters, turn left, direct to LKO, LKO-02 arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R, CSN 319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 3900 米，左转，直飞 LKO，LKO-02 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CSN 319。

cards.audioText: B: A thunderstorm was detected near LKO, report it to Wuhan Approach and ask to deviate 20 miles to the left.
cards.audioTextZh: B：LKO 附近探测到雷暴，向武汉进近报告并请求向左偏置 20 海里。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN 319, there is a thunderstorm near LKO, request offset 20 miles to the left.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN 319，LKO 附近有雷暴，请求向左偏置 20 海里。

topics.name: CSN 817 强风切变 浓雾

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CSN 817, you are at gate 213, you have got information G, request ATC clearance to Guangzhou from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CSN 817，在 213 号登机口，已收到通播 G，向武汉放行请求飞往广州的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN 817, gate 213, information G, request ATC clearance to Guangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CSN 817，213 号登机口，通播 G，请求飞往广州的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 817, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, LKO-01 departure, initial climb to 1200 meters, cruising level 8400 meters, after departure, contact 119.7, squawk 3115.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 817，武汉放行，许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 36R，LKO-01 离场，起始爬升至 1200 米，巡航高度 8400 米，离场后联系 119.7，应答机 3115。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, LKO-01 departure, initial climb to 1200 meters, cruising level 8400 meters, after departure, contact 119.7, squawk 3115, CSN 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 36R，LKO-01 离场，起始爬升至 1200 米，巡航高度 8400 米，离场后联系 119.7，应答机 3115，CSN 817。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and engine have been started up, contact Wuhan Ground for taxiing instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出并已开车，联系武汉地面获取滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 817, push backand start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 817，推出和开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 817, taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 817，经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, CSN 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CSN 817。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 817, taxi with caution, men and equipment operating east of taxiway A.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 817，谨慎滑行，A 滑行道以东有人和设备作业。
cards.referenceText: Roger, CSN 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，CSN 817。

cards.audioText: B: Just after liftoff, you encountered strong wind shear between 200 meters and 400 meters, report it to Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：刚离地后，你在 200 米至 400 米之间遭遇强风切变，向武汉进近报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN 817, we encountered strong wind shear between 200 meters and 400 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN 817，我们在 200 米至 400 米之间遭遇强风切变。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are cruising at 8400 meters, approaching DAPRO, make an initial contact with Guangzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 8400 米巡航，接近 DAPRO，与广州管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN 817, maintaining 8400 meters, approaching DAPRO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CSN 817，保持 8400 米，接近 DAPRO。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 817, Guangzhou Control, radar identified, omit position reports.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 817，广州管制，雷达识别，省略位置报告。
cards.referenceText: Omit position reports, CSN 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 省略位置报告，CSN 817。

cards.audioText: B: As you are descending to 4200 meters, you executed TCAS RA climbing maneuver, report the situation to the controller.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你下降至 4200 米时，执行了 TCAS RA 爬升机动，向管制员报告情况。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CSN 817, descending to 4200 meters, TCAS climbing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，CSN 817，下降至 4200 米，TCAS 爬升。

cards.audioText: B: Now the conflicting traffic is clear, resumed descent, report the situation to the controller.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在冲突飞机已脱离，恢复下降，向管制员报告情况。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CSN 817, clear of traffic, resume descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，CSN 817，冲突已解除，恢复下降。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 817, continue descent to 3600 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 817，继续下降至 3600 米。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to 3600 meters, CSN 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降至 3600 米，CSN 817。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are established on ILS approach Runway 36R, tell the controller you can't see the PAPI lights.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已建立 ILS 进近跑道 36R，告诉管制员你看不到 PAPI 灯。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN 817, established on ILS approach Runway 36R, we can't see the PAPI lights.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN 817，已建立 ILS 进近跑道 36R，我们看不到 PAPI 灯。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 817, cleared to land Runway 36R, the PAPI is out of service.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 817，跑道 36R 可以落地，PAPI 不工作。
cards.referenceText: Roger, cleared to land Runway 36R, CSN 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，跑道 36R 可以落地，CSN 817。

cards.audioText: B: After landing, due to the thick fog, you can't find the taxiway clearly, ask Tower for a follow-me car to taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：落地后，由于浓雾，你看不清滑行道，向塔台请求引导车滑行。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN 817, due to the thick fog, we can't find the taxiway clearly, request a follow-me car.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN 817，由于浓雾，我们看不清滑行道，请求引导车。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 817, the follow-me car will be waiting for you on the taxiway A.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 817，引导车将在 A 滑行道上等你。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CSN 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CSN 817。

topics.name: CSN 557 左主起落架未收回 液压系统漏油

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CSN 557, you are flying from Wuhan to Rome, you are taxiing southbound on taxiway C to holding point Runway 36L, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CSN 557，从武汉飞往罗马，你正在 C 滑行道向南滑行至跑道 36L 等待点，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN 557, taxiing on taxiway C to holding point Runway 36L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN 557，在 C 滑行道滑行至跑道 36L 等待点。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 557, line up Runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 557，进入跑道 36L。
cards.referenceText: Line up Runway 36L, CSN 557.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进入跑道 36L，CSN 557。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 557, wind calm, contact Approach on 119.25 when airborne, cleared for takeoff Runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 557，风静，离地后联系进近 119.25，跑道 36L 可以起飞。
cards.referenceText: 119.25, cleared for takeoff Runway 36L, CSN 557.
cards.referenceTextZh: 119.25，跑道 36L 可以起飞，CSN 557。

cards.audioText: B: After airborne, you have an undercarriage warning, your left main gear has not fully retracted, call Wuhan Approach and request maintain 1200 meters and speed 180 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: B：离地后，你有起落架警告，左主起落架未完全收上，呼叫武汉进近并请求保持 1200 米、速度 180 节。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN 557, we have an undercarriage warning, our left main gear has not fully retracted, request maintain 1200 meters and speed 180 knots.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN 557，我们有起落架警告，左主起落架未完全收上，请求保持 1200 米、速度 180 节。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 557, climb and maintain 1200 meters, speed 180 knots approved, advise intentions when able.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 557，爬升并保持 1200 米，速度 180 节同意，能够时告知意图。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 1200 meters, speed 180 knots approved, CSN 557.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 1200 米，速度 180 节同意，CSN 557。

cards.audioText: B: After performing the checklist, you still can't verify the landing gear position, tell Wuhan Approach you want to return to Wuhan Airport and fly a low pass over airfield for visual inspection.
cards.audioTextZh: B：完成检查单后，你仍无法确认起落架位置，告诉武汉进近你想返回武汉机场，并在机场上空低通场进行目视检查。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN 557, we can't verify the landing gear position, request return to Wuhan Airport and request a low pass over airfield for visual inspection.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN 557，我们无法确认起落架位置，请求返回武汉机场，并请求在机场上空低通场进行目视检查。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 557, turn right, track direct to DA NDB, descend to 900 meters, follow published procedure, cleared ILS approach 36 right.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 557，右转，直飞 DA NDB，下降至 900 米，按公布程序，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, track direct to DA NDB, descend to 900 meters, follow published procedure, cleared ILS approach 36R, CSN 557.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 DA NDB，下降至 900 米，按公布程序，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CSN 557。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 557, you are 10 miles from touchdown, contact Wuhan Tower 118.5.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 557，你距接地点 10 海里，联系武汉塔台118.5。

cards.audioText: B: Call tower and tell them you are established on ILS Runway 36R, you are ready for low pass.
cards.audioTextZh: B：呼叫塔台并告诉他们你已建立 ILS 跑道 36R，准备低通场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN 557, established on ILS Runway 36R, ready for low pass.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN 557，已建立 ILS 跑道 36R，准备低通场。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 557, wind calm, cleared low pass Runway 36R, not below 100 meters above the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 557，风静，跑道 36R 低通场许可，不低于跑道上方 100 米。
cards.referenceText: Cleared low pass Runway 36R, not below 100 meters above the runway, CSN 557.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R 低通场许可，不低于跑道上方 100 米，CSN 557。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 557, after low pass, maintain runway heading, climb to 900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 557，低通场后，保持跑道航向，爬升至 900 米。
cards.referenceText: After low pass, maintain runway heading, climb to 900 meters, CSN 557.
cards.referenceTextZh: 低通场后，保持跑道航向，爬升至 900 米，CSN 557。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 557, we have a good look at your undercarriage, your left main landing gear is stuck halfway, it is not in the extended position, advise intention.
B: Tell Tower you want to perform hold near the airport.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 557，我们看清了你的起落架，你的左主起落架卡在半程，未在放下位置，告知意图。
B：告诉塔台你想在机场附近等待。
cards.referenceText: Roger, request hold near the airport, CSN 557.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，请求在机场附近等待，CSN 557。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 557, turn left, direct to DA, climb to 1200 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 119.25.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 557，左转，直飞 DA，爬升至 1200 米，联系武汉进近119.25。
cards.referenceText: Turn left, direct to DA, climb to 1200 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 119.25, CSN 557.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转，直飞 DA，爬升至 1200 米，联系武汉进近119.25，CSN 557。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are tracking direct to DA, maintaining 1200 meters, call Wuhan Approach and request holding instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你正直飞 DA，保持 1200 米，呼叫武汉进近并请求等待指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN 557, tracking direct to DA, maintaining 1200 meters, request holding instructions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN 557，正直飞 DA，保持 1200 米，请求等待指令。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 557, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, hold at DA NDB as published, expect further clearance at 50, report entering the hold.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 557，武汉进近，雷达识别，在 DA NDB 按公布程序等待，预计进一步许可 50，报告进入等待。
cards.referenceText: Hold at DA NDB as published, CSN 557.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在 DA NDB 按公布程序等待，CSN 557。

cards.audioText: B: During hold, another warning is triggered, 1 of the hydraulic systems is leaking fluid slowly, this is an Urgency call, you want to dump fuel and return for emergency landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：等待中，另一个警告触发，1 套液压系统缓慢漏油，这是紧急情况呼叫，你想放油并返回紧急着陆。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, CSN 557, 1 of the hydraulic systems is leaking fluid slowly, request dump fuel and return for emergency landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉进近，CSN 557，1 套液压系统缓慢漏油，请求放油并返回紧急着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 557, roger PAN, climb to and maintain 3000 meters, turn left heading 310, radar vector to dump fuel, we will have emergency services ready and foam the runway slowly.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 557，收到 PAN，爬升并保持 3000 米，左转航向 310，雷达引导航空放油，我们将准备好应急服务并缓慢给跑道铺泡沫。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 3000 meters, turn left heading 310, radar vector to dump fuel, roger, thanks, CSN 557.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 3000 米，左转航向 310，雷达引导航空放油，收到，谢谢，CSN 557。

cards.audioText: B: After emergency landing at Runway 36R, the aircraft is still intact, you want to make an emergency evacuation.
cards.audioTextZh: B：在跑道 36R 紧急着陆后，飞机仍保持完整，你想进行紧急撤离。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN 557, the aircraft is still intact, request emergency evacuation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN 557，飞机仍保持完整，请求紧急撤离。

topics.name: CSN 371 自动刹车警告 丢失几页飞行手册

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CSN 371, a flight from Wuhan to Moscow, you are at bay 224, you have got information C, request ATC clearance to Moscow from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CSN 371，从武汉飞往莫斯科，在 224 号机位，已收到通播 C，向武汉放行请求飞往莫斯科的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN 371, bay 224, information C, request ATC clearance to Moscow.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CSN 371，224 号机位，通播 C，请求飞往莫斯科的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 371, cleared to Moscow via flight planned route, follow ZF-01 departure, cruising level 8900 meters, initial climb 1500 meters, departure frequency 119.45, squawk 3223.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 371，许可飞往莫斯科，按飞行计划航路，执行 ZF-01 离场，巡航高度 8900 米，起始爬升 1500 米，离场频率 119.45，应答机 3223。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Moscow via flight planned route, follow ZF-01 departure, cruising level 8900 meters, initial climb 1500 meters, departure frequency 119.45, squawk 3223, CSN 371.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往莫斯科，按飞行计划航路，执行 ZF-01 离场，巡航高度 8900 米，起始爬升 1500 米，离场频率 119.45，应答机 3223，CSN 371。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 371, read back correct, contact Wuhan Ground on 121.9.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 371，复诵正确，联系武汉地面121.9。

cards.audioText: B: The maintenance staff has deferred an MEL item regarding APU, contact Ground and tell the controller you will be ready to start 1 engine at the bay in 5 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: B：维修人员已保留一项关于 APU 的 MEL 项目，联系地面并告诉管制员你将在 5 分钟后准备好在机位启动 1 台发动机。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 371, request start 1 engine at the bay in 5 minutes due to APU problem.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 371，因 APU 问题，请求 5 分钟后在机位启动 1 台发动机。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 371, slot time 50, start 1 engine at the bay approved, call me back when ready for push back.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 371，时隙 50，同意在机位启动 1 台发动机，准备好推出时再呼叫我。
cards.referenceText: Slot time 50, start 1 engine at the bay approved, CSN 371.
cards.referenceTextZh: 时隙 50，同意在机位启动 1 台发动机，CSN 371。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 371, ready for push back.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 371，准备好推出。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 371, push back onto F, facing south.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 371，推出至 F，机头朝南。
cards.referenceText: Push back onto F, facing south, CSN 371.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出至 F，机头朝南，CSN 371。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 371, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 371，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 371, taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway F, A9, hold short of A.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 371，经滑行道 F、A9 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，A 外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway F, A9, hold short of A, CSN 371.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 F、A9 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，A 外等待，CSN 371。

cards.audioText: B: During taxi an auto brake caution message is displayed on the aircraft warning system, so you stop taxiing, advise Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行中飞机警告系统显示自动刹车警戒信息，所以你停止滑行，告知地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 371, we have an auto brake caution message, we stopped taxiing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 371，我们有自动刹车警戒信息，我们已停止滑行。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 371, roger, hold at present position, advise your intention when able.
B: Tell the controller you are still able to taxi, but you need 5 minutes to deal with the problem, ask to hold at the convenient position.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 371，收到，在当前位置等待，能够时告知意图。
B：告诉管制员你仍能滑行，但需要 5 分钟处理问题，请求在方便位置等待。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 371, we are still able to taxi, but we need 5 minutes to deal with the problem, request hold at the convenient position.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 371，我们仍能滑行，但需要 5 分钟处理问题，请求在方便位置等待。

cards.audioText: B: While communicating with mechanic and dispatcher, you discovered that some pages of onboard flight manuals were missing, it is against regulation to continue flight, report it to ATC and ask for returning to the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: B：与机务和签派沟通时，你发现机载飞行手册有部分页面缺失，继续飞行违反规定，向 ATC 报告并请求返回登机口。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 371, some pages of onboard flight manuals were missing, it is against regulation to continue flight, request return to the gate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 371，机载飞行手册有部分页面缺失，继续飞行违反规定，请求返回登机口。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 371, taxi to bay 224 via taxiway A8, A, A5.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 371，经滑行道 A8、A、A5 滑行至 224 号机位。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to bay 224 via taxiway A8, A, A5, CSN 371.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 A8、A、A5 滑行至 224 号机位，CSN 371。

cards.audioText: B: 2 hours later, now you are maintaining 9500 meters, approaching WXI, squawking 3223, contact Beijing Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：2 小时后，现在你保持 9500 米，接近 WXI，应答机 3223，联系北京管制。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 371, maintaining 9500 meters, approaching WXI, squawking 3223.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 371，保持 9500 米，接近 WXI，应答机 3223。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 371, maintain 9500 meters, report VYK.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 371，保持 9500 米，报告 VYK。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 9500 meters, report VYK, CSN 371.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 9500 米，报告 VYK，CSN 371。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over VYK, maintaining 9500 meters, report it to Beijing Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 VYK 上空，保持 9500 米，向北京管制报告。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 371, over VYK, maintaining 9500 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 371，VYK 上空，保持 9500 米。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 371, climb to and maintain 10700 meters.
B: Tell Beijing Control you are too heavy, request a step climb to 10700 meters in about 1 hour.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 371，爬升并保持 10700 米。
B：告诉北京管制你太重，请求约 1 小时后阶梯爬升至 10700 米。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 371, request a step climb to 10700 meters in about 1 hour due heavy weight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 371，因重量大，请求约 1 小时后阶梯爬升至 10700 米。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 371, due separation, maintain not greater than Mach 0.80.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 371，因间隔，保持不大于马赫 0.80。
cards.referenceText: Maintain not greater than M.80, CSN 371.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持不大于 M.80，CSN 371。

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CSN 102, a flight from Wuhan to Guangzhou, you are at gate 213, you have got information K, request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CSN 102，从武汉飞往广州，在 213 号登机口，已收到通播 K，请求 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN 3102, gate 213, information K, request ATC clearance to Guangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CSN 3102，213 号登机口，通播 K，请求飞往广州的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, runway in use 36R, LKO-02 departure, initial altitude 1200 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, departure frequency 119.75, squawk 2736.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，使用跑道 36R，LKO-02 离场，起始高度 1200 米，巡航高度 10400 米，离场频率 119.75，应答机 2736。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, runway in use 36R, LKO-02 departure, initial altitude 1200 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, departure frequency 119.75, squawk 2736, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，使用跑道 36R，LKO-02 离场，起始高度 1200 米，巡航高度 10400 米，离场频率 119.75，应答机 2736，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 3102, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 3102，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, push back and start up approved, facing north.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，同意推出和开车，机头朝北。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing north, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出和开车，机头朝北，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: B: During engine start up, your APU has malfunctioned, ask Wuhan Ground to start 1 engine at the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: B：开车过程中，你的 APU 故障，请求武汉地面在登机口启动 1 台发动机。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 3102, request start 1 engine at the gate due APU malfunction.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 3102，因 APU 故障，请求在登机口启动 1 台发动机。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, start 1 engine at the gate approved, report when ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，同意在登机口启动 1 台发动机，准备滑行时报告。
cards.referenceText: Start 1 engine at the gate approved, wilco, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意在登机口启动 1 台发动机，照办，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have started up your engines, you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已启动发动机，准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 3102, start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 3102，开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, hold position, give way to Boeing 747 passing from left to right.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，原地等待，避让从左至右经过的 Boeing 747。
cards.referenceText: Holding position, give way to B747 passing from left to right, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 原地等待，避让从左至右经过的 B747，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, traffic passed and clear, continue taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，飞机已通过并脱离，继续滑行。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue taxi, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续滑行，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, contact Wuhan Tower 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，联系武汉塔台124.35。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are approaching holding point Runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower and tell the controller you are ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你正接近跑道 36R 等待点，联系武汉塔台并告诉管制员你准备好起飞。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN 3102, approaching holding point Runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN 3102，接近跑道 36R 等待点，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, hold short of Runway 36R, expect 15 minutes delay due thunderstorm approaching the upwind of Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，跑道 36R 外等待，因雷暴接近跑道 36R 上风边，预计延误 15 分钟。
cards.referenceText: Roger, hold short of Runway 36R, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，跑道 36R 外等待，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: B: After ten minutes, you find you need to refuel the aircraft due to a long time delay, you have to taxi back for refueling the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: B：十分钟后，由于长时间延误，你发现需要给飞机加油，必须滑回给飞机加油。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN 3102, request taxi back for refueling the aircraft due to long time delay.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN 3102，因长时间延误，请求滑回给飞机加油。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, enter Runway 36R, vacate runway via A2, then T5 to gate 211.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，进入跑道 36R，经 A2 脱离跑道，然后经 T5 到 211 号登机口。
cards.referenceText: Enter Runway 36R, vacate runway via A2, then T5 to gate 211, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进入跑道 36R，经 A2 脱离跑道，然后经 T5 到 211 号登机口，CSN 3102。

topics.name: CSN 3109 冰雹风挡裂 自动降落许可

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CSN 109, you are approaching VYK, maintaining 4500 meters, squawking 3125, make initial contact with Beijing Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CSN 109，正接近 VYK，保持 4500 米，应答机 3125，与北京管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 3109, approaching VYK, maintaining 4500 meters, squawking 3125.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 3109，接近 VYK，保持 4500 米，应答机 3125。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 109, Beijing Control, radar contact, direct to VYK, after passing VYK, climb to 8400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 109，北京管制，雷达识别，直飞 VYK，过 VYK 后爬升至 8400 米。
cards.referenceText: Direct to VYK, after passing VYK, climb to 8400 meters, CSN 3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 VYK，过 VYK 后爬升至 8400 米，CSN 3109。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar observed a thunderstorm ahead, request Beijing Control for a right turn to avoid the thunderstorm.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的气象雷达观察到前方雷暴，请求北京管制右转避开雷暴。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 3109, our weather radar observed a thunderstorm ahead, request right turn to avoid it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 3109，我们的气象雷达观察到前方雷暴，请求右转避让。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 109, negative due military activity, turn left heading 010.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 109，不能同意，因军事活动，左转航向 010。
cards.referenceText: Roger, turn left heading 010, CSN 3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，左转航向 010，CSN 3109。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 109, turn left heading 350.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 109，左转航向 350。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 350, CSN 3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 350，CSN 3109。

cards.audioText: B: Now there is a strong E of thunderstorm, you are too close to the weather, request left turn to avoid it.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在有强雷暴回波，你离天气太近，请求左转避让。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 3109, there is a strong E of thunderstorm, we are too close to the weather, request left turn to avoid it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 3109，有强雷暴回波，我们离天气太近，请求左转避让。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 109, left turn is not permitted due restricted area.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 109，因限制区，不允许左转。
cards.referenceText: Roger, CSN 3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，CSN 3109。

cards.audioText: B: Suddenly, you have suffered from hail strike, the wind shield is cracked on the outside, report it to Beijing Control and request return to land.
cards.audioTextZh: B：突然，你遭遇冰雹撞击，风挡外层开裂，向北京管制报告并请求返回着陆。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 3109, we have suffered from hail strike, the wind shield is cracked on the outside, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 3109，我们遭遇冰雹撞击，风挡外层开裂，请求返回着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 109, roger, turn right heading 340, direct to VYK, descend to and maintain 5100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 109，收到，右转航向 340，直飞 VYK，下降并保持 5100 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 340, direct to VYK, descend to and maintain 5100 meters, CSN 3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 340，直飞 VYK，下降并保持 5100 米，CSN 3109。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 109, descend to 4200 meters, contact Beijing Approach 119.25.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 109，下降至 4200 米，联系北京进近119.25。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 4200 meters, 119.25, CSN 3109.

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 4200 meters, over VYK, you have got information K, contact Beijing Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你保持 4200 米，在 VYK 上空，已收到通播 K，联系北京进近。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CSN 3109, maintaining 4200 meters, over VYK, information K.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CSN 3109，保持 4200 米，VYK 上空，通播 K。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 109, Beijing Approach, radar contact, follow VYK-05 arrival, expect radar vectors for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 109，北京进近，雷达识别，执行 VYK-05 进场，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Follow VYK-05 arrival, expect radar vectors for ILS approach Runway 36R, CSN 3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行 VYK-05 进场，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CSN 3109。

cards.audioText: B: During approach, neither of you can see through the windshield due to crack windshield, you ask Beijing Tower if Beijing Airport permits auto-land.
cards.audioTextZh: B：进近中，由于风挡开裂，你们两人都无法透过风挡看清，询问北京塔台北京机场是否允许自动着陆。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN 3109, neither of us can see through the windshield due to crack windshield, does your airport permit auto-land ?
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN 3109，由于风挡开裂，我们两人都无法透过风挡看清，你机场是否允许自动着陆？

cards.audioText: C: CSN 109, Runway 36R, cleared to land, surface wind 350, 3 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 109，跑道 36R，可以落地，地面风 350，3 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, cleared to land, CSN 3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R，可以落地，CSN 3109。

cards.audioText: B: After landing, you can't see the taxiway clearly due to cracked windshield, request a tug.
cards.audioTextZh: B：落地后，由于风挡开裂，你看不清滑行道，请求拖车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN 3109, we can't see the taxiway clearly due to cracked windshield, request a tug.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN 3109，由于风挡开裂，我们看不清滑行道，请求拖车。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 109, hold position, the tug will come soon.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 109，原地等待，拖车很快会来。
cards.referenceText: Roger, hold position, CSN 3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，原地等待，CSN 3109。

topics.name: CSN 1310 减跑道 地面延误加油

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CSN 310, performing a flight from Beijing to Guangzhou, you are parking at gate 221, you have received information B, contact Beijing Delivery and request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CSN 310，执行北京至广州航班，停在 221 号登机口，已收到通播 B，联系北京放行并请求 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, CSN 1310, gate 221, information B, request ATC clearance to Guangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，CSN 1310，221 号登机口，通播 B，请求飞往广州的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 310, Beijing Delivery, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, BOBAK-03 departure, departure Runway 36R, initial climb 1800 meters, cruising level 9500 meters, squawk 2536.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 310，北京放行，许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，BOBAK-03 离场，离场跑道 36R，起始爬升 1800 米，巡航高度 9500 米，应答机 2536。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, BOBAK-03 departure, departure Runway 36R, initial climb 1800 meters, cruising level 9500 meters, squawk 2536, CSN 1310.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，BOBAK-03 离场，离场跑道 36R，起始爬升 1800 米，巡航高度 9500 米，应答机 2536，CSN 1310。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 310, expect slot time 0215 due to temporary departure restrictions, report when ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 310，因临时离场限制，预计时隙 0215，准备好推出和开车时报告。
cards.referenceText: Roger, CSN 1310.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，CSN 1310。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 310, slot time restriction has canceled, monitored Beijing Ground 121.975.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 310，时隙限制已取消，守听北京地面 121.975。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back, contact Beijing Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出，联系北京地面。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN 1310, request push back.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN 1310，请求推出。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 310, Beijing Ground, push back approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 310，北京地面，同意推出，机头朝东。
cards.referenceText: Push back approved, facing east, CSN 1310.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出，机头朝东，CSN 1310。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back, you are on taxiway Z4, you are ready for start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出，在滑行道 Z4，准备好开车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN 1310, taxiway Z4, request start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN 1310，滑行道 Z4，请求开车。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 310, your slot time has expired, your new slot time is 0325, start up at own discretion.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 310，你的时隙已过期，新时隙是 0325，自行决定开车。
cards.referenceText: Roger, slot time 0325, start up at own discretion, CSN 1310.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，时隙 0325，自行决定开车，CSN 1310。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed startup and before taxiing checklist, you are ready for taxi, contact Beijing Ground for taxiing instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成开车和滑行前检查单，准备好滑行，联系北京地面获取滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN 1310, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN 1310，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 310, taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z4, Z3, T5, D6.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 310，经滑行道 Z4、Z3、T5、D6 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z4, Z3, T5, D6, CSN 1310.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、Z3、T5、D6 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CSN 1310。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 310, hold short of T5, give way to Boeing 747 passing from left to right.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 310，T5 外等待，避让从左至右经过的 Boeing 747。
cards.referenceText: Hold short of T5, traffic in sight, CSN 1310.
cards.referenceTextZh: T5 外等待，看到飞机，CSN 1310。

cards.audioText: B: Now the traffic is clear, you decide to make intersection departure from W2, contact Beijing Ground to request intersection departure from W2.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在飞机已脱离，你决定从 W2 交叉口离场，联系北京地面请求从 W2 交叉口离场。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN 1310, clear of traffic, request intersection departure from W2.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN 1310，飞机已脱离，请求从 W2 交叉口离场。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 310, negative intersection departure due sequencing, continue taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway T5 and D6.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 310，因排序不能同意交叉口离场，继续经滑行道 T5 和 D6 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway T5 and D6, CSN 1310.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续经滑行道 T5 和 D6 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CSN 1310。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point Runway 36R, you are ready for takeoff, contact Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36R 等待点，准备好起飞，联系北京塔台。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN 1310, holding point Runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN 1310，跑道 36R 等待点，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 310, hold short of Runway 36R, expect 15 minutes delay due thunderstorms in the vicinity of the airport.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 310，跑道 36R 外等待，因机场附近雷暴预计延误 15 分钟。
cards.referenceText: Roger, hold short of Runway 36R, CSN 1310.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，跑道 36R 外等待，CSN 1310。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 310, Runway 36R, line up and cleared for takeoff, surface wind 350 degrees, 3 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 310，跑道 36R，进跑道并可以起飞，地面风 350 度，3 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, line up and cleared for takeoff, CSN 1310.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R，进跑道并可以起飞，CSN 1310。

cards.audioText: B: You find you have no enough fuel to the destination due to long ground delay, tell Beijing Tower you have to taxi back to refuel your aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: B：由于长时间地面延误，你发现燃油不足以到达目的地，告诉北京塔台你必须滑回给飞机加油。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN 1310, we have no enough fuel to the destination due long ground delay, request taxi back to refuel the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN 1310，由于长时间地面延误，我们没有足够燃油到达目的地，请求滑回给飞机加油。

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CSN 202, destination Harbin. You just departed from Beijing airport at 23. You are passing 1200 meters and want to climb to 1800 meters, contact Beijing Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CSN 202，目的地哈尔滨。你 23 从北京机场刚起飞，正通过 1200 米，想爬升至 1800 米，联系北京离场。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CSN 6202, from Beijing to Harbin, airborne 23, passing 1200 meters, request climb to 1800 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，CSN 6202，从北京飞往哈尔滨，23 离地，通过 1200 米，请求爬升至 1800 米。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 202, Beijing Departure, radar contact, due to slower preceding traffic, cancel SID, turn right heading 010.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 202，北京离场，雷达识别，因前机速度较慢，取消 SID，右转航向 010。
cards.referenceText: Cancel SID, turn right heading 010, CSN 6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消 SID，右转航向 010，CSN 6202。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 202, climb to 5400 meters on standard, resume own navigation, direct to YV, via flight planned route.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 202，标准气压爬升至 5400 米，恢复自主导航，直飞 YV，按飞行计划航路。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 5400 meters on standard, resume own navigation, direct to YV via flight planned route, CSN 6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 标准气压爬升至 5400 米，恢复自主导航，直飞 YV，按飞行计划航路，CSN 6202。

cards.audioText: B: Inform the controller that your weather radar shows a build-up around YV, request direct to KAKAT.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告知管制员你的气象雷达显示 YV 附近有云团发展，请求直飞 KAKAT。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CSN 6202, our weather radar shows a build-up around YV, request direct to KAKAT.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，CSN 6202，我们的气象雷达显示 YV 附近有云团发展，请求直飞 KAKAT。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 202, contact Beijing Control 125.9 for request.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 202，请联系北京管制125.9 提出请求。

cards.audioText: B: Make an initial contact with Beijing Control, 5400 meters maintaining, request direct to KAKAT due to weather.
cards.audioTextZh: B：与北京管制首次联系，保持 5400 米，因天气请求直飞 KAKAT。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 6202, 5400 meters maintaining, request direct to KAKAT due weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 6202，保持 5400 米，因天气请求直飞 KAKAT。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 202, climb to and maintain 10700 meters due Air Force restriction, suggest heading 020.
B: Because the CB is 2 large, you want heading 030.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 202，因空军限制，爬升并保持 10700 米，建议航向 020。
B：由于 CB 太大，你想航向 030。
cards.referenceText: Climb to maintaining 10700 meters, request heading 030 due CB, CSN 6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 10700 米，因 CB 请求航向 030，CSN 6202。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 202, turn right heading 030 approved.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 202，同意右转航向 030。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 030, CSN 6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 030，CSN 6202。

cards.audioText: B: Now, you have clear weather, back on course.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已脱离天气，回到航路。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 6202, cleared weather, back on course.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 6202，脱离天气，回到航路。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 202, Beijing roger.
B: Tell the controller that you are getting an ice build-up as a result of suspected de-icing equipment failure, request descent below freezing level.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 202，北京收到。
B：告诉管制员，疑似除冰设备故障导致结冰积聚，请求下降到冰点高度以下。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 6202, possible de-icing equipment failure, ice is building up, request descent below freezing level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 6202，可能除冰设备故障，正在积冰，请求下降到冰点高度以下。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 202, roger, descend to 6300 meters, report when require lower, do emergency conditions exist?
B: Tell the controller this level should be sufficient and emergency conditions do not exist.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 202，收到，下降至 6300 米，需要更低高度时报告，是否存在紧急情况？
B：告诉管制员该高度应足够，且不存在紧急情况。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 6300 meters, it should be low enough and no emergency conditions exists, CSN 6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 6300 米，应该足够低，没有紧急情况，CSN 6202。

cards.audioText: B: There may be a problem about flight control system, request return to Beijing airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B：飞控系统可能有问题，请求返回北京机场。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 6202, possible problem with flight control system, request return to Beijing airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 6202，飞控系统可能有问题，请求返回北京机场。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 202, roger, confirm approach and landing normal?
B: Say no problem.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 202，收到，确认进近和着陆正常？
B：回答没问题。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, CSN 6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 肯定，CSN 6202。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 202, turn right direct to GITUM, descend to and maintain 3600 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 202，右转直飞 GITUM，下降并保持 3600 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right direct to GITUM, descend to and maintain 3600 meters, CSN 6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 GITUM，下降并保持 3600 米，CSN 6202。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 202, contact Approach 120.6.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 202，联系进近 120.6。

cards.audioText: B: Descend to 3600 meters, contact Approach, tell him you have a further problem with your leading edge flap extension and believe it is because of the prior icing issue.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降至 3600 米，联系进近，告诉他前缘襟翼伸展又有问题，并认为这是先前结冰问题造成的。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CSN 6202, descend to 3600 meters, we have a further problem with our leading edge flap extension, possibly due to earlier icing issues.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CSN 6202，下降至 3600 米，我们的前缘襟翼伸展又有问题，可能由于先前结冰问题。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 202, Beijing Approach, roger, do you require any other assistance?
B: Tell Approach you have a micro-switch malfunction and will conduct a flapless landing and request Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 202，北京进近，收到，你需要其他协助吗？
B：告诉进近你有微动开关故障，将执行无襟翼着陆，并请求跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CSN 6202, we have a micro-switch malfunction and will conduct a flapless landing and request Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CSN 6202，我们有微动开关故障，将执行无襟翼着陆，请求跑道 36R。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 202, roger, change of Runway 36R, turn left heading 090, descend to and maintain 2700 meters on QNH 1013, information C.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 202，改用跑道 36R，左转航向 090，QNH 1013 下降并保持 2700 米，通播 C。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, turn left heading 090, descend to and maintain 2700 meters on QNH 1013, information C, CSN 6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R，左转航向 090，QNH 1013 下降并保持 2700 米，通播 C，CSN 6202。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 202, turn right heading 270, descend to 1800 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 202，右转航向 270，下降至 1800 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 270, descend to 1800 meters, CSN 6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 270，下降至 1800 米，CSN 6202。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 202, the field is 11 miles away, report visual contact.
B: Tell the Approach, you have the runway in sight.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 202，机场距你 11 海里，报告目视。
B：告诉进近你看到跑道。
cards.referenceText: We have the field and runway in sight, CSN 6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们看到机场和跑道，CSN 6202。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 202, make visual approach 36 right, turn final when ready.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 202，执行目视进近 36R，准备好时转五边。
cards.referenceText: Make visual approach 36R, turn final when ready, CSN 6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行目视进近 36R，准备好时转五边，CSN 6202。

topics.name: CSN 7353 危险品卸载 浓雾
