cards.audioText: CSN 3102 when airborne, turn right heading 120, climb to 900 meters, cleared for takeoff Runway 19, contact Departure on 121.95.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，离地后右转航向 120，爬升至 900 米，许可从 Runway 19 起飞，联系离场 121.95。
cards.referenceText: when airborne, turn right heading 120, climb to 900 meters, cleared for takeoff Runway 19, 121.95, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离地后右转航向 120，爬升至 900 米，许可从 Runway 19 起飞，121.95，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, contact Guangzhou Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，正通过 600 米，联系广州离场。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Departure, CSN 3102, airborne, passing 600 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州离场，CSN 3102，已离地，通过 600 米。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, Guangzhou Departure, radar contact, turn right heading 300, climb to 900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，广州离场，雷达识别，右转航向 300，爬升至 900 米。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 300, climb to 900 meters, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 300，爬升至 900 米，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, climb to 3000 meters on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，按标准气压爬升至 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: climb to 3000 meters on standard, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按标准气压爬升至 3000 米，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: B: During climb, 1 of the passengers was scalded by hot coffee, contact Guangzhou Departure and request return to land.
cards.audioTextZh: B：爬升中，1 名旅客被热咖啡烫伤，联系广州离场并请求返回着陆。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Departure, CSN 3102, 1 of the passengers was scalded by hot coffee, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州离场，CSN 3102，1 名旅客被热咖啡烫伤，请求返回着陆。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 3102, what assistance do you need?
B: tell the controller you need medical services upon landing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CSN 3102，你需要什么协助？
B： 告诉管制员你需要落地时提供医疗服务。
cards.referenceText: request medical services upon landing, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求落地时提供医疗服务，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, medical services will be ready upon landing.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，医疗服务将在落地时就位。
cards.referenceText: roger, thanks, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, descend to 2,100 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，下降至 2,100 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 19。
cards.referenceText: descend to 2100 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 19, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 2100 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 19，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, cleared for ILS approach Runway 19, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 19，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: cleared for ILS approach Runway 19, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可 ILS 进近 Runway 19，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: now you have established on ILS approach Runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 19。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CSN 3102, established ILS approach Runway 19.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，CSN 3102，已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 19。

cards.audioText: B: Now you confirm if the medical service will be ready at the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你确认医疗服务是否会在登机口准备好。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN 3102, is medical service ready at the gate ?
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN 3102，医疗服务是否已在登机口准备好？

topics.name: CSN 3102 机翼/控制面损坏 积冰/防冰 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: your call sign is CSN 3102, a flight from Beijing to Guangzhou, you are at gate 211, you are ready for pushback and startup, contact Beijing Apron.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CSN 3102，这是一趟从北京飞往广州的航班，你位于 211 登机口，已准备好推出和开车，联系北京机坪。
cards.referenceText: Apron, CSN 3102, gate 211, ready for pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机坪，CSN 3102，211 登机口，已准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, pushback and startup approved, Runway 19R, QNH 1014.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，推出和开车批准，Runway 19R，QNH 1014。
cards.referenceText: pushback and startup approved, Runway 19R, QNH 1014, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，Runway 19R，QNH 1014，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: B: You have completed push back and start up, but the chocks are still in position, inform the controller of the situation and ask ground handling to remove the chocks.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你已完成推出和开车，但轮挡仍在位，告知管制员情况并请求地面保障移除轮挡。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Apron, CSN 3102, the chocks are still in position, request ground handling to remove the chocks.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京机坪，CSN 3102，轮挡仍在位，请求地面保障移除轮挡。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi, contact Beijing Apron.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好滑行，联系北京机坪。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Apron, CSN 3102, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京机坪，CSN 3102，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, taxi to holding point Runway 19R via taxiway Z18, M5, hold short of F.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，经 Z18、M5 滑行道滑行至 Runway 19R 等待点，在 F 前等待。
cards.referenceText: taxi to holding point Runway 19R via taxiway Z18, M five, hold short of F, CSN 3102
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z18、M5 滑行道滑行至 Runway 19R 等待点，在 F 前等待，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding short of taxiway F, contact Beijing Apron.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 F 滑行道外等待，联系北京机坪。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Apron, CSN 3102, holding short of taxiway F.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京机坪，CSN 3102，在 F 滑行道外等待。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, hold short of F, contact Beijing Ground on 121.95.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，在 F 前等待，联系北京地面 121.95。
cards.referenceText: hold short of F, contact Beijing Ground on 121.95, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在 F 前等待，联系北京地面 121.95，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: B: During taxi, you find there is ice and snow on the aircraft wings, contact Beijing Ground and tell the controller you want to have the ice and snow removed before takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行中，你发现机翼上有冰雪，联系北京地面并告诉管制员你想在起飞前除冰雪。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN 3102, there is ice and snow on the aircraft wings, request de-icing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN 3102，机翼上有冰雪，请求除冰。

cards.audioText: tell Beijing Ground the de-icing fluid is only effective for 30 minutes and your slot time is 35.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉北京地面，除冰液仅在 30 分钟内有效，而你的时隙时间是 35。
cards.referenceText: Ground, CSN 3102, there is ice and snow on the wings, request de-icing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，CSN 3102，机翼上有冰雪，请求除冰。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, taxi via taxiway Z4 and F to holding point Runway 19R.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，经 Z4 和 F 滑行道滑行至 Runway 19R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi via taxiway Z four and F to holding point Runway 19R, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4 和 F 滑行道滑行至 Runway 19R 等待点，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, you are passing 600 meters, make initial contact with Beijing Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，正通过 600 米，与北京离场首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CSN 3102, airborne, passing 600 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，CSN 3102，已离地，通过 600 米。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, Beijing Departure, radar contact, climb to 1,800 meters on QNH 1014.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，北京离场，雷达识别，在 QNH 1014 上爬升至 1,800 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 1800 meters on QNH 1014, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在 QNH 1014 上爬升至 1800 米，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: You are maintaining 1,800 meters, you are encountering severe icing, tell the controller you want a higher level.
cards.audioTextZh: 你正保持 1,800 米，遭遇严重积冰，告诉管制员你想要更高的高度。
cards.referenceText: Departure, CSN 3102, 1,800 meters, we are encountering severe icing, request a higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离场，CSN 3102，1,800 米，我们正遭遇严重积冰，请求更高的高度。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, negative due traffic, maintain 1,800 meters until advised.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，不行，因交通原因，保持 1,800 米直至通知。
cards.referenceText: roger, maintain maintain 1800 meters until advised, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，保持、保持 1800 米直至通知，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: B: Now the icing condition is deteriorating, your left engine anti-ice has failed, make an Urgency call and ask for a higher level to leave icing area.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在结冰情况恶化，你的左发防冰失效，发布紧急情况呼叫，并请求更高高度离开结冰区。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Beijing Departure, CSN 3102, the icing condition is deteriorating, our left engine anti-ice has failed, request a higher level to leave icing area.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，北京离场，CSN 3102，结冰情况正在恶化，我们左发防冰失效，请求更高高度离开结冰区。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, roger PANPAN, climb to and maintain 3000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，收到 PANPAN，爬升至并保持 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: climb to and maintain 3000 meters, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至并保持 3000 米，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have left icing area, tell the controller that you have experienced severe icing between 1800 meters and 2100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离开结冰区，告诉管制员你在 1800 米至 2100 米之间遭遇严重结冰。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CSN 3102, we have experienced severe icing between 1800 meters and 2100 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，CSN 3102，我们在 1800 米至 2100 米之间遭遇严重结冰。

cards.audioText: You confirm with Beijing Departure if you should descend to 900 meters because it is below the minimum safe altitude.
cards.audioTextZh: 你向北京离场确认是否应下降至 900 米，因为这低于最低安全高度。
cards.referenceText: Confirm descend to 900 meters, it is below the minimum safe altitude, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 确认下降至 900 米，这低于最低安全高度，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, my apologies, cancel speed restrictions, recleared to descend to 1,500 meters on QNH 1014.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，抱歉，取消速度限制，重新许可在 QNH 1014 上下降至 1,500 米。
cards.referenceText: cancel speed restrictions, descend to 1500 meters QNH 1014, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消速度限制，在 QNH 1014 上下降至 1500 米，CSN 3102。

topics.name: CSN 3102 雷暴绕飞 TCAS机动 舱门问题

cards.audioText: Your callsign is CSN 3102, a flight from Beijing to Guangzhou, you are at Gate 234, you have got information A, request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CSN 3102，这是一趟从北京飞往广州的航班，你位于 234 登机口，已收到 A 情报，申请 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, CSN 3102, Gate 234, information A, request ATC clearance to Guangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，CSN 3102，234 登机口，A 情报，申请前往广州的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, runway in use 18 Left, RENOB-8 departure, initial altitude 900 meters, request level change en route, departure frequency 126.5, squawk 3113.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，许可按飞行计划航路飞往广州，使用 Runway 18L，RENOB-8 离场，初始高度 900 米，途中申请改变高度，离场频率 126.5，应答机 3113。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, runway in use 18 Left, RENOB eight Departure, initial altitude 900 meters, request level change en route, departure frequency 126.5, squawk 3113, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往广州，使用 Runway 18L，RENOB-8 离场，初始高度 900 米，途中申请改变高度，离场频率 126.5，应答机 3113，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, readback correct, contact Beijing Ground on 121.95when ready for pushback and startup.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，复诵正确，准备好推出和开车时联系北京地面 121.95。

cards.audioText: all the passengers have boarded, all the cabin doors have been closed, request permission to pushback, contact Beijing Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 所有乘客均已登机，所有客舱门均已关闭，联系北京地面申请推出许可。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN 3102, request pushback.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN 3102，申请推出。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, pushback approved.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，推出批准。
cards.referenceText: pushback approved, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出批准，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: Now you are ready for startup.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已准备好开车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN 3102, request startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN 3102，申请开车。

cards.audioText: During engine startup, your Auxilary Power Unit has malfunctioned, ask Beijing Ground to start one engine at the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: 发动机启动期间，你的辅助动力装置发生故障，请求北京地面允许在登机口启动一台发动机。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN 3102, request start one engine at the gate due APU malfunction.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN 3102，因 APU 故障，请求在登机口启动一台发动机。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, start one engine at the gate approved, report when ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，允许在登机口启动一台发动机，准备滑行时报告。
cards.referenceText: start one engine at the gate approved, wilco, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 允许在登机口启动一台发动机，照办，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: While starting up the engine, you find the EGT exceeds the temperature limits, report it to Beijing Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 启动发动机时，你发现 EGT 超过温度限制，向北京地面报告。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN 3102, the EGT exceeds the temperature limits.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN 3102，EGT 超过温度限制。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have started up your engines, you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已启动发动机，准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 3102, start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 3102，开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, taxi to holding point Runway 18L via taxiway M, Z6, M2 and E8.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，经 M、Z6、M2 和 E8 滑行道滑行至 Runway 18L 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi to holding point Runway 18L via taxiway M, Z six, M two and E eight, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 M、Z6、M2 和 E8 滑行道滑行至 Runway 18L 等待点，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, taxi to holding point Runway 18L via taxiway M, Z6, M2 and E8.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，经 M、Z6、M2 和 E8 滑行道滑行至 Runway 18L 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi to holding point Runway 18L via taxiway M, Z six, M two and E eight, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 M、Z6、M2 和 E8 滑行道滑行至 Runway 18L 等待点，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, hold short of taxiway M2, expect 40 minutes delay due departure sequence.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，在 M2 滑行道前等待，因离场排序预计延误 40 分钟。
cards.referenceText: holding short of taxiway M two, roger, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在 M2 滑行道前等待，收到，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: Now you are holding at holding point Runway 18L, there is an indication of thunderstorm on your weather radar, contact Beijing Tower and ask for the revised slot time.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正在 Runway 18L 等待点等待，气象雷达上有雷暴指示，联系北京塔台并询问修订后的时隙时间。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN 3102, holding at holding point Runway 18L, there is an indication of thunderstorm on our weather radar, request the revised slot time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN 3102，正在 Runway 18L 等待点等待，我们的气象雷达上有雷暴指示，请求修订后的时隙时间。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, hold short of Runway 18L, the new slot time is 1615.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，在 Runway 18L 前等待，新的时隙时间是 1615。
cards.referenceText: roger, hold short of Runway 18L, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，在 Runway 18L 前等待，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: After a long time delay, you find your fuel endurance is dropping fast, you have to taxi back for refueling the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 长时间延误后，你发现燃油续航时间正在快速下降，必须滑回为航空器加油。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN 3102, our fuel endurance is dropping fast, request taxi back for refueling the aircraft due to long time delay.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN 3102，由于长时间延误，我们的燃油续航时间正在快速下降，请求滑回为航空器加油。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, roger, enter Runway 18L, vacate runway via A9, taxi via taxiway Z2 and Z4 to Gate 234.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，收到，进入 Runway 18L，经 A9 脱离跑道，经 Z2 和 Z4 滑行道滑行至 234 登机口。
cards.referenceText: enter Runway 18L, vacate runway via A niner, taxi via taxiway Z two and Z four to Gate 234, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进入 Runway 18L，经 A9 脱离跑道，经 Z2 和 Z4 滑行道滑行至 234 登机口，CSN 3102。

topics.name: CSN 6682 液压问题 襟翼问题 积冰/防冰

cards.audioText: your call sign is CSN 6682, you are at stand K38 with Information B, your destination is Guangzhou, request ATC clearance from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CSN 6682，你位于 K38 停机位，已收到 B 情报，目的地为广州，向武汉放行申请 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN 6682, stand K38, Information B, destination Guangzhou, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CSN 6682，K38 停机位，B 情报，目的地广州，申请 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: you have the transmitter checked and carry out radio check with Wuhan Delivery on the frequency 118.3.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已检查发射机，并在频率 118.3 上与武汉放行进行无线电检查。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN 6682, radio check on one onr 8.3, how do you read?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CSN 6682，在 one onr 8.3 上进行无线电检查，听我信号如何？

cards.audioText: acknowledge the transmission and request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 确认收到并申请 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: roger request ATC clearance to Guangzhou, CSN 6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，申请前往广州的 ATC 放行许可，CSN 6682。

cards.audioText: CSN 6682, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, follow LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1,200 meters, cruising level 8,400 meters, departure frequency 119.6, squawk 3115.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 6682，武汉放行，许可按飞行计划航路飞往广州，离场使用 Runway 36R，执行 LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1,200 米，巡航高度 8,400 米，离场频率 119.6，应答机 3115。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, follow LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 8400 meters, departure frequency 119.6, squawk 3115, CSN 6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往广州，离场使用 Runway 36R，执行 LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1200 米，巡航高度 8400 米，离场频率 119.6，应答机 3115，CSN 6682。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, and you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出和开车，准备好滑行，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 6682, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 6682，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CSN 6682, taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 6682，经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi via taxiway Z four, A tree and A to holding point Runway 36R, CSN 6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点，CSN 6682。

cards.audioText: now you are at holding point Runway 36R, you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你位于 Runway 36R 等待点，已准备好离场，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN 6682, holding point Runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN 6682，Runway 36R 等待点，已准备好离场。

cards.audioText: CSN 6682, Runway 36R, cleared for takeoff, surface wind 350 degrees, 5 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 6682，Runway 36R，许可起飞，地面风向 350 度，风速 5 节。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, cleared for takeoff, CSN 6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: Runway 36R，许可起飞，CSN 6682。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，正通过 600 米，联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN 6682, airborne, passing 600 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN 6682，已离地，通过 600 米。

cards.audioText: CSN 6682, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, climb to 3900 meters, expedite until passing 2,100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 6682，武汉进近，雷达识别，爬升至 3900 米，加速爬升直至通过 2,100 米。
cards.referenceText: climb to 3900 meters, expedite until passing 2100 meters, CSN 6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 3900 米，加速爬升直至通过 2100 米，CSN 6682。

cards.audioText: B: During climb, you find that the flaps are jammed at takeoff position, inform Wuhan Approach this situation, and ask to fly direct to WHA for trouble shooting.
cards.audioTextZh: B：爬升中，你发现襟翼卡在起飞位置，告知武汉进近该情况，并请求直飞 WHA 排故。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN 6682, our flaps are jammed at takeoff position, request fly direct to WHA for trouble shooting.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN 6682，我们的襟翼卡在起飞位置，请求直飞 WHA 排故。

cards.audioText: CSN 6682, roger, turn right, direct to WHA, climb to and maintain 3000 meters, hold at WHA as published.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 6682，收到，右转直飞 WHA，爬升至并保持 3000 米，按公布程序在 WHA 等待。
cards.referenceText: turn right, direct to WHA, climb to and maintain 3000 meters, hold at WHA as published, CSN 6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 WHA，爬升至并保持 3000 米，按公布程序在 WHA 等待，CSN 6682。

cards.audioText: B: During hold, you notice that 1 of the hydraulic systems is leaking fluid rapidly, make an urgency call to Wuhan Approach and request descent and return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B：等待中，你注意到 1 套液压系统正在快速漏液，向武汉进近发布紧急情况呼叫，并请求下降返回武汉机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, CSN 6682, 1 of the hydraulic system is leaking fuel rapidly, request descent and return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉进近，CSN 6682，1 套液压系统正在快速漏燃油，请求下降并返回武汉机场着陆。

cards.audioText: CSN 6682, roger PAN, turn right heading 240, descend to 2,400 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 6682，收到 PAN，右转航向 240，下降至 2,400 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 240, descend to 2004 hunderd meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 36R, CSN 6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，下降至 2004 hunderd 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，CSN 6682。

cards.audioText: CSN 6682, turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 6682，右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R, CSN 6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，CSN 6682。

cards.audioText: now you have intercepted the localizer Runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已截获 Runway 36R 航向道，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN 6682, established on the localizer Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN 6682，已建立在 Runway 36R 航向道上。

cards.audioText: CSN 6682, cleared to land Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 6682，许可在 Runway 36R 落地。
cards.referenceText: cleared to land Runway 36R, CSN 6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可在 Runway 36R 落地，CSN 6682。

topics.name: CSN 371 刹车问题 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CSN 371, a flight from Wuhan to Moscow, you are at bay 224, you have got information C, request ATC clearance to Moscow from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CSN 371，从武汉飞往莫斯科，在 224 号机位，已收到通播 C，向武汉放行请求飞往莫斯科的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN 371, bay 224, information C, request ATC clearance to Moscow.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CSN 371，224 号机位，通播 C，请求飞往莫斯科的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: CSN 371, cleared to Moscow via flight planned route, follow ZF-01 departure, cruising level 8,900 meters, initial climb 1,500 meters, departure frequency 119.45, squawk 3223.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 371，许可按飞行计划航路飞往莫斯科，执行 ZF-01 离场，巡航高度 8,900 米，初始爬升至 1,500 米，离场频率 119.45，应答机 3223。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Moscow via flight planned route, ZF-01 departure, cruising level 8900 meters, initial climb 1500 meters, departure frequency 119 devimal 45, squawk 3223, CSN 371.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往莫斯科，执行 ZF-01 离场，巡航高度 8900 米，初始爬升至 1500 米，离场频率 119 devimal 45，应答机 3223，CSN 371。

cards.audioText: CSN 371, readback correct, contact Wuhan Ground on 121.9
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 371，复诵正确，联系武汉地面 121.9。

cards.audioText: B: The maintenance staff has deferred an MEL item regarding APU, contact Ground and tell the controller you will be ready to start 1 engine at the bay in 5 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: B：维修人员已保留一项关于 APU 的 MEL 项目，联系地面并告诉管制员你将在 5 分钟后准备好在机位启动 1 台发动机。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 371, request start 1 engine at the bay in 5 minutes due to APU problem.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 371，因 APU 问题，请求 5 分钟后在机位启动 1 台发动机。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 371, slot time 50, start 1 engine at the bay approved, call me back when ready for push back.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 371，时隙 50，同意在机位启动 1 台发动机，准备好推出时再呼叫我。
cards.referenceText: Slot time 50, start 1 engine at the bay approved, CSN 371.
cards.referenceTextZh: 时隙 50，同意在机位启动 1 台发动机，CSN 371。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 371, ready for push back.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 371，准备好推出。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 371, push back onto F, facing south.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 371，推出至 F，机头朝南。
cards.referenceText: Push back onto F, facing south, CSN 371.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出至 F，机头朝南，CSN 371。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 371, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 371，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 371, taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway F, A9, hold short of A.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 371，经滑行道 F、A9 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，A 外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway F, A9, hold short of A, CSN 371.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 F、A9 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，A 外等待，CSN 371。

cards.audioText: B: During taxi an auto brake caution message is displayed on the aircraft warning system, so you stop taxiing, advise Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行中飞机警告系统显示自动刹车警戒信息，所以你停止滑行，告知地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 371, we have an auto brake caution message, we stopped taxiing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 371，我们有自动刹车警戒信息，我们已停止滑行。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 371, roger, hold at present position, advise your intention when able.
B: Tell the controller you are still able to taxi, but you need 5 minutes to deal with the problem, ask to hold at the convenient position.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 371，收到，在当前位置等待，能够时告知意图。
B：告诉管制员你仍能滑行，但需要 5 分钟处理问题，请求在方便位置等待。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 371, we are still able to taxi, but we need 5 minutes to deal with the problem, request hold at the convenient position.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 371，我们仍能滑行，但需要 5 分钟处理问题，请求在方便位置等待。

cards.audioText: B: While communicating with mechanic and dispatcher, you discovered that some pages of onboard flight manuals were missing, it is against regulation to continue flight, report it to ATC and ask for returning to the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: B：与机务和签派沟通时，你发现机载飞行手册有部分页面缺失，继续飞行违反规定，向 ATC 报告并请求返回登机口。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 371, some pages of onboard flight manuals were missing, it is against regulation to continue flight, request return to the gate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 371，机载飞行手册有部分页面缺失，继续飞行违反规定，请求返回登机口。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 371, taxi to bay 224 via taxiway A8, A, A5.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 371，经滑行道 A8、A、A5 滑行至 224 号机位。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to bay 224 via taxiway A8, A, A5, CSN 371.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 A8、A、A5 滑行至 224 号机位，CSN 371。

cards.audioText: two hours later, now you are maintaining 9500 meters, approaching WXI, Squawking 3223, contact Beijing Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 两小时后，现在你正保持 9500 米，接近 WXI，应答机 3223，联系北京管制。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 371, maintaining 9005 meters, approaching WXI, squawking 3223.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 371，正保持 9005 米，接近 WXI，应答机 3223。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 371, maintain 9500 meters, report VYK.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 371，保持 9500 米，报告 VYK。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 9500 meters, report VYK, CSN 371.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 9500 米，报告 VYK，CSN 371。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over VYK, maintaining 9500 meters, report it to Beijing Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 VYK 上空，保持 9500 米，向北京管制报告。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 371, over VYK, maintaining 9500 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 371，VYK 上空，保持 9500 米。

cards.audioText: Tell Beijing Control you are too heavy, request a step climb to 10,700 meters in about one hour.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉北京管制，你的重量过大，请求大约一小时后阶梯爬升至 10,700 米。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 371, request step climb to 1700 meters due heavy weight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 371，因重量过大，请求阶梯爬升至 1700 米。

cards.audioText: CSN 371, due separation, maintain not greater than mach decimal 80.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 371，因间隔需要，保持不大于 Mach 0.80。
cards.referenceText: maintain not greater than mach decimal eight zero, CSN 371.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持不大于 Mach 0.80，CSN 371。

topics.name: CSN 319 液压问题 雷暴绕飞 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CSN 319, you are parking at gate 51, you have received information C, from Wuhan to Guangzhou, ask for ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CSN 319，停在 51 号登机口，已收到通播 C，从武汉飞往广州，请求 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN 319, gate 51, information C, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CSN 319，51 号登机口，通播 C，请求 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: CSN 319, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, follow LKO-01 departure, initially climb to 1,200 meters, cruising level 9800 meters, when airborne, contact 119.7, squawk 2515.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 319，许可按飞行计划航路飞往广州，离场使用 Runway 36R，执行 LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1,200 米，巡航高度 9800 米，离地后联系 119.7，应答机 2515。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, LKO-01 departure, one thousan 200 meters, cruising level niner thousan 800 meters, 119.7, squawk 2515, CSN 319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往广州，离场使用 Runway 36R，执行 LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1200 米，巡航高度 9800 米，119.7，应答机 2515，CSN 319。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 319, due to military activity, expect 1 hour delay, you are number 5 for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 319，因军事活动，预计延误 1 小时，你是第 5 架离场。
cards.referenceText: Roger, CSN 319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，CSN 319。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已准备好推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 319, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 319，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: CSN 319, after Boeing 7 37 behind is clear, push back onto taxiway Z4, abeam gate 213, facing East.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 319，后方的 Boeing 737 通过后，向后推出至 Z4 滑行道，与 213 登机口平行，机头朝东。
cards.referenceText: after Boeing 737 is clear, push back onto taxiway Z four, abeam gate 213, facing East, CSN 319.
cards.referenceTextZh: Boeing 737 通过后，向后推出至 Z4 滑行道，与 213 登机口平行，机头朝东，CSN 319。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, request taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出和开车，请求滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 319, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 319，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CSN 319, taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3, A.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 319，经 Z4、A3、A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z four, A tree, A, hold short of Runway 36R, CSN 319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4、A3、A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点，在 Runway 36R 前等待，CSN 319。

cards.audioText: now you are at holding point Runway 36R, you are ready for takeoff, contact Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你位于 Runway 36R 等待点，已准备好起飞，联系塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN 319, holding at holding point Runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN 319，正在 Runway 36R 等待点等待，已准备好离场。

cards.audioText: CSN 319, behind Boeing 7 37 on final, line up Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 319，跟随五边上的 Boeing 737，进入 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: behind Boeing 737 on final, line up Runway 36R, CSN 319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟随五边上的 Boeing 737，进入 Runway 36R，CSN 319。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are passing 900 meters, contact Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你正通过 900 米，联系武汉离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CSN 319, passing 900 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，CSN 319，通过 900 米。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 319, climb to 3900 meters, expedite climb until passing 2100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 319，爬升至 3900 米，通过 2100 米前加快爬升。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 3900 meters, expedite climb until passing 2100 meters, CSN 319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 3900 米，通过 2100 米前加快爬升，CSN 319。

cards.audioText: CSN 319, stop climbing due to converging traffic, level off at 2,700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 319，因汇聚交通停止爬升，在 2,700 米改平。
cards.referenceText: level off at 2700 meters, CSN 319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在 2700 米改平，CSN 319。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 319, continue climb to 4500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 319，继续爬升至 4500 米。
cards.referenceText: Continue climb to 4500 meters, CSN 319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续爬升至 4500 米，CSN 319。

cards.audioText: during climb, you found one of your hydraulic systems has failed, make an urgency call and tell ATC this situation and ask to level off at 3,900 meters and then return to Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 爬升期间，你发现一个液压系统失效，发出紧急呼叫，向 ATC 通报情况，并请求在 3,900 米改平，然后返回武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Departure, CSN 319, one of our hydraulic systems has failed, request level off at 3900, return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，武汉离场，CSN 319，我们的一个液压系统失效，请求在 3900 改平，返场落地。

cards.audioText: CSN 319, roger PAN, maintain 3,900 meters, turn left, direct to LKO, LKO-02 arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 319，收到 PAN，保持 3,900 米，左转直飞 LKO，执行 LKO-02 进场，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: maintain 3900 meters, turn left, direct to LKO, LKO-02 arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R, CSN 319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 3900 米，左转直飞 LKO，执行 LKO-02 进场，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，CSN 319。

cards.audioText: B: A thunderstorm was detected near LKO, report it to Wuhan Approach and ask to deviate 20 miles to the left.
cards.audioTextZh: B：LKO 附近探测到雷暴，向武汉进近报告并请求向左偏置 20 海里。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN 319, there is a thunderstorm near LKO, request offset 20 miles to the left.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN 319，LKO 附近有雷暴，请求向左偏置 20 海里。

topics.name: CSN 3109 风挡裂纹 雷暴绕飞 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: Your call sign is CSN 3109, you are approaching VYK, maintaining 4500 meters, squawking 3125, make initial contact with Beijing Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CSN 3109，正接近 VYK，保持 4500 米，应答机 3125，与北京管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 3109, approaching VYK, maintaining 4005 hunderd meters, squawking 3215.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 3109，正接近 VYK，保持 4005 hunderd 米，应答机 3215。

cards.audioText: CSN 3109, Beijing Control, radar contact, direct to VYK, after passing VYK, climb to 8400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3109，北京管制，雷达识别，直飞 VYK，飞越 VYK 后爬升至 8400 米。
cards.referenceText: direct to VYK, after passing VYK, climb to 8400 meters, CSN 3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 VYK，飞越 VYK 后爬升至 8400 米，CSN 3109。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar observed a thunderstorm ahead, request Beijing Control for a right turn to avoid the thunderstorm.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的气象雷达观察到前方雷暴，请求北京管制右转避开雷暴。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 3109, our weather radar observed a thunderstorm ahead, request right turn to avoid it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 3109，我们的气象雷达观察到前方雷暴，请求右转避让。

cards.audioText: CSN 3109, negative due military activity, turn left heading 010.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3109，不行，因军事活动，左转航向 010。
cards.referenceText: roger, turn left heading 010, CSN 3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，左转航向 010，CSN 3109。

cards.audioText: CSN 3109, turn left heading 350.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3109，左转航向 350。
cards.referenceText: turn left heading 350, CSN 3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 350，CSN 3109。

cards.audioText: B: Now there is a strong E of thunderstorm, you are too close to the weather, request left turn to avoid it.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在有强雷暴回波，你离天气太近，请求左转避让。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 3109, there is a strong E of thunderstorm, we are too close to the weather, request left turn to avoid it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 3109，有强雷暴回波，我们离天气太近，请求左转避让。

cards.audioText: CSN 3109, left turn is not permitted due restricted area.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3109，因限制区，不允许左转。
cards.referenceText: roger, CSN 3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，CSN 3109。

cards.audioText: suddenly, you have suffered from hail strike, you left wind shield has cracked, report it to Beijing Control and request return to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 你突然遭遇冰雹撞击，左侧风挡开裂，向北京管制报告并请求返场落地。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 3109, we have had a hail strike, our left wind shield has cracked, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 3109，我们遭遇冰雹撞击，左侧风挡开裂，请求返场落地。

cards.audioText: CSN 3109, roger, turn right heading 340, direct to VYK, descend to and maintain 5100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3109，收到，右转航向 340，直飞 VYK，下降至并保持 5100 米。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 340, direct to VYK, descend to and maintain 5100 meters, CSN 3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 340，直飞 VYK，下降至并保持 5100 米，CSN 3109。

cards.audioText: CSN 3109, descend to 4,200 meters, contact Beijing Approach 119.25.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3109，下降至 4,200 米，联系北京进近 119.25。
cards.referenceText: descend to 4,200 meters, 119.25, CSN 3109.

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 4200 meters, over VYK, you have got information K, contact Beijing Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你保持 4200 米，在 VYK 上空，已收到通播 K，联系北京进近。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CSN 3109, maintaining 4200 meters, over VYK, information K.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CSN 3109，保持 4200 米，VYK 上空，通播 K。

cards.audioText: CSN 3109, Beijing Approach, radar contact, follow VYK-05 arrival, expect radar vectors for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3109，北京进近，雷达识别，执行 VYK-05 进场，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: VYK-05 arrival, ILS approach Runway 36R, CSN 3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: VYK-05 进场，ILS 进近 Runway 36R，CSN 3109。

cards.audioText: B: During approach, neither of you can see through the windshield due to crack windshield, you ask Beijing Tower if Beijing Airport permits auto-land.
cards.audioTextZh: B：进近中，由于风挡开裂，你们两人都无法透过风挡看清，询问北京塔台北京机场是否允许自动着陆。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN 3109, neither of us can see through the windshield due to crack windshield, does your airport permit auto-land ?
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN 3109，由于风挡开裂，我们两人都无法透过风挡看清，你机场是否允许自动着陆？

cards.audioText: CSN 3109, Runway 36R, cleared to land, surface wind 350, 3 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3109，Runway 36R，许可落地，地面风向 350，风速 3 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, cleared to land, CSN 3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: Runway 36R，许可落地，CSN 3109。

cards.audioText: B: After landing, you can't see the taxiway clearly due to cracked windshield, request a tug.
cards.audioTextZh: B：落地后，由于风挡开裂，你看不清滑行道，请求拖车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN 3109, we can't see the taxiway clearly due to cracked windshield, request a tug.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN 3109，由于风挡开裂，我们看不清滑行道，请求拖车。

cards.audioText: CSN 3109, hold position, the tug will come soon.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3109，保持位置，牵引车很快会来。
cards.referenceText: roger, hold position, CSN 3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，保持位置，CSN 3109。

topics.name: CSN 7353 TCAS机动 危险品 延误/加油

cards.audioText:
your call sign is CSN 7353, a flight from Wuhan to Los Angeles, the cargo manifest shows that there is forbidden goods on board, report it to company operations and request offload the luggage.
forbidden goods/prohibited goods
cards.audioTextZh:
你的呼号是 CSN 7353，这是一趟从武汉飞往洛杉矶的航班，货舱单显示机上有禁运品，向公司运行部门报告并请求卸下行李。
禁运品/违禁品
cards.referenceText: Dispatch, CSN 7353, CSN 353 cargo manifest shows, forbidden goods, request offload the luggage.
cards.referenceTextZh: 签派，CSN 7353，CSN 353，货舱单显示有禁运品，请求卸下行李。

cards.audioText: Now you are at Gate 23, you have got information N, request ATC clearance to Los Angeles from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你位于 23 登机口，已收到 N 情报，向武汉放行申请前往洛杉矶的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Delivery, CSN 7353, CSN 353 Gate 23, information N, request ATC clearance, Los Angeles
cards.referenceTextZh: 放行，CSN 7353，CSN 353，23 登机口，N 情报，申请前往洛杉矶的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: CSN 7353, cleared to Los Angeles via flight planned route, Runway 36R, LKO01 DAL Departure, initial climb 1,200 meters, cruising level 8,900 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 2515.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 7353，许可按飞行计划航路飞往洛杉矶，Runway 36R，执行 LKO-01 DAL 离场，初始爬升至 1,200 米，巡航高度 8,900 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 2515。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Los Angeles, flight planned route, Runway 36R, LKO-01 departure, 1200 meters, 8900 meters, 119.7, squawk 2515, CSN 7353 CSN 353.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往洛杉矶，Runway 36R，执行 LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1200 米，巡航高度 8900 米，119.7，应答机 2515，CSN 7353，CSN 353。

cards.audioText: CSN 7353, expect 15 minutes delay, the airport is temporarily closed due heavy fog. Call you back.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 7353，预计延误 15 分钟，因大雾机场暂时关闭。稍后呼叫你。
cards.referenceText: roger, expect 15 minutes delay, CSN 7353.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，预计延误 15 分钟，CSN 7353。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 7353, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 7353，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: CSN 7353, after traffic taxiing behind is clear, push back and startup approved, push back onto taxiway Z4, abeam Gate 232, facing East.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 7353，后方滑行航空器通过后，推出和开车批准，向后推出至 Z4 滑行道，与 232 登机口平行，机头朝东。
cards.referenceText: after traffic is clear, push back and startup approved, push back onto taxiway Z four, abeam Gate 232, facing East, CSN 7353. CSN 353.
cards.referenceTextZh: 相关航空器通过后，推出和开车批准，向后推出至 Z4 滑行道，与 232 登机口平行，机头朝东，CSN 7353。CSN 353。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are on taxiway Z4, you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在滑行道 Z4，准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 7353, taxiway Z4, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 7353，滑行道 Z4，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CSN 7353, taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 7353，经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi via taxiway Z four, A four and A, holding point Runway 36R, CSN 7353. CSN 353.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4、A4 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点，CSN 7353。CSN 353。

cards.audioText: during taxi, the visibility is getting worse due to heavy fog, you are unable to taxi, tell the controller that you will hold at present position until visibility gets better.
cards.audioTextZh: 滑行期间，因大雾能见度持续恶化，你无法滑行，告诉管制员你将在当前位置等待，直至能见度改善。
cards.referenceText: Ground, CSN 7353, CSN 353 visibility, getting worse, heavy fog, unable to taxi, request hold at present position, until visibility gets better.
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，CSN 7353，CSN 353，能见度因大雾持续恶化，无法滑行，请求在当前位置等待，直至能见度改善。

cards.audioText: CSN 7353, the visibility is improving, continue taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway A3 and A.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 7353，能见度正在改善，经 A3 和 A 滑行道继续滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway A tree, A, CSN 7353. CSN 353.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点，CSN 7353。CSN 353。

cards.audioText: CSN 7353, contact Wuhan Tower 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 7353，联系武汉塔台 124.35。

cards.audioText: now you are at holding point Runway 36R, you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你位于 Runway 36R 等待点，已准备好离场，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN 7353, holding point Runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN 7353，Runway 36R 等待点，已准备好离场。

cards.audioText: CSN 7353, Runway 36R, cleared for takeoff, when airborne, contact 119.7.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 7353，Runway 36R，许可起飞，离地后联系 119.7。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, cleared for takeoff, 119.7, CSN 7353. CSN 353.
cards.referenceTextZh: Runway 36R，许可起飞，119.7，CSN 7353。CSN 353。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 1200 meters, contact Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，正通过 1200 米，联系离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CSN 7353, airborne, passing 1200 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，CSN 7353，已离地，通过 1200 米。

cards.audioText: CSN 7353, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, climb to 3,900 meters at 3000 feet per minute or greater.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 7353，武汉离场，雷达识别，以每分钟 3000 英尺或更大的爬升率爬升至 3,900 米。
cards.referenceText: climb to 3900 meters, at 3000 feet per minute or greater, CSN 7353. CSN 353.
cards.referenceTextZh: 以每分钟 3000 英尺或更大的爬升率爬升至 3900 米，CSN 7353。CSN 353。

cards.audioText: CSN 7353, continue climb to 8,900 meters, report passing 6,000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 7353，继续爬升至 8,900 米，通过 6,000 米时报告。
cards.referenceText: continue climb to 8900 meters, CSN 7353. CSN 353.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续爬升至 8900 米，CSN 7353。CSN 353。

topics.name: CSN 1310 雷暴绕飞 TCAS机动 延误/加油

cards.audioText: Your call sign is CSN 1310, performing a flight from Beijing to Guangzhou, you are parking at Gate 221, you have received information B, contact Beijing Delivery and request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CSN 1310，正在执行从北京飞往广州的航班，停在 221 登机口，已收到 B 情报，联系北京放行并申请 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Delivery, CSN 1310, Gate 221, information B, request ATC clearance, Guangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 放行，CSN 1310，221 登机口，B 情报，申请前往广州的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText:
CSN 1310, Beijing Delivery, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, BOBAK-03 departure, departure Runway 36R, initial climb 1800 meters, cruising level 9500 meters, squawk 2536.
BOBAK
VYK
SOSID
RENOB
GUVBA
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 1310，北京放行，许可按飞行计划航路飞往广州，执行 BOBAK-03 离场，离场使用 Runway 36R，初始爬升至 1800 米，巡航高度 9500 米，应答机 2536。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Guangzhou, BOBAK-03 departure, departure Runway 36R, 1800 meters, 9500 meters, squawk 2536, CSN 3001.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往广州，执行 BOBAK-03 离场，离场使用 Runway 36R，初始爬升至 1800 米，巡航高度 9500 米，应答机 2536，CSN 3001。

cards.audioText: CSN 1310, expect slot time 0215 due to temporary departure restrictions, report when ready for pushback and startup.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 1310，因临时离场限制，预计时隙时间 0215，准备好推出和开车时报告。
cards.referenceText: roger, CSN 1310.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，CSN 1310。

cards.audioText: CSN 1310, slot time restriction has canceled, monitor Beijing Ground 121.975.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 1310，时隙限制已取消，监听北京地面 121.975。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back, contact Beijing Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出，联系北京地面。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN 1310, request push back.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN 1310，请求推出。

cards.audioText: CSN 1310, Beijing Ground, pushback approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 1310，北京地面，推出批准，机头朝东。
cards.referenceText: pushback approved, facing east, CSN 3001.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出批准，机头朝东，CSN 3001。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back, you are on taxiway Z4, you are ready for start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出，在滑行道 Z4，准备好开车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN 1310, taxiway Z4, request start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN 1310，滑行道 Z4，请求开车。

cards.audioText: CSN 1310, your slot time has expired, your new slot time is 0325, start up at own discretion.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 1310，你的时隙时间已失效，新的时隙时间为 0325，自主决定开车。
cards.referenceText: slot time, 0325, start up at own discretion, CSN 3001.
cards.referenceTextZh: 时隙时间 0325，自主决定开车，CSN 3001。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed startup and before taxiing checklist, you are ready for taxi, contact Beijing Ground for taxiing instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成开车和滑行前检查单，准备好滑行，联系北京地面获取滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN 1310, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN 1310，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CSN 1310, taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z4, Z3, T5, D6.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 1310，经 Z4、Z3、T5、D6 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi to holding point Runway 36R, taxiway Z four, Z tree, T five, DAL 6, CSN 1310.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4、Z3、T5、DAL 6 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点，CSN 1310。

cards.audioText: CSN 1310, hold short of T5, give way to B747 passing from left to right.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 1310，在 T5 前等待，给从左向右经过的 B747 让行。
cards.referenceText: hold short of T five, traffic in sight, CSN 1310.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在 T5 前等待，已看到相关航空器，CSN 1310。

cards.audioText: B: Now the traffic is clear, you decide to make intersection departure from W2, contact Beijing Ground to request intersection departure from W2.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在飞机已脱离，你决定从 W2 交叉口离场，联系北京地面请求从 W2 交叉口离场。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN 1310, clear of traffic, request intersection departure from W2.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN 1310，飞机已脱离，请求从 W2 交叉口离场。

cards.audioText: CSN 1310, negative intersection departure due sequencing, continue taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway T5 and D6.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 1310，因排序原因不批准交叉口离场，经 T5 和 D6 滑行道继续滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi to holding point Runway 36R, taxiway T five, DAL 6, CSN 1310.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 T5、DAL 6 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点，CSN 1310。

cards.audioText: Now you are at holding point Runway 36R, you are ready for takeoff, contact Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你位于 Runway 36R 等待点，已准备好起飞，联系北京塔台。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN 1310, holding point Runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN 1310，Runway 36R 等待点，已准备好离场。

cards.audioText: CSN 1310, hold short of Runway 36R, expect 15 minutes delay due thunderstorms in the vicinity of the airport.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 1310，在 Runway 36R 前等待，因机场附近有雷暴，预计延误 15 分钟。
cards.referenceText: roger, hold short of Runway 36R, CSN 1310.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，在 Runway 36R 前等待，CSN 1310。

cards.audioText: CSN 1310, Runway 36R, line up and cleared for takeoff, surface wind 350 degrees, 3 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 1310，进入 Runway 36R 等待，许可起飞，地面风向 350 度，风速 3 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, line up, cleared for takeoff, CSN 1310.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进入 Runway 36R 等待，许可起飞，CSN 1310。

cards.audioText: B: You find you have no enough fuel to the destination due to long ground delay, tell Beijing Tower you have to taxi back to refuel your aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: B：由于长时间地面延误，你发现燃油不足以到达目的地，告诉北京塔台你必须滑回给飞机加油。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN 1310, we have no enough fuel to the destination due long ground delay, request taxi back to refuel the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN 1310，由于长时间地面延误，我们没有足够燃油到达目的地，请求滑回给飞机加油。

topics.name: CSN 3235 TCAS机动 导航/自动驾驶问题 舱门问题

cards.audioText: Your call sign is CSN 3235, a flight from Beijing to Shanghai Hongqiao, you are parking at gate 217, you have got information G, contact Beijing Delivery and request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CSN 3235，这是一趟从北京飞往上海虹桥的航班，你停在 217 登机口，已收到 G 情报，联系北京放行并申请 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Delivery, CSN 3235, gate 215, information G, request ATC clearance, Shanghai.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，CSN 3235，215 登机口，G 情报，申请前往上海的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: CSN 3235, Beijing Delivery, cleared to Shanghai Hongqiao via flight planned route, departure Runway 08L, LMN-41 departure, initial climb 1,500 meters, cruising level 9200 meters, after departure, contact 119.8, squawk 3223.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3235，北京放行，许可按飞行计划航路飞往上海虹桥，离场使用 Runway 08L，执行 LMN-41 离场，初始爬升至 1,500 米，巡航高度 9,200 米，离场后联系 119.8，应答机 3223。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Shanghai, flight planned route, 08 left, LMN-41 departure, 1500 meters, 9002 hudnred meters, 119.8, squawk 3223, CSN 3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往上海，Runway 08L，LMN-41 离场，1,500 米，9002 百米，119.8，应答机 3223，CSN 3235。

cards.audioText: CSN 3235, your slot time is 0800, expect 15 minutes delay due temporary airway restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3235，你的时隙时间是 0800，因临时航路限制，预计延误 15 分钟。
cards.referenceText: roger, slot time 0800, expect 15 minutes delay, CSN 3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，时隙时间 0800，预计延误 15 分钟，CSN 3235。

cards.audioText: CSN 3235, the airway restriction has been canceled, report ready for startup.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3235，航路限制已取消，准备好开车时报告。
cards.referenceText: roger, report ready for startup, CSN 3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，准备好开车时报告，CSN 3235。

cards.audioText: All the passengers have boarded the aircraft, all cabin doors have been closed, you are fully ready.
cards.audioTextZh: 所有乘客均已登机，所有客舱门均已关闭，你已完全准备好。
cards.referenceText: Ground, CSN 3235, fully ready.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN 3235，已完全准备好。

cards.audioText: CSN 3235, startup approved.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3235，开车批准。
cards.referenceText: startup approved, CSN 3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 开车批准，CSN 3235。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN 3235, ready for push back.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN 3235，准备好推出。

cards.audioText: CSN 3235, pushback approved, facing south.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3235，推出批准，机头朝南。
cards.referenceText: pushback approved, facing south, CSN 3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出批准，机头朝南，CSN 3235。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed the push back, you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出，准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN 3235, push back completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN 3235，推出完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CSN 3235, taxi via taxiway T4, D and A to holding point Runway 08L.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3235，经 T4、D 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 08L 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi via taxiway T four, DAL, A, holding point Runway 08L, CSN 3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 T4、DAL、A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 08L 等待点，CSN 3235。

cards.audioText: Now you are holding short of Runway 08L, you are ready for departure, contact Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正在 Runway 08L 前等待，已准备好离场，联系北京塔台。
cards.referenceText: Tower, CSN 3235, holding short of Runway 08L, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN 3235，正在 Runway 08L 前等待，已准备好离场。

cards.audioText: CSN 3235, line up Runway 08L and cleared for takeoff, caution strong wind shear at the departure end of the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3235，进入 Runway 08L 等待，许可起飞，注意跑道离场端有强风切变。
cards.referenceText: line up Runway 08L, cleared for takeoff, CSN 3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进入 Runway 08L 等待，许可起飞，CSN 3235。

cards.audioText: Just after liftoff, you encountered strong wind shear between the surface and 200m, report it to Beijing Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 离地后不久，你在地面至 200 米之间遭遇强风切变，向北京离场报告。
cards.referenceText: Departure, CSN 3235, we encountered strong wind shear, between the surface and 200 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，CSN 3235，我们在地面至 200 米之间遭遇强风切变。

cards.audioText: CSN 3235, roger, climb to 4,200 meters, resume own navigation to LMN.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3235，收到，爬升至 4,200 米，恢复自主领航至 LMN。
cards.referenceText: climb to 4200 meters, resume own navigation to LMN, CSN 3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 4,200 米，恢复自主领航至 LMN，CSN 3235。

cards.audioText: CSN 3235, continue climb to 5100 meters, contact Beijing Control on 118.9.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3235，继续爬升至 5,100 米，联系北京管制 118.9。
cards.referenceText: continue climb to 5100 meters, 118.9, CSN 3235.

topics.name: CSN 3112 燃油紧急 颠簸 雷暴绕飞

cards.audioText: Your call sign is CSN 3112, a flight from Beijing to Guangzhou, the preceding aircraft reported a squall line 100 miles ahead on the weather radar, contact Beijing Control and request turn right to circumnavigate the weather.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CSN 3112，这是一趟从北京飞往广州的航班，前机通过气象雷达报告前方 100 英里有飑线，联系北京管制并请求右转绕飞天气。
cards.referenceText: Control, CSN 3112, preceding aircraft reported a squall line, 100 miles, request turn right.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 3112，前机报告 100 英里处有飑线，请求右转。

cards.audioText: CSN 3112, Beijing Control, negative due prohibited area, turn left 30 degrees, track out 35 kilometers, report clear of CB.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3112，北京管制，不行，因禁区限制，左转 30 度，偏出航迹 35 公里，脱离 CB 后报告。
cards.referenceText: roger, turn left 30 degrees, track out 35 kilometers, CSN 3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，左转 30 度，偏出航迹 35 公里，CSN 3112。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are clear of CB and closing back to the course, contact Beijing Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已脱离 CB，正回到航路，联系北京管制。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 3112, clear of CB and closing back to the course.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 3112，已脱离 CB，正回到航路。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 3112, the preceding aircraft reported severe turbulence at 10400 meters, 11000 meters is available, what's your intention?
B: acknowledge the transmission and tell the controller you'd like to climb to 11000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CSN 3112，前机报告在 10,400 米有严重颠簸，11,000 米可用，你的意图是什么？
B： 复诵该通话，并告诉管制员你希望爬升至 11,000 米。
cards.referenceText: request climb to 2000 meters 11000 meters, CSN 3112.

cards.audioText: CSN 3112, climb to and maintain 11000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3112，爬升至并保持 11,000 米。
cards.referenceText: climb to and maintain 11000 meters, CSN 3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至并保持 11,000 米，CSN 3112。

cards.audioText: CSN 3112, after passing MUDAM, fly direct to ASAVA.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3112，飞越 MUDAM 后，直飞 ASAVA。
cards.referenceText: after passing MUDAM, fly direct to ASAVA, CSN 3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞越 MUDAM 后，直飞 ASAVA，CSN 3112。

cards.audioText: CSN 3112, orbit right from present position until advised due weather ahead.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3112，因前方天气，从当前位置开始向右盘旋，直至另行通知。
cards.referenceText: orbit right from present position until advised, CSN 3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从当前位置开始向右盘旋，直至另行通知，CSN 3112。

cards.audioText: B: After several orbits, you find you don't have enough fuel to hold any further, report the situation to Beijing Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：几圈盘旋后，你发现没有足够燃油继续等待，向北京管制报告情况。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 3112, we don't have enough fuel to hold any further.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 3112，我们没有足够燃油继续等待。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 3112, roger, say your intention.
B: Tell the controller you require radar vector to Beijing for priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CSN 3112，收到，报告你的意图。
B： 告诉管制员你需要雷达引导前往北京并优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: request radar vector to Beijing, priority landing, CSN 3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求雷达引导前往北京并优先着陆，CSN 3112。

cards.audioText: CSN 3112, roger, turn left heading 190, fly direct to GUVBA.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3112，收到，左转航向 190，直飞 GUVBA。
cards.referenceText: turn left heading 190, fly direct to GUVBA, CSN 3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 190，直飞 GUVBA，CSN 3112。

cards.audioText: CSN 3112, turn left heading 150, direct to AA446, hold at AA446 as published due weather.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3112，左转航向 150，直飞 AA446，因天气按公布程序在 AA446 等待。
cards.referenceText: turn left heading 150, direct to AA446, hold at AA446 as published, CSN 3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 150，直飞 AA446，按公布程序在 AA446 等待，CSN 3112。

cards.audioText: B: You have been holding at AA446 for about 30 minutes, you are reaching the minimum fuel situation, contact Beijing Control and request leave the hold and land as soon as possible.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你已在 AA446 等待约 30 分钟，正接近最低燃油状态，联系北京管制并请求离开等待并尽快着陆。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 3112, we have been holding at AA446 for about 30 minutes, we are reaching the minimum fuel situation, request leave the hold and land as soon as possible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 3112，我们已在 AA446 等待约 30 分钟，正接近最低燃油状态，请求离开等待并尽快着陆。

cards.audioText: CSN 3112, roger, leave the hold, proceed to LADIX, descend to 6000 meters, contact Beijing Approach on 119.35, we have informed them about your situation.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3112，收到，退出等待，前往 LADIX，下降至 6,000 米，联系北京进近 119.35，我们已将你的情况通知他们。
cards.referenceText: leave the hold, proceed to LADIX, descend to 6000 meters, 119.35, CSN 3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 退出等待，前往 LADIX，下降至 6,000 米，119.35，CSN 3112。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over LADIX, maintaining 6000 meters, you have received information L, contact Beijing Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 LADIX 上空，保持 6000 米，已收到通播 L，联系北京进近。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CSN 3112, over LADIX, maintaining 6000 meters, information L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CSN 3112，LADIX 上空，保持 6000 米，通播 L。

cards.audioText: CSN 3112, Beijing Approach, radar contact, descend to 4,200 meters, expect radar vector ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3112，北京进近，雷达识别，下降至 4,200 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: descend to 4,200 meters, expect radar vector ILS approach Runway 36R, CSN 3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 4,200 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，CSN 3112。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 3112, are you declaring fuel emergency?
B: Tell the controller that you are declaring fuel emergency and request priority landing Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CSN 3112，你是否宣布燃油紧急状态？
B： 告诉管制员你宣布燃油紧急状态，并请求优先使用 Runway 36R 着陆。
cards.referenceText: affirm, we are declaring fuel emergency, request priority landing Runway 36R, CSN 3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我们宣布燃油紧急状态，请求优先使用 Runway 36R 着陆，CSN 3112。

cards.audioText: CSN 3112, roger, you are number one to land, cleared straight in ILS approach Runway 36R, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3112，收到，你是第一架落地航空器，许可直线 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: cleared straight in ILS approach Runway 36R, roger, thanks, CSN 3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可直线 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，收到，谢谢，CSN 3112。

cards.audioText: Now you have established on ILS approach Runway 36R, contact Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，联系北京塔台。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN 3112, established on ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN 3112，已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。

cards.audioText: CSN 3112, Beijing Tower, Runway 36R, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3112，北京塔台，Runway 36R，许可着陆。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, cleared to land, CSN 3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: Runway 36R，许可着陆，CSN 3112。

topics.name: CSN 9302 雷暴绕飞 TCAS机动 备降/返航

cards.audioText: Your call sign is CSN 9302, you are at parking bay 235, you are ready for pushback, contact Guangzhou Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CSN 9302，你位于 235 停机位，已准备好推出，联系广州地面。
cards.referenceText: Ground, CSN 9302, Bay 235, ready for pushback. I request pushback
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，CSN 9302，235 停机位，已准备好推出。我请求推出。

cards.audioText: CSN 9302, stand by, expect 20 minutes delay, thunderstorm is approaching the airport, numerous aircraft holding for weather improvement.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 9302，等待，预计延误 20 分钟，雷暴正在接近机场，许多航空器正在等待天气改善。
cards.referenceText: roger, stand by, CSN 9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，等待，CSN 9302。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 9302, report tug is ready.
B: Tell the controller the tug is in position and you are ready for pushback.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CSN 9302，报告牵引车是否准备好。
B： 告诉管制员牵引车已就位，你已准备好推出。
cards.referenceText: The tug, ready, ready for pushback request pushback, CSN 9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 牵引车已准备好，已准备好推出，请求推出，CSN 9302。

cards.audioText: CSN 9302, pushback approved, facing east, Runway 19, stand by for startup.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 9302，推出批准，机头朝东，Runway 19，等待开车。
cards.referenceText: pushback approved, facing east, Runway 19, stand by startup, CSN 9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出批准，机头朝东，Runway 19，等待开车，CSN 9302。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have been waiting for the start of clearance for about 15 minutes, contact Guangzhou Ground for start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已等待开车许可约 15 分钟，联系广州地面请求开车。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CSN 9302, we have been waiting for about 15 minutes, request start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，CSN 9302，我们已等待约 15 分钟，请求开车。

cards.audioText: CSN 9302, expect departure at 49, start up at own discretion, QNH 1008, report when ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 9302，预计 49 时离场，自主决定开车，QNH 1008，准备好滑行时报告。
cards.referenceText: start up at own discretion, QNH 1008, CSN 9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 自主决定开车，QNH 1008，CSN 9302。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CSN 9302, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，CSN 9302，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CSN 9302, taxi via J, D, T3 and T4 to holding point Runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 9302，经 J、D、T3 和 T4 滑行至 Runway 19 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi via J, DAL, T tree, T four, to holding point Runway 19, CSN 9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 J、DAL、T3、T4 滑行至 Runway 19 等待点，CSN 9302。

cards.audioText: CSN 9302, hold short of T3, give way to Airbus 3 20 crossing from right to left.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 9302，在 T3 前等待，给从右向左穿越的 Airbus 320 让行。
cards.referenceText: hold short of T3, give way to Airbus 3 20, CSN 3902.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在 T3 前等待，给 Airbus 320 让行，CSN 3902。

cards.audioText: CSN 9302, traffic is clear, continue taxi via D, T3 and T4 to holding point Runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 9302，相关航空器已通过，经 D、T3 和 T4 继续滑行至 Runway 19 等待点。
cards.referenceText: continue taxi via DAL, T tree, T four, holding point Runway 19, CSN 9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 DAL、T3、T4 继续滑行至 Runway 19 等待点，CSN 9302。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding point F1, Runway 19, you are fully ready, contact Guangzhou Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 F1、跑道 19 等待点，完全准备好，联系广州塔台。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN 9302, holding point F1, Runway 19, fully ready.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN 9302，F1 等待点，跑道 19，完全准备好。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 9302, line up and wait Runway 19, caution thunderstorm building up at the departure end of Runway 19.
B: Read back ATC clearance and request right turn when airborne due weather.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CSN 9302，进入 Runway 19 等待，注意 Runway 19 离场端有雷暴发展。
B： 复诵 ATC 许可，并因天气原因请求离地后右转。
cards.referenceText: line up and wait Runway 19, request right turn due weather, CSN 9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进入 Runway 19 等待，因天气原因请求右转，CSN 9302。

cards.audioText: CSN 9302, turn right heading 120, direct to LMN, Runway 19, cleared for takeoff, surface wind 180 degrees, 5 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 9302，右转航向 120，直飞 LMN，Runway 19，许可起飞，地面风向 180 度，风速 5 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 120, direct to LM Novenmber, Runway 19, cleared for takeoff, CSN 9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 120，直飞 LMN，Runway 19，许可起飞，CSN 9302。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, maintaining 2100 meters, heading 120, contact Guangzhou Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，保持 2100 米，航向 120，联系广州进近。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CSN 9302, airborne, maintaining 2100 meters, heading 120.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，CSN 9302，已离地，保持 2100 米，航向 120。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 302, climb to 2700 meters on QNH 1008.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 302，QNH 1008 爬升至 2700 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 2700 meters on QNH 1008, CSN 9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: QNH 1008 爬升至 2700 米，CSN 9302。

cards.audioText: B: During climb, suddenly you have been struck by foreign object, possibly hail strike, your instruments are indicating incorrectly, report it to Guangzhou Approach and request return to land.
cards.audioTextZh: B：爬升中，你突然被外来物击中，可能是冰雹撞击，仪表指示不正确，向广州进近报告并请求返回着陆。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CSN 9302, we have been struck by foreign object, possibly hail strike, our instruments are indicating incorrectly, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，CSN 9302，我们被外来物击中，可能是冰雹撞击，仪表指示不正确，请求返回着陆。

cards.audioText: CSN 9302, roger, descend to 1500 meters, expect radar vector for final Runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 9302，收到，下降至 1500 米，预计雷达引导 Runway 19 五边。
cards.referenceText: descend to 1500 meters, radar vector for final Runway 19, CSN 9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 1500 米，雷达引导 Runway 19 五边，CSN 9302。

cards.audioText: CSN 9302, contact Guangzhou Tower on 118.5.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 9302，联系广州塔台 118.5。

cards.audioText: CSN 9302, Runway 19, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 9302，Runway 19，许可落地。
cards.referenceText: Runway 19, cleared to land, CSN 9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: Runway 19，许可落地，CSN 9302。

topics.name: CES 556 醉客不理性乱秩序 氧气面罩 灭火器

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CES 556, from Seoul to Wuhan, you are maintaining 9200 meters, approaching JTN, squawking 1532, make an initial contact with Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CES 556，从首尔飞往武汉，保持 9200 米，接近 JTN，应答机 1532，与上海管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 556, maintaining 9200 meters, approaching JTN, squawking 1532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 556，保持 9200 米，接近 JTN，应答机 1532。

cards.audioText: C: CES 556, direct to TOL, reduce speed to Mach 0.79.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 556，直飞 TOL，减速至马赫 0.79。
cards.referenceText: Direct to TOL, reduce speed to M.79, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 TOL，减速至 M.79，CES 556。

cards.audioText: B: Near TOL, you are experiencing moderate to severe clear air turbulence between 6000 meters and 10400 meters, contact Shanghai Control and request climb.
cards.audioTextZh: B：在 TOL 附近，你在 6000 米至 10400 米之间遭遇中到强晴空颠簸，联系上海管制并请求爬升。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 556, we are experiencing moderate to severe clear air turbulence between 6000 meters and 10400 meters, request climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 556，我们在 6000 米至 10400 米之间遭遇中到强晴空颠簸，请求爬升。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 556, the alternative level is 11600 meters, what's your intention?
B: Tell the controller you can accept 11600 meters.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CES 556，备选高度为 11600 米，你的意图？
B：告诉管制员你可以接受 11600 米。
cards.referenceText: We can accept 11600 meters, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们可以接受 11600 米，CES 556。

cards.audioText: C: CES 556, climb to and maintain 11600 meters, report reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 556，爬升并保持 11600 米，报告到达。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 11600 meters, report reaching, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 11600 米，报告到达，CES 556。

cards.audioText: B: You receive the report from the cabin that a drunk passenger is behaving irrationally, affecting cabin services and disturbing cabin order, you suspect the higher cabin altitude is making passengers uncomfortable, you want to fly lower levels.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你收到客舱报告，一名醉酒旅客行为异常，影响客舱服务并扰乱客舱秩序，你怀疑较高客舱高度让旅客不适，想飞较低高度。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 556, a drunk passenger is behaving irrationally, affecting cabin services and disturbing cabin order, we suspect the higher cabin altitude is making passengers uncomfortable, request descent to lower levels.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 556，一名醉酒旅客行为异常，影响客舱服务并扰乱客舱秩序，我们怀疑较高客舱高度让旅客不适，请求下降至较低高度。

cards.audioText: C: CES 556, maintain 11600 meters due to airspace congestion, reduce speed to Mach 0.75.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 556，因空域拥挤，保持 11600 米，减速至马赫 0.75。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 11600 meters, reduce speed to M.75, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 11600 米，减速至 M.75，CES 556。

cards.audioText: C: CES 556, contact Wuhan Control on 128.55.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 556，联系武汉管制128.55。

cards.audioText: B: The flight attendant reported 2 passengers took out their overhead oxygen masks, they are being closely monitored, report it to Wuhan Control and request descent now.
cards.audioTextZh: B：乘务员报告 2 名旅客取出了头顶氧气面罩，他们正被严密监控，向武汉管制报告并请求立即下降。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES 556, the flight attendant reported 2 passengers took out their overhead oxygen masks, they are being closely monitored, request descent now.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CES 556，乘务员报告 2 名旅客取出了头顶氧气面罩，他们正被严密监控，请求立即下降。

cards.audioText: C: CES 556, descend to 6600 meters and level by XSH.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 556，下降至 6600 米，并在 XSH 前改平。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 6600 meters and level by XSH, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 6600 米，并在 XSH 前改平，CES 556。

cards.audioText: C: CES 556, due to temporary airspace restriction is effective immediately, after passing XSH, follow ZF-03A arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 556，因临时空域限制立即生效，过 XSH 后，执行 ZF-03A 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: After passing XSH, follow ZF-03A arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 过 XSH 后，执行 ZF-03A 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CES 556。

cards.audioText: C: CES 556, contact Wuhan Approach 120.4.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 556，联系武汉进近120.4。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over ZF, maintaining 6600 meters, you have got information O, contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 ZF 上空，保持 6600 米，已收到通播 O，联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 556, over ZF, maintaining 6600 meters, information O.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 556，ZF 上空，保持 6600 米，通播 O。

cards.audioText: C: CES 556, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, information is P, descend and maintain 4200 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 556，武汉进近，雷达识别，通播是 P，下降并保持 4200 米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, information P, descend and maintain 4200 meters, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，通播 P，下降并保持 4200 米，CES 556。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar observed a cumuliform clouds ahead, contact Wuhan Approach and request turn left and track direct to HG.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的气象雷达观察到前方积状云，联系武汉进近并请求左转直飞 HG。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 556, our weather radar observed CB ahead, request turn left and track direct to HG.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 556，我们的气象雷达观察到前方 CB，请求左转并直飞 HG。

cards.audioText: C: CES 556, turn left heading 220, expect radar vectors for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 556，左转航向 220，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 220, expect radar vectors for ILS approach Runway 36R, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 220，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CES 556。

cards.audioText: C: CES 556, turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 556，右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CES 556。

cards.audioText: B: While intercepting the localizer, 1 drunk passenger discharged the fire extinguisher, the purser make an emergency call said there are still passengers standing in the cabin, inform Wuhan Approach the situation and request terminate approach and proceed to holding area.
cards.audioTextZh: B：截获航向道时，1 名醉酒旅客释放了灭火器，乘务长紧急呼叫称客舱仍有旅客站立，通知武汉进近该情况并请求终止进近，前往等待区。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 556, 1 drunk passenger discharged the fire extinguisher, there are still passengers standing in the cabin, request terminate approach and proceed to holding area.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 556，1 名醉酒旅客释放了灭火器，客舱仍有旅客站立，请求终止进近并前往等待区。

cards.audioText: C: CES 556, turn left, direct to DA, climb to 1200 meters, hold as published, expect further clearance at time 50.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 556，左转，直飞 DA，爬升至 1200 米，按公布程序等待，预计进一步许可时间 50。
cards.referenceText: Turn left, direct to DA, climb to 1200 meters, expect further clearance at time 50, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转，直飞 DA，爬升至 1200 米，预计进一步许可时间 50，CES 556。

cards.audioText: B: Now the problematic passenger has been properly restrained, advise the Approach controller you are ready to leave the hold.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在问题旅客已被妥善约束，告知进近管制员你准备好离开等待。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 556, the problematic passenger has been properly restrained, request leave the hold.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 556，问题旅客已被妥善约束，请求离开等待。

topics.name: CES 232 右主起落架 通场 等待

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CES 232, from Wuhan to Singapore, you are taxiing Southbound on taxiway C to holding point Runway 36L, call Wuhan Tower for takeoff clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CES 232，从武汉飞往新加坡，正在 C 滑行道向南滑行至跑道 36L 等待点，呼叫武汉塔台请求起飞许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 232, taxiing Southbound on taxiway C to holding point Runway 36L, request takeoff clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 232，正在 C 滑行道向南滑行至跑道 36L 等待点，请求起飞许可。

cards.audioText: C: CES 232, Wuhan Tower, line up and wait Runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 232，武汉塔台，跑道 36L 进跑道等待。
cards.referenceText: Line up and wait Runway 36L, CES 232.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36L 进跑道等待，CES 232。

cards.audioText: C: CES 232, wind calm, cleared for takeoff Runway 36L, contact Wuhan Departure 118.25 when airborne.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 232，风静，跑道 36L 可以起飞，离地后联系武汉离场 118.25。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff Runway 36L, 118.25, CES 232.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36L 可以起飞，118.25，CES 232。

cards.audioText: B: After airborne, you have an undercarriage warning, the indication shows your right main gear has not been retracted, call Wuhan Approach and request maintain 1500 meters and speed 200 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: B：离地后，你有起落架警告，指示显示右主起落架未收上，呼叫武汉进近并请求保持 1500 米、速度 200 节。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 232, we have an undercarriage warning, our right main gear has not been retracted, request maintain 1500m and speed 200kts.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 232，我们有起落架警告，右主起落架未收上，请求保持 1500 米、速度 200 节。

cards.audioText: C: CES 232, Wuhan Approach, roger, climb and maintain 1500 meters, speed 200 knots approved, advise intentions when able.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 232，武汉进近，收到，爬升并保持 1500 米，速度 200 节同意，能够时告知意图。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 1500m, speed 200 knots, CES 232.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 1500 米，速度 200 节，CES 232。

cards.audioText: B: After performing the abnormal checklist, you still cannot confirm the landing gear position, tell Wuhan Approach you want to return to Wuhan Airport and make a low-pass over the runway for visual check.
cards.audioTextZh: B：完成非正常检查单后，你仍无法确认起落架位置，告诉武汉进近你想返回武汉机场，并在跑道上方低通场目视检查。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 232, we cannot confirm the landing gear position, request return to Wuhan Airport and make a low-pass over the runway for visual check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 232，我们无法确认起落架位置，请求返回武汉机场，并在跑道上方低通场目视检查。

cards.audioText: C: CES 232, turn right track direct to EB NDB, descend and maintain 1200 meters, follow the published procedure, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 232，右转直飞 EB NDB，下降并保持 1200 米，按公布程序，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Turn right track direct to EB NDB, descend and maintain 1200m, follow the published procedure, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R, CES 232.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 EB NDB，下降并保持 1200 米，按公布程序，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CES 232。

cards.audioText: C: CES 232, you are 11 miles from touchdown, contact Wuhan Tower on 118.5.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 232，你距接地点 11 海里，联系武汉塔台118.5。
cards.referenceText: 11 miles from touchdown, 118.5, CES 232.
cards.referenceTextZh: 距接地点 11 海里，118.5，CES 232。

cards.audioText: B: Call Wuhan Tower and tell the controller you have established ILS Runway 36R and you are ready for the low-pass.
cards.audioTextZh: B：呼叫武汉塔台并告诉管制员你已建立 ILS 跑道 36R，准备低通场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 232, established ILS Runway 36R, ready for low-pass.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 232，已建立 ILS 跑道 36R，准备低通场。

cards.audioText: C: CES 232, wind calm, cleared low-pass Runway 36R, not below 200 meters above the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 232，风静，跑道 36R 低通场许可，不低于跑道上方 200 米。
cards.referenceText: Cleared low-pass Runway 36R, not below 200m above the runway, CES 232.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R 低通场许可，不低于跑道上方 200 米，CES 232。

cards.audioText: C: CES 232, after low-pass, maintain runway heading, climb to 1200 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 232，低通场后，保持跑道航向，爬升至 1200 米。
cards.referenceText: After low-pass, maintain runway heading, climb to 1200m, CES 232.
cards.referenceTextZh: 低通场后，保持跑道航向，爬升至 1200 米，CES 232。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 232, we’ve had a good look at your undercarriage, your right main gear seems to be in the extended position, advise intentions.
B: Tell Wuhan Tower the indication still shows right landing gear unlocked, you want to perform a hold over WHA as published.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CES 232，我们已看清你的起落架，你的右主起落架似乎在放下位置，告知意图。
B：告诉武汉塔台指示仍显示右起落架未锁定，你想在 WHA 上空按公布程序等待。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 232, the indication still shows right landing gear unlocked, request hold over WHA as published.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 232，指示仍显示右起落架未锁定，请求在 WHA 按公布程序等待。

cards.audioText: C: CES 232, turn left proceed direct to DA, climb and maintain 1500 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 119.225.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 232，左转直飞 DA，爬升并保持 1500 米，联系武汉进近119.225。
cards.referenceText: Turn left proceed direct to DA, climb and maintain 1500m, 119.225, CES 232.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞 DA，爬升并保持 1500 米，119.225，CES 232。

cards.audioText: B: You are tracking direct to DA, maintaining 1500 meters, call Wuhan Approach and request holding instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你正直飞 DA，保持 1500 米，呼叫武汉进近并请求等待指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 232, tracking direct to DA, maintaining 1500m, request holding instructions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 232，正直飞 DA，保持 1500 米，请求等待指令。

cards.audioText: C: CES 232, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, hold at DA as published, expect further clearance at time 30, report entering the hold.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 232，武汉进近，雷达识别，在 DA 按公布程序等待，预计进一步许可时间 30，报告进入等待。
cards.referenceText: Hold at DA as published, expect further clearance at time 30, report entering the hold, CES 232.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在 DA 按公布程序等待，预计进一步许可时间 30，报告进入等待，CES 232。

topics.name: CES 529 右空调过热都失效 5乘客重伤

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CES 529, you are maintaining 8400 meters, make an initial contact with Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CES 529，保持 8400 米，与上海管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 529, maintaining 8400 meters,.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 529，保持 8400 米。

cards.audioText: C: CES 529, Shanghai Control, radar contact, climb to 10400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 529，上海管制，雷达识别，爬升至 10400 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 10400 meters, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 10400 米，CES 529。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are cruising at 10400 meters, your instruments indicate 1 of your air conditioning packs has malfunctioned, contact Shanghai Control and request descend to lower levels.
