cards.audioText: now you are airborne from Runway 18L, you encountered a bird strike during the initial climb, one of your engines failed, inform the situation to Wuhan Approach and tell the controller you intend to return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已从 Runway 18L 离地，在初始爬升期间遭遇鸟击，一台发动机失效，向武汉进近通报情况，并告诉管制员你打算返回武汉机场落地。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 2151, we encountered a bird strike during initial climb, one of the engines failed, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 2151，我们在初始爬升期间遭遇鸟击，一台发动机失效，请求返场落地。

cards.audioText: CES 2151, climb and maintain 600 meters, turn right to join downwind and cleared for ILS Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 2151，爬升并保持 600 米，右转加入三边，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: climb and maintain 600 meters, turn right to join downwind and cleared for ILS Runway 36R, CES 2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 600 米，右转加入三边，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，CES 2151。

cards.audioText: Because of strong tailwind, you want to change to Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于强顺风，你想改用 Runway 18L。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 2151, request change to Runway 18L due strong tailwind.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 2151，因强顺风请求改用 Runway 18L。

cards.audioText: CES 2151, change to Runway 18L is approved, maintain 600 meters, turn right direct to WHA, contact Wuhan Approach 121.7.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 2151，批准改用 Runway 18L，保持 600 米，右转直飞 WHA，联系武汉进近 121.7。
cards.referenceText: change to Runway 18L is approved, maintain 600 meters, turn right, direct to WHA, 121.7, CES 2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 批准改用 Runway 18L，保持 600 米，右转，直飞 WHA，121.7，CES 2151。

cards.audioText: CES 2151, climb to and maintain 900 meters, after WHA, fly heading 360, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 2151，爬升至并保持 900 米，飞越 WHA 后飞航向 360，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 18L。
cards.referenceText: climb to and maintain 900 meters, after WHA, fly heading 360, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 18L, CES 2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至并保持 900 米，飞越 WHA 后飞航向 360，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 18L，CES 2151。

topics.name: CES 5118 雷暴绕飞 TCAS机动 舱门问题

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CES 5118, from Wuhan to Beijing, parking at gate 223, when you are ready request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CES 5118，从武汉飞往北京，停在 223 号登机口，准备好时请求 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 5118, gate 223, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 5118，223 号登机口，请求 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: CES 5118, stand by one, I'll check your flight plan.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 5118，稍等，我会检查你的飞行计划。
cards.referenceText: stand by, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: B: All flight attendants told you passengers have boarded, all cargo doors are closed, now report ready for clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：所有乘务员告诉你旅客已登机，所有货舱门已关闭，现在报告准备好接收放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 5118, gate 223, ready to copy ATC clearance to Beijing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 5118，223 号登机口，准备好抄收飞往北京的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: CES 5118 is cleared to Beijing, cruising level 10,700 meters, r/w 18 Left, Z FOXTROT-11 departure, initially 900 meters, departure frequency 120.6, squawk 3021.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 5118，许可飞往北京，巡航高度 10,700 米，Runway 18L，执行 ZF-11 离场，初始高度 900 米，离场频率 120.6，应答机 3021。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Beijing, cruising level 1700 meters, Runway 18L, ZF-11 departure, initially 900 meters, departure frequency 120.6, squawk 3021, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往北京，巡航高度 1700 米，Runway 18L，执行 ZF-11 离场，初始高度 900 米，离场频率 120.6，应答机 3021，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: C: CES 5118, read back correct, remain this frequency, call you back.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 5118，复诵正确，保持本频率，稍后呼叫你。
cards.referenceText: Remain this frequency, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持本频率，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: 5 minutes later, no call from delivery. Ask about the duration and reason of the delay
cards.audioTextZh: 5 分钟后，仍未收到放行的呼叫。询问延误时长和原因。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan delivery, CES 5118, what's the delay like and what's the reason for the delay? Wuhan delivery, CES 5118, confirm the duration and reason for delay
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 5118，延误情况如何，延误原因是什么？武汉放行，CES 5118，请确认延误时长和原因。

cards.audioText: C: CES 5118, due to thunderstorm activity, flow control is now in effect, expect 8 minutes separation between each aircraft going the same direction.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 5118，由于雷暴活动，流量控制现已生效，预计同方向每架飞机间隔 8 分钟。
cards.referenceText: Roger, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，CES 5118。

cards.audioText:
B: Heavy rain is starting to fall, accompanied with lightning and thunder.
C: All the aircraft on my frequency, airport will temporarily close, thunderstorms on final, expect delay until the weather improves, squawk ident if you copy this message.
cards.audioTextZh:
B：大雨开始落下，并伴随闪电和雷声。
C：我频率上的所有飞机，机场将临时关闭，五边有雷暴，预计延误至天气好转，如收到此信息请应答机识别。
cards.referenceText: Roger, squawk ident, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，应答机识别，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: B: 1 hour later, the weather is getting better and the airport is open, now ask for your departure sequence.
cards.audioTextZh: B：1 小时后，天气好转，机场开放，现在询问你的离场顺序。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 5118, request departure sequence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 5118，请求离场顺序。

cards.audioText: CES 5118, you are currently No. 1 in your direction, expect about 20 minutes delay, contact ground on 121.8.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 5118，你当前在本方向排序第一，预计延误约 20 分钟，联系地面 121.8。
cards.referenceText: roger, 101.8, CES 5118.

cards.audioText: B: Inform Ground that you are ready for push back and start.
cards.audioTextZh: B：通知地面你准备好推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 5118, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 5118，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: CES 5118, push back approved, facing north.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 5118，同意推出，机头朝北。
cards.referenceText: Push back approved, facing north, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出，机头朝北，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: B: You realize that the tug is not in position yet, advise Ground control you need another 5 minutes to be ready.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你意识到拖车还未到位，告知地面管制你还需要 5 分钟准备。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 5118, tug is not in position, request 5 minutes to be ready.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 5118，拖车未到位，请求 5 分钟准备。

cards.audioText: C: CES 5118, roger, stand by for push, I will call you back.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 5118，收到，等待推出，我稍后呼叫你。
cards.referenceText: Stand by, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待，CES 5118。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 5118, are you fully ready now? We have a slot time for departure in 10 minutes.
B: You need to open the cabin door for adding passenger's food and drinks due to long delay. Advise ground you will need another 5 minutes for catering.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CES 5118，你现在完全准备好了吗？我们有一个 10 分钟后离场的时隙。
B： 由于长时间延误，你需要打开舱门补充乘客的餐食和饮料。通知地面你还需要 5 分钟进行配餐。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 5118, we need to open cabin door for adding passenger's food and drinks due long delays, we need another five minutes for catering. we need another 5 minutes for catering, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 5118，由于长时间延误，我们需要打开舱门补充乘客的餐食和饮料，还需要五分钟进行配餐。我们还需要 5 分钟进行配餐，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: CES 5118, roger report ready.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 5118，收到，准备好后报告。
cards.referenceText: wilco, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: 5 minutes later, catering completed, call ready
cards.audioTextZh: 5 分钟后，配餐完成，呼叫已准备好。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 5118, catering completed, ready for pushback.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 5118，配餐完成，已准备好推出。

cards.audioText: CES 5118, push back approved until abeam Gate 221, do not block gate 222, there's incoming traffic to the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 5118，批准推出至与 221 登机口平行的位置，不要挡住 222 登机口，有航空器正进该登机口。
cards.referenceText: roger, push back approved until abeam Gate 221, do not block gate 222, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，批准推出至与 221 登机口平行的位置，不要挡住 222 登机口，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: B: Engine start completed, now request taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：发动机启动完成，现在请求滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 5118, startup completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 5118，开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CES 5118, taxi via M, A, hold short of E1.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 5118，经 M、A 滑行，E1 外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via M, A, hold short of E1, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 M、A 滑行，E1 外等待，CES 5118。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 5118, Can you accept E1 intersection for departure? takeoff roll distance available 3300 m.
B: tell tower you can accept it.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CES 5118，你能接受从 E1 交叉口离场吗？可用起飞滑跑距离为 3300 m。
B： 告诉塔台你可以接受。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 5118, affirm, we can accept intersection departure from E one. affirm, we can accept intersection departure from E one, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 5118，可以，我们可以接受从 E1 交叉口离场。可以，我们可以接受从 E1 交叉口离场，CES 5118。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 5118, roger, line up and wait via taxiway E1.
B: Report to Tower that the aircraft in front of you is blocking E1.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CES 5118，收到，经 E1 滑行道进入跑道等待。
B： 向塔台报告你前方的航空器挡住了 E1。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 5118, line up and wait via taxiway E one, but the aircraft in front of us is blocking E one. the aircraft in front of us is blocking E one, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 5118，经 E1 滑行道进入跑道等待，但我们前方的航空器挡住了 E1。我们前方的航空器挡住了 E1，CES 5118。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 5118, roger, break! break! CSN 328, taxi forward to be clear of E1.
B: The aircraft moved, you are able to continue taxi and line up.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CES 5118，收到，break！break！CSN 328，向前滑行以让开 E1。
B：该飞机移动后，你可以继续滑行并进跑道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 5118, traffic is clear, we are able to continue taxi and line up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 5118，交通已脱离，我们可以继续滑行并进跑道。

cards.audioText: C: CES 5118, cleared for takeoff, Runway 18L, initially maintain runway heading, climb to 1,500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C： CES 5118，许可从 Runway 18L 起飞，起初保持跑道航向，爬升至 1,500 米。
cards.referenceText: cleared for takeoff, Runway 18L, initially maintain runway heading, climb to 1500 meters, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可从 Runway 18L 起飞，起初保持跑道航向，爬升至 1500 米，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CES 769, a flight from Wuhan to Amsterdam, you are parking at stand 221, you have received information C, request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CES 769，从武汉飞往阿姆斯特丹，停在 221 号停机位，已收到通播 C，请求 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 769, stand 221, information C, request ATC clearance to Amsterdam.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 769，221 号停机位，通播 C，请求飞往阿姆斯特丹的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: CES 769, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Amsterdam via flight planned route, departure Runway 04, initial climb 1,800 meters, HZ-01 departure, cruising level 11,000 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3562.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 769，武汉放行，许可按飞行计划航路飞往阿姆斯特丹，离场使用 Runway 04，初始爬升至 1,800 米，执行 HZ-01 离场，巡航高度 11,000 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 3562。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Amsterdam via flight planned route, departure Runway 04, initial climb 1800 meters, HZ-01 departure, cruising level 2000 meters, 11000 meters departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3562, CES 769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往阿姆斯特丹，离场使用 Runway 04，初始爬升至 1800 米，执行 HZ-01 离场，巡航高度 2000 米，11000 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 3562，CES 769。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 769, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 769，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: CES 769, push back and start up approved, long pushed back, facing south.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 769，同意推出和开车，长推出，机头朝南。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, long pushed back, facing south, CES 769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出和开车，长推出，机头朝南，CES 769。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出和开车，准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 769, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 769，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CES 769, taxi via D, D4, hold short of Runway 36.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 769，经 D、D4 滑行，跑道 36 外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via D, D4, hold short of Runway 36, CES 769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 D、D4 滑行，跑道 36 外等待，CES 769。

cards.audioText: B: During taxiing, a passenger opened an emergency exit, inform the controller of this situation and airport security is needed to remove the passenger.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行中，一名旅客打开了应急出口，通知管制员该情况并需要机场安保带走该旅客。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 769, a passenger opened an emergency exit, request airport security to remove the passenger.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 769，一名旅客打开了应急出口，请求机场安保带走该旅客。

cards.audioText: CES 769, recleared to Amsterdam, initial climb 2,100 meters, HZ-02 departure, cruising level 10,400 meters, the rest unchanged.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 769，重新许可飞往阿姆斯特丹，初始爬升至 2,100 米，执行 HZ-02 离场，巡航高度 10,400 米，其余不变。
cards.referenceText: recleared to Amsterdam, initial climb 2100 meters, HZ-02 departure, cruising level 1400 meters, 10004 hudnred meters the rest unchanged, CES 769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 重新许可飞往阿姆斯特丹，初始爬升至 2100 米，执行 HZ-02 离场，巡航高度 1400 米，10004 hudnred 米，其余不变，CES 769。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding at holding point W2 Runway 36, contact Wuhan Tower and ask the permission to cross Runway 36.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36 W2 等待点等待，联系武汉塔台并请求穿越跑道 36。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 769, holding point W2 runway36, request cross Runway 36.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 769，跑道 36 W2 等待点，请求穿越跑道 36。

cards.audioText: CES 769, expedite cross Runway 36, when vacated, taxi via taxiway Z5, A4 and A, hold short of Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 769，加速穿越 Runway 36，脱离后经 Z5、A4 和 A 滑行道滑行，在 Runway 04 前等待。
cards.referenceText: expedite cross Runway 36, taxi via taxiway Z five, A four and A, hold short of Runway 04, CES 769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 加速穿越 Runway 36，经 Z5、A4 和 A 滑行道滑行，在 Runway 04 前等待，CES 769。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding short of Runway 04, you are ready for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 04 外等待，准备好离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 769, holding short of Runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 769，跑道 04 外等待，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: CES 769, line up Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 769，进入跑道 04。
cards.referenceText: Line up Runway 04, CES 769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进入跑道 04，CES 769。

cards.audioText: C: CES 769, cleared for takeoff Runway 04, surface wind 020, 2 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 769，跑道 04 可以起飞，地面风 020，2 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff Runway 04, CES 769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 04 可以起飞，CES 769。

cards.audioText: Now you are maintaining 2000 meters, over WXI, squawking 3562, contact Beijing Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正保持 2000 米，飞越 WXI，应答机 3562，联系北京管制。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CES 769, maintaining 2000 meters, 11000 meters over WXI, squawking 3562.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CES 769，正保持 2000 米，11000 米，飞越 WXI，应答机 3562。

cards.audioText: CES 769, increase speed to mach decimal 83 or greater, fly direct to PEK.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 769，将速度增加至 Mach 0.83 或更大，直飞 PEK。
cards.referenceText: increase speed to mach decimal 83 or greater, fly direct to PEK, CES 769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 将速度增加至 Mach 0.83 或更大，直飞 PEK，CES 769。

topics.name: CES 529 TCAS机动 备降/返航

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CES 529, you are maintaining 8400 meters, make an initial contact with Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CES 529，保持 8400 米，与上海管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 529, maintaining 8400 meters,.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 529，保持 8400 米。

cards.audioText: CES 529, Shanghai Control, radar contact, climb to 10,400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 529，上海管制，雷达识别，爬升至 10,400 米。
cards.referenceText: climb to 10400 meters, CES 529. climb to 1400 meters, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 10400 米，CES 529。爬升至 1400 米，CES 529。

cards.audioText: now you are cruising at 10,400 meters, your instruments indicate left pack has malfunctioned, contact Shanghai Control and request descend to lower levels.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正以 10,400 米巡航，仪表显示左组件故障，联系上海管制并请求下降至较低高度。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 529, maintaining 1400 meters, 10400 meters our instruments indicate left pack has malfunctioned, request descent to lower levels.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 529，正保持 1400 米，10400 米，我们的仪表显示左组件故障，请求下降至较低高度。

cards.audioText: C: CES 529, turn right heading 240, descend to 8900 meters initially.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 529，右转航向 240，先下降至 8900 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, descend to 8900 meters initially, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，先下降至 8900 米，CES 529。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, your right pack is overheating, both packs have malfunctioned and request emergency descent, this is a Distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降中，你的右组件过热，两个组件都故障，请求紧急下降，这是遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Shanghai Control, CES 529, our right pack is overheating, both packs have malfunctioned, request emergency descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，上海管制，CES 529，我们的右组件过热，两个组件都故障，请求紧急下降。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, your cabin altitude is rising rapidly, request emergency descent to 3000 meters, this is a Distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降中，你的客舱高度快速上升，请求紧急下降至 3000 米，这是遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Shanghai Control, CES 529, our cabin altitude is rising rapidly, request emergency descent to 3000 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，上海管制，CES 529，我们的客舱高度快速上升，请求紧急下降至 3000 米。

cards.audioText: C: CES 529, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1031.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 529，QNH 1031 下降至 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1031, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: QNH 1031 下降至 3000 米，CES 529。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 3000 meters, cabin altitude has resumed to normal, you will cancel Distress, report it to Shanghai Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你保持 3000 米，客舱高度已恢复正常，你将取消遇险，向上海进近报告。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Approach, CES 529, maintaining 3000 meters, the cabin altitude has resumed to normal, cancel Distress.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海进近，CES 529，保持 3000 米，客舱高度已恢复正常，取消遇险。

cards.audioText: B: The cabin crew reports 5 passengers in the cabin are seriously injured during emergency descent, inform the situation to Shanghai Control and request diversion to Hangzhou.
cards.audioTextZh: B：客舱机组报告 5 名旅客在紧急下降中严重受伤，向上海管制通报情况并请求备降杭州。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 529, 5 passengers are seriously injured, request divert to Hangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 529，5 名旅客严重受伤，请求备降杭州。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 529, divert to Hangzhou approved, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller you need ambulances upon arrival.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CES 529，同意备降杭州，你需要什么协助？
B：告诉管制员抵达时需要救护车。
cards.referenceText: Divert to Hangzhou approved, request ambulances upon arrival, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意备降杭州，请求抵达时救护车，CES 529。

cards.audioText: CES 529, roger, ambulance will be ready upon arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 529，收到，救护车将在到达时就位。
cards.referenceText: roger, thanks, CES 529. CES 529
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CES 529。CES 529。

cards.audioText: C: CES 529, turn right heading 180, descend and maintain 2100 meters, QNH 1031, expect ILS approach Runway 06.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 529，右转航向 180，下降并保持 2100 米，QNH 1031，预计 ILS 进近跑道 06。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 180, descend and maintain 2100 meters, QNH 1031, expect ILS approach Runway 06, CES 529.

cards.audioText: B: Now tell Hangzhou Tower about your situation and request priority landing.

topics.name: CES 209 TCAS机动 备降/返航

cards.audioText: Your call sign is CES 209, you are in Shanghai Control area, you are maintaining 8400 meters, make an initial contact with Shanghai Control.

cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 209，正保持 8400 米。

cards.audioTextZh: CES 209，上海管制，雷达识别，爬升至 1400 米。
cards.referenceText: climb to 1400 meters, CES 209.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 1400 米，CES 209。

cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正以 1400 米巡航，仪表显示左组件故障，联系上海管制并请求下降至较低高度。

cards.audioText: During descent, your right pack is overheating and both packs have malfunctioned, and request emergency descent. This is a distress call.

title: OPI
description: 发音 结构 词汇 流利度 理解能力 应对能力

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered a lightning strike during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行中遇到过雷击吗？
cards.referenceText: No, I have never encountered a lightning strike during flight. I know that lightning strikes are dangerous, so I avoid them during flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，我在飞行中从未遭遇过雷击。我知道雷击很危险，因此在飞行中会避开雷电活动区域。

cards.audioText: Under what weather conditions are lightning strikes most likely to occur?
cards.audioTextZh: 雷击最可能在哪些天气条件下发生？
cards.referenceText: Lightning strikes are most likely to occur in thunderstorms or cumulonimbus clouds.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷击最可能发生在雷暴或积雨云中。

cards.audioText: Why are lightning strikes hazardous to flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么雷击会危及飞行安全？
cards.referenceText: A lightning strike may damage the fuselage, wings, or electronic equipment. It may also cause electrical failure or disrupt communication and navigation systems.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷击可能损坏机身、机翼或电子设备，还可能导致电气故障，或使通信和导航系统中断。

cards.audioText: What should a pilot do if the aircraft is struck by lightning during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中飞机遭遇雷击时，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: I would first maintain control of the aircraft and follow the SOP and checklist. I would check for structural or system damage and report the situation to ATC. If the damage were severe, I would request a diversion to an alternate airport. After landing, I would request a maintenance inspection.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会首先控制好飞机，并遵循标准操作程序和检查单。我会检查飞机是否存在结构或系统损伤，并向空中交通管制报告情况。如果损伤严重，我会申请改航至备降机场。着陆后，我会申请进行维修检查。

cards.audioText: What measures can pilots take to reduce the risk of a lightning strike?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员可以采取哪些措施降低遭遇雷击的风险？
cards.referenceText: Before flight, I check the weather reports and avoid areas where lightning is likely. During flight, I monitor the weather radar and request a deviation from ATC if lightning is detected ahead. I also avoid cumulonimbus clouds and thunderstorm areas.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行前，我会查看天气报告，并避开可能发生雷电的区域。飞行中，我会监控气象雷达；如果前方探测到雷电，就向空中交通管制申请绕飞。我还会避开积雨云和雷暴区域。

cards.audioText: What damage can a lightning strike cause to an aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 雷击会对飞机造成哪些损伤？
cards.referenceText: A lightning strike may damage the fuselage, wings, or electronic equipment. It may also cause communication or navigation failure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷击可能损坏机身、机翼或电子设备，还可能导致通信或导航失效。

cards.audioText: During which phase of flight is an aircraft most likely to be struck by lightning?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机在哪个飞行阶段最容易遭遇雷击？
cards.referenceText: An aircraft is most likely to be struck by lightning during climb, descent, or holding rather than at normal cruise altitude. These phases often take it through active cloud layers at lower altitudes. The risk is greatest near thunderstorms and at levels where the temperature is close to freezing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机在爬升、下降或等待阶段比在正常巡航高度更容易遭到雷击，因为这些阶段常会穿过较低高度的活跃云层。雷暴附近以及温度接近冰点的高度层风险最大。

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered icing conditions during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行中遇到过结冰条件吗？
cards.referenceText: No, I have never encountered in-flight icing. I know that icing can affect aircraft performance, so I try to avoid icing conditions during flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，我从未在飞行中遇到过结冰。我知道结冰会影响飞机性能，因此会尽量避开结冰条件。

cards.audioText: What cockpit or other indications can alert pilots to airframe icing?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些驾驶舱指示或其他迹象可以提醒飞行员机体结冰？
cards.referenceText: Pilots may see ice building up on the windshield or wings. Reduced airspeed, changes in altitude or climb performance, and reports from ATC or other pilots can also provide warning. Some large aircraft have ice detectors that give a direct indication.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员可能看到风挡或机翼上开始积冰。空速下降、高度或爬升性能变化，以及空中交通管制或其他飞行员的报告，也能提供警示。一些大型飞机装有可直接提供指示的结冰探测器。

cards.audioText: How can in-flight icing affect flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 空中结冰会如何影响飞行安全？
cards.referenceText: In-flight icing may reduce lift, increase drag, and cause flight-control problems or a stall. It may also cause incorrect airspeed or altitude indications and may lead to engine vibration, flameout, or failure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行中结冰会减小升力、增大阻力，并可能导致飞行操纵问题或失速。它还可能造成空速或高度指示错误，并可能引起发动机振动、熄火或失效。

cards.audioText: What should pilots do if they encounter icing conditions in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中遇到结冰条件时，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: I would turn on the pitot heating system, advise ATC of the situation, and request a route or flight-level change to avoid the icing conditions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会打开空速管加温系统，向空中交通管制报告情况，并申请改变航路或飞行高度层，以避开结冰条件。

cards.audioText: What should a pilot do if ice begins to accumulate on the wings in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中机翼开始积冰时，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: I would report the situation to ATC and request an altitude change to leave the icing area. I would also turn on the aircraft's de-icing and anti-icing systems.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会向空中交通管制报告情况，并申请改变高度以离开结冰区域。我还会打开飞机的除冰和防冰系统。

cards.audioText: Under what atmospheric conditions is aircraft icing likely to occur?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些大气条件下容易发生飞机结冰？
cards.referenceText: Aircraft icing is likely when the air and aircraft surface temperatures are below 0°C and there are enough supercooled droplets in the air. It is more likely in cold, humid conditions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当空气和飞机表面温度低于 0°C，且空气中有足够多的过冷水滴时，飞机容易结冰。寒冷潮湿条件下更容易发生结冰。

cards.audioText: On which parts of an aircraft is ice most likely to form?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机哪些部位最容易结冰？
cards.referenceText: Ice is most likely to form on exposed leading edges and critical components. These include the wings, windshield, engine air intakes, pitot tubes, static ports, radio antennas, and landing gear.
cards.referenceTextZh: 冰最容易积聚在暴露的前缘和关键部件上，包括机翼、风挡、发动机进气口、空速管、静压孔、无线电天线和起落架。

cards.audioText: What de-icing systems are installed on the aircraft you fly?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所飞的飞机安装了哪些除冰系统？
cards.referenceText: The aircraft I fly uses hot air, electrical heating, and de-icing fluid for ice protection.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我所飞的飞机使用热空气、电加温和除冰液进行防冰保护。

cards.audioText: How does an aircraft's anti-icing system work?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机的防冰系统如何工作？
cards.referenceText: An aircraft anti-icing system uses electrical power or hot engine bleed air to heat critical surfaces. These may include the windshield, pitot tubes, wing leading edges, and engine intakes. The heat prevents ice from building up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机防冰系统利用电力或发动机热引气加热关键表面。这些表面可能包括风挡、空速管、机翼前缘和发动机进气口。加热可以防止冰层积聚。

cards.audioText: What types of airframe ice can form in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中可能形成哪些类型的机体积冰？
cards.referenceText: The common types of airframe ice are rime ice, clear ice, and mixed ice.
cards.referenceTextZh: 常见的机体积冰类型包括雾凇冰、明冰和混合冰。

cards.audioText: Which type of airframe ice poses the greatest threat to flight safety, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪种类型的机体积冰对飞行安全威胁最大？为什么？
cards.referenceText: Clear ice poses the greatest threat. It can form a smooth, hard layer that changes the aerodynamic shape, is difficult to remove, and can accumulate quickly. This may lead to a loss of lift and control.
cards.referenceTextZh: 明冰的威胁最大。它会形成光滑坚硬的冰层，改变气动外形，难以清除，而且可能迅速积聚。这可能导致升力和操纵能力丧失。

cards.audioText: What is the difference between de-icing and anti-icing?
cards.audioTextZh: 除冰与防冰有什么区别？
cards.referenceText: De-icing removes ice, snow, or frost that has already accumulated on an aircraft. Anti-icing helps prevent new ice from forming after de-icing. Many operations use de-icing first and anti-icing second.
cards.referenceTextZh: 除冰是清除已经积聚在飞机上的冰、雪或霜。防冰则是在除冰后帮助防止新的冰层形成。许多运行先除冰，随后再进行防冰。

cards.audioText: What is holdover time in ground de-icing and anti-icing operations?
cards.audioTextZh: 在地面除冰和防冰作业中，什么是保持时间？
cards.referenceText: Holdover time is the estimated period during which anti-icing fluid protects an aircraft from ice, snow, or frost accumulation. It begins when the final anti-icing application starts and ends when the fluid loses effectiveness. It depends on the fluid type, weather, and precipitation intensity; if it expires before takeoff, new contamination may form and re-treatment may be needed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持时间是指防冰液保护飞机免受冰、雪或霜积聚的预计时段。它从最后一次防冰液喷洒开始时计算，到防冰液失效时结束。保持时间取决于液体类型、天气和降水强度；如果起飞前超过保持时间，可能再次形成污染，需要重新处理。

cards.audioText: Why must an aircraft take off within the applicable holdover time after ground de-icing or anti-icing?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机在地面除冰或防冰后，为什么必须在适用的保持时间内起飞？
cards.referenceText: Anti-icing fluid loses effectiveness over time. If takeoff is delayed beyond the applicable holdover time, ice, snow, or frost may accumulate again on critical surfaces. This contamination can reduce lift and increase drag, so the aircraft must be treated again before takeoff.
cards.referenceTextZh: 防冰液的有效性会随时间下降。如果起飞延误并超过适用的保持时间，冰、雪或霜可能再次积聚在关键表面上。这种污染会减小升力并增大阻力，因此飞机必须在起飞前重新进行除防冰处理。

cards.audioText: What are the common types of aircraft de-icing and anti-icing fluids?
cards.audioTextZh: 常见的飞机除冰液和防冰液有哪些类型？
cards.referenceText: The four common fluid categories are Type I, Type II, Type III, and Type IV.
cards.referenceTextZh: 常见的四类液体是 I 型、II 型、III 型和 IV 型。

cards.audioText: How do the common types of aircraft de-icing and anti-icing fluids differ?
cards.audioTextZh: 常见类型的飞机除冰液和防冰液有何区别？
cards.referenceText: Type I is a thin, heated de-icing fluid that runs off quickly and provides a short holdover time. Type II is thicker and remains on the surface longer, while Type III is designed for smaller aircraft. Type IV is very thick and provides the longest holdover time.
cards.referenceTextZh: I 型是黏度较低的加热除冰液，会很快流走，保持时间较短。II 型黏度更高，在表面停留时间更长；III 型适用于较小型飞机。IV 型黏度很高，保持时间最长。

cards.audioText: Who is responsible for deciding whether de-icing or anti-icing is needed before takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 起飞前由谁负责决定是否需要除冰或防冰？
cards.referenceText: The pilot in command has final responsibility for deciding whether de-icing or anti-icing is required. The pilot should assess the weather and any contamination and may consult dispatch and ground de-icing personnel for technical advice. The final decision remains with the captain.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是否需要除冰或防冰，最终由机长负责决定。机长应评估天气和任何污染情况，并可向签派和地面除冰人员征询技术意见。最终决定仍由机长作出。

cards.audioText: How should the appropriate de-icing or anti-icing fluid be selected in heavy snow?
cards.audioTextZh: 大雪条件下应如何选择合适的除冰液或防冰液？
cards.referenceText: In heavy snow, a two-step process may use heated Type I fluid to remove existing contamination, followed by Type IV fluid for anti-icing. The crew should check the fluid's certified weather conditions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在大雪条件下，两步法可以先使用加热的 I 型液体清除已有污染，再使用 IV 型液体进行防冰。机组应核对该液体获准使用的天气条件。

cards.audioText: What is wind shear?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么是风切变？
cards.referenceText: Wind shear is a sudden change in wind speed or direction over a short distance or within a small area. It can cause rapid changes in aircraft airspeed and altitude.
cards.referenceTextZh: 风切变是风速或风向在很短距离或很小区域内突然发生变化。它会使飞机空速和高度迅速改变。

cards.audioText: Where is wind shear most likely to occur?
cards.audioTextZh: 风切变最可能在哪里发生？
cards.referenceText: Wind shear is most likely near thunderstorms and convective cells, especially close to the ground where microbursts can affect takeoff and approach. It can also occur near frontal weather and strong changes in surface wind. Low-level wind shear is particularly dangerous because there is little height available for recovery.
cards.referenceTextZh: 风切变最容易发生在雷暴和强对流单体附近，尤其在接近地面的区域，微下击暴流会影响起飞和进近。它也可能出现在锋面天气和地面风发生强烈变化的区域。低空风切变特别危险，因为可用于改出的高度很少。

cards.audioText: Have you ever received a wind shear warning in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行中收到过风切变警告吗？
cards.referenceText: No, I have never received a wind shear warning in flight. I fly a DA-40 for flight training, and that aircraft does not have a wind shear warning system.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，我在飞行中从未收到过风切变警告。我使用 DA-40 进行飞行训练，这种飞机没有风切变警告系统。

cards.audioText: What are the possible consequences if a pilot ignores a wind shear warning?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果飞行员忽视风切变警告，可能会造成哪些后果？
cards.referenceText: If a pilot ignores a wind shear warning, the aircraft may experience sudden airspeed and altitude changes. It may become difficult to control and could stall or crash.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果飞行员忽视风切变警告，飞机的空速和高度可能突然变化。飞机可能变得难以操纵，并可能失速或坠毁。

cards.audioText: How are pilots warned about wind shear on your aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所飞的飞机通过什么方式向飞行员发出风切变警告？
cards.referenceText: The DA-40 I fly does not have a wind shear warning system. On large commercial aircraft, weather radar and EGPWS can provide a wind shear warning to the pilots.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我飞的 DA-40 没有风切变警告系统。在大型商用飞机上，气象雷达和 EGPWS 可以向飞行员提供风切变警告。

cards.audioText: Why is wind shear a threat to flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么风切变会威胁飞行安全？
cards.referenceText: Wind shear can cause sudden increases or decreases in airspeed and a rapid loss of altitude. The aircraft may become difficult to control, stall, or crash.
cards.referenceTextZh: 风切变会使空速突然增大或减小，并造成高度迅速下降。飞机可能变得难以操纵、失速，甚至坠毁。

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered wind shear in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行中遇到过风切变吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I once encountered wind shear during a training flight. The aircraft's speed and altitude changed abruptly. I maintained control, communicated with ATC, and adjusted the flight parameters to recover from the situation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我曾在一次训练飞行中遭遇风切变。飞机的速度和高度突然变化。我控制好飞机，与空中交通管制沟通，并调整飞行参数，使飞机恢复正常状态。

cards.audioText: What should pilots do if they hear a "GO-AROUND, WINDSHEAR AHEAD" warning during approach?
cards.audioTextZh: 进近过程中听到“复飞，前方风切变”警告时，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: The pilots should go around immediately. They should use TOGA thrust, maintain the required configuration until clear of the wind shear, and closely monitor airspeed, altitude, attitude, and vertical speed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员应立即复飞。他们应使用 TOGA 推力，在脱离风切变之前保持规定的构型，并密切监控空速、高度、姿态和垂直速度。

cards.audioText: What should pilots do if they encounter wind shear during the takeoff roll before V1?
cards.audioTextZh: 在 V1 前的起飞滑跑阶段遇到风切变时，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: Before V1, the pilots should reject the takeoff by reducing power, using rudder to keep the aircraft straight, and applying the brakes to stop on the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在 V1 之前，飞行员应减小推力，使用方向舵保持飞机直线，并使用刹车使飞机停在跑道上，从而中断起飞。

cards.audioText: What would you do if you encountered wind shear and a sudden loss of airspeed as the aircraft approached rotation speed?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机接近抬前轮速度时，如果遭遇风切变并且空速突然下降，你会如何处置？
cards.referenceText: If the event were recognized before the takeoff decision speed and a safe rejection could be initiated, I would maintain directional control and reject the takeoff in accordance with the procedure. At or after the decision speed, I would continue, rotate normally at the calculated rotation speed, and follow the wind-shear escape guidance. I would avoid configuration changes until the aircraft was clear of the shear.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果在起飞决断速度之前识别到该情况，并且能够安全中断起飞，我会保持方向控制并按照程序中断起飞。在达到或超过决断速度后，我会继续起飞，按计算的抬轮速度正常抬轮，并遵循风切变逃逸指引。在飞机脱离风切变之前，我会避免改变构型。

cards.audioText: How can wind shear cause an aircraft to deviate from the glide slope during approach?
cards.audioTextZh: 进近过程中，风切变如何导致飞机偏离下滑道？
cards.referenceText: A sudden increase in headwind can raise indicated airspeed and lift, causing the aircraft to move above the glide slope. A downdraft or a change to tailwind can reduce airspeed and lift and push it below the glide slope. Because these changes can occur quickly, large corrections may make the approach unstable.
cards.referenceTextZh: 顶风突然增强会使指示空速和升力增大，导致飞机高于下滑道。下沉气流或变为顺风会使空速和升力减小，并将飞机推至下滑道以下。由于这些变化可能迅速发生，过大的修正会使进近变得不稳定。

cards.audioText: Why is low-level wind shear more hazardous than wind shear at higher altitudes?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么低空风切变比高空风切变更危险？
cards.referenceText: Low-level wind shear occurs close to the ground, often during takeoff, climb, approach, or landing. A sudden loss of airspeed or altitude leaves less time and height for recovery, and nearby terrain or buildings may be difficult to clear.
cards.referenceTextZh: 低空风切变发生在接近地面的区域，通常出现在起飞、爬升、进近或着陆阶段。空速或高度突然下降会使飞行员用于改出的时间和高度更少，附近地形或建筑物也可能难以越过。

cards.audioText: How should pilots respond to a wind shear warning in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中收到风切变警告时，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: During takeoff, the pilots should maintain control, add power, and leave the wind shear area. During landing, they should go around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 起飞过程中，飞行员应控制好飞机，增加推力并离开风切变区域。着陆过程中则应复飞。

cards.audioText: What should pilots do if they encounter wind shear during takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 起飞过程中遇到风切变时，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: If wind shear is encountered before V1, the pilots should not continue the takeoff. If it is encountered after V1, they should maintain aircraft control, add power, and leave the wind shear area.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果在 V1 之前遭遇风切变，飞行员不应继续起飞。如果在 V1 之后遭遇，应控制好飞机，增加推力并离开风切变区域。

cards.audioText: How can wind shear affect aircraft performance?
cards.audioTextZh: 风切变会如何影响飞机性能？
cards.referenceText: Wind shear may cause the aircraft's airspeed to increase or decrease, and it may cause a loss of altitude.
cards.referenceTextZh: 风切变可能使飞机空速增大或减小，也可能造成高度损失。

cards.audioText: What would you do if low-level wind shear were forecast for takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果预报起飞时会出现低空风切变，你会如何处置？
cards.referenceText: If low-level wind shear were forecast before takeoff, I would delay the takeoff or change to another runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果起飞前预报有低空风切变，我会推迟起飞或改用另一条跑道。

cards.audioText: How can pilots recognize that they have encountered wind shear?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员如何判断飞机已经遭遇风切变？
cards.referenceText: Pilots may recognize wind shear from sudden changes in airspeed, ground speed, or vertical speed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员可以通过空速、地速或垂直速度突然变化来识别风切变。

cards.audioText: What measures can help reduce accidents caused by wind shear?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些措施有助于减少风切变造成的事故？
cards.referenceText: Pilots can check forecasts, ATIS, and NOTAMs before flight and avoid takeoff or landing in areas affected by wind shear. In flight, they can use weather radar and pilot reports and monitor wind changes. Training, predictive wind shear systems, and timely ATC alerts also help reduce accidents.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员可以在飞行前查看预报、ATIS 和航行通告，并避免在受风切变影响的区域起飞或着陆。飞行中可以利用气象雷达和飞行员报告，并监控风的变化。训练、预测式风切变系统以及空中交通管制及时发出的警告也有助于减少事故。

cards.audioText: During which seasons is wind shear most likely to occur?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些季节最容易出现风切变？
cards.referenceText: The season depends on the local climate, so there is no single answer worldwide. Convective wind shear is most likely during the local thunderstorm season, while frontal and inversion-related wind shear can occur at other times. Pilots should use current forecasts, reports, and local weather patterns rather than relying only on the time of year.
cards.referenceTextZh: 具体季节取决于当地气候，因此全球没有统一答案。对流性风切变最常见于当地雷暴季节，而锋面或逆温相关的风切变也可能在其他时段发生。飞行员应依据当前预报、报告和当地天气规律，而不能只看季节。

cards.audioText: What is runway visual range (RVR)?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么是跑道视程（RVR）？
cards.referenceText: Runway visual range is the distance over which a pilot on the runway centreline can see the runway surface markings or the lights that outline the runway or identify its centreline. It is normally reported in metres or feet for a particular part of the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道视程是指位于跑道中线上的飞行员能够看清跑道道面标志，或跑道边界灯光及中线灯光的距离。通常以米或英尺报告，并对应跑道的特定部分。

cards.audioText: When should pilots obtain current RVR information?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员应在什么时候获取最新的 RVR 信息？
cards.referenceText: Pilots should obtain current RVR information when visibility at the airport is low.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机场能见度较低时，飞行员应获取当前的跑道视程信息。

cards.audioText: From what sources can pilots obtain RVR information?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员可以从哪些来源获取 RVR 信息？
cards.referenceText: Pilots can obtain RVR information from ATIS or from the air traffic controller.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员可以从 ATIS 或空中交通管制员处获得跑道视程信息。

cards.audioText: When are low-visibility procedures required?
cards.audioTextZh: 何时需要实施低能见度程序？
cards.referenceText: Low-visibility procedures are required when the reported visibility, cloud ceiling, or RVR reaches the activation criteria published for that aerodrome. ATC or the aerodrome operator activates the procedures to protect sensitive areas and control surface movements. The exact trigger is local, so pilots must check the current airport information.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当报告能见度、云底高或跑道视程达到该机场公布的启动标准时，就需要实施低能见度程序。空中交通管制或机场运营方会启动这些程序，以保护敏感区并控制地面活动。具体启动条件由当地规定，因此飞行员必须查看最新机场信息。

cards.audioText: What is your company's policy on takeoffs in low-visibility conditions?
cards.audioTextZh: 贵公司对低能见度条件下起飞有什么规定？
cards.referenceText: At my flight school, if the visibility is below our takeoff minimum, we wait for the weather to improve.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在我的航校，如果能见度低于我们的起飞最低标准，就等待天气好转。

cards.audioText: What is your company's policy on landings in low-visibility conditions?
cards.audioTextZh: 贵公司对低能见度条件下着陆有什么规定？
cards.referenceText: At my flight school, we do not land when the reported weather is below the applicable landing minimum. The approach may be continued only when the aircraft, equipment, airport facilities, and pilot qualifications meet the requirements. If the required visual reference is not obtained at the decision point, we go around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在我的航校，报告天气低于适用的着陆最低标准时，我们不会着陆。只有飞机、设备、机场设施和飞行员资质均满足要求时，才能继续进近。如果在决断点未获得所需目视参考，我们就复飞。

cards.audioText: How can pilots prevent runway incursions while taxiing in low visibility?
cards.audioTextZh: 低能见度滑行时，飞行员如何防止跑道侵入？
cards.referenceText: Pilots should taxi slowly, use the airport chart, and obtain ATC clearance before entering a runway. They should read back instructions clearly, confirm any doubt with ATC, and maintain good situational awareness. A follow-me vehicle can be requested if necessary.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员应缓慢滑行、使用机场图，并在进入跑道前取得空中交通管制许可。他们应清楚复诵指令，对任何疑问向管制确认，并保持良好情景意识。必要时可以申请引导车。

cards.audioText: What precautions should pilots take when taxiing in low visibility?
cards.audioTextZh: 低能见度滑行时，飞行员应采取哪些预防措施？
cards.referenceText: Pilots should maintain good situational awareness and follow ATC instructions carefully. If visibility is extremely poor, they may request a follow-me vehicle.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员应保持良好情景意识，并认真遵循空中交通管制指令。如果能见度极低，可以申请引导车。

cards.audioText: How can pilots prevent ground collisions in low-visibility conditions?
cards.audioTextZh: 低能见度条件下，飞行员如何防止地面碰撞？
cards.referenceText: Pilots should taxi slowly and cautiously, follow ATC instructions, and read them back clearly. They should monitor the frequency and airport chart, confirm their position if in doubt, and maintain good cockpit communication and situational awareness.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员应缓慢谨慎滑行，遵循空中交通管制指令并清楚复诵。他们应守听频率、查看机场图，有疑问时确认位置，并保持良好的驾驶舱沟通和情景意识。

cards.audioText: What should a pilot do after missing the correct taxiway in low visibility?
cards.audioTextZh: 低能见度下错过正确滑行道后，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: The pilot should stop immediately, report the aircraft's position to ATC, and request further instructions. The aircraft should not continue without ATC clearance, and the pilot may request a follow-me vehicle if necessary.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员应立即停车，向空中交通管制报告飞机位置，并申请进一步指令。未经管制许可不得继续滑行，必要时飞行员可以申请引导车。

cards.audioText: What consequences can result from disorientation in low-visibility conditions?
cards.audioTextZh: 低能见度条件下迷失方向可能导致哪些后果？
cards.referenceText: Disorientation in low visibility can lead to a runway incursion, a ground collision, entry onto the wrong taxiway, or a missed approach. It may also cause an unstable landing, runway overrun or veer-off, aircraft damage, and injuries.
cards.referenceTextZh: 低能见度下的迷航可能导致跑道侵入、地面碰撞、误入错误滑行道或复飞。还可能造成着陆不稳定、冲出或偏出跑道、飞机损坏和人员受伤。

cards.audioText: What hazards can arise during low-visibility operations?
cards.audioTextZh: 低能见度运行中可能出现哪些危险？
cards.referenceText: Low visibility can reduce situational awareness, increase pilot workload, and raise the risk of misjudgment. It may lead to a runway incursion, ground collision, missed taxiway or runway, unstable approach, go-around, delay, or diversion.
cards.referenceTextZh: 低能见度会降低情景意识、增加飞行员工作负荷，并提高误判风险。它可能导致跑道侵入、地面碰撞、错过滑行道或跑道、进近不稳定、复飞、延误或改航。

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered turbulence during a flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行中遇到过颠簸吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes. During a training flight from Guanghan to Suining, I encountered severe turbulence while cruising at 1,800 metres. We maintained control and climbed to 2,100 metres, where the conditions became normal.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的。在一次从广汉飞往遂宁的训练飞行中，我在 1,800 米巡航时遭遇严重颠簸。我们控制好飞机并爬升到 2,100 米，之后飞行条件恢复正常。

cards.audioText: Do you think turbulence is dangerous to flight safety? Why or why not?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为颠簸会危及飞行安全吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText: Light turbulence is usually manageable, but severe turbulence can be dangerous. It may make the aircraft difficult to control, cause an altitude deviation or structural damage, and injure people on board. For that reason, severe turbulence should be avoided when possible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 轻度颠簸通常可以应对，但严重颠簸可能非常危险。它会使飞机难以操纵，造成高度偏差或结构损伤，并使机上人员受伤。因此，应尽可能避开严重颠簸。

cards.audioText: Why is severe turbulence dangerous?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么严重颠簸很危险？
cards.referenceText: Severe turbulence can make the aircraft difficult to control and cause a sudden loss of speed or altitude. It may damage the fuselage or wings and injure crew members or passengers. It is especially hazardous during critical phases such as takeoff and landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 严重颠簸会使飞机难以操纵，并造成速度或高度突然下降。它可能损坏机身或机翼，使机组成员或旅客受伤。在起飞和着陆等关键阶段，危险尤其大。

cards.audioText: What damage can severe turbulence cause?
cards.audioTextZh: 严重颠簸会造成哪些损伤？
cards.referenceText: Severe turbulence can cause structural damage to the aircraft, including damage to the fuselage and wings.
cards.referenceTextZh: 严重颠簸会造成飞机结构损伤，包括机身和机翼损伤。

cards.audioText: What procedures should pilots follow to avoid clear-air turbulence?
cards.audioTextZh: 为避免晴空颠簸，飞行员应遵循哪些程序？
cards.referenceText: Before flight, pilots should review weather forecasts, pilot reports, and information from ATC and brief the crew about possible clear-air turbulence. In flight, they should remain in contact with ATC and request a route or altitude change when necessary. The crew and passengers should fasten their seatbelts when turbulence is expected or encountered.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行前，飞行员应查看天气预报、飞行员报告和空中交通管制信息，并向机组说明可能出现的晴空颠簸。飞行中应与管制保持联系，并在必要时申请改变航路或高度。预计或遭遇颠簸时，机组和旅客应系好安全带。

cards.audioText: What threats does clear-air turbulence pose to flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 晴空颠簸会对飞行安全构成哪些威胁？
cards.referenceText: Clear-air turbulence can be difficult to detect before the aircraft enters it. It can make the aircraft difficult to control, cause structural damage to the fuselage or wings, and injure passengers.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机进入晴空颠簸前可能很难探测到它。晴空颠簸会使飞机难以操纵，造成机身或机翼结构损伤，并使旅客受伤。

cards.audioText: How can pilots reduce the risks of turbulence during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中，飞行员如何降低颠簸带来的风险？
cards.referenceText: Pilots can obtain turbulence reports from other aircraft and ATC. If turbulence is encountered, they should report it to ATC and request an altitude change when appropriate. They should also inform the cabin crew and passengers to remain seated and fasten their seatbelts.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员可以从其他飞机和空中交通管制获得颠簸报告。遭遇颠簸时，应向管制报告，并在适当情况下申请改变高度。还应通知客舱机组和旅客保持就座并系好安全带。

cards.audioText: What is clear-air turbulence (CAT)?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么是晴空颠簸（CAT）？
cards.referenceText: CAT stands for clear-air turbulence. It is turbulence that occurs in clear air without visible clouds.
cards.referenceTextZh: CAT 是晴空颠簸的缩写。它是发生在没有可见云层的晴空中的颠簸。

cards.audioText: How can mountain-wave turbulence affect flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 山岳波颠簸会如何影响飞行安全？
cards.referenceText: Mountain-wave turbulence can cause violent shaking and make the aircraft difficult to control. It may lead to a loss of speed or altitude, structural damage, and injuries. It also increases pilot workload and the risk of unstable flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 山地波颠簸会造成剧烈抖动，并使飞机难以操纵。它可能导致速度或高度损失、结构损伤和人员受伤，还会增加飞行员工作负荷和飞行不稳定的风险。

cards.audioText: How can pilots detect cumulonimbus clouds or thunderstorms ahead during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中，飞行员如何探测前方的积雨云或雷暴？
cards.referenceText: Pilots can obtain information from ATC, look outside for visible cumulonimbus clouds, and monitor the airborne weather radar for cumulonimbus clouds or thunderstorms ahead. Good task sharing allows the pilot flying to control the aircraft while the pilot monitoring watches the weather information.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员可以从空中交通管制获取信息，目视查找积雨云，并利用机载气象雷达监控前方积雨云或雷暴。良好的任务分工使操纵飞行员能够控制飞机，监控飞行员则关注天气信息。

cards.audioText: What hazards can cumulonimbus clouds and thunderstorms pose to an aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 积雨云和雷暴会给飞机带来哪些危险？
cards.referenceText: Cumulonimbus clouds and thunderstorms may contain lightning, heavy rain, strong winds, and severe turbulence. These hazards can make the aircraft difficult to control, reduce visibility, damage the structure or electronic equipment, and injure passengers. Heavy rain may also contribute to an engine flameout.
cards.referenceTextZh: 积雨云和雷暴中可能有雷电、强降雨、强风和严重颠簸。这些危险会使飞机难以操纵、降低能见度、损坏结构或电子设备，并使旅客受伤。强降雨还可能导致发动机熄火。

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered a cumulonimbus cloud or thunderstorm during a flight? If so, what happened?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行中遇到过积雨云或雷暴吗？如果遇到过，当时发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: No, I have never flown into a cumulonimbus cloud or thunderstorm.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，我从未飞入积雨云或雷暴。

cards.audioText: How does a thunderstorm cell appear on the cockpit weather radar display?
cards.audioTextZh: 雷暴单体在驾驶舱气象雷达显示器上呈现什么样子？
cards.referenceText: On the airborne weather radar display, the area of intense precipitation associated with a thunderstorm cell typically appears red.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在机载气象雷达显示器上，与雷暴单体相关的强降水区域通常显示为红色。

cards.audioText: What should a pilot do if the weather radar indicates a thunderstorm ahead?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果气象雷达显示前方有雷暴，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: The pilot should advise ATC and request a deviation around the thunderstorm. The crew should monitor the weather radar, change the route to remain clear of the weather, and avoid flying through the thunderstorm. Once clear, the aircraft can rejoin the planned route.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员应通知空中交通管制，并申请绕开雷暴。机组应监控气象雷达、改变航路以远离危险天气，并避免穿越雷暴。脱离后，飞机可以重新加入计划航路。

cards.audioText: How does airborne weather radar estimate the intensity of precipitation?
cards.audioTextZh: 机载气象雷达如何估算降水强度？
cards.referenceText: Airborne weather radar sends out microwave pulses that are reflected by water droplets or ice crystals in precipitation. It measures the strength of the returned signal: a stronger return indicates more intense precipitation, while a weaker return indicates lighter precipitation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机载气象雷达发射微波脉冲，脉冲会被降水中的水滴或冰晶反射。雷达测量返回信号的强度：回波越强表示降水越强，回波越弱表示降水较轻。

cards.audioText: What is the main purpose of airborne weather radar?
cards.audioTextZh: 机载气象雷达的主要用途是什么？
cards.referenceText: The main purpose of airborne weather radar is to show weather returns and help pilots identify hazardous precipitation ahead. Pilots use this information to avoid dangerous areas and choose a safer deviation path. They must also understand limitations such as attenuation and radar shadowing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机载气象雷达的主要用途是显示天气回波，帮助飞行员识别前方的危险降水。飞行员利用这些信息避开危险区域并选择更安全的绕飞路线。他们还必须了解衰减和雷达阴影等局限。

cards.audioText: How can pilots use airborne weather radar to avoid thunderstorms?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员如何使用机载气象雷达避开雷暴？
cards.referenceText: Pilots can use the weather radar to locate heavy precipitation and monitor how the storm is changing. They should adjust the radar tilt to examine the weather near their flight level and request an ATC deviation when necessary. They should not try to fly through or under a thunderstorm, and they should continue to use visual observations and ATC information.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员可以利用气象雷达定位强降水并监控雷暴变化。他们应调整雷达俯仰角，查看本飞行高度附近的天气，并在必要时申请空中交通管制批准绕飞。不应尝试穿越雷暴或从雷暴下方飞过，还应继续结合目视观察和管制信息。

cards.audioText: What are the limitations of weather radar?
cards.audioTextZh: 气象雷达有哪些局限性？
cards.referenceText: Weather radar detects precipitation, so it does not show dry turbulence, clear-air turbulence, or volcanic ash directly. Heavy rain can attenuate the signal, and a strong return can hide weather behind it through radar shadowing. An incorrect tilt setting may also show ground returns instead of the weather of interest. Pilots should therefore use other weather information and visual observation as well.
cards.referenceTextZh: 气象雷达探测的是降水，因此不能直接显示无降水回波的颠簸、晴空颠簸或火山灰。强降雨会使信号衰减，强回波还可能通过雷达阴影遮住其后方的天气。俯仰角设置不当也可能显示地面回波，而不是需要关注的天气。因此，飞行员还应使用其他天气信息和目视观察。

cards.audioText: What conditions are needed for a thunderstorm to develop?
cards.audioTextZh: 雷暴形成需要哪些条件？
cards.referenceText: A thunderstorm needs moist air, an unstable atmosphere, and strong upward motion to develop.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷暴形成需要湿润空气、不稳定大气和强烈上升运动。

cards.audioText: What are the stages in the life cycle of a thunderstorm?
cards.audioTextZh: 雷暴的生命周期分为哪些阶段？
cards.referenceText: A thunderstorm has three stages: developing, mature, and dissipating. The developing stage is dominated by updrafts as moisture condenses and the cloud grows. The mature stage has both updrafts and downdrafts, together with heavy rain, lightning, and thunder. In the dissipating stage, downdrafts dominate and the storm weakens.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷暴分为发展、成熟和消散三个阶段。发展阶段以上升气流为主，水汽凝结，云体增长。成熟阶段同时存在上升和下沉气流，并伴有强降雨、闪电和雷声。消散阶段以下沉气流为主，雷暴逐渐减弱。

cards.audioText: What should pilots consider when deviating around a thunderstorm?
cards.audioTextZh: 绕飞雷暴时，飞行员应考虑哪些因素？
cards.referenceText: Pilots should advise ATC about the thunderstorm and request an offset to the left or right of the planned track to avoid it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员应向空中交通管制报告雷暴，并申请向计划航迹左侧或右侧偏置以避开雷暴。

cards.audioText: In which season is a thunderstorm most likely to occur?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪个季节最容易出现雷暴？
cards.referenceText: In many regions, thunderstorms are most likely to occur in summer because high temperatures can produce strong convection and cumulonimbus clouds. They can also occur in spring or autumn where the weather is unstable.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在许多地区，雷暴最容易出现在夏季，因为高温会产生强对流和积雨云。天气不稳定时，春季或秋季也可能出现雷暴。

cards.audioText: What should a pilot do if a thunderstorm is affecting the airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果雷暴正在影响机场，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: If the aircraft is still on the ground, the pilot can delay departure and wait for the weather to improve. If the aircraft is airborne, the pilot can ask ATC to hold until conditions improve or request a diversion to an alternate airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果飞机仍在地面，飞行员可以推迟离场并等待天气好转。如果已经在空中，可以申请空中交通管制安排等待，直至条件改善，或申请改航至备降机场。

cards.audioText: What actions should a pilot take when encountering a strong crosswind on approach?
cards.audioTextZh: 进近过程中遇到强侧风时，飞行员应采取哪些措施？
cards.referenceText: The pilot should check the crosswind direction and speed and monitor the aircraft’s airspeed, altitude, attitude, and flight path closely. An appropriate crab or sideslip technique can be used to align the aircraft while avoiding over-control. The approach should remain stable, and the pilot should be ready to go around if the crosswind exceeds the applicable limit.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员应检查侧风方向和速度，并密切监控飞机的空速、高度、姿态和航迹。可以采用适当的蟹形修正或侧滑技术使飞机与跑道对正，同时避免过度操纵。进近应保持稳定，如果侧风超过适用限制，应随时准备复飞。

cards.audioText: How would you respond if the preceding aircraft went around because of strong crosswinds?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果前机因强侧风复飞，你会如何处置？
cards.referenceText: I would confirm why the preceding aircraft went around and request a current wind check from ATC. I would compare the wind with our applicable limit and continue only if the approach remained within limits and stable. If the crosswind exceeded the limit or conditions deteriorated, I would go around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会确认前机复飞的原因，并向空中交通管制申请最新风况检查。我会把风与本机适用限制比较，只有进近保持在限制内且稳定时才继续。如果侧风超过限制或条件恶化，我会复飞。

cards.audioText: Do you consider a crosswind landing particularly hazardous? Why or why not?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为侧风着陆特别危险吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText: Yes, a strong crosswind can make a landing particularly hazardous. It can cause the aircraft to drift from the correct flight path, skid, or veer off the runway, and it can increase pilot workload. An unstable landing may also lead to a tail, wingtip, or engine strike, aircraft damage, or injuries.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，强侧风会使着陆特别危险。它可能使飞机偏离正确航迹、侧滑或偏出跑道，并增加飞行员工作负荷。不稳定着陆还可能造成机尾、翼尖或发动机擦地、飞机损坏或人员受伤。

cards.audioText: How would you decide whether to continue an approach when the crosswind is close to the applicable limit?
cards.audioTextZh: 当侧风接近适用限制时，你会如何决定是否继续进近？
cards.referenceText: I would compare the actual crosswind with the applicable limit and consider the aircraft’s performance, visibility, and runway conditions. If the crosswind were close to the limit and the conditions were uncertain, I would make a conservative decision and go around rather than force the landing. I would also consider diverting to an alternate airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会把实际侧风与适用限制比较，并考虑飞机性能、能见度和跑道状况。如果侧风接近限制且条件不确定，我会作出保守决定并复飞，而不是勉强着陆。我也会考虑改航至备降机场。

cards.audioText: What preparations should pilots make before arriving at a destination where strong crosswinds are forecast?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果预报目的地有强侧风，飞行员在到达前应做哪些准备？
cards.referenceText: Pilots should obtain the latest wind information from ATC and compare the crosswind with the applicable limit. They should be prepared to go around if the limit is exceeded and consider diverting to an alternate airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员应从空中交通管制获取最新风况，并把侧风与适用限制比较。超过限制时应准备复飞，并考虑改航至备降机场。

cards.audioText: What would you do if the crosswind exceeded the applicable limit but the other pilot insisted on landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果侧风超过适用限制，但另一名飞行员坚持着陆，你会如何处理？
cards.referenceText: I would state the risk clearly, ask the other pilot to recheck the crosswind limit, and call for a go-around. I would emphasize that the crew must follow the applicable SOP and company policy. I would continue to support the safe go-around decision rather than accept a landing outside the limit.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会明确说明风险，请另一名飞行员重新核对侧风限制，并要求复飞。我会强调机组必须遵循适用的标准操作程序和公司政策。我会继续支持安全复飞的决定，而不会接受超限着陆。

cards.audioText: What should a flight crew monitor closely during a crosswind landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 侧风着陆过程中，机组应密切监控哪些事项？
cards.referenceText: The crew should monitor the crosswind direction and speed closely and request an updated wind check from ATC when needed. They should compare the current wind with the applicable operational limit and be prepared to go around if the limit is exceeded.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机组应密切监控侧风方向和速度，并在需要时向空中交通管制申请更新风况。他们应把当前风况与适用运行限制比较，并在超过限制时准备复飞。

cards.audioText: What can happen if an aircraft lands in a strong crosswind?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机在强侧风中着陆可能会发生什么？
cards.referenceText: A strong crosswind can cause the aircraft to skid, veer off, or overrun the runway. It may also lead to a tail strike or damage to the landing gear, engines, wings, or other structure. An unstable landing can injure crew members or passengers.
cards.referenceTextZh: 强侧风会使飞机侧滑、偏出或冲出跑道，还可能导致擦尾，或损坏起落架、发动机、机翼及其他结构。不稳定着陆会使机组成员或旅客受伤。

cards.audioText: What is a microburst?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么是微下击暴流？
cards.referenceText: A microburst is a localized, short-lived weather event with a strong column of sinking air. When the air reaches the ground, it spreads out horizontally and produces severe wind shear. It is especially dangerous to aircraft during takeoff and landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 微下击暴流是一种局地、短时天气现象，具有很强的下沉气流柱。气流到达地面后向水平方向扩散，并产生严重风切变。它对起飞和着陆阶段的飞机特别危险。

cards.audioText: How can a microburst threaten flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 微下击暴流会如何威胁飞行安全？
cards.referenceText: A microburst can cause rapid changes in wind, lift, and airspeed together with a strong downdraft. The aircraft may lose altitude or approach a stall, and the crew may have difficulty maintaining control.
cards.referenceTextZh: 微下击暴流会使风、升力和空速迅速变化，并伴有强烈下沉气流。飞机可能损失高度或接近失速，机组也可能难以保持控制。

cards.audioText: Under what weather conditions are microbursts most likely to occur?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些天气条件下最容易出现微下击暴流？
cards.referenceText: Microbursts are most likely in severe convective weather, especially beneath intense thunderstorms or cumulonimbus clouds and near heavy rain showers. These conditions can produce strong downdrafts and wind shear.
cards.referenceTextZh: 微下击暴流最容易发生在强对流天气中，尤其是强雷暴或积雨云下方以及强阵雨附近。这些条件会产生强烈下沉气流和风切变。

cards.audioText: What could happen if an aircraft flew through a microburst?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果飞机穿越微下击暴流，可能会发生什么？
cards.referenceText: As the aircraft approaches the microburst, a strong headwind may increase its airspeed and lift. Inside it, a severe downdraft can cause rapid altitude loss. On exit, a strong tailwind may reduce airspeed and lift, possibly leading to a stall or loss of control.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机接近微下击暴流时，强顶风可能使空速和升力增大。进入内部后，强烈下沉气流会造成高度迅速损失。离开时，强顺风可能使空速和升力减小，并可能导致失速或失去控制。

cards.audioText: What factors would you consider if you encountered heavy rain during approach?
cards.audioTextZh: 进近过程中遇到大雨时，你会考虑哪些因素？
cards.referenceText: I would consider the reduced visibility, engine performance, runway condition, and reported braking action. I would also assess the risk of a runway overrun on a wet surface. If I did not have the required visual reference at the minimum, I would go around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会考虑能见度降低、发动机性能、跑道状况和报告的制动作用，也会评估湿跑道冲出风险。如果在最低标准处没有取得所需目视参考，我会复飞。

cards.audioText: Have you ever flown in heavy rain?
cards.audioTextZh: 你曾在大雨中飞行过吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I have flown through heavy rain during an approach. I used the windshield wipers, monitored visibility and runway braking action, and adjusted the approach speed in accordance with the procedure. Although visibility was reduced and the landing distance increased, I maintained a stable approach and landed safely.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我曾在进近期间穿过强降雨。我使用风挡雨刷，监控能见度和跑道制动作用，并按照程序调整进近速度。虽然能见度降低、着陆距离增加，我仍保持稳定进近并安全着陆。

cards.audioText: How can heavy rain affect a flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 大雨会如何影响飞行？
cards.referenceText: Heavy rain can reduce visibility and obscure the windshield. It can reduce runway braking action and increase the risk of an overrun or runway excursion. It may also affect engine performance and aircraft stability during approach.
cards.referenceTextZh: 强降雨会降低能见度并遮蔽风挡，降低跑道制动作用，并增加冲出或偏出跑道的风险。它还可能影响进近期间的发动机性能和飞机稳定性。

cards.audioText: How do you analyze weather conditions before a flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行前你如何分析天气状况？
cards.referenceText: I collect weather information from dispatch, ATIS, and ATC. I analyze hazards such as thunderstorms, wind shear, icing, and low visibility, and discuss them with the crew during the preflight briefing. If necessary, I adjust the flight plan or select a more suitable alternate airport or runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会从签派、自动终端情报服务和空中交通管制获取气象信息。我会分析雷暴、风切变、结冰和低能见度等危险，并在飞行前简令中与机组讨论。必要时，我会调整飞行计划，或选择更合适的备降机场或跑道。

cards.audioText: Why is understanding adverse weather important for flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么了解不利天气对飞行安全很重要？
cards.referenceText: Understanding adverse weather helps pilots recognize and avoid serious threats such as thunderstorms, lightning, icing, and wind shear. For example, ice can block a pitot tube, create abnormal indications, reduce lift, and increase drag. Knowing these effects supports safer planning and avoidance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 了解不利天气有助于飞行员识别和避开雷暴、雷击、结冰和风切变等严重威胁。例如，结冰可能堵塞空速管、造成异常指示、减小升力并增大阻力。掌握这些影响有助于更安全地进行计划和规避。

cards.audioText: How can adverse weather conditions other than cumulonimbus clouds and turbulence affect flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 除积雨云和颠簸外，其他不利天气条件会如何影响飞行安全？
cards.referenceText: Wind shear and microbursts can cause sudden changes in airspeed or altitude and make the aircraft difficult to control. Icing reduces lift and increases drag, while a strong crosswind can make runway alignment difficult. Lightning may damage aircraft systems, and low visibility can increase navigation, runway-incursion, and ground-collision risks.
cards.referenceTextZh: 风切变和微下击暴流会使空速或高度突然变化，令飞机难以操纵。结冰会减小升力并增大阻力，强侧风则会增加保持跑道对正的难度。雷击可能损坏飞机系统，低能见度会增加导航、跑道侵入和地面碰撞的风险。

cards.audioText: How can strong winds affect an aircraft during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中，强风会如何影响飞机？
cards.referenceText: Strong winds can affect fuel use and landing distance. Crosswinds can make it difficult to maintain runway alignment, while wind shear can cause sudden changes in airspeed and altitude and make control more difficult. The crew may need to adjust the flight path and aircraft attitude to manage these effects.
cards.referenceTextZh: 强风会影响燃油消耗和着陆距离。侧风会增加保持跑道对正的难度，风切变则可能造成空速和高度突然变化，使飞机更难操纵。机组可能需要调整飞行轨迹和飞机姿态来应对这些影响。

cards.audioText: Which weather condition do you consider the greatest threat to flight safety, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为哪种天气条件对飞行安全威胁最大？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I consider a severe thunderstorm with cumulonimbus clouds to be the greatest weather threat. It can combine lightning, severe turbulence, icing, hail, and wind shear. Together, these hazards can damage the aircraft, cause system failures, and make control difficult.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为伴有积雨云的强雷暴是最大的天气威胁。它可能同时带来雷电、严重颠簸、结冰、冰雹和风切变。这些危险共同作用时可能损坏飞机、导致系统失效，并使飞机难以操纵。

cards.audioText: What measures can reduce the risk of incidents caused by hazardous weather?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些措施可以降低危险天气引发不安全事件的风险？
cards.referenceText: The crew should complete a thorough preflight weather analysis, make contingency plans, and assign clear monitoring duties. During flight, they should obtain current reports and use available weather-detection equipment. If hazardous weather affects the route or airport, they may delay, change the runway or level, deviate, hold, or divert as appropriate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机组应在飞行前全面分析天气，制定备选方案，并明确分配监控职责。飞行中，他们应获取最新报告，并使用可用的气象探测设备。如果危险天气影响航路或机场，可视情况延误、改变跑道或高度层、绕飞、等待或备降。

cards.audioText: Where do pilots obtain weather information before departure?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员在起飞前从哪里获取天气信息？
cards.referenceText: Pilots obtain weather information from ATIS broadcasts, ATC briefings, METARs, pilot reports, and the dispatch office. They review conditions at the departure airport, along the route, and at the destination.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员通过自动终端情报服务广播、空中交通管制简令、机场例行天气报告、驾驶员报告和签派室获取气象信息。他们会查看起飞机场、航路沿线和目的地的天气状况。

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered severe weather during a flight? If so, what happened?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行中遇到过恶劣天气吗？如果遇到过，当时发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: No, I have not encountered severe weather during an actual flight. I have studied these hazards and practised weather-avoidance decisions during training. The exercises taught me to obtain current weather information, avoid hazardous areas, maintain control, and change the route or landing plan when necessary.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，我在实际飞行中没有遇到过严重天气。我学习过这些危险，并在训练中练习了天气规避决策。这些练习教会我获取最新气象信息、避开危险区域、保持飞机控制，并在必要时改变航路或着陆计划。

cards.audioText: What is air density in simple terms?
cards.audioTextZh: 简单来说，什么是空气密度？
cards.referenceText: Air density is the mass of air in a given volume. In simple terms, it describes how thick or thin the air is.
cards.referenceTextZh: 空气密度是一定体积内空气的质量。简单来说，它描述了空气的稠密或稀薄程度。

cards.audioText: Why is air density so important for aircraft performance?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么空气密度对飞机性能如此重要？
cards.referenceText: Air density affects how much lift the wings can produce and how much power the engine can develop. Higher-density air generally supports better lift and engine performance, while lower-density air reduces performance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 空气密度会影响机翼能够产生的升力和发动机能够产生的功率。密度较高的空气通常有利于获得更好的升力和发动机性能，密度较低的空气则会降低性能。

cards.audioText: What are the three main factors that affect air density?
cards.audioTextZh: 影响空气密度的三个主要因素是什么？
cards.referenceText: The three main factors are altitude, temperature, and humidity. Air density decreases as altitude, temperature, or humidity increases.
cards.referenceTextZh: 三个主要因素是高度、温度和湿度。随着高度、温度或湿度升高，空气密度会降低。

cards.audioText: How does altitude affect air density and aircraft performance?
cards.audioTextZh: 高度如何影响空气密度和飞机性能？
cards.referenceText: As altitude increases, air pressure and density decrease. The engine generally produces less power and the wings generate less lift under the same conditions. This can increase takeoff distance and reduce the rate of climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 随着高度增加，气压和空气密度都会降低。在其他条件相同的情况下，发动机产生的功率通常会减小，机翼产生的升力也会减少。这会增加起飞距离，并降低爬升率。

cards.audioText: How does temperature affect air density?
cards.audioTextZh: 温度如何影响空气密度？
cards.referenceText: As temperature rises, air expands and its molecules spread farther apart. There are then fewer air molecules in a given volume, so air density decreases.
cards.referenceTextZh: 温度升高时，空气会膨胀，空气分子之间的距离增大。一定体积内的空气分子随之减少，因此空气密度会降低。

cards.audioText: How does increasing humidity affect air density, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 湿度增加会如何影响空气密度？为什么？
cards.referenceText: Increasing humidity reduces air density. Water vapor is lighter than the nitrogen and oxygen in dry air, so adding water vapor replaces some heavier air molecules and makes the air less dense.
cards.referenceTextZh: 湿度增加会降低空气密度。水蒸气比干燥空气中的氮气和氧气轻，因此加入水蒸气会取代一部分较重的空气分子，使空气密度降低。

cards.audioText: What does high density altitude mean?
cards.audioTextZh: 高密度高度意味着什么？
cards.referenceText: High density altitude means that the air density is low and the aircraft performs as if it were at a higher altitude. High temperature, high elevation, and high humidity can contribute to it. The result is reduced aircraft performance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 高密度高度意味着空气密度较低，飞机的性能表现如同处在更高的高度。高温、高海拔和高湿度都会导致密度高度升高，其结果是飞机性能下降。

cards.audioText: What performance problems might occur during takeoff in low-density conditions?
cards.audioTextZh: 在低空气密度条件下起飞时，可能出现哪些性能问题？
cards.referenceText: Low-density conditions can produce a longer takeoff roll because the wings need more speed to generate enough lift. The aircraft may also have a weaker rate of climb, which can be critical when there are obstacles beyond the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在低密度条件下，机翼需要更高的速度才能产生足够升力，因此起飞滑跑距离可能更长。飞机的爬升率也可能降低，当跑道外存在障碍物时，这会成为关键问题。

cards.audioText: How can a pilot compensate for the effects of low air density?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员如何补偿低空气密度带来的影响？
cards.referenceText: The pilot should calculate takeoff performance from the aircraft manual using the actual temperature, pressure, and runway length. If the calculation requires it, the takeoff weight can be reduced by carrying less payload. A longer runway may also be selected when available, and the pilot should allow for reduced climb performance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员应根据实际温度、气压和跑道长度，使用飞机手册计算起飞性能。如果计算结果有要求，可以通过减少业载来降低起飞重量。在条件允许时也可选择更长的跑道，并应考虑爬升性能下降的影响。

cards.audioText: Can you describe a dangerous situation that could result from ignoring the effects of low air density?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能描述一种忽视低空气密度影响可能造成的危险情况吗？
cards.referenceText: A pilot might attempt to take off from a mountain airport on a hot afternoon without completing the performance calculations. The aircraft could use most of the runway and then struggle to lift off or climb. It could strike obstacles beyond the runway and cause an accident.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员可能在炎热的下午试图从山区机场起飞，却没有完成性能计算。飞机可能用掉大部分跑道后仍难以离地或爬升，进而撞上跑道外的障碍物并造成事故。

cards.audioText: What factors should pilots consider during winter operations?
cards.audioTextZh: 冬季运行中，飞行员应考虑哪些因素？
cards.referenceText: Pilots should review the weather for icing conditions along the planned route. Before takeoff, they must make sure that ice has not accumulated on the aircraft and arrange deicing when required. They should also consider that runway braking action may be poor.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员应查看计划航路沿线是否存在结冰天气。起飞前，必须确保飞机没有积冰，并在需要时安排除冰。他们还应考虑跑道刹车效应可能较差。

cards.audioText: What hazards can pilots face during summer operations?
cards.audioTextZh: 夏季运行中，飞行员可能面临哪些危险？
cards.referenceText: Summer operations can expose pilots to thunderstorms, heavy rain, and lightning.
cards.referenceTextZh: 夏季运行可能使飞行员面临雷暴、大雨和雷电。

cards.audioText: What emergency equipment is available in the cockpit of the aircraft you fly?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所飞飞机的驾驶舱内配备了哪些应急设备？
cards.referenceText: The example DA-40 I use for training carries a portable fire extinguisher within reach of the pilots and the emergency equipment required by its approved equipment list. It does not have transport-aircraft equipment such as quick-donning masks, protective breathing equipment, or escape ropes. Before flight, I verify the equipment actually installed and required for the planned operation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我用于训练的示例 DA-40 在飞行员触手可及的位置配有便携式灭火器，并携带其批准设备清单规定的应急设备。它没有快戴式面罩、防护式呼吸设备或逃生绳等运输机设备。飞行前，我会核实飞机实际安装的设备以及本次运行所需的设备。

cards.audioText: Does the aircraft type you fly have evacuation slides? If so, where are they located?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所飞的机型配有撤离滑梯吗？如果有，安装在哪里？
cards.referenceText: No. I fly a DA-40 for flight training, and it does not have evacuation slides.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有。我使用 DA-40 进行飞行训练，这种飞机没有撤离滑梯。

cards.audioText: How many evacuation slides are installed on the aircraft type you fly?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所飞的机型安装了多少个撤离滑梯？
cards.referenceText: I fly the C172, which has no evacuation slides.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我飞的是 C172，这种飞机没有撤离滑梯。

cards.audioText: Under what circumstances should evacuation slides be used?
cards.audioTextZh: 在什么情况下应使用撤离滑梯？
cards.referenceText: Evacuation slides should be deployed when an emergency evacuation is required, for example because of a bomb on board, an engine fire, or smoke in the cabin.
cards.referenceTextZh: 需要紧急撤离时应放出撤离滑梯，例如机上有炸弹、发动机起火或客舱出现烟雾。

cards.audioText: Have you ever heard of an evacuation slide being deployed accidentally during ground operations?
cards.audioTextZh: 你听说过地面运行期间撤离滑梯意外释放的情况吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes. I heard about a passenger opening an overwing emergency exit on the ground, which caused the slide to deploy.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的。我听说过一名旅客在地面打开翼上应急出口，导致滑梯放出的事件。

cards.audioText: Why are pilots required to be familiar with emergency equipment?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么要求飞行员熟悉应急设备？
cards.referenceText: Pilots need to know the location and function of emergency equipment so they can use it quickly and correctly during an emergency.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员需要了解应急设备的位置和功能，以便在紧急情况下快速、正确地使用。

cards.audioText: How easy is the emergency equipment on your aircraft to use?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所飞飞机上的应急设备是否容易使用？
cards.referenceText: The emergency equipment on my aircraft is designed to be easy to reach and convenient to use. It includes fire extinguishers, oxygen masks, a flashlight, a first-aid kit, and life vests.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我所飞机型的应急设备设计得便于接近和使用，包括灭火器、氧气面罩、手电筒、急救箱和救生衣。

cards.audioText: What functions do evacuation slides serve?
cards.audioTextZh: 撤离滑梯有哪些用途？
cards.referenceText: Evacuation slides help people on board leave the aircraft as quickly as possible during an evacuation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 撤离滑梯可以帮助机上人员在撤离时尽快离开飞机。

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered an emergency, urgency, or distress situation during a flight? If so, what happened?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行中遇到过应急、紧急或遇险情况吗？如果遇到过，当时发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: No, I have never encountered an emergency, urgency, or distress situation during a flight. However, I have practised responses to engine failure, depressurization, and turbulence in simulator training, using SOPs and checklists.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，我在飞行中从未遇到过紧急、紧迫或遇险情况。不过，我在模拟机训练中按照标准操作程序和检查单练习过发动机失效、失压和颠簸的处置。

cards.audioText: What assistance might a flight crew need from ATC or ground personnel during an emergency?
cards.audioTextZh: 紧急情况下，机组可能需要 ATC 或地面人员提供哪些协助？
cards.referenceText: The crew may need ATC to coordinate a priority landing and the necessary airspace and to provide updated weather information. ATC or ground personnel may also arrange fire, rescue, medical, and airport police services.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机组可能需要空中交通管制协调优先着陆和所需空域，并提供最新天气信息。空中交通管制或地面人员还可以安排消防、救援、医疗和机场公安等服务。

cards.audioText: When is an emergency descent necessary?
cards.audioTextZh: 何时需要实施紧急下降？
cards.referenceText: An emergency descent may be necessary after a decompression or a pressurization-system failure. It may also be needed when there is uncontrollable smoke or fire in flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 发生失压或增压系统故障后，可能需要紧急下降。飞行中出现无法控制的烟雾或火灾时，也可能需要这样做。

cards.audioText: What procedures should a pilot follow during an emergency descent?
cards.audioTextZh: 紧急下降过程中，飞行员应遵循哪些程序？
cards.referenceText: The pilot should put on an oxygen mask, notify the crew and passengers, complete the recall items, and follow the aircraft's emergency descent profile. The pilot should monitor the instruments and communicate with the crew. If time permits, the pilot should advise ATC of the situation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员应戴上氧气面罩，通知机组和旅客，完成记忆项目，并按照该机型的紧急下降剖面操作。飞行员应监控仪表并与机组沟通。如果时间允许，还应向空中交通管制报告情况。

cards.audioText: What assistance can ATC provide during an emergency descent?
cards.audioTextZh: ATC 在紧急下降过程中可以提供哪些协助？
cards.referenceText: ATC can issue the necessary clearance, advise other aircraft that an emergency descent is in progress, and help provide separation. It can also provide information about the flight conditions and the en-route minimum altitude.
cards.referenceTextZh: 空中交通管制可以发布必要的许可，通知其他飞机正在进行紧急下降，并协助提供间隔。它还可以提供飞行条件和航路最低高度等信息。

cards.audioText: What can cause an aircraft to make a belly landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些情况会导致飞机进行机腹着陆？
cards.referenceText: A belly landing may be necessary if the pilot forgets to extend the landing gear or if a mechanical problem prevents the gear from extending.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果飞行员忘记放起落架，或机械故障使起落架无法放下，可能需要进行机腹着陆。

cards.audioText: How should a flight crew prepare for a belly landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 机组应如何为机腹着陆做准备？
cards.referenceText: The crew should inform ATC and request fire and medical services. The cabin crew should prepare the passengers to fasten their seat belts, brace for impact, and be ready for evacuation. The passengers should remain calm and follow the cabin crew's instructions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机组应通知空中交通管制并申请消防和医疗服务。客舱机组应让旅客系好安全带、采取防冲击姿势，并做好撤离准备。旅客应保持冷静并听从客舱机组指令。

cards.audioText: How dangerous is a belly landing, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 机腹着陆有多危险？为什么？
cards.referenceText: A belly landing is very dangerous because it may cause structural damage to the aircraft, start a fire, and injure people on board.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机腹着陆非常危险，因为它可能造成飞机结构损伤、引发火灾，并使机上人员受伤。

cards.audioText: What factors should a pilot consider before deciding to make a belly landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 在决定进行机腹着陆前，飞行员应考虑哪些因素？
cards.referenceText: Before deciding on a belly landing, the pilot should consider the aircraft's weight and landing speed, the weather and runway conditions, and the available ground services.
cards.referenceTextZh: 决定进行机腹着陆前，飞行员应考虑飞机重量和着陆速度、天气和跑道状况，以及可用的地面保障服务。

cards.audioText: What actions should a pilot take when carrying out a belly landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 实施机腹着陆时，飞行员应采取哪些措施？
cards.referenceText: The pilot should report the situation to ATC and request an emergency landing, fire services, and medical services. After landing, the crew should carry out an emergency evacuation if required.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员应向空中交通管制报告情况，并申请紧急着陆、消防和医疗服务。着陆后，机组应在需要时实施紧急撤离。

cards.audioText: What is the difference between an urgency situation and a distress situation?
cards.audioTextZh: 紧急情况与遇险情况有什么区别？
cards.referenceText: An urgency situation requires prompt attention but not immediate assistance, and the signal is PAN PAN. A distress situation requires immediate assistance because there is a serious threat to the aircraft or to life, and the signal is MAYDAY.
cards.referenceTextZh: 紧迫情况需要及时关注，但不需要立即援助，其信号是 PAN PAN。遇险情况表示飞机或人员生命受到严重威胁，需要立即援助，其信号是 MAYDAY。
