cards.audioTextZh: 如果可以选择，你更愿意驾驶波音还是空客飞机？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I would prefer to fly an Airbus. Its side-stick layout provides more space around the pilot's seat, which I find comfortable. I also like its fly-by-wire technology because it can reduce pilot workload.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我更愿意驾驶空客飞机。它的侧杆布局让驾驶座周围有更大的空间，我觉得很舒适。我也喜欢它的电传操纵技术，因为这项技术可以减轻飞行员的工作负荷。

cards.audioText: What general differences do pilots notice between Boeing and Airbus flight decks?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员通常会注意到波音与空客驾驶舱之间有哪些差异？
cards.referenceText: A common difference is the primary control interface. Boeing flight decks typically use control columns, while Airbus flight decks use side-sticks.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个常见区别是主要操纵装置。波音驾驶舱通常使用驾驶盘，而空客驾驶舱使用侧杆。

cards.audioText: What do you consider the main technological strengths and limitations of the aircraft type you currently fly?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为目前所飞机型的主要技术优势和局限性是什么？
cards.referenceText: I currently fly the C172. Its main strength is that it is easy to control, which makes it suitable for initial training. Its limitations include relatively modest operating altitude and endurance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我目前驾驶 C172。它的主要优点是容易操纵，因此适合初始训练。它的局限包括运行高度和续航能力相对有限。

cards.audioText: What is the passenger capacity of the aircraft type you fly?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所飞机型的载客量是多少？
cards.referenceText: I fly the C172, which can accommodate two passengers.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我飞的是 C172，它可以搭载两名乘客。

cards.audioText: Which aircraft types are operated in your company's fleet?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所在公司的机队运营哪些机型？
cards.referenceText: I am not employed by an airline, so I do not have a company fleet. My flight school operates the DA-40, which is the aircraft I currently use for training. Other aircraft may be available at the school, but I do not claim to fly them.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我没有在航空公司任职，因此没有所谓的公司机队。我的航校使用 DA-40，这也是我目前用于训练的飞机。学校可能还有其他飞机，但我不会声称自己驾驶过它们。

cards.audioText: How does the aircraft you fly now compare with the aircraft you flew during flight training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在所飞的航空器与飞行训练期间驾驶的航空器相比如何？
cards.referenceText: I am still in flight training, so the aircraft I fly now is the same DA-40 that I use for training. I like its predictable handling and modern cockpit, and it is suitable for learning normal procedures and instrument flying. I have not yet transitioned to a different aircraft type.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我仍在接受飞行训练，所以我现在驾驶的就是训练所用的 DA-40。我喜欢它稳定且易于预判的操纵特性和现代化驾驶舱，它适合学习正常程序和仪表飞行。我还没有改装到其他机型。

cards.audioText: What is your opinion of large commercial aircraft designed and manufactured in China?
cards.audioTextZh: 你如何看待中国设计和制造的大型商用飞机？
cards.referenceText: I have a positive opinion of Chinese-designed commercial aircraft such as the ARJ21 and C919. They use advanced equipment and systems designed to support safe and comfortable operations. I am proud of their development and would be interested in flying one in the future.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我对 ARJ21 和 C919 等中国设计的商用飞机持积极看法。它们采用先进的设备和系统，旨在支持安全、舒适的运行。我为它们的发展感到自豪，也有兴趣将来驾驶其中一种机型。

cards.audioText: Which aircraft type ratings have you held?
cards.audioTextZh: 你曾持有哪些航空器型别等级？
cards.referenceText: I have not held an aircraft type rating. I am still training on the DA-40 at flight school, so I do not claim an airline-aircraft qualification. I would need to complete the approved training and checks before holding any type rating.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我还没有取得任何型别等级。目前我仍在航校使用 DA-40 训练，因此不会声称自己具备航空公司飞机的资质。取得任何型别等级前，我都需要完成批准的训练和检查。

cards.audioText: What are the main systems on the aircraft type you fly?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所飞的机型有哪些主要系统？
cards.referenceText: The main systems on the aircraft I fly include the navigation, electrical, and communication systems.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我所驾驶的飞机主要系统包括导航系统、电气系统和通信系统。

cards.audioText: Would you like to work for a foreign airline, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你愿意为外国航空公司工作吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I would consider working for a foreign airline. It would allow me to experience a different aviation culture and management system, improve my cross-cultural communication, and develop my professional skills.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我会考虑到外国航空公司工作。这样可以让我体验不同的航空文化和管理体系，提高跨文化沟通能力，并发展自己的专业技能。

cards.audioText: What challenges might a pilot face when working for a foreign airline?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员为外国航空公司工作时可能面临哪些挑战？
cards.referenceText: A pilot may face language barriers when communicating with colleagues and controllers. The pilot also has to adapt to different aviation regulations, operating procedures, cultural expectations, and working rhythms. Integrating into a new team can take time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员在与同事和管制员沟通时可能遇到语言障碍，还需要适应不同的航空法规、运行程序、文化习惯和工作节奏。融入一个新团队可能需要一些时间。

cards.audioText: Which aircraft types have you flown?
cards.audioTextZh: 你飞过哪些机型？
cards.referenceText: I have flown the DA-40 during my flight training. It is the only aircraft type I claim to have flown.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我在飞行训练期间驾驶过 DA-40。这是我唯一声称驾驶过的机型。

cards.audioText: How are you today?
cards.audioTextZh: 你今天感觉怎么样？
cards.referenceText: I am doing well today, thank you for asking.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我今天状态很好，谢谢关心。

cards.audioText: What is the weather like today, and is it suitable for flying?
cards.audioTextZh: 今天天气怎么样？适合飞行吗？
cards.referenceText: The sky is clear, visibility is acceptable, and the wind is calm. There is plenty of sunshine, so it is a good day for flying.
cards.referenceTextZh: 天空晴朗，能见度可以接受，风也很小。阳光充足，因此今天很适合飞行。

cards.audioText: How did you get to the test center today?
cards.audioTextZh: 你今天是怎么到达考试中心的？
cards.referenceText: I came to the test center by subway. It was convenient and punctual, and I avoided the road traffic.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我是乘地铁到考试中心的。地铁方便准时，也让我避开了道路交通。

cards.audioText: Did you sleep well last night?
cards.audioTextZh: 你昨晚睡得好吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I slept well last night. I went to bed early so that I would have enough energy for today's test.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我昨晚睡得很好。我很早就上床休息了，以保证有足够的精力参加今天的考试。

cards.audioText: What are you going to do after this test?
cards.audioTextZh: 这次考试结束后你打算做什么？
cards.referenceText: After the test, I will review the main topics and identify the areas I need to improve. I will also continue practising spoken aviation English to prepare for future flight work.
cards.referenceTextZh: 考试后，我会复习主要话题，找出自己需要提高的方面。我也会继续练习航空英语口语，为今后的飞行工作做准备。

cards.audioText: Which part of the ICAO English test do you find most difficult, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得 ICAO 英语考试的哪个部分最难？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I find the interactive communication section the most difficult, especially when discussing complex emergency situations. It requires fluent expression, accurate aviation terminology, and a quick response to the examiner's questions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我觉得互动交流部分最难，尤其是讨论复杂紧急情况时。它要求表达流利、航空术语准确，并能迅速回答考官的问题。

cards.audioText: How many flight hours have you accumulated in total?
cards.audioTextZh: 你总共积累了多少飞行小时？
cards.referenceText: I have accumulated about 15 flight hours in total. Most of that time was gained through dual instruction on the DA-40. I am continuing to build experience as I prepare for my first solo flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我累计飞行了大约 15 小时，其中大部分是在 DA-40 上进行的带飞训练。为了准备第一次单飞，我正在继续积累经验。

cards.audioText: What does your company's logo look like?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所在公司的标志是什么样的？
cards.referenceText: I am a student pilot and have not officially joined an airline, so I do not have a company logo to describe.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我是一名学员飞行员，尚未正式加入航空公司，因此没有可以介绍的公司标志。

cards.audioText: Which airline do you work for?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在哪家航空公司工作？
cards.referenceText: I am currently a student pilot, so I have not officially joined an airline yet.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我目前是一名飞行学员，所以还没有正式加入航空公司。

cards.audioText: How many years have you worked as a pilot?
cards.audioTextZh: 你从事飞行员工作多少年了？
cards.referenceText: I have not worked as a professional pilot yet because I am still a student pilot. My aviation experience comes from flight training rather than employment. I plan to apply for a pilot position after I complete the required licences and training.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我仍是一名飞行学员，因此还没有担任过职业飞行员。我的航空经历来自飞行训练，而不是受雇工作。完成规定的执照和训练后，我计划应聘飞行员职位。

cards.audioText: How long have you worked for your current company?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在目前所在的公司工作多长时间了？
cards.referenceText: I do not have a current employer because I am still training at flight school. Therefore, I have not worked for a company as a pilot. My present focus is completing my training and building the experience needed for future employment.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我仍在航校训练，目前没有雇主。因此，我还没有在任何公司担任过飞行员。现阶段我主要专注于完成训练，并积累未来就业所需的经验。

cards.audioText: Do you like your company's logo, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢自己公司的标志吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I have not joined an airline yet, so I do not have a company logo to evaluate. I do like my flight school's logo because it is simple, easy to recognise, and represents aviation training. A good logo should be clear and professional rather than too complicated.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我还没有加入航空公司，所以没有可以评价的公司标志。我很喜欢航校的标志，因为它简洁、容易识别，也能体现飞行训练的特点。好的标志应当清晰、专业，不宜过于复杂。

cards.audioText: What is your favorite city, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢哪座城市？为什么？
cards.referenceText: My favourite city is Chengdu because it is my hometown and my family lives there. I enjoy its relaxed atmosphere, Sichuan food, and green public spaces. It also has many interesting places to visit, including the giant panda research base.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢的城市是成都，因为那里是我的家乡，我的家人也住在那里。我喜欢成都悠闲的氛围、川菜和绿意盎然的公共空间。那里还有许多有趣的景点，包括大熊猫繁育研究基地。

cards.audioText: What is the traffic like where you live now?
cards.audioTextZh: 你目前居住地的交通状况怎么样？
cards.referenceText: I currently live in Xi'an. Traffic is often busy, and there are frequent traffic jams because it is a large city.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我目前住在西安。作为一座大城市，这里的交通经常很繁忙，也时常堵车。

cards.audioText: Which do you prefer, your hometown or the city where you live now, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的家乡和目前居住的城市相比，你更喜欢哪一个？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I prefer my hometown because I grew up there and know it very well. My family still lives there, which makes it especially important to me.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我更喜欢自己的家乡，因为我在那里长大，对那里非常熟悉。我的家人现在仍住在那里，所以家乡对我格外重要。

cards.audioText: What is your hometown famous for?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的家乡因什么而闻名？
cards.referenceText: My hometown is Chengdu in Sichuan Province. It is famous for Sichuan food, especially hot pot and mapo tofu, and for attractions such as the Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我的家乡是四川省成都市。那里以川菜闻名，尤其是火锅和麻婆豆腐，还有成都大熊猫繁育研究基地等景点。

cards.audioText: What is the weather usually like in your hometown?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的家乡通常是什么天气？
cards.referenceText: The weather in my hometown is usually mild and humid. Summers are not extremely hot, winters are relatively warm, and most of the rain falls in summer and autumn.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我的家乡通常气候温和湿润。夏天不会极端炎热，冬天相对温暖，降雨大多集中在夏季和秋季。

cards.audioText: How does your hometown compare with the city where you live now?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的家乡与目前居住的城市相比如何？
cards.referenceText: My hometown is more relaxed, with a strong cultural atmosphere and a slower pace of life. The city where I live now is a busy aviation hub with a faster working rhythm and more convenient transport, especially for air travel.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我的家乡生活节奏较慢，氛围更轻松，也有浓厚的文化气息。我现在居住的城市是一座繁忙的航空枢纽，工作节奏更快，交通也更便利，尤其是航空出行。

cards.audioText: What interesting places can visitors see in your hometown?
cards.audioTextZh: 游客可以在你的家乡参观哪些有趣的地方？
cards.referenceText: Visitors can see giant pandas at the Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding. They can also visit Jinli Ancient Street to experience traditional Sichuan culture and the Dujiangyan Irrigation System to see remarkable ancient engineering.
cards.referenceTextZh: 游客可以在成都大熊猫繁育研究基地看到大熊猫。他们也可以到锦里古街体验传统四川文化，或参观都江堰水利工程，了解非凡的古代工程技术。

cards.audioText: What is your preferred mode of transportation, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢哪种交通方式？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I prefer to travel by air because it is fast and efficient, especially over long distances. It also lets me experience aviation directly.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我更喜欢乘飞机旅行，因为它快捷高效，尤其适合长途出行。乘飞机也能让我直接感受航空。

cards.audioText: Do you think owning a car is necessary in your hometown, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为在家乡拥有一辆汽车有必要吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText: It depends on a person's needs. A car is useful for families in suburban areas or people who often travel to remote places. For someone living downtown with convenient public transport, owning a car may not be necessary.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这取决于个人需求。对住在郊区的家庭或经常前往偏远地区的人来说，汽车很有用。对住在市中心且公共交通便利的人来说，可能没有必要拥有汽车。

cards.audioText: Which place abroad would you most like to visit, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最想去国外的哪个地方？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I have not travelled abroad yet, but I would most like to visit the United States. I would like to see its aviation museums and training institutions and learn more about aviation technology and training concepts.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我还没有出国旅行过，但最想去美国。我想参观那里的航空博物馆和训练机构，进一步了解航空技术和训练理念。

cards.audioText: Have you ever operated an international flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你是否曾执行过国际航班？
cards.referenceText: No, I have not operated an international flight yet. My flight experience is mainly limited to domestic training flights, although I have studied international flight operations in theory. I hope to gain experience on international routes after becoming a professional pilot.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，我还没有执行过国际航班。我的飞行经历主要是国内训练飞行，不过我在理论上学习过国际飞行运行。成为职业飞行员后，我希望能积累国际航线经验。

cards.audioText: Does your company operate any international routes?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所在公司是否运营国际航线？
cards.referenceText: I am not employed by an airline, so I do not have a company route network. My flight-school operations are domestic training flights rather than scheduled international services. I hope to gain international flying experience after completing my training and joining an airline.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我没有在航空公司任职，因此没有公司的航线网络。我的航校运行是国内训练飞行，而不是定期国际航班。完成训练并加入航空公司后，我希望能获得国际飞行经验。

cards.audioText: Do you prefer international or domestic routes, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你更喜欢国际航线还是国内航线？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I appreciate both types of route. International routes offer opportunities to experience different cultures and aviation environments, while domestic routes involve more familiar procedures. For those reasons, I do not have a strong preference.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我喜欢这两类航线。国际航线提供了体验不同文化和航空环境的机会，国内航线的运行程序则更加熟悉。因此，我没有明显的偏好。

cards.audioText: Do you prefer long-haul or short-haul routes, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你更喜欢远程航线还是短程航线？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I do not have a strong preference. Long-haul routes require good physical fitness and fatigue management, while short-haul routes require pilots to adapt to frequent takeoffs and landings. Both types of route can help a pilot improve different skills.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我没有明显的偏好。长途航线要求良好的身体素质和疲劳管理能力，短途航线则要求飞行员适应频繁的起飞和着陆。两类航线都能帮助飞行员提高不同方面的技能。

cards.audioText: What hobbies do you have?
cards.audioTextZh: 你有哪些爱好？
cards.referenceText: I enjoy reading, especially books about aviation history. It broadens my knowledge of the aviation industry.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我喜欢阅读，尤其喜欢航空史方面的书籍。这能拓宽我对航空业的了解。

cards.audioText: What do you like to do when you are not flying?
cards.audioTextZh: 不飞行时你喜欢做什么？
cards.referenceText: When I am not flying, I like to cook. Trying new recipes and preparing good meals is a relaxing way to spend my time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不飞行时，我喜欢做饭。尝试新食谱并做出可口的饭菜，是一种令人放松的休闲方式。

cards.audioText: Do you enjoy traveling?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢旅行吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I enjoy traveling.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我喜欢旅行。

cards.audioText: Have you ever traveled abroad?
cards.audioTextZh: 你出国旅行过吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I have. I have travelled to Australia, the United States, Japan, and South Africa.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我去过澳大利亚、美国、日本和南非。

cards.audioText: Do you enjoy listening to music?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢听音乐吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I enjoy listening to music.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我喜欢听音乐。

cards.audioText: Do you enjoy watching movies?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢看电影吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I enjoy watching movies because they allow me to experience different stories.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我喜欢看电影，因为电影能让我体验不同的故事。

cards.audioText: What type of movie do you like best?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢哪种类型的电影？
cards.referenceText: I do not have just one favorite type. I enjoy action films, comedies, horror films, romances, documentaries, and cartoons. For me, the quality of the movie matters more than its genre.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我并非只喜欢一种类型。我喜欢动作片、喜剧片、恐怖片、爱情片、纪录片和动画片。对我来说，电影本身的质量比类型更重要。

cards.audioText: What's your favorite movie?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢哪部电影？
cards.referenceText: My favorite movie is Sully. It tells the story of Captain Sully's successful river ditching after a bird strike. I see him as a hero.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢的电影是《萨利机长》。它讲述了萨利机长在遭遇鸟击后成功迫降河面的故事。我把他视为英雄。

cards.audioText: Who is your favorite movie star?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢的电影明星是谁？
cards.referenceText: My favorite movie star is Tom Cruise. I think he is handsome and charming, and I especially enjoy his performance in Mission: Impossible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢的电影明星是汤姆·克鲁斯。我觉得他英俊而有魅力，尤其喜欢他在《碟中谍》中的表演。

cards.audioText: Do you enjoy reading?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢阅读吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I enjoy reading.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我喜欢阅读。

cards.audioText: What is your favorite book?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢哪本书？
cards.referenceText: My favorite book is To Kill a Mockingbird because it is full of wisdom.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢的书是《杀死一只知更鸟》，因为书中充满智慧。

cards.audioText: Do you enjoy sports or outdoor activities?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢运动或户外活动吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I enjoy sports. Swimming and running are my favorites because they help me build strength.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我喜欢运动。游泳和跑步是我最喜欢的运动，因为它们能帮助我增强体质。

cards.audioText: What is your favorite sport?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢哪项运动？
cards.referenceText: Swimming and running are my favorite sports. They help me build strength.
cards.referenceTextZh: 游泳和跑步是我最喜欢的运动，它们能帮助我增强体质。

cards.audioText: How often do you play sports?
cards.audioTextZh: 你多久参加一次体育运动？
cards.referenceText: I usually play sports two or three times a week. I enjoy running and playing badminton because they improve my fitness and help me relax after studying or flight training. I reduce the intensity before an important flight so that I am properly rested.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我通常每周运动两到三次。我喜欢跑步和打羽毛球，因为这些运动既能改善体能，也能让我在学习或飞行训练后放松下来。重要飞行前，我会降低运动强度，确保自己得到充分休息。

cards.audioText: Who is your favorite athlete?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢的运动员是谁？
cards.referenceText: My favorite athlete is Kobe Bryant. I admire him very much.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢的运动员是科比·布莱恩特，我非常敬佩他。

cards.audioText: How often do you use a computer?
cards.audioTextZh: 你多久使用一次电脑？
cards.referenceText: I use a computer often.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我经常使用电脑。

cards.audioText: How have computers changed people's lives?
cards.audioTextZh: 电脑如何改变了人们的生活？
cards.referenceText: Computers have become an essential part of daily life. People now use them for work, entertainment, games, and finding information.
cards.referenceTextZh: 电脑已经成为日常生活中不可或缺的一部分。人们现在用电脑工作、娱乐、玩游戏和查找信息。

cards.audioText: What kind of music do you like best?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢哪种类型的音乐？
cards.referenceText: I like light music best. Its gentle melodies and soothing rhythms help me relax after training and concentrate while reading or thinking. Cheerful light music can also improve my mood.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢轻音乐。轻柔的旋律和舒缓的节奏能让我在训练后放松，也有助于我在阅读或思考时集中注意力。欢快的轻音乐还能改善我的心情。

cards.audioText: Who is your favorite singer?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢的歌手是谁？
cards.referenceText: My favorite singer is Jay Chou. I find his music touching and beautiful.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢的歌手是周杰伦。我觉得他的音乐动人而优美。

cards.audioText: How often do you go to the cinema?
cards.audioTextZh: 你多久去一次电影院？
cards.referenceText: I go to the cinema about twice a month.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我大约每月去电影院两次。

cards.audioText: Do you enjoy shopping online?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢网上购物吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I enjoy shopping online. I often use Taobao because many goods are affordable and delivery is fast.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我喜欢网上购物。我经常使用淘宝，因为许多商品价格实惠，而且配送很快。

cards.audioText: Which website do you visit most often, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最常访问哪个网站？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I visit Taobao most often. I use it for online shopping because many goods are affordable and delivery is fast.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最常访问淘宝。我用它进行网上购物，因为许多商品价格实惠，而且配送很快。

cards.imageAlt: 夜航驾驶舱航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What are the main hazards of flying at night?
cards.audioTextZh: 夜间飞行的主要危险有哪些？
cards.referenceText: The main hazards are reduced visibility, higher cockpit workload, spatial disorientation, and difficulty judging terrain or clouds.
cards.referenceTextZh: 主要风险包括能见度降低、驾驶舱工作负荷增大、空间定向障碍，以及难以判断地形或云层。

cards.audioText: What preparations should pilots make before a night flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员在夜间飞行前应做哪些准备？
cards.referenceText: Before a night flight, I would brief the threat, check the relevant aircraft systems and performance, coordinate with the crew and ATC, and follow the checklist. If safety were not assured, I would delay the flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 夜间飞行前，我会对相关威胁进行简令，检查飞机系统和性能，与机组及空中交通管制协调，并执行检查单。如果无法确保安全，我会推迟飞行。

cards.imageAlt: 机翼积冰航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What can you see in this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能在这张图片中看到什么？
cards.referenceText: The picture shows a large passenger aircraft parked at a snow-covered airport. Snow is lying across the apron, and the weather appears very cold. Airport buildings and other aircraft can be seen in the background.
cards.referenceTextZh: 图片中，一架大型客机停在被积雪覆盖的机场。停机坪上有积雪，天气看起来非常寒冷。背景中可以看到机场建筑和其他飞机。

cards.audioText: How can ice on a wing affect flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 机翼结冰会如何影响飞行安全？
cards.referenceText: Ice on a wing can reduce lift, increase drag, raise the stall speed, and cause possible control problems. These effects may reduce safety margins.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机翼结冰会减小升力、增大阻力、提高失速速度，并可能导致操纵问题。这些影响会降低安全裕度。

cards.audioText: What should a pilot do if ice or frost is found on the wings before departure?
cards.audioTextZh: 起飞前如果发现机翼上有冰或霜，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: I would identify the wing contamination, communicate clearly, follow the checklist, and choose the safest option according to the aircraft status and operating conditions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会识别机翼污染情况，保持清晰沟通，执行检查单，并根据飞机状态和运行条件选择最安全的方案。

cards.imageAlt: 夜间跑道起飞航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What preparations should a flight crew make before taking off at night from the runway shown?
cards.audioTextZh: 从图中所示跑道夜间起飞前，飞行机组应做哪些准备？
cards.referenceText: Before the night takeoff, I would brief the threat, check the relevant aircraft systems and performance, coordinate with the crew and ATC, and follow the checklist. If safety were not assured, I would delay or reject the takeoff.
cards.referenceTextZh: 夜间起飞前，我会对相关威胁进行简令，检查飞机系统和性能，与机组及空中交通管制协调，并执行检查单。如果无法确保安全，我会推迟起飞或中断起飞。

cards.audioText: What hazards should pilots consider when taking off at night from the runway shown?
cards.audioTextZh: 从图中所示跑道夜间起飞时，飞行员应考虑哪些危险？
cards.referenceText: At night, reduced visibility makes it harder to judge height, distance, terrain, and clouds. Spatial disorientation and higher cockpit workload can make the takeoff and departure more demanding. A thorough briefing and a careful instrument cross-check help control these risks.
cards.referenceTextZh: 夜间能见度较低，更难判断高度、距离、地形和云层。空间定向障碍和较高的驾驶舱工作负荷会使起飞和离场更具挑战。充分的简令和谨慎的仪表交叉检查有助于控制这些风险。

cards.audioText: What types of runway lighting help pilots during takeoff and landing at night?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些类型的跑道灯光可以在夜间起飞和着陆时帮助飞行员？
cards.referenceText: Approach lights and runway-end identifier lights help pilots find and align with the runway. Threshold, edge, centerline, and touchdown-zone lights show the runway's position and usable landing area. Runway-end lights and visual glide-slope indicators provide additional guidance during landing, while edge and centerline lights also support takeoff.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近灯和跑道入口识别灯帮助飞行员找到跑道并与跑道对正。入口灯、边灯、中线灯和接地区灯显示跑道位置及可用着陆区域。跑道末端灯和目视下滑指示器在着陆时提供进一步引导，而边灯和中线灯也为起飞提供支持。

cards.imageAlt: 飞机接近风险航空场景图片

cards.audioText: If you were the captain of one of these aircraft, how would you respond to the risk of a collision?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你是图中其中一架航空器的机长，你会如何应对碰撞风险？
cards.referenceText: I would recognize the risk as early as possible, maintain clear communication, and follow the standard operating procedures.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会尽早识别风险，保持清晰沟通，并遵循标准操作程序。

cards.audioText: What factors can cause aircraft to come dangerously close to each other?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些因素可能导致航空器彼此危险接近？
cards.referenceText: Possible factors include loss of separation, wake turbulence, a runway incursion, or a misunderstanding of ATC instructions. Human factors, weather, aircraft condition, the airport environment, and communication problems may also contribute.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可能的因素包括间隔丧失、尾流、跑道侵入，或对空中交通管制指令的误解。人的因素、天气、飞机状况、机场环境和通信问题也可能起到作用。

cards.imageAlt: 起落架异常航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What appears to have happened to the landing gear of the aircraft in this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 图中航空器的起落架似乎发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: The aircraft appears to be sitting unusually low, and the main landing gear area seems to be under inspection. This suggests that part of the landing gear may have collapsed or failed to support the aircraft properly. The exact fault cannot be confirmed from the picture alone.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机看起来位置异常低，主起落架区域似乎正在接受检查。这表明部分起落架可能已经坍塌，或未能正常支撑飞机。仅凭图片无法确认具体故障。

cards.audioText: What can cause an aircraft's landing gear to collapse or retract on the ground?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些因素可能导致航空器起落架在地面坍塌或收起？
cards.referenceText: A mechanical failure or a maintenance error can cause the landing gear to collapse or retract on the ground.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机械故障或维修差错可能导致起落架在地面坍塌或意外收起。

cards.audioText: What consequences can result from a landing gear collapse or retraction on the ground?
cards.audioTextZh: 起落架在地面坍塌或收起可能造成哪些后果？
cards.referenceText: A landing gear collapse or retraction on the ground can cause serious structural damage.
cards.referenceTextZh: 起落架在地面坍塌或收起可能造成严重的结构损伤。

cards.imageAlt: 冬季起飞前运行航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What pre-takeoff preparations should a flight crew make in the winter conditions shown?
cards.audioTextZh: 在图中所示的冬季条件下起飞前，飞行机组应做哪些准备？
cards.referenceText: I would brief the winter-weather threat, check the relevant aircraft systems and performance, coordinate with the crew and ATC, and follow the checklist. If safety were not assured, I would delay or reject the takeoff.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会对冬季天气威胁进行简令，检查相关飞机系统和性能，与机组及空中交通管制协调，并执行检查单。如果无法确保安全，我会推迟起飞或中断起飞。

cards.audioText: What challenges do pilots face when operating in the winter weather shown?
cards.audioTextZh: 在图中所示的冬季天气下运行时，飞行员会面临哪些挑战？
cards.referenceText: The main challenges are contaminated surfaces, low visibility, reduced braking action, and de-icing requirements.
cards.referenceTextZh: 主要挑战包括道面污染、低能见度、制动作用降低，以及除冰要求。

cards.imageAlt: 高高原机场航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What is meant by a high-altitude airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么是高海拔机场？
cards.referenceText: A high-altitude airport is located at a high elevation above sea level. Because the air is thinner, aircraft performance, approach planning, and landing distance must be checked carefully.
cards.referenceTextZh: 高海拔机场位于海拔较高的位置。由于空气较稀薄，必须仔细检查飞机性能、进近计划和着陆距离。

cards.audioText: If you had to land at the high-altitude airport shown, how would you prepare for a safe arrival?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果必须在图中所示的高海拔机场着陆，你会如何为安全到达做准备？
cards.referenceText: Because the air is thinner at a high-altitude airport, I would check the aircraft performance, approach planning, and landing distance very carefully before arrival.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于高海拔机场空气较稀薄，我会在到达前非常仔细地检查飞机性能、进近计划和着陆距离。

cards.audioText: What challenges do pilots face when operating at high-altitude airports?
cards.audioTextZh: 在高海拔机场运行时，飞行员会面临哪些挑战？
cards.referenceText: Pilots face thin air, longer landing distances, reduced engine performance, and terrain restrictions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员面临的挑战包括空气稀薄、着陆距离增加、发动机性能下降和地形限制。

cards.imageAlt: 模拟机训练航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What can you see in the simulator training scene shown in this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能从图中的模拟机训练场景中看到什么？
cards.referenceText: I can see two pilots seated in a full-flight simulator. The cockpit has realistic flight instruments, controls, and outside visual displays. They appear to be practising normal or abnormal procedures in a controlled training environment.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我看到两名飞行员坐在全动飞行模拟机内。驾驶舱配有逼真的飞行仪表、操纵装置和外部视景显示。他们似乎正在受控的训练环境中练习正常或非正常程序。

cards.audioText: What are the benefits of simulator training?
cards.audioTextZh: 模拟机训练有哪些好处？
cards.referenceText: Simulator training can improve situational awareness. It gives pilots clearer information, supports better monitoring, and gives them more time to make safe decisions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 模拟机训练可以提高情景意识。它能为飞行员提供更清晰的信息，帮助他们更好地监控，并留出更多时间作出安全决策。

cards.imageAlt: 传统仪表驾驶舱航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What are the main differences between a cockpit with traditional flight instruments and a modern glass cockpit?
cards.audioTextZh: 采用传统飞行仪表的驾驶舱与现代玻璃驾驶舱有哪些主要区别？
cards.referenceText: Compared with traditional flight instruments, a modern glass cockpit gives pilots clearer information, supports better monitoring, and provides more time to make safe decisions. This can improve situational awareness.
cards.referenceTextZh: 与传统飞行仪表相比，现代玻璃驾驶舱能向飞行员提供更清晰的信息，帮助他们更好地监控，并留出更多时间作出安全决策。这有助于提高情景意识。

cards.audioText: What challenges do pilots face when flying an aircraft with traditional flight instruments?
cards.audioTextZh: 驾驶采用传统飞行仪表的航空器时，飞行员会面临哪些挑战？
cards.referenceText: Traditional flight instruments can create a higher scan workload, provide less integrated information, and require more manual cross-checking.
cards.referenceTextZh: 传统飞行仪表可能增加仪表扫描工作量，提供的综合信息较少，并要求飞行员进行更多人工交叉检查。

cards.imageAlt: 发动机整流罩损伤航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What damage can you see on the aircraft in this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 这张图片中的飞机有哪些损伤？
cards.referenceText: The cowling around one engine is open or partly missing, and internal components are exposed. The nacelle area appears to be damaged. The picture does not provide enough detail to determine the cause or the full extent of the damage.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一台发动机周围的整流罩已经打开或部分缺失，内部部件暴露在外。短舱区域看起来已经受损。图片细节不足，无法判断损伤原因和完整范围。

cards.audioText: What actions should a pilot take if engine cowling damage occurs during cruise?
cards.audioTextZh: 巡航过程中如果发动机整流罩发生损坏，飞行员应采取哪些措施？
cards.referenceText: I would monitor the aircraft carefully for engine vibration, possible debris, performance loss, or further structural damage. I would be ready to take conservative action if these risks reduced the safety margin.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会密切监控飞机，注意发动机振动、可能的碎片、性能下降或进一步的结构损伤。如果这些风险降低了安全裕度，我会准备采取保守措施。

cards.audioText: What inspections should be performed to help prevent engine cowling failures?
cards.audioTextZh: 应进行哪些检查，以帮助防止发动机整流罩失效？
cards.referenceText: The preflight inspection should check that every cowling panel is correctly seated and that all latches and fasteners are secure. Maintenance inspections should look for worn hinges, damaged fasteners, cracks, distortion, and previous repairs. After maintenance work, the cowling should be closed, documented, and independently checked as required.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行前检查应确认每块整流罩面板都正确就位，所有锁扣和紧固件均已固定。维修检查应查找铰链磨损、紧固件损坏、裂纹、变形和既往修理痕迹。维修工作完成后，应按要求关闭整流罩、做好记录并进行独立复查。

cards.imageAlt: 尾部发动机火警航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What can you see in this picture of a tail-mounted engine fire?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能从这张尾置发动机起火的图片中看到什么？
cards.referenceText: The picture shows flames and dark smoke coming from the rear engine of a three-engine aircraft. The fire appears to be concentrated around the tail-mounted engine. The exact cause of the fire is not visible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 图片中，一架三发飞机的后部发动机冒出火焰和浓烟。火势似乎集中在尾置发动机周围。图片无法显示起火的确切原因。

cards.audioText: What risks can a fire in a tail-mounted engine pose to an aircraft and its occupants?
cards.audioTextZh: 尾置发动机起火会给航空器及其乘员带来哪些风险？
cards.referenceText: The main risks are smoke, fire spreading, system damage, passenger panic, and a possible evacuation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 主要风险包括烟雾、火势蔓延、系统损坏、旅客恐慌，以及可能需要撤离。

cards.audioText: As the pilot in command, how would you respond to the tail-mounted engine fire shown in this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 作为机长，你会如何处置图中所示的尾置发动机起火？
cards.referenceText: For the tail-mounted engine fire, I would check the relevant aircraft systems and performance, coordinate with the crew and ATC, and follow the checklist. If safety were not assured, I would divert as appropriate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 对于尾置发动机起火，我会检查相关飞机系统和性能，与机组及空中交通管制协调，并执行检查单。如果无法确保安全，我会视情况改航。

cards.audioText: What measures can help reduce the risk of an in-flight engine fire?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些措施可以降低发动机在飞行中起火的风险？
cards.referenceText: Regular maintenance should detect fuel, oil, and hydraulic leaks and any damage to engine wiring or hot sections. Crews should complete careful preflight inspections, monitor engine indications, and respond promptly to abnormal temperatures, vibration, or warning messages. Good FOD control and correct engine-start procedures also reduce the risk.
cards.referenceTextZh: 定期维修应发现燃油、滑油和液压油泄漏，以及发动机线路或高温部件的损伤。机组应认真完成飞行前检查，监控发动机指示，并及时处置温度异常、振动或警告信息。良好的外来物管理和正确的发动机起动程序也能降低风险。

cards.imageAlt: 滑行道起飞排队航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What can you see in the aircraft queue shown in this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能从图中的航空器排队场景中看到什么？
cards.referenceText: Several passenger aircraft are lined up one behind another on a taxiway or apron. Their noses point in the same direction, and the aircraft are fairly close together. The picture clearly shows a queue, but it does not show why the queue has formed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 数架客机在滑行道或机坪上首尾排成一列，机头朝向相同，飞机之间距离较近。图片清楚显示飞机正在排队，但没有显示排队原因。

cards.audioText: What can cause aircraft to queue on a taxiway before takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些因素可能导致航空器起飞前在滑行道上排队等候？
cards.referenceText: Possible contributors to taxiway congestion include human factors, weather, aircraft condition, the airport environment, and communication problems.
cards.referenceTextZh: 造成滑行道拥堵的因素可能包括人为因素、天气、飞机状况、机场环境和通信问题。

cards.audioText: What risks can arise when aircraft wait on the ground for an extended period before takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 航空器在起飞前长时间停留在地面可能产生哪些风险？
cards.referenceText: A long ground wait can increase fuel burn, brake heating, congestion, exposure to foreign object debris, and crew workload. These risks can reduce safety margins.
cards.referenceTextZh: 长时间地面等待会增加燃油消耗、刹车温度、拥堵、外来物暴露和机组工作负荷。这些风险可能降低安全裕度。

cards.audioText: How can long ground queues before takeoff be managed or reduced?
cards.audioTextZh: 如何管理或减少起飞前的长时间地面排队？
cards.referenceText: Airports and ATC can reduce queues through better departure sequencing, traffic-flow planning, and timely information about restrictions. Airlines can hold an aircraft at the gate or delay engine start when a long wait is expected. During a queue, the crew should monitor fuel, brake temperature, weather, and duty time and coordinate any change of plan.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机场和空中交通管制可以通过优化离场排序、流量规划，并及时提供限制信息来减少排队。航空公司预计等待时间较长时，可以让飞机留在登机口或推迟起动发动机。排队期间，机组应监控燃油、刹车温度、天气和值勤时间，并协调任何计划变更。

cards.imageAlt: 外来物损伤航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What is foreign object debris (FOD), and why is it hazardous?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么是外来物（FOD）？它为什么危险？
cards.referenceText: FOD means foreign object debris or foreign object damage. It is hazardous because it can damage tyres, engines, and aircraft structures. Ramp inspections and runway cleaning are therefore important.
cards.referenceTextZh: FOD 指外来物碎片或外来物损伤。它会危及安全，因为可能损坏轮胎、发动机和飞机结构。因此，机坪检查和跑道清扫十分重要。

cards.audioText: What measures can reduce the risk of foreign object debris being ingested by an aircraft engine?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些措施可以降低航空器发动机吸入外来物的风险？
cards.referenceText: Airport operators should inspect and clean runways, taxiways, and aprons regularly. Airlines need good housekeeping and tool-control procedures, while crews should check the engine intake and nearby ground area during the walk-around. Pilots should also avoid using high thrust where loose debris may be drawn into an engine.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机场运营方应定期检查并清扫跑道、滑行道和机坪。航空公司需要做好现场管理和工具管控，机组则应在绕机检查时查看发动机进气口及附近地面。飞行员还应避免在松散碎片可能被吸入发动机的区域使用大推力。

cards.imageAlt: 现代玻璃驾驶舱航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What are the main advantages of a modern glass cockpit over a cockpit with traditional flight instruments?
cards.audioTextZh: 与采用传统飞行仪表的驾驶舱相比，现代玻璃驾驶舱有哪些主要优势？
cards.referenceText: A modern glass cockpit can improve situational awareness. Compared with traditional flight instruments, it gives pilots clearer information, supports better monitoring, and provides more time to make safe decisions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 现代玻璃驾驶舱可以提高情景意识。与传统飞行仪表相比，它向飞行员提供更清晰的信息，帮助他们更好地监控，并留出更多时间作出安全决策。

cards.audioText: How do multiple display screens help pilots manage a flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 多个显示屏如何帮助飞行员管理飞行？
cards.referenceText: Multiple screens can present flight, navigation, engine, system, and weather information in an organized way. They help both pilots monitor the same situation, compare information, and notice abnormal conditions quickly. Separate displays also provide useful redundancy, although the crew must still cross-check them and understand any display failure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 多个显示屏可以有序呈现飞行、导航、发动机、系统和天气信息。它们有助于两名飞行员监控同一情况、比对信息并迅速发现异常。独立显示屏还能提供一定冗余，但机组仍须交叉检查，并了解显示故障的影响。

cards.imageAlt: 强侧风着陆航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What types of aircraft damage can result from a poorly controlled landing in a strong crosswind?
cards.audioTextZh: 在强侧风中着陆控制不当可能对航空器造成哪些损伤？
cards.referenceText: A poorly controlled crosswind landing can place excessive side loads on the landing gear and damage tyres, wheels, or gear components. A hard or sideways touchdown may also damage the wing, engine nacelle, tail, or fuselage if any part strikes the runway. Severe loads can cause structural damage that requires a detailed inspection.
cards.referenceTextZh: 侧风着陆操纵不当会使起落架承受过大的侧向载荷，并损坏轮胎、机轮或起落架部件。重着陆或带侧滑接地还可能使机翼、发动机短舱、机尾或机身撞击跑道而受损。严重载荷可能造成需要详细检查的结构损伤。

cards.audioText: As captain, how would you prepare for an approach when strong crosswinds are reported?
cards.audioTextZh: 作为机长，接到强侧风报告后，你会如何为进近做准备？
cards.referenceText: Before the approach, I would brief the crosswind threat, check the relevant aircraft performance, coordinate with the crew and ATC, and follow the checklist. If safety were not assured, I would delay the approach or divert as appropriate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近前，我会对侧风威胁进行简令，检查相关飞机性能，与机组及空中交通管制协调，并执行检查单。如果无法确保安全，我会推迟进近或视情况改航。

cards.audioText: As captain, how would you manage an approach if you encountered stronger-than-expected crosswinds?
cards.audioTextZh: 作为机长，如果进近中遇到比预期更强的侧风，你会如何处置？
cards.referenceText: I would check the relevant aircraft performance, coordinate with the crew and ATC, and follow the checklist. If safety were not assured in the stronger crosswind, I would go around or divert as appropriate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会检查相关飞机性能，与机组及空中交通管制协调，并执行检查单。如果更强的侧风下无法确保安全，我会复飞或视情况改航。

cards.imageAlt: 跑道发动机火警航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What can cause an aircraft engine fire during ground operations?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些因素可能导致航空器发动机在地面运行期间起火？
cards.referenceText: Fuel leakage or overheating can cause an aircraft engine fire during ground operations.
cards.referenceTextZh: 燃油泄漏或过热可能导致飞机在地面运行期间发生发动机火灾。

cards.audioText: What risks can an engine fire during taxi pose to the aircraft and its occupants?
cards.audioTextZh: 滑行期间发动机起火会给航空器及其乘员带来哪些风险？
cards.referenceText: An engine fire during taxi may create smoke and an evacuation risk. These risks may reduce safety margins and increase crew workload.
cards.referenceTextZh: 滑行期间发动机起火可能产生烟雾，并带来撤离风险。这些风险可能降低安全裕度并增加机组工作负荷。

cards.audioText: What preflight inspections can help reduce the risk of an engine fire during ground operations?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些飞行前检查可以帮助降低发动机在地面运行期间起火的风险？
cards.referenceText: The walk-around should look for fuel, oil, or hydraulic leaks, damaged wiring, loose panels, and signs of overheating around the engine. The crew should confirm that the nacelle and cowling are secure and that the intake is clear of FOD. Required maintenance checks should also confirm that the fire-detection and extinguishing systems are serviceable.
cards.referenceTextZh: 绕机检查应查找燃油、滑油或液压油泄漏、线路损坏、面板松动，以及发动机周围的过热迹象。机组应确认短舱和整流罩固定可靠，进气口内没有外来物。规定的维修检查还应确认火警探测和灭火系统工作正常。

cards.audioText: As captain, how would you respond to an engine fire detected during takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 作为机长，起飞过程中发现发动机起火时，你会如何处置？
cards.referenceText: If the fire warning occurred before the takeoff decision speed and the aircraft could stop safely, I would reject the takeoff in accordance with the procedure. At or after the decision speed, I would continue the takeoff, maintain control, climb safely, and then complete the engine-fire memory actions and checklist. I would declare an emergency and arrange the earliest safe landing, treating a continuing fire as an immediate threat.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果火警出现在起飞决断速度之前，且飞机能够安全停下，我会按照程序中断起飞。在达到或超过决断速度后，我会继续起飞，控制好飞机并安全爬升，然后完成发动机火警记忆项目和检查单。我会宣布紧急状态并安排尽早安全着陆，把持续燃烧的火情视为直接威胁。

cards.imageAlt: 水上迫降航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What types of serious failures could make it necessary for a large passenger aircraft to ditch at sea?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些严重故障可能使大型客机必须在海上迫降？
cards.referenceText: A ditching may become necessary after a total or major loss of engine thrust when no runway is within reach. Other possible reasons include an uncontrollable fire, fuel exhaustion, severe structural or flight-control damage, or the loss of essential systems. The crew would consider ditching only when continued flight or a safe landing on land was no longer possible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当发动机推力全部或大部分丧失，且没有可到达的跑道时，可能需要水上迫降。其他可能原因包括无法控制的火灾、燃油耗尽、严重的结构或飞行操纵损伤，以及关键系统丧失。只有在无法继续飞行或无法在陆地安全着陆时，机组才会考虑水上迫降。

cards.audioText: As captain, how would you manage a total loss of engine power over water if ditching became unavoidable?
cards.audioTextZh: 作为机长，如果航空器在水域上空丧失全部发动机动力且水上迫降已无法避免，你会如何处置？
cards.referenceText: I would brief the threat, check the relevant aircraft systems and performance, coordinate with the crew and ATC, and follow the checklist.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会对相关威胁进行简令，检查飞机系统和性能，与机组及空中交通管制协调，并执行检查单。

cards.audioText: What should the flight crew do to evacuate an aircraft after a ditching?
cards.audioTextZh: 水上迫降后，飞行机组应如何组织人员撤离航空器？
cards.referenceText: After the aircraft stops, the pilots should secure it as required and order an evacuation if remaining on board is unsafe. The crew should use only exits that are above the water and free from hazards, deploy the available slide-rafts or life rafts, and direct occupants to leave baggage behind. Everyone should move into the rafts, stay together, and use the survival and signalling equipment.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机停止后，飞行员应按要求使飞机处于安全状态；如果留在机上不安全，就下令撤离。机组应只使用位于水面以上且没有危险的出口，展开可用的滑梯救生筏或救生筏，并指挥人员不要携带行李。所有人应进入救生筏、保持在一起，并使用救生和信号设备。

cards.imageAlt: 擦尾风险航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What can you see in this picture of an apparent tail-strike event?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能从这张疑似擦机尾事件的图片中看到什么？
cards.referenceText: The aircraft is rotating for takeoff with a high nose-up attitude. Its rear fuselage appears to be contacting or scraping the runway. This is consistent with a tail strike, although the amount of damage cannot be judged from the picture.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机正以较大的机头上仰姿态抬轮起飞，其后机身似乎正在接触或擦碰跑道。这与擦尾现象相符，但无法从图片判断损伤程度。

cards.audioText: How can takeoff weight affect the risk of a tail strike?
cards.audioTextZh: 起飞重量会如何影响擦机尾风险？
cards.referenceText: High takeoff weight is one factor that can increase the risk of a tail strike.
cards.referenceTextZh: 较大的起飞重量是可能增加擦尾风险的因素之一。

cards.audioText: How can a flight crew reduce the risk of a tail strike?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行机组如何降低擦机尾风险？
cards.referenceText: The crew should brief the tail-strike threat, check the relevant aircraft performance, coordinate clearly, and follow the checklist. If safety were not assured, the takeoff should be delayed or rejected.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机组应对擦尾威胁进行简令，检查相关飞机性能，保持清晰协调，并执行检查单。如果无法确保安全，应推迟起飞或中断起飞。

cards.imageAlt: 地面保障事故航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What factors may have contributed to the ground-handling accident shown in this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些因素可能促成图中所示的地面作业事故？
cards.referenceText: The aircraft appears to have collided with ground equipment near its forward fuselage. Possible contributing factors include poor communication, inadequate clearance, incorrect positioning, or a loss of control during towing or pushback. The picture alone cannot establish the exact cause.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机的前机身附近似乎与地面设备发生碰撞。可能的促成因素包括沟通不畅、间距不足、位置错误，或牵引、推出时失去控制。仅凭图片无法确定确切原因。

cards.audioText: How can ground-handling accidents involving aircraft be prevented?
cards.audioTextZh: 如何预防涉及航空器的地面作业事故？
cards.referenceText: The crew should recognize ground-handling risks early, maintain clear communication, and follow the standard operating procedures.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机组应尽早识别地面保障风险，保持清晰沟通，并遵循标准操作程序。

cards.imageAlt: 积雪和结冰污染航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What risks can snow and ice contamination on an aircraft pose to flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 航空器上的冰雪污染会给飞行安全带来哪些风险？
cards.referenceText: Snow and ice contamination can reduce lift and increase drag. It may also lead to inaccurate airspeed indications and possible control difficulty. These effects may reduce safety margins and increase crew workload.
cards.referenceTextZh: 冰雪污染会减小升力并增大阻力，还可能导致空速指示不准确和操纵困难。这些影响可能降低安全裕度并增加机组工作负荷。

cards.audioText: How can ice contamination on a wing affect aircraft performance and handling?
cards.audioTextZh: 机翼结冰污染会如何影响航空器性能和操纵特性？
cards.referenceText: Ice contamination changes the wing shape, reducing lift and increasing drag. It can raise the stall speed, reduce climb performance, and cause the wing to stall earlier and less predictably. It may also reduce control effectiveness and make the aircraft difficult to handle.
cards.referenceTextZh: 冰污染会改变机翼外形，使升力减小、阻力增大。它会提高失速速度、降低爬升性能，并使机翼更早且更难预测地失速。它还可能降低操纵效能，使飞机难以操纵。

cards.audioText: What should pilots do if snow or ice is found on critical aircraft surfaces before departure?
cards.audioTextZh: 起飞前发现航空器关键表面有冰雪时，飞行员应怎么做？
cards.referenceText: I would identify the snow or ice contamination, communicate clearly, follow the checklist, and choose the safest option according to the aircraft status and operating conditions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会识别冰雪污染情况，保持清晰沟通，执行检查单，并根据飞机状态和运行条件选择最安全的方案。

cards.imageAlt: 鸟击航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What visible bird-strike damage can you identify in this photograph?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能从这张照片中识别出哪些明显的鸟击损伤？
cards.referenceText: Flames and smoke are visible around one engine, and birds can be seen close to the aircraft. The engine may have ingested one or more birds and suffered serious damage. Internal damage cannot be confirmed from the photograph.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一台发动机周围可以看到火焰和烟雾，飞机附近还有鸟。发动机可能吸入了一只或多只鸟并受到严重损伤。照片无法确认内部损伤。

cards.audioText: As captain, how would you respond to a suspected bird strike in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 作为机长，怀疑飞行中发生鸟击时，你会如何处置？
cards.referenceText: I would check the relevant aircraft systems and performance, coordinate with the crew and ATC, and follow the checklist. If safety were not assured, I would divert as appropriate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会检查相关飞机系统和性能，与机组及空中交通管制协调，并执行检查单。如果无法确保安全，我会视情况改航。

cards.audioText: What environmental and operational factors increase the risk of a bird strike?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些环境和运行因素会增加鸟击风险？
cards.referenceText: Bird-strike risk is highest near airports and at low altitude during takeoff, climb, approach, and landing. It increases during migration periods and around wetlands, open water, grass, rubbish sites, or other places that attract birds. Dawn, dusk, poor visibility, and airport activities that disturb flocks can make detection and avoidance more difficult.
cards.referenceTextZh: 鸟击风险在机场附近以及起飞、爬升、进近和着陆的低高度阶段最高。迁徙季节，以及湿地、开阔水域、草地、垃圾场或其他吸引鸟类的地点附近，风险会增大。黎明、黄昏、低能见度，以及惊扰鸟群的机场活动，都可能使发现和避让更加困难。

cards.imageAlt: 山区夜间进近航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What weather conditions can further reduce visibility during a night approach to an airport in mountainous terrain?
cards.audioTextZh: 夜间进近山区机场时，哪些天气条件会进一步降低能见度？
cards.referenceText: Low cloud, fog, rain, snow, and haze can all reduce visibility during a night approach. Blowing dust or snow may obscure the runway, while heavy precipitation on the windshield can make the lights harder to see. In mountainous terrain, cloud can also hide ridges and remove the few outside visual references available at night.
cards.referenceTextZh: 低云、雾、雨、雪和霾都会降低夜间进近时的能见度。风吹起的尘土或积雪可能遮蔽跑道，风挡上的强降水会使灯光更难看清。在山区，云层还可能遮住山脊，并使夜间本就有限的外部目视参照进一步减少。

cards.audioText: How do runway lights help pilots during a night approach and landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 跑道灯光如何在夜间进近和着陆时帮助飞行员？
cards.referenceText: Runway lights improve situational awareness by giving pilots clearer information, supporting better monitoring, and providing more time to make safe decisions during a night approach and landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道灯光能向飞行员提供更清晰的信息，帮助他们更好地监控，并在夜间进近和着陆时留出更多时间作出安全决策，从而提高情景意识。

cards.audioText: What should a pre-descent briefing cover before a night approach to an airport in mountainous terrain?
cards.audioTextZh: 夜间进近山区机场前，下降前简令应涵盖哪些内容？
cards.referenceText: The briefing should cover low cloud, rain, fog, terrain shadow, and limited visual references. It should also address careful aircraft monitoring and the need for conservative action if safety margins are reduced.
cards.referenceTextZh: 简令应包括低云、降雨、雾、地形阴影和有限目视参照等内容。还应说明如何认真监控飞机，以及安全裕度降低时采取保守措施的必要性。

cards.imageAlt: 地面火灾应急航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What can you see in this picture of a ground-fire emergency?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能从这张地面火灾紧急情况的图片中看到什么？
cards.referenceText: A passenger aircraft is on the ground with a major fire and heavy black smoke around it. Another aircraft is parked nearby, close to the burning aircraft. The fire appears intense, but its source and the condition of the occupants cannot be determined from the picture.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一架客机停在地面，周围发生严重火灾并冒出大量黑烟。另一架飞机停在附近，距离起火飞机很近。火势看起来非常猛烈，但无法从图片判断火源和机上人员状况。

cards.audioText: What factors can increase the risk of an aircraft fire on the ground?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些因素会增加航空器在地面起火的风险？
cards.referenceText: Fuel, hot brakes, leaking fluids, and nearby ground equipment can increase the risk of an aircraft fire on the ground.
cards.referenceTextZh: 燃油、高温刹车、泄漏的液体和附近的地面设备都会增加飞机在地面起火的风险。

cards.audioText: If your aircraft were parked near the burning aircraft shown, how would you protect your aircraft and its occupants?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你的航空器停在图中起火航空器附近，你会如何保护自己的航空器及其乘员？
cards.referenceText: I would alert ground control and the cabin crew immediately and stop boarding or servicing activities. If there were enough time and it was safe and authorized, I would have the aircraft moved away from the fire. Otherwise, I would shut it down and evacuate through exits away from the flames and smoke, directing everyone to assemble upwind at a safe distance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会立即通知地面管制和客舱机组，并停止登机或保障作业。如果时间充足且安全并获得许可，我会让飞机移离火场。否则，我会关闭飞机，并通过远离火焰和烟雾的出口撤离，指挥所有人到上风向的安全距离集合。

title: 故事复诵
description: 发音 结构 词汇 流利度 理解能力

cards.audioText: AFR123 crashed at Singapore Changi Airport during takeoff. The tower controller instructed the crew to takeoff on Runway 02L, but the crew lined up runway 02R and began their takeoff rolling. The aircraft overran the runway and crashed. Crew members and 110 passengers were killed, and the co-pilot was badly wounded. According to the investigation, there were three reasons for the accidents. First of all, the crew didn't use effective methods to verify their position. Secondly, the crew forgot to check whether they were on the correct runway or not. Finally, the crew members' idle chatting during the taxi resulted the loss of situation awareness.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR123在新加坡樟宜机场起飞期间坠毁。塔台管制员指示机组从02L跑道起飞，但机组却在02R跑道对正并开始起飞滑跑。飞机冲出跑道并坠毁。机组成员和110名乘客遇难，副驾驶严重受伤。调查显示，这起事故有三个原因。首先，机组没有采用有效方法确认自己所在的位置。其次，机组忘记检查自己是否位于正确的跑道。最后，机组成员在滑行期间闲聊，导致情景意识丧失。

cards.audioText: An A320 collided with a B737 during taxi. The right ailerons of B737 was severely damaged but A320 only had minor damage on left wing. Luckily, there were no injuries. After receiving taxi instruction, the A320 began to pass the B737 from the right side. The captain of A320 thought they had enough room. But unfortunately, two aircraft collided together. Both captains reported the collision immediately. Because the Boeing aircraft was damaged seriously, fuel leakage was reported and fire services were required. Fortunately, the fuel leak didn't develop into fire. The crew of the Boeing aircraft complained that they just parked stationary with the parking brakes when they were hit.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架A320在滑行期间与一架B737相撞。B737的右副翼严重受损，而A320的左翼仅轻微受损。幸运的是，没有人员受伤。收到滑行指令后，A320开始从B737右侧通过。A320机长认为有足够空间可以通过，但两架飞机不幸发生碰撞。两位机长立即报告了相撞情况。由于波音飞机受损严重，机组报告发生燃油泄漏并请求消防救援。幸运的是，泄漏的燃油没有起火。波音飞机机组表示，他们被撞时一直设置着停留刹车，停在原地。

cards.audioText: A pilot of Air China airline told us an event with landing gear problem. After normal push-back, start-up and taxi, he requested takeoff. However, he was instructed to hold short of the runway in order to give way to ACA702 on final. ACA702 declared emergency because of landing gear problem. ACA702 asked for a low pass. The controller verified the landing gear was still in up position. Then ACA702 requested a touch and go to jar the jammed gear. Unfortunately, the landing gear still couldn't be extended. So, ACA702 had to make a belly landing on a foamed runway. There were no casualties except some minor injuries.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航的一名飞行员告诉了我们一起关于起落架问题的事件。在正常的推出、开车和滑行后，他请求起飞。然而，他被指示在跑道外等待，以便给五边的ACA702让路。不过，ACA702因为起落架问题宣布进入紧急状态，并且请求低空通场，管制员证实起落架仍在收上位。然后ACA702请求飞一个连续起飞去把起落架震动下来。但是，起落架仍然没放下来。因此，ACA702必须要做一个机腹着陆，并且跑道要铺泡沫。除了一些人员受到轻伤外，没有人员伤亡。

cards.audioText: When the pilot initially contacted the tower controller, he was told the Runway Visual Range was 500 m. The pilot executed a missed approach because of no contact at minima. Then, he was given radar vectors for a second ILS approach. In the second approach, the controller issued landing clearance at outer marker. One minute later, the controller observed the airplane was leaving the glide path on the radar display and issued missed approach instructions again. There was no further reply from the pilot. The airplane impacted a building and crashed. According to the investigation, the poor visibility made the pilot nervous and he misunderstood the missed approach instructions and made a wrong turn. (113 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 当飞行员最初联系塔台管制员时，他被告知跑道视程为500米。由于最低高度跑道不可见，飞行员执行了复飞。之后，管制员雷达引导进行第二次盲降进近。在第二次进近中，管制员在外指点标处发布了着陆许可。一分钟后，管制员在雷达屏幕上观察到飞机正在偏离下滑道，所以他再次发出复飞指令。后来再没有收到飞行员的回复。飞机撞上建筑物，坠毁了。据调查，低能见度让飞行员变得非常紧张，他误解了复飞指令，转弯出现失误。

cards.audioText: A Delta Airline aircraft departed from Shanghai to Seoul. It carried 256 passengers and 13 crew members on board. During takeoff rolling, an unknown foreign object was sucked into port engine and the engine fire warning light illuminated. Then the flight crew declared an emergency right after airborne and completed the emergency checklist procedure. Through good communication, the controller understood the flight crew wanted to return to land. But the pilot had to dump fuel before landing because the aircraft was overweight to land. So the controller vectored the aircraft to the dumping area. After circling over the sea and dumping fuel for almost one hour, the plane returned to land safely (112 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 达美航空一架飞机从上海飞往首尔。机上载有256名乘客和13名机组人员。在起飞滑跑过程中，左发吸进不明异物，发动机火警警示灯亮起。随后，机组人员在升空后立即宣布紧急情况，并完成了紧急检查单程序。通过沟通，管制员了解到机组人员想要返回着陆。但由于飞机超重，飞行员不得不在降落前放油。所以管制员引导飞机到了放油区。在海上盘旋并放了近一个小时的油后，飞机安全降落。

cards.audioText: The crew of flight 523 found a traffic 20 miles at FL294 right ahead of the airplane on TCAS at FL290 near LAMEN.The captain reported to Shanghai Control immediately, but the controller responded that there was no indication on his radar screen and there had not been any flight advisory. The captain then instructed the crew to turn left and found the conflicting traffic closing to the flight path and a TCAS warning was initiated. The crew then immediately turns right for avoidance, disengage the autopilot and descended to a lower altitude. The crew reported to the controller about the conflict after the conflict had been cleared.
cards.audioTextZh: 523号航班在LAMEN附近以FL290飞行时，机组通过TCAS发现飞机正前方20海里处有一架位于FL294的航空器。机长立即向上海管制报告，但管制员回应称，雷达屏幕上没有相关显示，此前也没有收到任何飞行情报。随后，机长指示机组左转，并发现冲突航空器正不断接近本机航迹，TCAS警告随即触发。机组立即右转避让，断开自动驾驶并下降到较低高度。冲突解除后，机组向管制员报告了此次冲突。

cards.audioText: An United aircraft experienced an in-flight engine fire during departure climb from New York City. During the return to the departure airport, the nose landing gear failed to extend, and the flight crew was instructed to execute a go-around, during which the crew extended the nose gear using the emergency procedure. The flight crew conducted an emergency landing, and the 2 flight crew members, 3 flight attendants, and 138 passengers deplaned on the runway. No occupant injuries were reported, but the airplane sustained substantial damage from the fire. The NTSB determines that the probable cause of this accident was the inappropriate manual engine-start procedure used by maintenance personnel. (108 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航一架飞机，在从纽约起飞爬升时，飞机发动机起火。在返回起飞机场期间，前起落架未能放出，空管指示机组人员执行复飞，在此期间，机组人员使用紧急程序放下了前起落架。之后，机组人员执行了紧急降落，2名机组人员、3名空乘人员和138名乘客在跑道上下机。没有乘客受伤，但飞机在火灾中遭受了重大损失。美国国家运输安全委员会认为，这起事故的可能原因是维修人员使用了不适当的手动启动引擎的程序。

cards.audioText: A China Southern aircraft lost a left upper wing trailing edge panel during cruise at FL270. Initially, ATC received a pilot report that the flight crew had experienced "light chop". The flight was en route from Greenyard to Blueyard Airport. The broken panel struck the window of passenger row 19ABC and cracked only the outer portion of the window. Pressurization was not lost. The flight crew continued on to Blueyard. Upon approach to Blueyard, ATC instructed the flight crew to expedite for separation. the flight crew informed ATC that they could not increase their airspeed due to possible airframe damage. The flight landed safely. There were 174 passengers and 6 crew members with no reported injuries. (116 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 中国南方航空一架飞机在FL270巡航时，左翼上表面的一块后缘面板脱落。最初，空中交通管制收到飞行员报告称，机组当时遭遇了“轻度颠簸”。该航班正从Greenyard机场飞往Blueyard机场。脱落的面板击中了19ABC排乘客的舷窗，仅使舷窗外层开裂，飞机没有失压。机组继续飞往Blueyard机场。飞机进近Blueyard机场时，空中交通管制为建立间隔指示机组加快速度；机组告知管制员，由于机体可能受损，他们无法提高空速。航班最终安全着陆。机上共有174名乘客和6名机组人员，没有人员受伤报告。

cards.audioText: An Airbus 320 collided with an ERJ 145 during taxi in the run-up area of runway 19. The right aileron of the ERJ was seriously damaged; the left winglet of the Airbus had minor damage. There were no injuries. The captain of the Airbus reported that he was positioned to the right of the ERJ.ATC cleared him for departure, which required him to taxi past the ERJ.He stated that he checked the proximity of the ERJ, and it looked like he could clear it and then felt the impact. The captain notified ATC of the collision. Airport fire crews responded, but there was no fuel leak or fire. (110 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 一架空客320在19号跑道的试车区滑行时与一架ERJ145相撞。ERJ右副翼严重受损；这架空客飞机的左小翼有轻微损坏。没有人员伤亡。空客机长报告说，他的位置在ERJ的右侧。管制允许他们起飞，要求他们滑行通过ERJ。他说他检查了ERJ的附近区域，看起来空间足够让飞机通过，可是没想到还是撞上了。机长向管制通报了相撞事件。机场消防人员做出了反应，但没有发生燃油泄漏或火灾。

cards.audioText: 10. Before the first ILS approach, the pilot was advised that the runway visual range was 600 feet, then he was given a landing clearance. The pilot declared a missed approach and was given radar vectors for a second ILS approach. After turning inbound on the localizer, the pilot was advised the runway visual range and then cleared to land. When the tower controller observed the airplane turning to the south of the runway, she issued missed approach instructions. There was no further reply from the pilot. The airplane impacted a tall tree and collided on the ground. According to the investigation, the pilot misinterpreted the missed approach instructions by making the right turn and then led to the accident. (119 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 在第一次盲降进近前，飞行员被告知跑道视距为600英尺，然后他得到了着陆许可。飞行员宣布复飞，并得到雷达引导进行第二次盲降进近。在转向对准航向道后，飞行员被告知跑道视距，然后获准着陆。塔台管制员观察到飞机转向跑道南面时，发布了复飞指令。飞行员没有进一步的答复。飞机撞上了一棵大树，撞向地上。据调查，飞行员错误理解了复飞指令，右转导致了事故。

cards.audioText: 11. A Boeing 757 and a Bombardier were seriously damaged when the tails of both airplanes collided during the pushback. The flight crew of the Bombardier reported that they were in a stopped position and their ground crew was in the process of disconnecting the tug. Company maintenance personnel stated they were pushing the 757 back and did not see the Bombardier. Communication recordings between ground control and both airplanes revealed that the 757 was cleared for pushback from gate 80. Later, the Bombardier was cleared to push back from gate 79. The ground controller did not advise either aircraft of simultaneous adjacent pushback operations and did not forecast a traffic conflict. (111 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 一架波音757和一架庞巴迪飞机在推出过程中尾部相撞，两架飞机均严重受损。庞巴迪机组报告称，碰撞发生时，他们的飞机已经停住，地面人员正在断开牵引车。航空公司维修人员表示，他们正将757向后推出，没有看到庞巴迪飞机。地面管制与两架飞机之间的通信录音显示，757获准从80号机位推出；随后，庞巴迪飞机获准从79号机位推出。地面管制员没有向任何一架飞机通报相邻机位同时推出的情况，也没有预见到交通冲突。

cards.audioText: 12. Air France 551 departed runway 15R and over flew United 83 at Atlantic Airport. The tower controller had cleared United 83 to land on runway 10 when the aircraft was about 6 miles on final approach. Simultaneously, ATC cleared Air France 551 for takeoff on runway 15R.Air France 551 was on taxiway when the takeoff clearance was issued. The pilots rotated at taxiway and over flew United 83 at the intersection of runways 10 and 15R.United 83 exited runway 10 afterwards. The main cause of this incident is local controller's failure of maintaining awareness of the situation and failing to provide the appropriate separation between the two aircraft on intersecting runways. (113 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 法国航空551号航班从15R跑道起飞，并在大西洋机场上空飞越美联航83号航班。当美联航83号航班在10号跑道最后进近约6海里处时，塔台管制员已许可其在10号跑道着陆。与此同时，空中交通管制许可法国航空551号航班从15R跑道起飞。起飞许可发布时，法国航空551号航班位于滑行道上。该航班在滑行道附近抬前轮，并在10号与15R跑道交叉口上方飞越美联航83号航班。随后，美联航83号航班脱离10号跑道。事件的主要原因是本场管制员未能保持情景意识，也未能为在相交跑道上运行的两架飞机提供适当间隔。

cards.audioText: The Piper and Cessna pilots were inbound to the same airport. The Cessna pilot was directed to enter a left downwind, then flew south before turning southwest. The Piper pilot was also directed to enter a left downwind. The controller noticed two VFR targets close to one another. Assuming the target on a southwest heading was a VFR helicopter when it was actually the Cessna. The controller issued conflict traffic to the southbound aircraft, assuming it was the Cessna pilot when it was actually the Piper pilot, and the Cessna pilot acknowledged the traffic call. Later, the Piper pilot informed the controller of the collision and declared an emergency. (109 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 一架派珀和一架塞斯纳都在飞往同一机场。塞斯纳飞行员被指示加入左三边，随后先向南飞行，再转向西南。派珀飞行员也被指示加入左三边。管制员注意到两个目视飞行规则目标彼此接近。他误以为向西南飞行的目标是一架目视飞行规则直升机，而实际上那是塞斯纳；他又向南行航空器通报了冲突交通，以为该航空器是塞斯纳，实际上却是派珀，而塞斯纳飞行员确认收到了这份交通通报。随后，派珀飞行员通知管制员两机已经相撞，并宣布紧急状态。

cards.audioText: 14. When SIA128 was approaching the airspace of Chicago center area control, the controller instructed the flight crew to change radio frequency for the next sector on 132.1. The first officer acknowledged the frequency change and read back the correct frequency. However, the flight crew did not contact ATC on the new frequency. Because the controllers in the receiving units were preparing for a shift change, they didn't know that flight 128 did not establish radio contact, 30 minutes later, the controller at the next sector identified SIA128 on the radar. Although they attempted to establish contact with the airplane by calling the company dispatcher, they got no response from the pilots. The controller finally regained contact with SIA128 on the emergency frequency 50 minutes later.
cards.audioTextZh: 当新航128接近芝加哥中心区管制空域时，管制员指示机组人员将无线电频率调到下一个扇区132.1。副驾驶确认了频率的变化，并把正确的频率复诵了出来。然而，机组人员并没有在新的频率上联系到管制员。由于接收的人员正在准备换班，他们不知道128航班没有建立联系，30分钟后，下一个扇区的管制员在雷达上识别出了新航128。虽然他们试图通过呼叫公司调度员与飞机建立联系，但没有得到飞行员的回应。50分钟后，管制员终于通过紧急频率与新航128重新取得了联系。

cards.audioText: Landing light signal could provide useful information to controllers. One day, a B757 vacated runway 36L via taxiway A9 after landing. It was then cleared to cross runway 36R.But it stopped taxiing on taxiway A9 between runway 36L and runway 36R.The tower controller attempted to contact the pilot but received no reply. He saw the aircraft landing lights were also off. This made him believe that the B757 had a radio failure and had not received the clearance to cross runway 36R.So he issued takeoff clearance to A320 on runway 36R.Suddenly, the controller noticed the B757's lights came on and it began to move. Realizing the risk of runway incursion, he canceled A320's takeoff clearance immediately.
cards.audioTextZh: 着陆灯可以作为信号向管制员发送有用信息。一天，一架B757在降落后经由滑行道A9脱离36左跑道。随后飞机获准穿越36右跑道。但它在36左和36右跑道之间的A9滑行道上停止滑行。塔台管制员试图联系飞行员但没有得到回复。他看到飞机着陆灯也关闭了。他猜想B757遇无线电故障，没有收到穿越36右跑道的许可，所以他给A320发布了起飞许可，使用跑道36右。突然，管制员注意到B757的着陆灯亮了并开始移动。管制员意识到跑道有被入侵的危险，于是立即取消了A320的起飞许可。

cards.audioText: It was a foggy day, Flight 626 was cleared to taxi to runway 36R.Later, the ground controller gave start-up clearance to a Cessna pilot. Then he requested Flight 626 to contact Tower controller. From then on, those two aircraft were on two different frequencies. The Cessna started to taxi, but the pilot entered wrong taxiway. The ground controller did not realize it and cleared the Cessna to continue taxi. At the same the active runway 36R.Unfortunately, the two aircraft collided, all people on board died. (114 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 那天有雾，626航班获准滑到36R跑道。后来，地面管制员给了塞斯纳飞行员开车许可。然后他要求626航班联系塔台管制员。从那时起，这两架飞机在两个不同的频率上飞行。塞斯纳飞机开始滑行，但飞行员进入了错误的滑行道。地面管制员没有意识到这一点，允许塞斯纳继续滑行。与此同时，塔台管制员批准626航班起飞。当626航班在跑道上滑跑时，塞斯纳越过跑道等待标志，进入活动跑道36R。不幸的是，两架飞机相撞，机上人员全部遇难。

cards.audioText: 17. The tower controller cleared Flight 145 to land on runway 22. But he forgot the arriving aircraft when he cleared Flight 101 to take off from the intersecting runway 16. After Flight 145 touched down, the ground radar system alerted. The controller tried to instruct Flight 145 to stop short of runway 16. However, the aircraft just managed to stop in the middle of the intersection. It was impossible for Flight 101 to abort takeoff. So Flight 101 made an early liftoff and flew over Flight 145. The two aircraft missed colliding by only 50 feet. There were no injuries or damage to either aircraft. But it was regarded as the most serious incident of this kind.
cards.audioTextZh: 塔台管制员允许145航班降落在22号跑道上。但是当他允许101航班从16号交叉跑道起飞时，他忘记了即将进场的飞机。145航班着陆后，地面雷达系统发出警报。管制员试图指示145航班在16号跑道外停止。然而，飞机只是在跑道交叉口的中间停了下来。101航班无法中止起飞。所以101航班提前离地飞，从145航班上方飞过。两架飞机只差50英尺就撞上了。两架飞机都没有人员伤亡或损坏。但这被认为是这类事件中最严重的一次。

cards.audioText: When an Flight 815 was approaching the terminal area of its destination, the flight crew contacted the Approach and requested ILS approach for runway 12. Because of the tailwind conditions, the controller advised the pilot to make a circling approach for runway 30. But the flight crew insisted to land on runway 12 and the controller cleared them to land on that runway. The runway was wet and the braking action was not good. During landing, the aircraft skidded to the right side of the runway. The fuselage was broken into three pieces, the right engine and right main gear were separated from the aircraft. No one was killed, but many passengers suffered from serious injuries.
cards.audioTextZh: 当815航班接近目的地终端区时，机组人员联系进近，要求盲降进近12号跑道。由于顺风，管制员建议飞行员在30号跑道作盘旋进近。但是机组人员坚持降落在12号跑道上，管制员允许他们降落在那条跑道上。跑道很湿，刹车效果也不好。在着陆时，飞机滑到跑道的右侧。机身断成三块，右发动机和右主起落架与飞机分离。没有人死亡，但许多乘客受了重伤。

cards.audioText: Flight 456 with 152 passengers and 9 crews was flying to land at Tokyo Airport. When it was transferred from Tokyo Control to Tokyo Approach, the pilot was instructed to proceed to DA to hold because of traffic congestion. During the holding, the pilot was informed that the local weather was deteriorating and the controller suggested the crew to divert to the alternate, but the pilot reported that their fuel was not enough. So the controller vectored the crew to land at runway 34R. Unfortunately, the pilot couldn't stabilize on the localizers due wind shear. The aircraft went around and made a second approach. Later, it crashed into a hillside due to fuel shortage.
cards.audioTextZh: 456号航班载有152名乘客和9名机组人员，正在飞往东京机场着陆。当该航班从东京区调移交给东京进近时，由于空中交通拥堵，飞行员被指示飞往DA点等待。在等待期间，飞行员获悉当地天气正在恶化，管制员建议机组备降，但飞行员报告剩余燃油不足。因此，管制员对机组实施雷达引导，使其在34R跑道着陆。遗憾的是，由于风切变，飞行员无法使飞机在航向道上稳定下来。飞机复飞后进行了第二次进近。随后，飞机因燃油不足撞上山坡。

cards.audioText: A Boeing 747 performed the flight from Taiwan to Hongkong carrying 206 passengers and 19 crew members on board. It broke up and crashed, killing all those on board. It is the deadliest air disaster in Taiwan. After careful investigation, scientists found the full story of the crash. About 20 years ago, the plane landed heavily and damaged the skin on its tail. Instead of replacing the whole skin in accordance with the maintenance guidelines, the airlines only covered the area with a piece of aluminum plate and painted it. This cause a buildup of metal fatigue in the area. For the following 22 years, maintenance crews had not noticed anything unusual.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架波音747从台湾飞往香港，机上载有206名乘客和19名机组人员。飞机解体坠毁，机上人员全部遇难。这是台湾最严重的空难。经过仔细调查，科学家们发现了坠机的全部经过。大约20年前，这架飞机遭遇重着陆，机身蒙皮受损。航空公司没有按照维护指南更换整个蒙皮，而是只用一块铝板覆盖了该区域并进行了喷漆。这导致该区域的金属疲劳。在接下来的22年里，维修人员没有注意到任何异常。

cards.audioText: Jiuzhai Huanglong Airport, also known as Jiuzhaigou Airport, is an airport in Songpan County, Sichuan province. It is one of the highest airport in the world with an altitude of 3448 meters. There are breathtaking mountain ranges on both sides of the axis of the runway, and the highest Xuebao peak is the main peak of Minshan Mountain, more than 18000 feet above the sea level. The terrain is complex and wind changes rapidly near the airport. So it is considered one of the most difficult airports to fly to in China. But those who fly over here are also amazed by the beautiful scenery. Due to the high elevation, some passengers may experience symptoms of altitude sickness.
cards.audioTextZh: 九寨黄龙机场，又被称为九寨沟机场，是四川省松潘县的一个机场。它是世界上海拔最高的机场之一，海拔3448米。跑道轴线两侧有令人惊叹的山脉，最高的雪豹峰是岷山的主峰，海拔超过18000英尺。机场附近地形复杂，风的变化迅速，所以它被认为是中国最难飞到的机场之一，但那些飞到这里的人也会被美丽的风景惊艳到。由于海拔高，一些乘客可能会出现高原反应的症状。

cards.audioText: A Pakistan flight reported the failure of the left hand engine. The crew shut the engine down and continued descending, some time later, they declared Mayday and shortly afterwards radio and radar contact was lost. The aircraft was unable to maintain heading and turned left before impact with the ground. And all occupants of the aircraft perished in the crash. The investigation into the crash showed that the accident was caused by technical factors and was not caused by human error. The flight crew faced an very complex technical error, that had never occurred before. Due to maintenance irregularities, a turbine blade fractured causing further damage, that made it impossible to control the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架巴基斯坦航班报告左发动机失效。机组关闭该发动机并继续下降；一段时间后，他们宣布MAYDAY，不久后无线电和雷达联系中断。飞机无法保持航向，在撞击地面前向左转弯，机上所有人员均在坠机事故中遇难。事故调查显示，事故由技术因素造成，并非人为错误。飞行机组面对的是一种此前从未发生过的、非常复杂的技术故障。由于维修不规范，一片涡轮叶片断裂并造成进一步损坏，使飞机最终无法操纵。

cards.audioText: A Boeing 747 was on final approach to runway 26. After the aircraft went around from very low height, it did not climb out to safety altitude and impacted terrain about 1100 meters past the runway. The cause of the accident was the missing control of the crew over the aircraft position in relation to the glide slope during the automatic approach. The flight was conducted at night in the weather conditions, which is suitable for ICAO CAT II landing. And as a result, the go-around was not taken in due time and the aircraft had a significant deviation from the established approach chart, which led to the controlled flight into terrain.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架波音747正在对26号跑道实施最后进近。飞机从极低高度复飞后，未能爬升至安全高度，并在越过跑道约1100米处撞地。事故原因是，在自动进近过程中，机组未能监控飞机相对于下滑道的位置。航班在夜间飞行，当时的天气条件适用于ICAO II类（CAT II）着陆。结果，机组没有及时复飞，且飞机严重偏离规定的进近航图，最终导致可控飞行撞地。

cards.audioText: A Cargo Boeing 747 with 7 crew and cargo of military vehicles, has crashed shortly after takeoff. Afghan Authorities immediately denied claims that the crash was the result of enemy activities. Several observers on the ground reported the aircraft had just lifted off and was climbing through approximately 1200 feet when it's nose sharply rose. The aircraft appeared to have stalled and came down. According to a listener on frequency, the crew reported the aircraft stalled due to a possible load shift. The NTSB determined that the probable cause of this accident was inadequate procedures for restraining special cargo loads. The cargo moved after and damaged hydraulic systems and horizontal stabilizer components.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架载有7名机组人员、装载军用车辆的波音747货机在起飞后不久坠毁。阿富汗当局立即否认坠机由敌对活动造成。多名地面目击者报告称，飞机刚刚离地，爬升通过大约1200英尺时，机头突然急剧上仰。飞机似乎发生失速，随后坠落。据一名监听该频率的人称，机组报告飞机可能因载荷移位而失速。美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）认定，这起事故的可能原因是特殊货物载荷的系留程序不充分。货物随后发生移动，损坏了液压系统和水平安定面部件。

cards.audioText: Flight 60 encountered moderate turbulence at 9000 feet during descending to Dallas. According to NTSB, as the flight began its descent, the captain illuminated the seat belt sign and made a public address reminding passengers to buckle up. Then the airplane entered a band of small cumulus clouds and experienced 10-15 seconds of moderate turbulence. The flight attendants were conducting their final cabin safety checks then, so 7 flight attendants received minor injuries, one passenger, who ignored the seat-belt sign and instructions, injured his left ankle. The aircraft continued for a landing on Dallas without further incident. The flight crew requested paramedics to meet the airplane at the gate. Finally, the passenger was transported to the hospital.
cards.audioTextZh: 60号航班在下降前往达拉斯期间，于9000英尺遭遇中度颠簸。据美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）称，飞机开始下降时，机长点亮安全带指示灯，并通过客舱广播提醒乘客系好安全带。随后，飞机进入一片小积云带，经历了10至15秒的中度颠簸。当时，乘务员正在进行最后的客舱安全检查，因此7名乘务员轻伤；另有一名无视安全带指示灯和相关指示的乘客左脚踝受伤。飞机继续飞往达拉斯并安全着陆，未再发生其他事件。飞行机组请求急救人员在登机口接机，最终该名乘客被送往医院。

cards.audioText: A flight with 98 passengers, encountered smoke in cockpit shortly after departure. The aircraft was cleared to FL340 and was about to contact Area Control when The crew declared an emergency, then the captain elected to hand over pilot flying duties to the first officer in order to give his attention to the overall management of the situation. Both pilots put on their oxygen masks, and begun the descent and preparations to evacuate the aircraft on the runway. Finally the aircraft landed safely.6 injured passengers received medical assistance after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架载有98名乘客的航班在起飞后不久，驾驶舱出现烟雾。这架飞机被允许飞往高度层340,正要与区域管制中心联系时，驾驶舱机组人员闻到了烟味。经过一番讨论，他们决定返回出发机场。机组人员宣布了紧急情况，然后机长选择将飞行员的飞行职责交给副驾驶，以便让他关注局势的整体管理。两名飞行员都戴上了氧气面罩，开始下降，准备在跑道上撤离。最后飞机安全着陆了。6名受伤乘客在着陆后接受了医疗救助。

cards.audioText: An Airbus with 146 passengers and 5 crew, encountered turbulence during climbing from FL320 to FL340, causing injuries to 24 passengers and 3 cabin creW. The aircraft diverted for a safe landing on runway 32 about 25 minutes after stopping the climb at FL334. The 27 injured were taken to a hospital. Passengers reported those not belted into their seats were lifted against the ceiling and then slammed down again. A number of cabin ceiling panels received cracks. A replacement A320 was dispatched and reached the final destination with a delay of 7.5 hours. According to NTSB, probable cause of the occurrence was an inadvertent encounter with convective turbulence while in cruise flight.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架空客飞机载有146名乘客和5名机组人员，在从FL320爬升至FL340期间遭遇颠簸，造成24名乘客和3名客舱机组人员受伤。飞机在FL334停止爬升约25分钟后备降，并在32号跑道安全着陆。27名伤者被送往医院。乘客报告称，没有系好安全带的人先被抛向客舱顶部，随后又重重摔下，多块客舱顶板出现裂纹。航空公司调派了一架替代A320，该机最终比原计划晚7.5小时到达目的地。美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）认为，这起事件的可能原因是飞机巡航期间意外遭遇对流性颠簸。

cards.audioText: Flight 08 was cleared to climb to and maintain FL220. At the same time, another flight 29 was en route at FL240. ATC instructed flight 08 to turn left heading 270. The crew however, read back "Climb FL270", which was not picked up by ATC.The crew selected FL270 into their Selected Altitude. The aircraft began to climb. Later, the radar issued an alert between these two aircraft. Then ATC instructed flight 08 to descend back to FL220 immediately. The aircraft already climbed through FL236. The separation reduced to O feet vertically and 2.6 nm horizontally and the aircraft continued to climb reaching FL250, and re-establishing vertical separation. ATC thus instructed 08 to continue the climb to FL260.
cards.audioTextZh: 航班被许可爬升并保持高度层220。与此同时，另一架29号航班在高度层240巡航。空中交通管制中心指示08航班左转航向270。然而，机组人员复诵成“上高度层270”,空管也没有注意到。机组人员将FL270选择到他们的“选择高度”。飞机开始爬升。后来，雷达在这两架飞机之间发出了警报。然后ATC指示08航班立即下降到高度220,飞机已经爬升到高度236。垂直距离降至0英尺，水平距离降至2.6海里，飞机继续爬升至高度层250,并重新建立垂直间隔。空管因此指示08航班继续爬升到高度层260。

cards.audioText: A flight was on NDB approach to runway 28 in instrument meteorological conditions. The aircraft descended below minimum safe altitude when it was go-around and the aircraft climbed to safe altitude. Then the crew positioned for another approach and landed safely on runway 28 after aborting the first approach. According to the investigation, the incident occurred while the aircraft performed an NDB approach without DME, probably without external visual references. Meanwhile, the first preparation of the approach was probably incomplete or imprecise.
cards.audioTextZh: 在仪表气象条件下，一架飞机在NDB进近28号跑道。当飞机被移交给塔台时，它下降到最低安全高度以下。进场管制员收到了最低安全高度警告，飞机的EGPWS也发出了警告。机组人员启动复飞，飞机爬升到安全高度。然后机组人员准备再次进近，在第一次复飞后安全降落在28号跑道上。根据调查，事故发生时，飞机在没有DME的情况下进行了NDB进近，可能没有外部视觉参考。同时，该进近的最初准备工作可能不完整或不精确。

cards.audioText: An A320 with 114 passengers and 6 crew, departed from the runway. At that time, the left engine dropped two bonnets. In the absence of any abnormal indications and unaware of the separation, the crew continued the flight for a safe landing. Although a part of the engine cowling became stuck in the left main gear, the gear retracted normally after takeoff and extended without problems. The aircraft received minor damage at the left main gear and the left side of the fuselage, however all persons on board disembarked normally, no medical attention was needed. The investigation has determined that the incident was caused by flying the airplane without closing and properly latching the cowls on the airplane's left engine.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架载有114名乘客和6名机组人员的A320飞机从跑道起飞。当时，左发动机掉了两个发动机盖。机组没有注意到任何异常指示，也不知道发生了发动机罩脱落，继续飞行安全着陆。虽然发动机整流罩的一部分卡在左主起落架上，但起飞后起落架收放正常，释出无问题。飞机的左主起落架和机身左侧受到轻微损坏，但机上所有人员正常下机，没有人需要医疗救助。调查确定，该事件是由于起飞时没有关闭并正确闩上飞机左发的整流罩。

cards.audioText: QFA67 had safely landed on runway 03, vacated the runway via taxiway but taxied past the holding point of runway 06 and crossed an illuminated stop bar without ATC clearance. Another QFA82 was accelerating for takeoff from runway 06 when QFA67 crossed the hold short line. QFA67 became aware of their position and stopped their aircraft just before crossing the edge of runway 06. Then QFA82 rejected takeoff and came to a stop. The aircraft vacated the runway and returned to the apron. QFA82's wingtip passing about 15 meters from QFA67's nose at low speed. The ATSB report that bad taxiway design, flight crew distraction and incorrect mental model is responsible for this runway incursion.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA67安全降落在03号跑道，经滑行道脱离跑道后，在未获得空中交通管制许可的情况下滑过06号跑道等待点，并越过亮起的停止排灯。QFA67越过跑道等待线时，另一架QFA82正在06号跑道加速起飞。QFA67意识到自身位置后，在即将越过06号跑道边缘前停住。随后，QFA82中断起飞并停下，之后脱离跑道返回停机坪。低速状态下，QFA82的翼尖从距QFA67机头约15米处经过。澳大利亚运输安全局（ATSB）报告称，滑行道设计不佳、飞行机组注意力分散以及错误的心理模型共同导致了这起跑道侵入事件。
